listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Fiery Pink Pepper Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Revel in the warmth of Molton Brown's iconic woody-spicy Eau de Parfum, presented in a striking limited edition bottle. This high-drama scent is rich with an abundance of pink pepper, lily of the valley, patchouli and a signature note of flamboyant osmanthus.

listings.rawTitle: Clinique My Happy Lily Of The Beach Eau de Parfum, 15ml
listings.description: What it is: Carefree like bottled sunshine. Escape to an ocean beach on the perfect summer day. With sweet Solar Lily, Frangipani, and a hint of Coconut. A FlAmber Woody scent to wear alone or layer.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Ombré Leather Eau de Parfum Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Ombré Leather evokes the American West’s desert beauty with rich, black leather layered beneath patchouli, vetiver and jasmine sambac. Fragrance Notes: Black Leather, Violet Flower, Jasmine Flower Fragrance Family: Leather Set contains: Ombré Leather Eau de Parfum, 100ml Ombré Leather All Over Body Spray, 150ml

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Intoxicated Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Kilian Hennessy's Inspiration: A cup of smooth dark Turkish coffee. The Perfume: Inexplicably addictive, Intoxicated curbs craving like a cup of rich Turkish coffee, laced with green cardamom - both in oil and absolute - doubling the addictive stronghold of this stimulating substance. Warmth rises like stream with spicy cinnamon and hallucinogenic nutmeg. At its base, like at the bottom of a delicate porcelain mug, floats the crystallised sweetness of caramelised sugar. Perfume notes: Mocha Coffee, Cardamom, Vanilla. Perfumer: Calice Becker.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Defy Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Fresh. Masculine. Addictive. Calvin Klein Defy is a daring contrast of invigorating freshness and powerful woods: an eau de toilette for men who break boundaries while exploring their authentic truths and the contrasts within. This Calvin Klein perfume opens with an addictive citrus blend highlighting crisp Bergamot and fresh Lavender Absolute. Rugged and earthy Vetiver Oil - responsibly sourced from Haiti - is the heart of this men's eau de toilette spray, connecting the vibrant textural elements with a rich and alluring base of Amber notes. Packaged in a modern bottle that reflects the iconic codes of Calvin Klein - denim blues and minimalism infused with a sensual edge. This CK scent has a textured matte cap atop the curved yet sharp silhouette, representing the duality of vulnerability and courage on the path to defiance. Dare to Defy. Fragrance family: Woody Fresh. Top notes: Bergamot Oil Heart notes: Lavender Absolute Base notes: Vetiver Oil

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Carrot Blossom Cologne, 30ml
listings.description: Life is sweet, just like carrot blossom gloriously gathered from the veggie patch. Notes of subtly sweet carrot, orange flower and white musk create a fresh floral scent. How to use: Spritz generously onto your wrists, neck and pulse points. Your body heat will help to diffuse the fragrance as the day goes on. Wear alone or layer with another cologne or your favourite bath and body products. Your Jo Malone London order will be exquisitely wrapped in their iconic box, tied with a beautiful grosgrain ribbon. Looking to find your new favourite scent in person? Visit our Jo Malone London boutiques inside selected John Lewis & Partners shops: Cheadle Chelmsford Cribbs Causeway Edinburgh Exeter High Wycombe Horsham Milton Keynes Oxford Street Reading Southampton Stratford White City

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Luckycharms Fearless & Fabulous Dot Drama Edition Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Playful, radiant, and unapologetically bold, Fearless & Fabulous Dot Drama embodies the joy of self-expression. Like a statement dress in scent form, this limited edition fragrance celebrates contrast, colour, and confidence, the essence of the Carolina Herrera woman who lives life with fearless flair and effortless elegance. Olfactive Family: Floral Fruity Woody. The bottle: Dressed in Carolina Herrera’s signature polka dots, the Fearless & Fabulous Dot Drama bottle contrasts black-and-white spots with a bold yellow cap dotted in black, an homage to the Spring 25 runway. The charm: The empowering Eye of the Tiger charm. A chic collectable with a fearless attitude.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Gaultier Divine Elixir Parfum Refillable 30ml
listings.description: Gaultier Divine Elixir fascinates with the exuberance of its floral marine amber fragrance encased in its amber and gold bottle. Magnetic tonka bean and creamy tuberose express themselves without restraint. Irresistibly feminine above all. From the case to that glittering corset, its glass reflections dazzle with extravagance. Her omnipotence boldly flaunts her unbridled femininity around which everything gravitates. She commands, and the world follows suit!

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Amber Musk Eau de Parfum 50ml

Amber musk blends sensual florals, distinctive amber and creamy musk. Ambrox makes a velvety first impression, contrasted by a succulent burst of coconut water and the femininity of rose centifolia absolute. Like the glow of amber flames, lingering benzoin and musk infuses the fragrance with warmth. Scent: Woody Amber. Notes: Ambrox, Coconut Water, Rose Centifolia, Muguet, Benzoin, Sandalwood, Musk. AERIN is a global luxury lifestyle brand inspired by the signature effortless style, aesthetic point of view, and heritage of its founder, Aerin Lauder. Each fragrance is designed to provide a sense of escape to make life more beautiful and feminine.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Layton Exclusif Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Generous, spirited and explosive, this Parfum asserts its strength and impetuousness. The striking new take on Layton is a deep, rich and woody fragrance for the connoisseur looking to make an impression. Top notes of bergamot, grapefruit and apple softly envelope the heart of cinnamon, lavender, agarwood and geranium. The base is concluded by guaiac wood, sensual vanilla and sweet cypriol. A revival on the traditional yet refined in its scent. Olfactive notes: Top notes: Bergamot, Grapefruit, Apple Heart notes: Geranium, Cinnamon, Lavender, Agarwood Base notes: Cypriol, Guaiac Wood, Patchouli, Vanilla Presented in a deep blue armour, Layton Exclusif by Parfums de Marly is an apotheosis of scents and an uninhibitedly seductive statement that pulls no punches. An ardent, densely spicy woodiness, perfectly at ease with itself and its wearer. Layton Exclusif is an original and rare composition.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau Poivrée Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: In 2019, Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel created Twilly Eau Poivrée, a new facet developed on the same canvas. The olfactory interpretation of the fiery spirit of the Hermès girls. The spicy Eau de Parfum expresses its mischievous character through impertinent pink peppercorn, a tender rose and deep patchouli. Designed by Florence Manlik, the lantern-shaped bottle has a square silhouette and reddish-pink colour. A unique, hand-tied silk ribbon playfully embellishes it. Its 30ml format allows you to diffuse the fiery spirit of the Hermès girls with Twilly Eau Poivrée wherever and whenever you want. Twilly d’Hermès is a name that evokes the know-how of Hermès silk on two fronts: it calls to mind the house’s silk twill scarf as well as the twilly, a small, colourful silk ribbon that can be worn in countless ways.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Lost Eden Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Confront your deepest temptations with Maison Margiela Replica Lost Eden Eau de Parfum, a gourmand fragrance that captures the irresistible allure of biting the forbidden fruit. This smoky and sweet eau de parfum from one of the most iconic French perfume brands embodies the push and pull of desire, drawing you into a fantastical garden where temptation and beauty intertwine. Experience the world of Replica Fantasies, where surreal ingredients born from the imagination of Master Perfumers create an entirely new olfactory sensation. Replica Lost Eden eau de parfum by Maison Margiela is shaped around the Forbidden Fruit Accord, a surreal creation by Master Perfumer Honorine Blanc. Built around a trio of intense ingredients, this unique accord encapsulates the allure of a sweet forbidden fruit hidden in the heart of an imaginary garden A luscious Red Apple Accord opens the senses with juicy, vibrant sweetness, while rich Vanilla brings a creamy, enveloping warmth The base deepens into a smoky Oud Accord, adding a dark, mysterious dimension that lingers on the skin like an unforgettable temptation Fruity and deep, Lost Eden emboldens you to make your desires come to life Discover this captivating creation from one of the finest designer perfume brands

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y For Men Eau de Toilette 60ml
listings.description: Y Eau de Toilette, now newly renovated with new formulation and an updated design. A mineral woody fragrance for men, with vibrant lavender, crisp geranium and warm cedarwood. Scent: With both light and dark fougère facets, Y Eau de Toilette, with reformulated fragrance notes, is a mineral woody fragrance that blends freshness and elegance, echoing the multifaceted personality of the YSL man of today. The new formulation has been renovated to be more long-lasting, with up to 12 hours of intensity in a spray. Bright and crisp, Y Eau de Toilette contrasts vibrant lavender with aromatic clary sage, both from Provence, France, with a crisp and verdant bite of geranium bourbon heart from Madagascar – three ingredients crafted for YSL Beauty. Like a black leather jacket slipped over a crisp white shirt, Y Eau de Toilette deepens in warmth as cedarwood essence and salty ambergris accord are revealed at the base. Starring YSL Beauty global fragrance ambassador Lenny Kravitz. Top notes: bergamot essence, aldehydes, ginger essence Heart notes: lavender heart, geranium heart, clary sage heart Base notes: cedarwood essence, olibanum essence, ambergris accord Inspiration: Y is a testament to the YSL modern man. A man who dares to follow his passions and carve his own path. From inspiration, through hard work and collaboration, to self-accomplishment and success. A man confident to take all of life’s challenges. For the authentic and bold, YSL Beauty creates Y: the fragrance for those who dare to ask themselves ‘why not’. Bottle: The Y bottle is an expression of modernity. An updated masculine and sharp design boldly cut out with the signature Y logo. Clear glass surrounds the now brighter crystal blue juice within, a fresh statement for a bright and mineral male fragrance. Collection: Y Eau de Toilette: Bright and Fresh Y Live Eau de Toilette Intense: Exhilarating and Confident Y Eau de Parfum: Elegant and Bold Y Le Parfum: Smooth and Intense

listings.rawTitle: Memo Paris Sintra Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: The sweetness of love, under the burning sun of the world’s largest sand desert, a touch of vanilla slips into the comforting embrace of a cereal. In the distant oasis of Siwa, anyone can consult the oracles, just as Alexander the Great and Cleopatra once did, to discover what their destiny holds and make it come true. Cries rise up to the heavens like incantations, and Siwa attracts the night. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Bergamot essence, Red Fruits accord, Petit Grain essence Heart notes: Orange Flower absolute, Cinnamon Bark essence, Rose absolute Base notes: Vanilla Bourbon extract, Caramel accord, Guimauve Musk

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Violette 30 Eau de Parfum 15ml
listings.description: Within the lexicon of floriography, the secret language of flowers meticulously preserved in Victorian-era texts, the violet evades easy explanation. Across history, violets have symbolised a delightfully paradoxical bouquet of meaning, standing for both burning passion and wide-eyed innocence, steadfast strength and poetic delicacy, measured wisdom and persistent optimism. Violette 30 is an ode to the undefinable contrasts in a single specimen. Centred around the rarer, shadow-seeking white violet, at once crystalline and untethered, it pairs verdant green floral notes with white tea notes, cedarwood, and a touch of guaiacwood. Familiar yet unknown, it is a study in saying yes to contradiction; a call to reclaim and embrace our many multitudes.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Amazone Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: A tender yet fiery fragrance, punctuated with aromas of citrus fruit, blackcurrant bud and daffodil. Symbolic of free and modern femininity, Amazone takes its inspiration from the mythical horsewomen who, according to legend, reigned over the shores of the Black Sea. A novel by Maurice Maurin written in 1974, with blackcurrant buds providing its central theme, the fragrance is a green, floral harmony in which daffodil, narcissus, galbanum, red fruit and vetiver provide the perfect foil for one another.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Coco Eau de Parfum Spray 35ml
listings.description: COCO expresses the intensity of Gabrielle Chanel's personality and her love of all things baroque. A luxuriant Amber symphony that gradually reveals its contrasting notes. A luxuriant composition with contrasting notes. The fragrance opens with a citrus note of Sicilian Mandarin, and reveals a voluptuous heart of Jasmine Absolute, heightened with touches of Ylang-Ylang from the Comoros and Tunisian Orange Blossom. A captivating harmony that leaves behind a vibrant trail of Indonesian Patchouli, Tonka note and Benzoin. The eau de parfum comes in a spray format for effortless application on skin or clothing. A complete perfuming ritual for the bath and body is also available to enhance its trail of scent.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Hermessence Agar Ébène Eau de Toilette Refill, 200ml
listings.description: Creation: The Hermessence Agar Ébène returns to where the story of perfumery began through a legendary raw material of agar wood. For Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel, it "carries a warm and mysterious vibration at its heart." Olfactory notes: Profound and mysterious, Agar Ébène marries the sensuality of agar wood with the balmy and enveloping notes of fir balsam. A Hermessence suitable for both men and women. Ethics: The Agar Ebène refill can be used to replenish the 100ml and 200ml bottles. A responsible gesture, integral to an object created to last. "To the scent of agar wood, which carries a warm and mysterious vibration at its heart, I wanted to bring another wood, fir balsam, with its balmy and enveloping notes." Christine Nagel.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d’Hermès Eau de Toilette Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Joyful effervescence. This limited edition gift set illustrated by Jonathan Burton is your invitation to a festive celebration with a difference in the Hermès workshop. A surreal commotion filled with fantasy and illusion for unforgettable gifts. Terre d’Hermès Eau do Toilette is a mineral, woody fragrance that combines the strength of cedar and the radiance of grapefruit with a vibrant touch of flint. Terre d’Hermès narrates the relationship between man and earth, his humble and harmonious dialogue with the elements and nature. Terre d’Hermès is the perfume that connects man to his origins, to the source of his creative power. Set contains: Terre d’Hermès Eau de Toilette, 50ml Terre d’Hermès Eau de Toilette travel size, 15ml

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum 50ml Holiday Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Celebrate this Holiday season with this limited-edition gift set by Givenchy featuring Irresistible Eau de Parfum, a hydrating body lotion and a travel spray. Discover the Givenchy Post Office and send the most precious present to your loved ones. Entirely adorned in gold and more couture than ever, from the Maison's iconic black belt to the GIVENCHY PARIS 1952 postal stamp, this limited-edition gift set is imagined as the most precious of packages. Irresistible Eau de Parfum: A floral woody fragrance for women, revealing the notes of luscious Rose and radiant Blond Wood, symbolising a carefree woman with a strong magnetic charm. Irresistible Eau de Parfum Travel Spray: Irresistible Eau de Parfum presented in an elegant, refillable travel spray. Set contains: Irresistible Eau de Parfum, 50ml Irresistible Hydrating Body Lotion, 75ml Irresistible Eau de Parfum Travel Spray, 12.5ml

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Allegra Insieme Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Bvlgari Allegra Insieme celebrates togetherness in an unexpected Eau de Parfum crafted by Master Perfumer Jacques Cavallier and Camille Cavallier. Insieme is a tribute to that special power which makes people draw out the very best from each other, the inspiration to embrace one’s authentic self. It is the subtle and refined scent of this intimate yet universal feeling. Bvlgari Allegra Insieme is an ode to the beauty of togetherness, its generosity and sincerity: embodied in the tender scent of peonies, enveloped in musk and woody notes. Amplified by the essence of Italian mandarin and a hint of patchouli. An irresistibly modern and daring olfactory signature. The Bvlgari Allegra personalising experience continues with Magnifying essences. Enhance your trail with one of the Bvlgari Allegra Magnifying essences, which blend perfectly with the Eaux de Parfum in the Bvlgari Allegra collection to create a unique scent.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Hermessence Cuir d'Ange Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: Cuir d'Ange offers the softness of leather, like a promise hovering over the skin. "For a long time I’d wanted to reveal the importance I attach to literature, and how it corresponds to perfume. More significantly, I wanted to evoke my discovery of the work of Jean Giono. Two words from a passage in Jean le Bleu came back to me: 'cuir d’ange' - angel leather. Using the smells that are my words, I wanted to write a poem to rekindle the love duet between leather and the skin. Its softness and lightness, its tension and caress. Heliotropes and hawthorn, leather and musk." - Jean-Claude Ellena. Fragrance notes: leather, hawthron.

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Eau des Sens Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: A composition that creates confusion. It caresses the skin and makes your mouth water like an indulgent treat, awakening you with its freshness. Eau des Sens owes its originality to the very idea behind its creation: bringing together all the dimensions of bitter orange tree, its branches, leaves and fruit.

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Her Majesty Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: A fragrance that reinvents the chypre accord with brilliance. Her Majesty marries Rose Damascena with velvety peach and a luscious rum accord, all underpinned by the refined power of woody notes. The perfume: Chypre, the emblematic accord born of citrus, florals and woods. With Her Majesty, KILIAN PARIS reimagines this exceptional signature, infusing it with a luminous and sensual modernity. At the heart, Rose Damascena absolute reigns, softened by tender peach and electrified by a breath of rum. Ambrette seeds unfurl their musky magnetism, warm and enchanting. In the dry down, papyrus and cedar etch a distinctly woody trail. A sovereign creation, in perfect harmony. Collection: The Narcotics. Perfumer: Caroline Dumur.

listings.description: Ambre Narguilé is a blends of honey of amber with a swirl of the East. "Amber, the Western expression of Eastern fragrances, has a warm, sensual, enveloping, almost carnal smell. I wanted to imbue this idea of amber with the memory of the East I love by recreating the ambiance of those lively places where tobacco – blended with the smells of fruit, honey and spices – is smoked in narguilés, or water pipes, and where swirls of smoke diffuse a sweet sense of intoxication." - Jean-Claude Ellena. Fragrance notes: perfumer's amber, roasted sesame seeds.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Kurky Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Kurky, the affectionate nickname of Francis Kurkdjian in his youth, evokes an insatiable desire for freedom. A perfume that encourages you to see life in colour, to dream and be amazed again. In a creamy and mouthwatering cloud of white musks, Kurky distils fruity notes, reminiscent of tutti frutti candies. A composition thought of as a great burst of laughter, a smile, and a ray of sunshine: an invitation to awaken the child within us. Amazed enough for dreams, carefree enough to make them come true: Kurky is the gourmand fragrance for grown-ups who dare to dream like kids. Olfactory family: gourmand musky fruity. Olfactory notes: tangy fruity accord with tutti-frutti notes, gourmand musky accord with white musk and vanilla.

listings.description: For the sparkling, luminous, charming and fun-loving. An unexpected and bubbly white floral. listings.description: Refill your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle in one simple step with the Bergamote Calabria refill format. In the spotlight, bergamot is spiced up by cardamom, pink peppercorn and ginger, warmed by petitgrain lemon, and enveloped in white musks. listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Extreme Parfum 100ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Montblanc Explorer Extreme is a bold tribute to the spirit of adventure, taking inspiration from the untamed, towering peaks and the desolate corners of the Earth. This fragrance captures the essence of a fearless explorer on a journey into the unknown. The fragrance opens with a vibrant burst of fresh bergamot, blending with green notes to create an invigorating and long-lasting freshness that mirrors the crisp mountain air. At its heart, rich patchouli unfolds, releasing a deep, woody aroma that resonates with strength and earthiness, evoking the raw beauty of untrodden paths. The base is anchored by a warm amber accord, merging with smooth leather notes for an added touch of sensuality and power. Together, these elements create a hypnotic, lasting presence that lingers in the air like the imprint of a bold adventure, capturing the essence of modern masculinity in a sophisticated and intense form. Set contains: Montblanc Explorer Extreme Eau de Parfum, 100ml Montblanc Explorer Extreme Shower Gel, 100ml Montblanc Explorer Extreme Parfum Travel Size, 2 x 7.5ml

Entirely adorned in gold and more couture than ever, from the Maison's iconic black belt to the GIVENCHY PARIS 1952 postal stamp, this limited edition gift set is imagined as the most precious of packages. L'Interdit Eau de Parfum: A floral woody fragrance for women that reveals a white flower crossed by a dark woody accord, unleashing a bold luminous trail and inviting you to embrace your singularity. listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS Tonic Eau de Toilette for Men, 100ml
listings.description: Take time to refocus and move ahead with BOSS Bottled Tonic fragrance for men. The new fresh fragrance from the iconic BOSS BOTTLED portfolio, BOSS Bottled Tonic reveals a new facet of modern masculinity, inviting the man of today to take a moment to refocus on his way to success. Driven, dedicated and passionate about success, BOSS Bottled Tonic encapsulates this need through its unique scent and empowers him to achieve his goals. An elegant blend of sophisticated notes of citrus, spices and woods that bring a lighter and refreshing dimension to the classic BOSS Bottled fragrance. The contrasting subtle sophistication and bitter nuances of citrus reflect the balance the man of today strives for in reaching his goals while staying true to his values. The sharp effervescence and vibrancy of ginger is piercing yet composed ginger - much like the man who wears it. The refined woody base evokes the richness of the earth, bringing to life the man of today’s authenticity and values, which ground him wherever his day may take him. Top Notes: Zesty Grapefruit, Bitter Orange, Lemon Heart Notes: Effervescent Ginger, Clove, Geranium, Cinnamon Base Notes: Vetiver

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Gentle Fluidity Gold Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Once again Francis Kurkdjian disrupts the rules of fragrance creation with a disconcerting composition exercise. With Gentle Fluidity, he unveils two Eau de Parfum from two utterly different olfactory worlds (one features a woody, aromatic scent, the other musky, Amber notes), by drawing from the same list of ingredients and going beyond the concept of perfumery for women, men or mixed. When he overdoses some ingredients, he under doses others because fragrances, like all the things that move us, are essentially about balance and expected effects... No more feminine or masculine. There is a personality, a sensitivity, a 'Gentle Fluidity' between all gender identities. Ingredients: juniper berry essence, nutmeg essence, coriander seed essence, musks, ambery woods and vanilla accord. Olfactory family: Musky Amber.

When he overdoses some ingredients, he under doses others because fragrances, like all the things that move us, are essentially about balance and expected effects... No more feminine or masculine. There is a personality, a sensitivity, a 'Gentle Fluidity' between all gender identities. Ingredients: juniper berry essence, nutmeg essence, coriander seed essence, musks, ambery woods and vanilla accord. Olfactory family: Musky Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Travalo Milano Refillable Perfume Atomiser
listings.description: Travalo's Milano perfume atomiser is a refined, aircraft-approved design made with textured leatherette and polished hardware. It refills in seconds directly from most standard perfume bottles using an innovative Genie-S pump-to-fill technology that transfers without spills or exposure to air. Despite its small profile, Milano will provide you with up to 65 sprays of fragrance mist. You can also easily alternate your fragrances using Travalo's convenient U-change system that makes it possible to combine a removable inner bottle (or engine) with the brand's cases.

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Tilbury Calm Bliss Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: “This calm infusion will help soothe your senses and make you feel reborn, with calming emotion-boosting molecules; sweet neroli oil and a watery accord! it’s inspired by the calming, cleansing effects of the sea and lakes of lotus flowers! “It opens with a blissful blend of relaxing lavandin oil and fresh bergamot oil, transporting you to a tranquil oasis where peace and harmony fill the air! “Bathe your senses in pure white musks, orange flower absolute, tonka bean and a peaceful orchid concentrate, eliciting feelings of calm like you’ve just returned from a peaceful, restful escape! “In a single spray, you’ll feel immersed in a calming and sensorial experience! It’s an ambient serene dream!” Charlotte Tilbury. This is serenity in a bottle. Calm Bliss gently manifests tranquillity and serenity, illuminated by the sparkling precious Neroli Oil that provides a fresh and floral facet to the fragrance. The peacefulness is embodied by the scent of natural Lavandin which gives it a distinctive and floral aromatic character. It evokes a beautiful, tranquil aroma which perfectly combines with the weightlessness of the watery accord. Orris concrete has flowery facets, with very powdery notes and a dry woody-root nuance that, combined with the softness of white musks, creates the innocence in Calm Bliss. Calm Bliss is the perfect relaxing scent that bathes you in a tranquil oasis of serenity and peace. Boost your feelings of calming serenity with the emotion-boosting molecules of calm bliss! How does Calm Bliss enhance feelings of calm? Charlotte worked with scientist Céline Manetta at IFF, who used the IFF Scentcube™ algorithm to identify the perfect combination of notes to create a fragrance that helps boost feelings of peace and calm. 93% agree they felt calmer** 91% agree they felt more relaxed** **Tested on 105 people over 1 week. Emotion-boosting molecules: Sweet Neroli Oil Refreshing Watery Accord Olfactive family: Aquatic, Floral. Magic fragrance notes: Top notes: Fresh Bergamot Oil, Sweet Neroli Oil, Relaxing Lavandin Oil Heart: Soothing Orange Flower Absolute, Refreshing Watery Accord Base: Warm Tonka Bean Accord, Pure White Musks, Peaceful Orris Concrete

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Buongiorno Amore Mio Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: A pure and bright fragrance that radiates the gentle clarity of early light, echoing the cheerful feeling of a fresh new day. Buongiorno Amore Mio evokes the beginning of a brand-new day, when the air is filled with the radiant freshness of Calabrian bergamot and the crisp accord of freshly pressed Italian cotton. At its heart, the velvety touch of iris brings a refined softness, unfolding into the comforting embrace of musk. Airy yet enveloping, it captures the quiet beauty of a perfect new day, where lightness and texture intertwine. The fragrance is presented in a bottle whose ridged glass form revisits and elevates a design drawn from Acqua di Parma’s archives. Its sculptural texture catches the light with a modern elegance, while the yellow-coloured glass cap adds a luminous contemporary accent.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Amber Labdanum Cologne Intense 50ml

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Smoking Hot Eau de Parfum Refillable, 50ml
listings.description: Kilian Hennessy's Inspiration: At night, there are no rules but one: just be Smoking Hot! KILIAN PARIS newest smoky fragrance is a truly caramelized delight. It features Kentucky Tobacco Absolute, infused with a hookah drag of Apple-flavoured shisha tobacco and intense Bourbon Vanilla. Evoking everything from European clubs to Eastern hookah lounges, Smoking Hot redefines what a smokey scent is today, going almost where it’s too hot to handle. The Perfume: The fragrance opens with forbidden fruit: a round Apple Hookah flavour blends with warm Cinnamon Bark essence. In a slow burn, notes of fire-cured Kentucky Tobacco Absolute emerge. Harmonised with Oakmoss, this resonant Tobacco absolute leads into a Bourbon Vanilla, with balsamic tonalities. Also known as a Pure Jungle essence™ Bourbon Vanilla, it is of the highest quality Vanilla available, especially intense, and textured. When crossed with Orcanox™, a powerful sensuality comes full circle. Perfume notes: Hookah Flavour, Tobacco Absolute, Bourbon Vanilla Pure Jungle Essence. Olfactive family: The Smokes. Perfumer: Mathieu Nardin.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Defy Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Fresh. Courageous. Seductive. Calvin Klein Defy Eau de Parfum for Him is a provocative new Calvin Klein aftershave for the daring modern man. Defiant of boundaries and expectations, the premium CK scent builds upon the original signature woody base with an unexpected darker, warmer twist. Opening with crisp top notes of mandarin oil and black pepper, this Calvin Klein scent has an irresistible fresh burst. Addictive and intense, the heart of velvety smooth leather accord offers a deep contrast to the freshness of the top notes, incorporating saffiano and rich suede in a new, rugged way. The base of vetiver oil – responsibly sourced from Haiti – anchors the vigour of this citrus perfume, adding strength, naturality and purpose to the aroma with a lasting masculine signature. Encapsulating the very essence of the Calvin Klein man, this uniquely rich Calvin Klein fragrance is housed in a unique bottle evoking denim and the iconic codes of CK’s iconic minimalism. The opposing straight corners and round curves of the silhouette pair represent both sides of this defiant and confident man, vulnerability and courage, duelling components that join to tell a complex story.

listings.description: K by Dolce & Gabbana. A new era of masculinity. Instantly conjuring the Italian countryside and the Mediterranean midday sun, the warm, enveloping embrace of K by Dolce & Gabbana evokes the fresh, earthy scent of wooded Tuscan hills. The fragrance invigorates the senses with an intense combination of citrus fresh blood orange and Sicilian lemon, amber accents of clary sage, crisp geranium and energising lavandin, a fresh bite of juniper berry and a spark of fiery pimento essence. Then comes a sensual cedarwood note, merging with earthy vetiver, before yielding to the sweet spiciness of patchouli, to intensify the innate charisma of a modern-day king. Fragrance Family: Woody Aromatic. Top Notes: Citrus, Sparkling Blood Orange, Juniper Berry Heart Notes: Citrus, Clary Sage, Geranium, Lavandin Base Notes: Cedarwood, Vetiver, Patchouli

A perfect balance between the vibrant, green notes of Galbanum and the soft, powdery notes of Iris Pallida. A rich, smooth variation with a greater floral dimension, heightened by Ylang-Ylang, Lily-of-the-Valley and Rose.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Charming and generous, the authentic, modern man was unveiled by Dolce & Gabbana with its fragrance for men ñ K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Toilette. Seductive, generous and charismatic, he is the king of his everyday life; a natural leader who cherishes his loved ones and inspires everyone around him. With K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum, the hidden facets of his personality are revealed through a captivating, woody fragrance. Vigorous, hypnotic, and irresistible, this spicy perfume offers an intimate glimpse into the heart of a modern king ñ a fascinatingly strong man with a heart that is always kind. The fragrance: K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum is a sensual scent for men with a deep, woody base and endlessly spicy notes. Dolce & Gabbana reveals the intense and passionate facets of a modern king who chooses his destiny with passion and confidence. Itís inspired by the earthiness of the rugged landscape of Tuscany and builds on the legacy of K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Toilette. However, the Eau de Parfum version has a deeper, more voluptuous and enchanting personality that embodies the life of an extraordinary man. The ingredients: An invigorating fusion of zesty citruses with explosive blood orange and Sicilian lemon opens K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum. Embellished by the freshness of juniper berry, this citrus blend is enhanced by sublime and spicy touches of cardamom, which kindles a spark of pimento essence to ignite the heart of the fragrance and magnify its passionate intensity. The combination of floral middle notes includes crunchy geranium, delicate clary sage and energising lavender. The sensuality of this woody perfume is intensified with the addition of a fig milk accord, which also lends to a smooth creamy touch. The fragrance then unfurls to a seductive base of cedarwood, smoky patchouli and earthy Nagarmotha wood. Deep, sensual and enticing, the scent perfectly reflects the passionate intensity of a king of today. The bottle: K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum maintains the chiselled geometric shape of the original bottle with a deeper shade of royal blue, highlighting the intensity of a powerful and magnetic perfume for men. The lacquered glass offers an intimate glimpse at the scent it houses. The iconic crown which tops the signature silhouette is overlaid with a burnished silver patina, accentuating the noble blue of its lapis dome and the stone orbs that surround it. On the bottle, the crowned letter K evokes the symbol of royalty combined with a daring simplicity that is contemporary in character. Majestic and memorable, the bottle perfectly represents the fascinating world of a modern king. Fragrance Family: Spicy Woody Aromatic. Top Notes: Citrus, Sparkling Blood Orange, Juniper Berry, Cardamom Heart Notes: Citrus, Clary Sage, Geranium, Lavandin, Fig Milk Base Notes: Cedarwood, Vetiver, Patchouli, Nagarmotha Wood

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Neroli Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Good to know: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs is being re-branded, the logo on your products may differ from the photos. The scent is still the same. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs invites you to compose your personalised Chloé fragrance as though arranging your favourite blossoms in a bouquet at a Parisian flower shop. Each perfume in the collection reveals a single floral, aromatic or woody scent rooted in the perfumer’s memory. Wear alone like a corsage or combine endlessly to create a lovely present or a perfume for all occasions. A flower, a perfumer, a story... Neroli, a refreshing perfume for women by Sidonie Lancesseur. In this interpretation of Neroli, Sidonie Lancesseur was guided by her memories of a trip to Seville where the orange blossoms exuded deliciously refreshing scents warmed by the sun. Neroli takes us on a true olfactory journey with the comforting and addictive floral accents of this lightly honeyed citrus perfume. Smooth and radiant, it’s the perfect evening scent. This Chloé perfume is housed in an elegant pleated glass bottle topped with an ivory cap that appears to be carved in stone. Touches of gold at the neckband and label trim enhance the light hue of each beautiful fragrance. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists. Wear your favourite flower on its own to celebrate its vitality and intensity, or combine Neroli with other perfumes from Atelier des Fleurs to create a personalised fragrance bouquet. listings.description: Good to know: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs is being re-branded, the logo on your products may differ from the photos. The scent is still the same. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs invites you to compose your personalised Chloé fragrance as though arranging your favourite blossoms in a bouquet at a Parisian flower shop. Each perfume in the collection reveals a single floral, aromatic or woody scent rooted in the perfumer’s memory. Wear alone like a corsage or combine endlessly to create a lovely present or a perfume for all occasions. A flower, a perfumer, a story... Neroli, a refreshing perfume for women by Sidonie Lancesseur. In this interpretation of Neroli, Sidonie Lancesseur was guided by her memories of a trip to Seville where the orange blossoms exuded deliciously refreshing scents warmed by the sun. Neroli takes us on a true olfactory journey with the comforting and addictive floral accents of this lightly honeyed citrus perfume. Smooth and radiant, it’s the perfect evening scent. This Chloé perfume is housed in an elegant pleated glass bottle topped with an ivory cap that appears to be carved in stone. Touches of gold at the neckband and label trim enhance the light hue of each beautiful fragrance. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists. Wear your favourite flower on its own to celebrate its vitality and intensity, or combine Neroli with other perfumes from Atelier des Fleurs to create a personalised fragrance bouquet. Disclaimer: Packaging may vary but scent remains the same.

listings.rawTitle: Aesop Virēre Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: A fresh and verdant fragrance, inspired by moments spent under an arbour of fig trees. A sip of green tea. The gentle creak of branches in a morning breeze. An interlude of treasured simplicity. How to use: Apply as desired to wrists and neck.

Masculine, luxurious and distinguished…A mysterious pack, a graphic, black and white object, a flashcode as a door to a digital universe. The bottle – square, faceted and streamlined, luxurious. listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums Fig Infusion by Nathalie Lorson Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the light of a sunny day in the south of France, Nathalie Lorson has composed an optimistic and reassuring fragrance. The top notes, a larger-than-life fig, are illuminated by a duo of juicy citrus mandarin and clementine. The floral heart, composed of freesia and orange blossom, meets the aromatic breath of Sri Lankan black tea. Finally, an enveloping wood accord, between the softness of Virginian cedarwood and the creaminess of sandalwood, provides comfort and refinement to the signature. The voluptuous benzoin reinforces this cocooning accord with its balmy effects.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Allegra Magnifying Sandalwood Essence Eau de Parfum, 40ml
listings.description: The woody Magnifying Sandalwood Essence expresses the wonderfully intense sensuousness of this gem of nature crafted by Master Perfumer Jacques Cavallier. A sensual texture, enveloping like a soft cashmere jumper and enhanced by a musk scent. The sandalwood selected by Jacques Cavallier has the richest and most fragrant smell: Santalum spicatum from Australia. The Magnifying Essences are made from precious, tailor-made ingredients to intensify magnificent Italian emotions. As their name suggests, these essences are highly concentrated, powerful and vibrant, an expression of true exclusivity. Beautiful worn alone, Bvlgari Allegra Magnifying essences also harmonise with any of the collection’s Eaux de Parfum to create a unique scent.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Hiris Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: Hiris is an ode to femininity and to the splendour of the iris. Created in 1999 by perfumer Olivia Giacobetti, this single-flower fragrance evokes both the goddess Iris, messenger of the gods and Hermès’s female alter ego, and the exquisite flower. An H has been added to its name in tribute to the first letter of Hermès. Hiris eau de toilette is a poetic composition that delicately expresses the charm of the iris in all its floral, powdery and botanical glory. The bottle, inspired by the lanterns of horse-drawn carriages, has a black cap reminiscent of a riding hat. The back label is illustrated with a design by Philippe Dumas, indicating that it belongs to the Parfums-Fondateurs collection. The Parfums-Fondateurs Collection: The Parfums-Fondateurs collection draws inspiration from the house’s heritage. Each THE CREATION encapsulates Hermès’ imaginary world in a name, a fragrance and a colour. Over the years, Hermès has pioneered a bold style of perfumery, resulting from encounters with exceptional perfumers. From flower to scent, this is the refined and modern intention of Hiris, an utterly original single-flower creation devoted to the splendour of the iris and dedicated to women. A fragrance of emotion and subtlety conceived by Olivia Giacobetti, it is a novel that expresses the shifting charms – sometimes floral, sometimes powdery or vegetal – of one of nature’s olfactory marvels with infinite delicacy.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Le Lion de CHANEL Les Exclusifs de CHANEL – Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Proud and passionate, Gabrielle Chanel fully embodied her astrological sign. Instinctive and daring, she took inspiration from it. The lion became her totem animal. Powerful and carnal, the ambery, leather-like notes of labdanum are softened and brightened by vanilla and bergamot. LE LION DE CHANEL is a warm, majestic and refined fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Le Lion de CHANEL Les Exclusifs de CHANEL – Eau de Parfum 200ml

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Limited Edition Eau des Sens Hair Mist, 30ml
listings.description: A light and delicate veil reveals the vibrant, zesty notes of summer. The bottle features an exquisite design, created by Mathilde Jonquière, representing the sunlit fragments of a mosaic to convey the freshness of orange blossom. This summer, Diptyque invites you to a refreshing, sensory escape in the heart of a water garden. A place paved with ancient stones, shaded by umbrella pines and where flowering bushes stand alongside blossoming orange trees. Majestic fountains flow with crystal-clear water, the droplets suspended in the air shimmering and sparkling in the bright sunlight. All the senses are awakened. To illustrate this summer scene, Diptyque called upon the exceptional expertise of Mathilde Jonquière to create a collection of original mosaic works. Inspired by summer water garden landscapes, the mosaic artist imagines and composes frescoes by meticulously arranging tesserae of Venetian enamels, glass paste and gold. On limited edition bottles and boxes of the collection, these designs capture the poetry of the moment, like a mirror reflecting the freshness of a lush natural setting.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Vitae Cologne Forte Scented Soap, 150g
listings.description: Aqua Vitae Cologne forte Scented Soap gently cleanses your skin while releasing a fragrant, soft and delicately textured foam. Aqua Vitae Cologne forte is unveiled in this fragrance ritual. Mandarin from Italy gives bright freshness to the bergamot, leading to a luminous, citrusy and sunny floral scent. The soap, stamped with the Maison's monogram, is enriched with coconut oil and leaves your skin infinitely soft.

listings.rawTitle: Goutal Un Matin d'Orage For Her Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Un Matin d'Orage captures the fragile moment when the garden wakes up after the rain. Under a sky still heavy with clouds, shiso and ginger release their lively freshness, while tuberose reveals a rare expression: green and subtly fruity. Gardenia softens the damp glow, before wood and resins prolong the image of nature reborn. An airy, fresh and delicately luminous tuberose.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Alto Astral Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: An embodiment of positive energy, Alto Astral Eau de Parfum takes its name from a vibrant Brazilian Portuguese expression that evokes an elevated state of mind – alto astral is the feeling of joy, optimism, and good vibes that uplift everyone around and waves its way through nature and culture. Opening on an addictive coconut note blended with vibrant aldehyde, the fragrance embraces an intense fruitiness that dynamically balances freshness with addiction, for a sparkling gourmand experience. A heart of incense, jasmine petals, and milky musk intensifies the scent before settling on a base of sandalwood, cashmere wood, and salted amber, which grounds this scent. Its intensity continually diffuses through the air, leaving a trail of positive energy in its wake. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Aldehyde, Coconut Water Heart notes: Incense, Jasmine Petals, Milky Musks Base notes: Sandalwood, Cashmere Woods, Salted Amber

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Thé Matcha 26 Eau de Parfum Travel Refill, 3 x 10ml
listings.description: Refill your travel tube with the fragrance(s) of your choice available in 3 x 10ml spray bottles. In the same way matcha tea is much more than just a drink in Japanese culture, Thé Matcha 26 is much more than a scent to us. It is a moment of introspection, a moment of self that offers a quiet inner celebration of grace and soulful beauty. A simple whiff takes us away from the hum of the outside and brings us back 'in'. Matcha tea accord is infused with a creamy fig note, grounded by soft vetiver and textural cedar woods and uplifted by enticing bitter orange. Introverted and deep by nature, Thé Matcha 26 is a skin scent, something meant for, and only those individuals lucky enough to be very close to, the wearer. It carries a noble stillness. To us, it is a scented reminder of home, of welcomed solitude, and of all things familiar and treasured.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense is the latest Bright Gourmand fragrance joining the Devotion collection. The new olfactive creation revisits the original fragrance with its characteristic notes of Orange Blossom and Vanilla, featuring a new addition of distinctive Hazelnut. Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense revisits the original fragrance with deeper and more enveloping notes. This fragrance was created by Olivier Cresp for Dolce & Gabbana. Top notes: The perfume opens with the distinctive and inviting notes of Hazelnut Heart notes: The freshness of Orange Blossom bursts from the heart of the fragrance Base notes: The warm and sensual hint of Vanilla transports the senses to a sophisticated olfactory destination Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense celebrates the brand's unwavering dedication to Italian design and craftsmanship. The design: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense is housed in a vibrant amber-tinted glass bottle beautifully adorned with the unmistakably symbolic Sacred Heart.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Elixir Parfum For Him 50ml
listings.description: The boxing king by Jean Paul Gaultier. Let the show begin! Boxing gloves on, this king of the Jean Paul Gaultier ring hits hard with the robust, addictive and incredibly sexy SCANDAL FOR MEN. Crowned with gold and victories, the athletically shaped refillable bottle affords protection to the stylish and original notes of caramel in this intense woody oriental Eau de Toilette. A knockout fragrance to overpower the senses. How scandalous! Scandal Pour Homme Elixir, luxury and exuberance aboard the Gaultier First Class. In first class on the Gaultier train, Scandal Pour Homme Elixir reigns supreme with its fruity, woody amber fragrance. Its provocative cherry and decadent patchouli assert themselves with panache. Its tonka bean is outrageously suave. Who wouldn't dream of crossing its path? Behind the red velvet and closed door of its very private case, only the most impertinent can enter and succumb to the silver gradation of its bottle and amber fragrance. Crowned with intensity and excess, everything about it says temptation. Its excess is all-powerful, its pleasures heightened. Are passengers offended? Great! That’s the goal. The red velvet case of an excessive hedonist. Behind the velvet of this first-class case, Jean Paul Gaultier keeps the most exuberant of scandals secret. Intense red, golden crown, sensual feel. The excess is obvious even before it's opened. Only the most rebellious are allowed. In the most exclusive space on the Gaultier train, the intensity of this fruity, woody amber fragrance takes control, no apologies. The insolence of a juicy black cherry. The panache of an all-powerful patchouli. The elegance of an extremely sensual tonka bean. Scandal Pour Homme Elixir is so appealing that every pleasure is heightened. Irresistible charisma and excess, causing a scandal in high style.

listings.rawTitle: LOEWE Solo Vulcan Eau de Parfum Pour Homme 50ml
listings.description: Aromatic and singular, LOEWE Solo Vulcan Eau de Parfum combines the rich, warm aroma of the new LOEWE Accord with notes of thyme, lavender, orange flower absolute and vetiver to create a balsamic, woody, herbal and fresh fragrance. Vulcan is the first perfume in the LOEWE Solo family of fragrances to feature the LOEWE Accord - a new and exclusive olfactory note inspired by the scent of the Spanish Rockrose wildflower. Raw and authentic, resinous and leathery, it has been crafted to capture the olfactory essence of LOEWE’s unique identity. While the LOEWE Solo family is inspired by the perfectly harmonious balance of sunset, Vulcan evokes the powerful, fiery eruption of a volcano and echoes the fleeting potency of the Rockrose’s fragrant blooms.

This mini Eau de Parfum for Baccarat Rouge 540 is born from the encounter between Maison Francis Kurkdjian and Baccarat. The travel-size perfume celebrates the crystal manufacturer’s 250th birthday. The woody scent releases a poetic alchemy, a highly condensed and graphic olfactory signature. Breezy jasmine facets, radiant saffron boost the ambergris mineral notes and the woody tones of freshly-cut cedar. Bright and sleek, Baccarat Rouge 540 portable perfume caresses the skin like an amber and woody floral whisper. Need extra protection? listings.description: The new fragrances from Tiffany & Co., Tiffany & Love Eau de Toilette for Him and Tiffany & Love Eau de Parfum for Her, were created as a tribute to modern love. Crafted by renowned perfumers Sophie Labbé and Nicolas Beaulieu, Tiffany & Love for Him is a citrusy, aromatic fragrance with a wood-infused base. An enticing composition, the scent begins with oils of ginger, mandarin and cardamom. At the heart is a juniper-cypress blend, a co-distillation process created exclusively for Tiffany, which brings a sense of modernity to the fragrance. Sandalwood, vetiver and the common ingredient of the duo, the signature blue sequoia note, complete the base of this masterful composition. Fresh, Aromatic & Modern. listings.rawTitle: Hermès Oud Alezan Perfumed Body Cream, 200ml
listings.description: The creation: The Hermessence Oud Alezan was born when Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel encountered an extraordinary oud. Continuing its pursuit of sensory appeal, Hermès introduces the Oud Alezan Eau de Parfum fragrance ritual with a perfumed body cream. The texture: The enveloping texture of Oud Alezan perfumed body cream melts into the skin to leave it fragranced, moisturised and nourished. Olfactory signature: On the skin, Oud Alezan perfumed body cream embodies an accord between an exceptional, enveloping oud and a striking duo of contrasting roses. The formulation: The formula of Oud Alezan perfumed body cream is a blend of nourishing, moisturising and soothing active ingredients: sweet almond oil, macadamia oil, shea butter and aloe vera extract. The object: Oud Alezan perfumed body cream is presented in a frosted glass jar, its silver lid adorned with the Hermès Clou de Selle. How to use: The perfumed body cream can be worn alone or in conjunction with Oud Alezan Eau de Parfum to intensify its fragrant trail.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Parfum Pour Homme
listings.description: The #ForeverGuilty universe continues to pursue a liberated notion of passion with Gucci Guilty Parfum For Him. The scents reinterpret the classic Gucci Guilty For Him in a move that elevates the juice to higher levels of intensity. For those looking for a declaration of love free from the rules and definitions of society, the scent is designed to act as an emblem of the connection between like-minded, eccentric lovers. Gucci Guilty Parfum For Him is a Woody Aromatic fragrance that magnifies the true essence of the Gucci Guilty For Him line. A new and intense vision of masculinity, Gucci Guilty Parfum For Him opens with a lighter, milder and more modernised aromatic hook of French Lavandin and uplifting Lemon that combine perfectly with the warmth of Juniper. The true essence of Gucci Guilty For Him is magnified at the heart with the deep ambery signature of Cistus combined with the floral richness of Orange Flower and a spicy hint of Nutmeg. Finally, the mysterious elegance of Patchouli is reinforced with a long-lasting woody and musky sensation.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Musc Nurāsana Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by Thibaud Crivelli’s experience of stretching on a terrace at first light, Musc Nurāsana unfolds as a fresh, luminous musky scent threaded with rose damascena and incense olibanum, while offering a radiant, long-lasting trail that is filled with vitality, balancing openness to the world with a return to the self.​ In the chiaroscuro of a terrace suspended in silence, Thibaud Crivelli captured the energy of a nascent morning: the cool air, the gradual ascent of the sun, and the musky, floral breath that heralds the world's awakening. Dry, resinous curls of incense smoke lend the scent a meditative verticality, which is permeated by a soft rose note whose mineral undertones evoke an image of the flower lying on the still-cool stone.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Homme Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Dior Homme Parfum, the new intensity by Francis Kurkdjian, Dior's Perfume Creative Director. An ode to sensuality and sophistication that celebrates the Iris, from flower to roots. Embodying a unique balance of strength and tenderness, the scent is crafted around notes of Iris and underlined by powerful accords of amber woods. Delivering a sensual trail, imbued with the distinguished allure of the Dior Homme fragrances. With its clean lines and sensual colour gradient, the timeless and masculine design of the monolithic bottle is topped with a cap featuring a sleek silver metal plaque. How to use: Spray Dior Homme Parfum directly on the skin or in a cloud for a deeply intense and long-lasting trail. Complete the olfactory ritual with more from the Dior Homme grooming collection. From the invigorating Shower Gel to the softening After-Shave Balm and highly-scented Deodorant.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Vanille Nude Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: La Vie Est Belle Vanille Nude by Lancôme is a floral musky gourmand feminine fragrance that combines glazed vanilla and solar jasmine with an enveloping base of creamy, white musk and sandalwood. A powerful skin scent that elevates your natural essence and lasts all day long with an exceptional, up to 5-hour intensity.* The scent: our first misky vanilla. Crafted by two of the most renowned French perfumers - Dominique Ropion and Anne Flipo - this floral, musky gourmand fragrance fuses the radiance of solar jasmine from Lancôme's Le Domaine de la Rose in Grasse, France with the sweetness of glazed Bourbon vanilla from Madagascar, culminating in an overdose of creamy white musks and sandalwood that melt into your skin. Inspired by the feeling of biting into a delicious French patisserie, this fragrance prolongs happiness with every note and reveals your most genuine essence, wrapped in a jewel-like bottle that's pure desire. Top Notes: Bergamot Essence, Orange Essence, Pink Pepper Heart Notes: Jasmine, Iris, Fluffy Coconut Accord Base Notes: Vanilla, White Musk, Sandalwood A skin scent: happiness becomes your second skin. La Vie Est Belle Vanille Nude is more than a perfume. It is a powerful skin scent that becomes one with you to reveal your most enticing self and elevate your natural essence with striking intimacy, lasting all day long* on your skin with an exceptional, up to 5-hour intensity* to carry you from day to night. The last ingredient is you. Why you'll love it: A long-lasting, Eau de Parfum with audacious, enveloping sensuality, crafted by world-class French perfumers Our first musky vanilla that creates an intimate connection between fragrance and skin A powerful skin scent that becomes one with you to reveal your most irresistible self Designed to empower you to feel confident as you surrender to a moment of happiness The bottle: an irresistible, iridescent smile: Draped in a precious, opal pink lacquer, this jewel-like bottle captures the feeling of being dressed only in self-love. Crafted in the iconic La vie est belle silhouette, a fusion of sensual curves and sharp lines, the bottle is set with the signature La Vie Est Belle crystal smile, symbolising the fragrance’s celebration of happiness, while the pale pink and silver-toned wings represent a nod to the nude gourmand effect of this skin-caressing fragrance. *Self-assessment test, 69 women.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Christmas Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Adventure, character, seduction. Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Toilette trio gift set is the perfect tribute to the modern man: dynamic, authentic, irresistibly sensual. Brilliant, bold, iconic. The Holiday packaging is dressed in glossy red with the embossed DG logo, an expression of style and sophistication wrapped in wonder. This Gift Set is a beauty ritual dedicated to the man who lives every day as an adventure. The fragrance was created by Alberto Morillas exclusively for Dolce & Gabbana. Fragrance notes: Top notes: The fragrance opens with an ultra-fresh cocktail of sun-ripened lemon, Sicilian mandarin and Bergamot, and juicy frozen grapefruit: all extracted by cold pressing of the peels Heart notes: The intensely masculine heart is dominated by aromatic rosemary, which, joined by the spicy touch of pepper and the sensuality of Brazilian rosewood, enhances the dominant character of the fragrance Base notes: Indonesian patchouli, a renowned ingredient, is combined with undertones of incense and oak moss in the base, resulting in a foundation of warm, woody scents that emphasise the incredibly seductive quality of the star fragrance Set contains: Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Toilette, 100ml Light Blue Pour Homme Shower Gel, 50ml Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Toilette, Travel Spray, 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Clinique My Happy Cookies & Kisses Eau de Parfum, 15ml
listings.description: What it is: Delicious like baking on a lazy Sunday. Nibble something yummy just out of the oven. A touch of Cinnamon, rich Vanilla, and creamy Chestnuts. An indulgent scent to wear alone or layer. How to use: Wear alone, layer, or collect them all. Fragrance style: Rich. Grounding. Irresistible. Fragrance notes: Baked apple and Vanilla bean.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Sedley Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Light, forceful and fresh, Sedley is an Eau de Parfum capturing watery and aerial scents that offer a true olfactory journey, with a freshness that follows you everywhere. This classic yet modern fragrance is a blend of bergamot, spearmint and watery accord, with geranium bourbon, lavender and sunny notes. In the background, the ultimate woody signature embodies tradition mixed with contemporary aestheticism. A fragrance for men and women. Top notes: Bergamot, Spearmint, Watery accord Heart notes: Geranium, Lavender, Solar note Base notes: Sandalwood, Incense, White Musk, Cedarwood An original fragrance with a radiant sillage designed as a manifesto for all generations of aesthetes. With its clear bottle, Sedley is modelled after its composition, which is light, forceful and fresh. Hot and cold. Selecting materials of exceptional quality and combining them with unprecedented molecules, the eau de parfum challenges the established codes of the olfactory pyramid to create a round and vibrant fragrance, where the notes expertly collide. The lightness of citrus sets off the power of mint, and Hivernal Neo reinvents the feeling of water.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci Bloom Parfum blossoms into the floating garden of dreams, bringing an addictively solar amber bouquet to the Bloom collection. The new Parfum from Gucci Beauty reimagines the iconic white Bloom Accord, transforming it into a golden Bloom Accord. Perfect for special occasions, both day and night, this women's perfume lasts for hours. The scent: It brings an intense gourmand edge with Coral Jasmine accord, a warm and luminous night-flowering jasmine that bathes the scent in a timelessly elegant golden veil. A modernising co-extraction of Tuberose accord brings intensely fragrant sophisticated richness and powdery sensuality with hints of orange blossom accord. With subtle yet unique differences created through a singular note, the new Bloom scent’s rich and ambery accent is driven by the Peru Balsam extract. This is passionately blended with a duo of vanilla notes: a contrasted blend of creamy sweet and spicy woody accords. With these additional notes, the fragrance is wrapped in golden layers of delectable Vanilla, sweet Balsam, and rich Amber accords that drive its addictive solar intensity. The bottle: The bottle is presented in a striking midnight black that echoes the concentrated depth and power of the juice within. The House’s iconic print of leaves, cherry branches, flowers, and butterflies is finished in gold to evoke its warm, elegant lightness. A modern portrayal of blooming femininity, Gucci Bloom is a place of self-discovery, where beauty blossoms and women celebrate each other as they evolve.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Diorissimo Eau de Toilette Spray, 100ml
listings.description: Created in 1956 by Edmond Roudnitska, Diorissimo is considered an absolute masterpiece of perfumery, capturing the olfactory essence of lily of the valley with rare realism. An eternal spring, the fragrance celebrates the freshness of this May flower, Christian Dior's lucky charm and the emblem of his couture House. Dioriginals brings together the House of Dior’s iconic fragrances, restored by Francis Kurkdjian, Perfume Creative Director. Faithful to the original fragrance compositions, they are presented in the iconic 1948 bottle that once housed Christian Dior’s very first creations.

listings.description: A magnetic fragrance with an elegant trail. Amber notes meet addictive woods to enhance a sensual heart of musc. listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Tobacco Carnaval Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Tobacco Carnaval is a colourful sensory carnival that lies at the heart of the Olfactory Mysteries collection by Maison Crivelli. The fragrance draws inspiration from the vibrant memory of a night of celebration, when Thibaud Crivelli, swept up in the rush of the party, caught the warm, diffuse scent of dried tobacco leaves in the air. From this adventure comes a scent that balances light and dark. In turns muted and incandescent, it is threaded with liqueur-like accents and festive bursts of radiance. The composition is based on a play of contrasts between a note of infused rum and the raw texture of tobacco. Gradually, the fragrance unfurls, rises in intensity, and settles in. Left in its wake is a trail that is both fascinating and indefinable, tinged with tobacco notes. The euphoria of a shared moment, where letting loose meets collective exhilaration. Maison Crivelli offers breathtaking olfactory adventures that arise from the encounter between a material and an unexpected moment experienced by Founder Thibaud Crivelli. Each fragrance bears the signature of an ultra-sensorial scene, where accords, sounds, colours, and textures collide and resonate with one another in a synesthetic alchemy. Through its creations, the Maison focuses on the aesthetics of surprise, that turning point when the eyes and senses attune to new ways of perceiving the world.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Pink Glaze Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Black Opium Pink Glaze, the strawberry craze. The iconic sensual coffee-floral fragrance turns pink with the sexiest ingredient, a juicy strawberry. The scent that makes you unlock the party. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Strawberry, Green Mandarin Superessence, Bergamot Essence Heart notes: Jasmine from YSL Ourika Community Gardens, Orange Flower Absolute Base notes: Vanilla Absolute, Resinoid Benzoin Tear, Coffee Accord, Woody Amber Accord, Patchouli Olfactory Family: Ambery Fruity. The scent: A sultry strawberry melts into head-turning sensual jasmine. A vibey reinterpretation of Black Opium’s coffee-floral signature notes. A true-to-taste smell, as seductive as it is delicious. The reflection of the Black Opium woman: magnetic, confident, main character energy. The bottle: Bolder and sexier it-design. The signature Black Opium bottle takes on a daring shape and shade. A dark pink lacquered tone contrasting with a powerful black core. Cassandre at heart. Sharp lines, new transparency, modern and unapologetically cool. The edgiest confidence booster accessory. Pink is the new black. How to use: Spray Black Opium on your pulse points and in the creases of your knees and elbows for a longer-lasting, stronger scent.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Calèche Soie de Parfum Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Created by perfumer Guy Robert in 1961, Hermès’ first fragrance for women, Calèche, was reinterpreted in 1992 as Calèche Soie de Parfum, the name of which refers to the horse-drawn carriages that are emblematic of the house and its silk métier. Floral with aldehyde aromas, Calèche Soie de Parfum combines the refined notes of aldehyde with opulent jasmine and generous rose. The bottle, inspired by the lanterns of horse-drawn carriages, has a black cap reminiscent of a riding hat. The back label is illustrated with a design by Philippe Dumas, indicating that it belongs to the Parfums-Fondateurs collection. The Parfums-Fondateurs Collection: The Parfums-Fondateurs collection draws inspiration from the house’s heritage. Each creation encapsulates Hermès’ imaginary world in a name, a fragrance and a colour. Over the years, Hermès has pioneered a bold style of perfumery, resulting from encounters with exceptional perfumers. Written in 1961 by Guy Robert, Calèche was Hermès' first fragrance for women. A highly feminine, woody, chypre floral, its name refers to the horse-drawn carriages that are emblematic of the house. Calèche is a novel that dazzles with the beauty of its raw materials, from the joyfulness of citrus fruit to the modernity of aldehyde notes; from the floral heart embellished with ylang-ylang, rose and jasmine to the woody, chypre sillage underscored by the nobility of the iris.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Burberry Goddess is a story of self-discovery found through confidence, strength and kindness. In this new chapter, Emma Mackey now radiates the power within, creating an intense magnetism that captivates those around her. Inspired by the shades of a radiant sunset, Burberry Goddess Parfum is housed in a refillable bronzed square bottle. Its elegant light brown packaging with a gold label is inspired by Burberry’s signature gabardine fabric. The refill for this Burberry perfume is sold separately. At the top of the fragrance, a vibrant raspberry accord complements the radiant lavender essence from Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum. The signature trio of vanilla extracts unveils its richness at the heart, while a suede leather accord brings more warmth, texture and sensuality to the gourmand vanilla base of this powerful scent. How to use: Spray Burberry Goddess Parfum generously onto pulse points such as the neck, wrists and décolletage to increase the longevity of this refined Burberry scent.|Gently press onto the skin to preserve the essence of the fragrance.

With Spicebomb Night Vision Eau de Parfum, cross the green light of intensity. Discover this new interpretation of Spicebomb Night Vision, fresh and addictive. The night has never been so intense. Spicebomb Night Vision Eau de Parfum is available in 50ml and 90ml. Fragrance Family: Fougere Ambery. listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Purple Melancholia Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Introducing the new fragrance for him, Born in Roma Uomo eau de toilette by Valentino, where masculine elegance meets an unexpected, modern edge. Born in Roma Uomo is a woody perfume which intertwines Valentino's couture elegance with edgy modernity, reminiscent of Rome's street culture. The sophistication of Aromatic Clary Sage, Violet Leaves and Vetiver Essence is contrasted with cool notes of Mineral Salt, radiant Modern Wood and electrifying Ginger. The bottle is encased in the armour of Valentino’s iconic stud, a fashion signature of Valentino Couture inspired by Roman architecture and representing a rebellious new era for high fashion. Born In Roma Uomo personifies this juxtaposition of old and new: Roma is where reverence for the past meets an irreverent attitude for now. To wear the Valentino stud is a symbol of strength; to wear Born In Roma is a symbol of celebration. Born In Roma for men celebrates where you have come from, and where you want to go. A statement of your personality, your heritage and your rules. Top Notes: Violet Leaves Absolute, Ginger Essence, Citron Essence Middle Notes: Clary Sage Essence, Peppermint Accord, Mineral Salt Accord Base Notes: Vetiver Essence, Guaiacwood Essence, Leather Born in Roma Purple takes you on a journey, inviting you to rediscover memories that define you and make you unique. Born from the desire to enjoy life to the fullest, this fragrance opens with an ambery, aromatic, woody fragrance note, built and developed around notes of cardamom and coconut, which lingers like a memory, wrapped in a bottle, as timeless as the moments it recalls. Unlock memories with every wear, experience the irresistible blend of confidence and allure. A scent designed not just to be worn, but to be remembered.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Shalimar Eau de Toilette Spray Refill, 93ml
listings.description: Elegance, sensuality, subtlety, feminine influence. Inspired by an Amber love story, Shalimar is the dazzling essence of a woman who is endlessly desirable and forever desired. Like her, Shalimar is at once sublime and intimate. Suave and luscious, this elegantly sensual and undeniably attractive perfume expresses itself in multiple and astonishing facets depending on the moment, the skin or the hour. Shalimar is the essence of femininity. Like all legendary elixirs, it springs from the basin of a magic fountain. Fragrance description: Soft Amber voluptuous, sensual, spellbinding tonic top notes of fresh flowers and bergamot are calmly intrepid. Like the savvy disorder of rumpled silk sheets, powdery notes of iris, jasmine and rose suggest or promise sensual embraces. The creamy softness of addictive vanilla, the penetrating charm of iris, the balmy roundness of opoponax and the gourmand warmth of tonka bean orchestrate an intimate symphony of scent for languorous interludes. Refill, 93ml

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain L'Instant de Guerlain pour Homme Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: L'Instant de Guerlain pour Homme highlights a unique moment: the one in which a man takes the initiative and after which everything will be different. This woody, sparkling, seductive fragrance was composed of contrasts. It is nothing less than surprising.

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés High Frequency Eau de Parfum, 90ml
listings.description: The combination of Magnolia and Almond, overtly so innocent yet truly sexy, takes you by surprise. Its effect is like a sound wave that starts off gently and then powers up the decibels on the skin. An overdose of hedione detonates the final explosion. Floral. Made in France Unisex Cruelty-free Fragrance notes: Magnolia, Jasmin, Vanilla, Heliotrope, Almond, Sandalwood, Hedione.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Buongiorno Dolce Far Niente Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: A fragrance of light-hearted ease that comes from choosing to do nothing at all, except enjoy the sweetness of an unhurried day. Buongiorno Dolce Far Niente is an ode to light-hearted ease, a fragrance that embraces the sweetness of unhurried hours. It conjures the sensation of resting beneath a lemon tree at midday, where the sparkling brightness of citrus mingles with the green shade of leaves and the resinous depth of its wood. The crisp vitality of lemon wood accord meets the warmth of musk, creating a scent that is both fresh and comforting — a luminous portrait of time suspended in pleasure. The fragrance is presented in a bottle whose ridged glass form revisits and elevates a design drawn from Acqua di Parma’s archives. Its sculptural texture catches the light with a modern elegance, while the Tangerine Orange-coloured glass cap adds a luminous contemporary accent.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden Vanilla Firenze Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden reimagines the four stages of ancient alchemy. The Substratum stage: Gucci Vanilla Firenze Eau de Parfum. The fusion of exclusive Italian Iris Pallida Concrete and a precious trio of Vanilla extracts. Earthy. Powerful. Mysterious. Fragrance family: Floral Amber. Gucci Beauty’s tailor-made, solvent-drawn Iris Pallida Concrete takes several years to macerate. The rhizomes are kept in Florence’s artisanal caves, and their earthy characteristics are drawn out via solvent extraction. Powerful excess is explored through three rich notes of Vanilla: the addictiveness of Vanilla Infusion, the animality of Vanilla Absolute, and the enthralling richness of gas-extracted Vanilla. Combined with warm Myrrh Resinoid, the floral vanilla perfume unfolds with ultra-textured opulence. The bottle: A black bottle reflects the earthy and carnal facets of Italian Iris. A majestic steed represents the nobility and strength of this Gucci fragrance. Olfactive Alchemists: Véronique Nyberg explores the Italian Iris for its contrasting dualities and embraces opulent excess by exploring the various qualities of Vanilla. How to use: To enjoy the addictive notes of this Gucci perfume for longer, it is recommended to apply it to the body’s pulse points, including the wrists, neck, behind the ears and chest Designed to be layered with other fragrances, create your own unique scent with other products from the Gucci Alchemist’s Garden collection. There are three recommended layering combinations for Gucci Vanilla Firenze Eau de Parfum: Enhance the opulence of Vanilla Firenze Eau de Parfum with A Reason to Love Eau de Parfum, where Italian Orris, Vanilla, and Oud accord unearth sensual rosy depths Pair Vanilla Firenze with Fiori di Neroli Eau de Parfum to create a zested vanilla. Merged together, Neroli, Italian Orris & Vanilla create a creamy violet citrus For a richer experience, layer Vanilla Firenze with Fading Autumn perfumed water and A Forgotten Rose perfumed oil, where Nature’s colours burst with Italian Orris, Vanilla, Woods & Rose

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Le Male Elixir sailor triggers a heatwave when he steps aboard! On deck, this Gaultier fragrance is so intense that gold melts in flaming streaks across his torso and metal can. Talk about sex appeal when this woody aromatic amber and totally addictive fragrance envelops his body! The horizon starts rocking and rolling. The senses are out of control. Burning with desire for this sensual elixir that works its magic beneath his translucent brown sailor top. The fragrance: Woody aromatic amber notes define this intense fragrance. Just one spritz of this woody aromatic amber elixir is enough to set the senses on fire. Ablaze with sensuality. Intense on the skin. Sunny tropical tonka bean gravitates towards legendary lavender. The animal magnetism of seductive benzoin. A blast of fresh mint and bergamot. Now, you’re ready! You’re melting with desire. The bottle: A dazzling bottle. Admire this sailor’s gold-striped torso as he takes the helm. With his torso bulging under the translucent amber sailor top, this dazzling golden bottle simply oozes sex appeal. But beware of his skin that gleams with copper hues in the setting sun! Don’t touch! You’ll get burnt! How to use: Sensually spray Le Male Elixir with a proud and extravagant gesture and let it melt into the warmth of your skin. One torrid spritz on your torso, wrists and sailor collars will have you exploding with virility. Full steam ahead!
