listings.description: Masculine distinction according to Gabrielle Chanel. A refined and timeless fresh-chypre fragrance. A bottle swathed in flannel grey: elegant, sober, discreet. The only men's fragrance created while Mademoiselle was still alive, in 1955. An elegant and refined fresh-chypre fragrance. A fresh citrusy burst with notes of Sicilian Lemon and Tunisian Neroli, revealing a deep, spicy heart. The sober, subtle presence of a woody trail.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Le Gemme Falkar Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Discover Bvlgari Le Gemme Falkar, a deep and opulent fragrance crafted around a woody black musk accord and a fascinating oud essence. Dive into the splendour and natural richness of the Brazilian rainforest, the impressive home of Falcon’s Eye. The fragrance draws its power from the green shimmering Falcon’s Eye gemstone of Brazil, which is said to protect travellers on their journeys. Inseparable from the majestic falcon, it is also associated with the hawk-headed Egyptian god Horus. His symbol is an eye, and so the stone is said to extend and focus one’s vision, providing deeper insight and keeping a safe watch over all journeys, near and far. Bvlgari Le Gemme Falkar is one of the deepest scents of all. It is mystic and rich, a distinct signature that leaves a rich sillage. The opulence of an exceptional, majestic oud essence, imbued with deep and opulent woody black musks, captures the majestic presence of Falcon’s Eye. Olfactive family: Woody, Black Musk. Olfactive pyramid: Black Musk Accord Oud Essence.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Gold Eau de Parfum Intense
listings.description: Elegance, style, and innate magnetism blend seamlessly in Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Gold Eau de Parfum Intense. This captivating masculine fragrance is crafted around the rich, woody, and spicy notes of Clary Sage, Bergamot, and Patchouli. The masculine essence of Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Gold Eau de Parfum Intense pays homage to the magnetic allure of its wearer, featuring a captivating blend of woody and spicy notes, including Clary Sage, Bergamot, and Patchouli. The design: The Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Gold Eau de Parfum Intense bottle design reimagines the essential lines of the original bottle, adorned with a striking gold lacquer. Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Gold Eau de Parfum Intense is synonymous with style and magnetic charm. This fragrance was exclusively created for Dolce&Gabbana by Rodrigo Flores-Roux, Michel Girard, and Olivier Pescheux. Top notes: The woody and spicy fragrance opens with the green note of Clary Sage Heart: At the heart of Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Gold Eau de Parfum Intense, the sparkling accord of Bergamot takes centre stage Base notes: The spicy note of Patchouli seals this composition with an unmistakable touch of charm

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d'Issey Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Toilette. The power of salt in a new fragrance for men. Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Toilette is the dynamic new vegan perfume by Issey Miyake, harnessing the power of salt. Water. Copious and crystal-clear. Within its vital current, salt, elusive and imperceptible, is carried. As water evaporates, the salt crystallises, leaving its tactile fragrance upon the skin. A surprising scent that awakens the senses, salt reveals the flavour of life. Flow with the movement and feel your pulse beat. Savour the vitality. A new freshness in a woody perfume for men. Made with 95% natural origin ingredients, and 100% natural origin French alcohol, Le Sel d’Issey is a fresh woody marine perfume. A vegan fragrance in which the power of salt is revealed by masculine earthy notes. With this new eau de toilette, perfumer Quentin Bisch gives scentless salt a fragrance, bringing an olfactory dimension to the otherwise odourless substance. This vibrant perfume journeys from the sea to the land, expressed through two olfactive polarities. The salty polarity encapsulates the sea with its vigorous salt accord. Natural-origin marine seaweed blends with natural-origin oak moss — a type of algae that migrated inland, linking to the fragrance’s second olfactive polarity. Enhancing the freshness of the salt accord, notes of sparkling ginger rush forth in the earthy polarity. Woody notes reveal their intensity, infusing the fragrance with density and texture. Natural sand vetiver combines with cedarwood — a natural upcycled ingredient distilled from side stream dust in furniture making. The dynamic interplay between the salty and earthy polarities invigorates the fragrance, for a raw and powerful masculinity. A pure and clean perfume bottle. With its sharp aesthetic, the perfume bottle captures the light and energy of salt. The internationally renowned designer behind the creation, Tokujin Yoshioka, has previously collaborated directly with Mr. Miyake, and his work explores the natural process of crystallisation. The light grey tone of the fragrance is visible through the transparent bottle — made with 20% recycled glass — symbolising the salt at the scent’s core. At the base, a clear hemisphere symbolises strength and masculinity. In harmony with the fragrance, the outer box is infused with a natural grey hue to reflect the purity of salt, while the matte surface echoes the rugged texture of salt crystals. For the first time, the card uses 10% upcycled seaweed and material from well-managed, FSC™-certified forests and other controlled sources. Le Sel d’Issey is refillable and is available in 50ml and 100ml sizes, with a 150ml refill. Made in France. How to use: Spray Le Sel d’Issey over your skin, focusing on your pulse points — your wrists, neck, and inside elbows — for a more powerful trail with an intensity that lasts.

listings.description: Maison Margiela's green and raw Untitled L'Eau perfume, unfolds a dazzling burst of Citrus freshness. Its simplicity echoes the style of Maison Margiela couture, revisiting yesterday's classics with a twist. Untitled L'Eau resonates with the notes of the original perfume Untitled, but offers another interpretation, celebrating the Citrus aromas, direct and spontaneous, cool and sparkling, compared to the original Untitled perfume which focuses on the cool green notes of Galbanum.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Concentré de Pamplemousse Rose Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: The intense version of Eau de Pamplemousse Rose. Concentré de Pamplemousse Rose was also created in 2009 by perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena. A fruity, citrus composition. Concentré de Pamplemousse Rose mingles the sparkling notes of grapefruit with the delicate notes of rose and lively vetiver. The iconic lantern bottle is adorned with a bright green hue. Around the orange box, a vivid contrasting band recalls its colour. The Hermès Colognes collection offers a playground that is as infinite as it is masterly for explore the sensory nature of materials. It brings immediate and abundant pleasure that unifies beyond genres, fashions, ages or seasons.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Eau de Parfum 100ml Festive Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: This festive season, Chloé draws inspiration from the Art Deco movement. The House revisits a period defined by effervescence. Graphic feathers and golden tones illuminate the gift boxes, recalling a time when celebration was conceived as an art form. Chloé captures the sparkle, the lightness, the joy of daring. A vibrant and feminine Holiday season. Set contains: Chloé Eau de Parfum, 100ml Chloé Eau de Parfum Mini, 5ml Chloé Eau de Parfum Travel Spray, 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's The Bewitching Yasmine Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Yasmine’s sights are set on London – and a suitable match. Her amber fragrance is a voluptuous affair: jasmine, incense, oud. A celebration of all that is gloriously sensual. Who could resist? Key notes: Coffee, Jasmine, Vanilla. "Mouth-watering coffee and cardamom blend with vanilla and oud, whilst dappled with soft white jasmine flowers are rounded off with smoky incense to ensure this bewitching fragrance lingers in the air."

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Woman In Gold Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Kilian Hennessy's Inspiration: A perfume as complex and dazzling as the woman who wears it. The Perfume: The notes conjure, in scent, the delicate gold leafing and play between light and shadow, for which the painting is celebrated. Perfumer Calice Becker. was inspired by the fascinating contrast between the painting’s facets, which she describes as "texturised and brilliant, rich and voluptuous." Its zesty luminosity is the fragrant expression of this brightness. The petal-y rose heart depicts all of the facets of the rose. Finally, vanilla absolute’s unctuosity appears generously in the dry-down, adorned by an exclusive patchouli molecule, the Akigalawood. Perfume notes: Bergamot, Rose, Tonka Bean. Perfumer: Calice Becker.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Citrus Riviera Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Inspiration; 1 - In the south of France, on the heights of Cap d'Antibes. 2 - A stroll in the house garden, followed by a siesta under the lemon tree in the shade. 3 - When the delicacy of sun-drenched citrus blends with the sensuality of white musk. 4 - A fresh, sparkling and energising accord. 5 - A luminous fragrance reminiscent of summer joys shared with loved ones. Top notes: Neroli Essence from Morocco, Mandarin Essence from Italy, Lemon Essence from Italy, Fig Accord Heart notes: Moroccan Orange Blossom Absolute, Jasmine, Strawberry Neo Jungle Essence, Eucalyptus Essence, Immortelle Absolute Background notes: White Musks, Indonesian Patchouli, Haitian Vetiver, Tonka Bean Absolute

listings.rawTitle: BOSS Bottled Absolu Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Exude the utmost sophistication with BOSS Bottled Absolu, a bold Parfum Intense featuring an irresistible roasted signature ingredient. Modern and memorable, this distinctive fragrance is a testament to the power of the BOSS Man, who adds his golden touch to every decision, every challenge, and every success. The Collection The third opus within a trilogy of intensity from BOSS Bottled, this woody-leathery scent instantly commands the senses. It is a captivating BOSS scent, formulated at the fragrance family’s highest concentration yet, building upon its quintessential woody signature with absolute depth – the essence of a BOSS. The Scent Crafted by Annick Menardo in collaboration with Suzy Le Helley, BOSS Bottled Absolu opens smoothly with a textured Leather accord – featuring a roasted facet – harmonised with invigorating Incense essence. At the heart of this BOSS parfum for men, enveloping Patchouli essence and Myrrh absolute elevate the vigour and splendour of this sophisticated scent. Warm Cedarwood and fruity Davana essences at the base leave a lasting, precious trail. The Bottle This unique BOSS Bottled fragrance bottle is rooted in richness with a warm yet bright, amber base – a nod to the nobility of the precious and tempting parfum within. A radiant double-lacquered finish and shiny golden cap complete the exquisite presentation of this woody fragrance for men, which complements the positive mindset of every BOSS. This men's fragrance is intensified by the warmth of your own body.|Apply this BOSS fragrance in the creases of your knees and elbows for a strong woody scent that smells amazing and lasts all day long.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Limited Edition Sauvage Spray for the Wild Eau de Toilette, 30ml
listings.description: To add a touch of couture to the 30ml Sauvage travel bottle, Dior has unveiled a new limited-edition case inspired by one of its most iconic designs. The iconic Sauvage fragrance, now housed in a true couture accessory, your favourite fragrance can join you for every getaway. The 30ml Sauvage bottles are refillable with the corresponding fragrance refill. The case is not sold separately. A radically fresh composition, dictated by a name that has the ring of a manifesto. That was the way François Demachy, DIOR Perfumer-Creator, wanted it: raw and noble all at once. Natural ingredients, selected with extreme care, prevail in excessive doses. Radiant top notes burst with the juicy freshness of Reggio di Calabria Bergamot. Ambroxan, derived from precious ambergris, unleashes a powerfully woody trail. It is an act of creation inspired by wide-open spaces. An ozone-blue sky sprawled above a rocky landscape, white-hot beneath the desert sun.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Eau de Parfum Natural Spray Refillable 30ml
listings.description: Alien Eau de Parfum, a woody floral women’s fragrance by Mugler. Alien Eau de Parfum is an iconic scent by Mugler, a fragrance like no other, the ultimate expression of femininity wrapped in a veil of sensuality. Embodying a Solar Goddess, radiant and sensual, Alien by Mugler diffuses peace with its scent, thanks to its talisman fragrance. The rich and sensual notes of the Alien perfume reveal a feminine force: a powerful floral scent of jasmine linked to woody and amber notes. An elixir of sensuality and femininity faceted around three revelations that merge in total harmony. Olfactory: The first woody-floral feminine fragrance overdosed in Cashmeran Wood and White Amber. An elixir of sensuality and femininity faceted around 3 revelations that merge in total harmony Solar revelation: Alien turns solar, illuminated by Jasmine Sambac from India. A sumptuous sun flower whose fragility contrasts with the power of its perfume. A spiritual offering, a promise of sacred femininity Mysterious revelation: Alien becomes a mystery, sublimated by the sensual notes of Cashmeran Wood. An enigmatic wood characterised by its assertive musky note, an exotic wood heated by an intense sun that captivates the senses Enveloping revelation: Alien is enveloping, enriched with White Amber. Mugler has built a modern and timeless white amber. Exuding sensuality and mystery, the Alien Eau de Parfum bottle is inspired by an amethyst, a symbol of meditation and inner peace, to reveal the radiance and the creative force of every woman. Alien Eau de Parfum is endlessly refillable at the Mugler Fountain or thanks to its Refill Bottle so you never go without it. The Alien Eau de Parfum bottle is a bottle imagined as a talisman charged with natural energy, a precious stone with secret powers. Cut like a talisman, set in gold like a diamond, this amethyst-colored talisman diffuses a soothing and extraordinary radiance. A mystical bottle, precious and timeless at the same time. Mugler is committed to more responsible luxury by offering unique bottles, infinitely refillable at the Mugler Fountain or thanks to the Refill Bottle.

Black pepper opens the composition with a spicy crackle, before resiny incense unfurls, full and luminous, enriched with cardamom and nutmeg. In the background, incense essence, Mediterranean mastic and balsam fir weave an intensely woody signature. A magnetic, luminous, deeply enveloping incense.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Private Blend Myrrhe Mystère Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Myrrhe Mystère captures a richly luminous aura, unlocking the senses through powerfully grounding myrrh essences and a modern Ultra-Vanille accord. This seductive expression of the mystical resin elevates one of perfumery’s most iconic ingredients with a duo of powerful myrrh essences and an exquisite Ultra-Vanille accord, embodying a timeless richness – unlocking a modern serenity.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Verbena Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Good to know: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs is being re-branded, the logo on your products may differ from the photos. The scent is still the same. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs invites you to compose your personalised Chloé fragrance as though arranging your favourite blossoms in a bouquet at a Parisian flower shop. Each perfume in the collection reveals a single floral, aromatic or woody scent rooted in the perfumer’s memory. Wear alone like a corsage or combine endlessly to create a lovely present or a perfume for all occasions. A flower, a perfumer, a story... Verbena, a fresh and delicate perfume for women by Mylène Alran. With this aromatic Eau de Parfum, Mylène Alran recalls the verbena from her parents’ garden that she would rub between her hands as a child to keep the scent with her all day. Verbena brings delicate lemony freshness and a natural radiance to the bouquet for a captivating women's fragrance. This Chloé perfume is housed in an elegant pleated glass bottle topped with an ivory cap that appears to be carved in stone. Touches of gold at the neckband and label trim enhance the light hue of each beautiful fragrance. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists. Wear your favourite flower on its own to celebrate its vitality and intensity, or combine Verbena with other perfumes from Atelier des Fleurs to create a personalised fragrance bouquet. Disclaimer: Packaging may vary but scent remains the same.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle L'Elixir Eau de Parfum Refill, 100ml
listings.description: What if happiness started with you? Let happiness emerge from the place that matters the most: yourself. The moment you realise you are your own source of happiness, everything changes. Be ready for a true act of self-love led by the fearless Julia Roberts. Our first velvety floral. Happiness is in you. It starts with a commitment to yourself. It means having the confidence to follow your intuition and to defy expectations. It's a belief embodied by the fierce human who has never been afraid to follow her desire: true happiness. Now, this exhilarating emotion of pursuing what matters most to you, has a signature scent: La vie est belle L'Elixir. More than a scent, a true emotion. An unexpected sillage built around the clash of a noble violet leaf absolute and a delicious cocoa butter absolute, evoking the liberation that comes with a radical act of self-love. Floral, Fruity, Gourmand. More than a bottle, a crystal statement. It captures L'Elixir's contrast of femininity, in the curves of its crystal smile that emerges from the glass, with the fragrance's boldness, symbolized by the bottle's sharp and sleek silhouette. A refillable crystal masterpiece, designed to keep your happiness forever. What makes it different: Two renowned French perfumers - Christophe Raynaud and Antoine Maisondieu reinvent the scent of happiness. The result? A head-turning and uplifting scent that embraces the most noble ingredients. Reimagined by Suzanne Dalton - a famous glass designer - the iconic La vie est belle's smile speaks to the highest craftsmanship, where for the first time the iconic La vie est belle's smile is engraved in the glass and can be felt under the fingers of the person holding it. How to use: Focus on the pulse points of the body to make perfume last longer. Apply perfume to the neck and the insides of the wrists.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 + Patchouli Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: EM's M+ line adds +1 to Iso E Super, the super aroma molecule that turned the cloistered world of perfumery upside down. Molecule 01 + Patchouli consists of Iso E Super + Patchouli. Iso E Super is an abstract synthetic molecule characterised as a cedarwood note with a warm, velvety cocooning sensation. Patchouli is a natural extract from the leaves of the patchouli plant. A minimal fragrance for maximum impact. Let M+ Patchouli take you for a whiff on the wild side of modern perfumery that will keep admirers second-guessing what you're thinking and wearing. M+ Patchouli is an innovative reimagining of the classic patchouli note enlivened with Molecule 01 with bewitching notes of cedarwood intermingled with the softness of Patchouli Coeur. "Patchouli is a unique natural. Unlike 99% of perfume ingredients, we associate it with a particular period, the sixties and seventies and that bohemian spirit. It has a cool, rather aloof woodiness to it, and I love it for its moody beauty. I've used two qualities of patchouli here. The biggest chunk is Patchouli Coeur, a very clean, soft patchouli oil fraction with the camphor-like top note removed. I have also included a patchouli oil from Indonesia to round it out with a little bit of a top note. The result is a sophisticated, clean patchouli that pairs fantastically well with Molecule 01," says Geza Schoen. This dark, moody beauty, with a musky-earthy aroma profile, blends two qualities of patchouli with the seductive insouciance of Iso E Super, wrapping you in warmth and hovering around you the whole day. How to use: Spritz onto your pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind your ears, as desired, and let it dry naturally.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Black Meisterstück Eau de Parfum, 125ml
listings.description: Encapsulating the essence of writing elegance, the iconic Meisterstück writing instrument inspires a captivating fragrance. Black Meisterstück Eau de Parfum embodies sophistication and grandeur with noble incense and spicy notes, amplified by the captivating sensuality of ambery notes. The exquisite bottle, encased in a sleek glass silhouette reminiscent of a Montblanc ink bottle, exudes elegance and sophistication. A signature metal strip accentuates the bottle's contours, echoing the iconic Meisterstück writing instrument's clip.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau de Toilette, 200ml
listings.description: Created in 2006 by Jean-Claude Ellena, Terre d’Hermès Eau de Toilette connects man to his origins, to the sources of his creative power. It tells the story of man’s relationship with the earth and his dialogue with nature. Since 2016, Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel has been exploring new aspects of this fragrance. A woody, mineral composition, Terre d’Hermès Eau de Toilette combines the power and radiance of cedar and grapefruit notes with a vibrant touch of flint. The base of the bottle is marked with an orange H, as if to leave its imprint on the earth. Its metal shoulders highlight the transparency of the fragrance. The Terre d’Hermès Eau de Toilette bottle unveils a range of details: the Hermès saddle nail, the sliding cover used to release the spray, etc. Designed by Philippe Mouquet, it is inspired by a bottle in a travel vanity case that is conserved at the Emile Hermès Museum.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Althair Coffret Gift Set
listings.description: For this Festive Season, Parfums de Marly invites you on a celestial journey inspired by the first hot-air balloon ascent above the Marly domaine, through this exceptional Althaïr gift set. Elegant, generous, and charismatic, Althaïr blends the sweetness of vanilla, the indulgence of praline, and the radiance of orange blossom. This set includes Althaïr Eau de Parfum 125ml and two 10ml travel sizes.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Haltane Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: "Haltane is a fragrance for a gentleman of today, inspired by the gentilhommes of the Chateau de Marly in the 18th century." Julien Sprecher, Founder and Artistic Director of Parfums de Marly. Haltane is an original scent of both radiance and shadow. Its composition features a blend of rare and noble ingredients which revisit the tradition of 18th-century French perfume making. Its dazzling freshness and herbal top notes quickly yield a warm and smooth sense of leather with a symphony of precious woods. Soft and sweet, escorted by saffron, its praline accord is an ultra-contemporary spin on the mythical oud wood. Agarwood emerges in this veil of contrasts and imprints the skin with luminous refinement for enduring comfort. A privilege that is all about sensation. Ofactive notes: Top notes: Bergamot, Lavender, Clary Sage Heart notes: Saffron, Cedarwood, Praline, Oudwood Base notes: Patchouli, Vetiver, Musk, Leather, Natural Agarwood The composition of Haltane is an ode to the finest ingredients. Precious woods are emblematic ingredients of Haute Parfumerie, but they are also an evocation of the wonders of nature and a homage to the forests surrounding the Château de Marly. This castle was designed to blend into nature and King Louis XV had an extreme fascination for it, spending entire days in the woods.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Baie 19 Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Truth is...Baie 19 should have been called Water 19. Not that it smells like nothing (though nothing smells like it), but it has this crisp, wet, drenched effect that water gives to the earth after the rain...And there’s a word for that, by the way: petrichor. It’s that magical feeling during heavy rain after a long dry spell, and it’s one of the most beautiful olfactive phenomena in nature. There are many reasons for this, including the ozone in the air, the negative ions, but most importantly the release of oil secretions from certain plants, accumulated after a long dry period. This is what Baie 19 is about: the dry juniper berry, the patchouli, the green leaves... all soaked by a beautiful, luminous, magnetic rain after a long drought. And the joy that comes with it...

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Forte Rosa Palissandro Eau de Parfum, 125ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Rosa Palissandro Forte, the spicy freshness of rosewood meets both the delicacy of rose and the intensity of patchouli. The flower and wood combine to give a fragrance blending strength and sophistication. "Rosa Palissandro Forte is a homage to the beauty of rosewood. A fresh wood with floral and spicy tones, paired with the intensity of patchouli and sandalwood, wrapped in an elegant vine of roses." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. Aqua Allegoria Forte, the intense collection, is a warm and enveloping journey to the heart of the world’s wonders: Eaux de Parfum celebrating the intense beauty of nature, revealed by the golden rays of a setting sun. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria Forte fragrances contain more than 90% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The 200ml refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75ml and 125ml bottles. *In accordance with ISO 16128, calculation including water. How to use: Create your own olfactory signature by pairing Rosa Palissandro Forte with Rosa Rossa, Flora Cherrysia or Granada Salvia. Select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy	Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extrême 60ml
listings.description: Givenchy proudly introduces new Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extrême for Men, a woody floral spicy fragrance designed for the fearless individuals who set their own standards. Embodying the essence of a modern Gentleman, this Eau de Parfum pushes olfactory boundaries to the extreme with an intense and sophisticated trail. A daring community: There are many ways to be a Gentleman. Join Givenchy’s Gentleman Society with a new masculine Eau de Parfum that gathers a community of thrill-seeking members who strive for excellence, shatter limits, and venture fearlessly into the unknown. Crafted with exceptional raw materials and Givenchy's renowned savoir-faire, this men’s fragrance marks the start of a new olfactory chapter in the Gentleman Society. A powerful and captivating new signature: This new Eau de Parfum reinvents the iconic Gentleman Society signature with a spicy twist, for a magnetic and deeply masculine trail. Top notes of Clary Sage and ice-cold Peppermint contrast with the warm and fiery notes of Nutmeg. The heart reveals the unique Gentleman Society accord, a combination of Narcissus Absolute and Iris Concrete, blended with a Vetiver Quartet. Unexpectedly, Coffee Extract Absolute emerges from this accord, enhanced by Peppermint Essence to reveal its deepest, most intense facets. This deliciously roasted note becomes even more addictive with the unfurling base notes of Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Patchouli Essence, and Vanilla Absolute, leaving a deep and lasting impression. A rallying symbol: Inspired by couture, the iconic Gentleman Society bottle is revisited to highlight the exhilarating facets of the fragrance within. With a deep black lacquer finish, the bottle is adorned with the Givenchy 4G logo in a striking gunmetal finish. An emblem of the Gentleman Society, unmistakably Givenchy. Moreover, the Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extrême bottle is made from 15% post-consumer recycled glass. Join the Gentleman Society. It’s not a place, it’s a state of mind. Fragrance family: Woody Floral Spicy. Head notes: Essence of Clary Sage France & Eastern Europe, Essence of Peppermint USA & China, Essence of Nutmeg Indonesia Heart notes: Concrete of Orris France, Absolute of Narcissus France, Absolute of Coffee Extract Ethiopia, Quartet of Vetiver (Madagascar, Uruguay, Haiti) extract Haïti, Essence of vetiver Uruguay, Organic essence of Vetiver Madagascar Base notes: Organic Essence of Cedarwood Himalaya India, Organic Essence of Sandalwood Australia, Absolute of Tasuki Vanilla Madagascar

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Limited Edition Aqua Allegoria Perle Rosa Rossa Eau de Parfum, 125ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Rosa Rossa Perle, the first micro-pearl Eau de Parfum*. Designed to be halfway between fragrance and skincare, Rosa Rossa Perle captures the pleasure of a freshly picked rose in an innovative water-based micro-pearl formula. This pioneering technology* combines the intensity of highly concentrated perfume micro-pearls with the hydrating effects of an alcohol-free aqueous base. Exalted by the freshness of water, Rosa Rossa is revealed in a new light. On the skin, it conjures up the delicacy of a freshly picked rose still covered in dew. Sparkling blackcurrant and lychee notes blend with the juicy and tangy radiance of mandarin. Infused with rose water, the composition highlights the powdery and enveloping accents of the flower, which blossoms in the musky facets of sandalwood. A tender and luminous ode to the queen of flowers. Perfumes that become one with skin, Aqua Allegoria Perle fragrances combine the intensity of an Eau de Parfum with the effect of hydrating skincare. In this new-generation water-based fragrance*, the perfume is captured inside micro-pearls composed of naturally-derived alginate in an alcohol-free aqueous base. Enriched with plant-based glycerine, its gel texture melts into skin in a single step. It leaves a soft and velvety veil with beautifying and hydrating effects on the skin. *At Guerlain. How to use: A highly sensory new perfume step. Sprayed onto pulse points, the neck, décolleté and wrists, the perfume is diffused in a generous mist. Its soft and enveloping texture melts onto skin when lightly massaged in circular movements.

listings.description: Blast of Tea... For this creation, Van Cleef & Arpels draws her inspiration from a peaceful stroll through tea plantation in the early morning. A sensational fragrance featuring complex nuanced for an emotionally charged creation. The elements intermingle in perfect alchemy... A tea that is both green and floral with bright notes of bergamot and peppermint complemented by the spicy accent of pink peppercorn, which introduces a timelessly elegant bouquet of rose and sweet pea. Her velvety and enveloping base of white musk and cashmeran, comes to warm up the fragrance bringing depth and singular sillage to this unique Eau de Parfum, Thé Amara.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Power of You Eau de Parfum For Her 30ml
listings.description: Discover Power Of You Eau de Parfum for her, by Emporio Armani. Captured in a ruby-toned, jewel-like bottle, Power of You encapsulates your new gourmand obsession - a sensual concentrate created to be worn from day to night. The fragrance opens with a captivating passion fruit accord, evoking the fruit's purest essence. At the very heart of the composition, the fragrance finds its radiant soul: a transparent frangipani flower accord, which reverberates through the fragrance, creating warmth and sweetness. A sensual depth then emerges: a creamy vanilla absolute from Madagascar is beautifully woven with the nuanced, caramel-like sweetness of benzoin resinoid. More than a scent, this is a fragrance that instantly owns the space of its projected, radiant halo, inspiring others to embrace their own power. The ruby-toned flacon proudly crowns this fragrance as a jewel. Power of You: a day to night exotic radiance.

listings.description: Thé Noir 29 is an ode to the noble leaf and the craft that surrounds it. Thé Noir 29 combines depth and freshness, softness and strength through permanent oscillation between the light of bergamot, fig and bay leaves and the depth of cedar wood, vetiver and musk. A special extraction of black tea leaves wraps up the composition by bringing to the formula a dry, leafy, hay, tobacco feeling in the dry down to transform this creation into a sensuous and addictive essence.

listings.rawTitle: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Santal Blanc Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: The House of Van Cleef & Arpel's couture perfumery collection 'Collection Extraordinaire' is an exquisite collection of rare and luxurious fragrances. The beauty of nature, which is always a major source of inspiration for Van Cleef & Arpels High Jewellery, is elementary to these compositions. Symbolising purity, softness, and perfect balance, White is a truly inspiring theme for the Collection, whose values are based on minimalism and olfactory excellence. This approach gives rise to the new fragrance: Santal Blanc. A velvety texture for a marvellous Sandalwood. Combined with a note of fig milk and a delicate powdery musk, its trail reveals a tender addiction...

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Les Sommets Collection Bois Rouge Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: A fragrance capturing the essence and intensity of woods. A woody ambery accord blends with a trio of deep and powerful accords: cypriol, patchouli and cedarwood. Saffron, known as 'red-gold', warms the composition with its rich, flamboyant spiciness, whilst cashmeran and cristal moss bring their elegant mineral inflections.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Le Gemme Orom Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Discover Bvlgari Le Gemme Orom, an intense woody and ambery fragrance crafted around the finest vanilla bourbon absolute and precious oud assam essence. Explore Madagascar, an island full of treasures where magical Labradorite hides beyond the shimmering greens and blues of its coastlines. A breathtaking gemstone, known as 'the rainbow gemstone' for its iridescent blue, green and gold shades, Labradorite is said to capture the colourful and magical powers of nature, as fascinating as the Aurora Borealis. It reflects light like a magical mirror and its colours resemble iridescent peacock feathers, which are also emblematic of Madagascar. The stone transforms its energy into a protective shield, inspiring its wearer to connect to their highest self. Bvlgari Le Gemme Orom is an exceptional fragrance that reflects the duality of exquisite vanilla and the juxtaposition of its virile strength with caressing sensuality. A raw jewel created by Master Perfumer Sophie Labbé. With its notes of deep leather, where the finest, exquisite pearls of vanilla bourbon caviar absolute intertwine with the richness of precious oud assam essence, to bring the magic of Labradorite to life, through a contrasted woody and ambery signature. Olfactive family: Woody, Amber. Olfactive pyramid: Vanilla Bourbon Absolute, Oud Assam Essence.

listings.rawTitle: Aesop Hwyl Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Aesop s third fragrance, Hwyl Eau de Parfum is an intriguing scent evoking the verdancy and stillness of an ancient Japanese forest. Opening on smoky notes, the fragrance clears into aromas of wood, moss and subtle spices.

listings.rawTitle: Aesop Hwyl Eau de Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Oud for Greatness Body Cream
listings.description: This cream pulses with the sacred force of Oud for Greatness. Desire for conquest ignites and greatness becomes reality, it melts into the skin, releasing the depth of oud, that inspires and elevates. Notes: natural oud wood, agar wood oil, lavender, saffron, patchouli, musk.

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS Bottled Striking Lavender Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Fuel your summer energy with BOSS Bottled Striking Lavender: a new freshness that scores big. With oversized yet refined surges of lavender, this limited-edition fragrance sets the day in motion with a bold new rhythm. Charged with intensity, this scent kicks the senses into action with crisp mineral notes. With an unexpected duo of lavender, this fougère-woody Eau de Parfum combines fresh power with clean, aromatic facets. Crafted by master perfumer Honorine Blanc and principal perfumer Sophie Labbé, BOSS Bottled Striking Lavender opens with white lavender essence for a bright, herbaceous hit. Vibrant blue lavender essence pulses through the heart, amplifying its masculine elegance with soft warmth. A moss accord forms an earthy base, grounding this impactful scent with a depth that nods to the woody olfactive signature of the original BOSS Bottled fragrances. The iconic BOSS Bottled glass is refreshed in a radiant blue double-lacquered finish, evoking the playful summer mood of the fragrance. Silver hot-foiled lettering and a glossy black cap round off this confident, limited-edition scent. How to use: The fragrance is intensified by the warmth of your own body. Apply BOSS Bottled Striking Lavender Eau de Parfum for Men in the creases of your knees and elbows for a longer-lasting, stronger scent.

listings.description: Inspired by tasting an infusion of hibiscus petals in the heart of a gemstone market, Hibiscus Majahad is a flamboyant, shimmering creation that glows with ruby red rose, crushed pomegranate and crystal clean mint, warmed by vanilla and amber. The first extrait in the Maison Crivelli collection takes you beyond the ordinary and into a colourful haze of sensual delights.

An everlasting salted mineral accord meets aromatic cypress of the eternal winner, and the opulence of vanilla caviar. An olfactive signature crafted for the undefeated hero as he scales new heights to snatch the golden trophy and celebrate his sporting success.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain L’Heure Bleue Eau de Parfum Refill, 200ml
listings.description: Between day and night, a deep blue embraces the sky: it is the blue hour. A moment with an electrifying effect, when everything shifts, and anything becomes possible. Inspired by this natural phenomenon, L’Heure Bleue Eau de Parfum captures the scent of the sky in this moment suspended in time. An amber floral perfume with an addictive fragrance trail. The crystalline freshness of the sky meets the velvety softness of iris and vanilla. An invitation to make every moment a “blue hour”: an hour when anything is possible. "I wanted to capture the blue hour with the same tenderness as Jacques Guerlain’s L’Heure Bleue in 1912. It’s a perfume that enfolds us in its powerful yet gentle and intimate scent," Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Director of Perfume Creation and Perfumer. A real Guerlain icon, the inverted heart bottle, the original bottle for L’Heure Bleue in 1912, has now been revisited. Adorned in a gradation of blue, like a fragment of sky between day and night, it is distinguished by its name in gold lettering. A jewel bottle, fashioned with precision and topped with a ring embellished with blue. A precious object designed to be refilled and stand the test of time. The 200ml refill extends the life of your L’Heure Bleue bottle without compromising on quality. The spray can be unscrewed by hand, allowing the bottle to be easily refilled using a user-friendly, anti-drip system. This refill cannot be used on its own. It is compatible with the rechargeable L’Heure Bleue bottles in 30ml, 50ml, and 100ml formats.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Limited Edition Born in Roma Ruby Uomo Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: Born in Roma Ruby Uomo Eau de Toilette is the new Valentino Beauty limited-edition fragrance for men, revealing a woody, fruity gourmand scent. Created for Holiday 2026, the Born in Roma Ruby Uomo Eau de Toilette brings a new red expression to the colourful Born in Roma collection, with a bold yet addictive fragrance for those who are drawn to vibrant contrasts and collector editions. The fragrance is built around three notes: Top notes: Raspberry accord, juicy and velvety with an intense red burst Heart notes: Lavender heart, aromatic and refined with a sophisticated floral trail Base notes: Woody cream accord, smooth and enveloping with warm gourmand depth Born in Roma Ruby Uomo Eau de Toilette is part of the Rendez-Vous Editions, the annual limited-edition chapter of Born in Roma. Created for Holiday 2026, it is a collector fragrance designed for the holiday season and available while stocks last.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Nahema Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: For almost two centuries, Guerlain has been a story of fragrance and beauty, legacy and creation, daring and exploration, heritage and the future. Our roots enrich the present and inspire the future. With more than 1,100 fragrances created since 1828 by five generations of perfumers, our heritage is unique. The Legendary fragrance collection pays tribute to this exceptional heritage. Nahema is part of Guerlain's Patrimoine Collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by 5 generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library, that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Nahema is an enigmatic elixir whose muse is an Amber rose with spellbinding charm. Its main olfactory note gradually transforms into a haunting presence. It took its creator four years to develop this rich and sumptuous women's fragrance. Designed by Georges Chevalier, its iconic 'inverted heart' bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever Eau de Parfum 40ml
listings.description: I Want Choo Forever, an intoxicating chypre ambery gourmand, celebrates energy and intensity, thanks to a particular blend of ingredients. On top, a powerful rose has been amalgamated with a spicy pink peppercorn to denote attraction. The heart is a potent black cherry liquor, seductive jasmine sambac and warm feminine vetiver. Finally, earthy moss, vanilla and tonka bean are combined to make this delicious scent truly addictive. The scent leaves a mysterious trail that endures all night. Encapsulating the essence of boldness and glamour of the Jimmy Choo house, this enchanting fragrance will become the backdrop to your most memorable evenings. Sophisticated and fun, it captures a playful spirit and the atmosphere of a moment of fun ahead of what is sure to be an exciting evening.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Private Blend Bitter Peach Eau de Parfum Atomiser, 10ml
listings.description: Intoxicating Pêche de Vigne and Sicilian Blood Orange Oil release the slick sweetness of Bitter Peach at its luscious peak. Spiked with the lavish spiciness of Cardamom Oil, the impression of explicitly ripe and voluptuous flesh is brought to life. A sumptuously sensual heart reveals itself through the almond bitterness of Heliotrope fused with Davana Oil – both drenched in heady Rum Absolute and Cognac Oil. Jasmin Absolute Sambac delivers an uninhibited exploration of desire. The final depth ignites inner sensuality and abandon. A sumptuous mélange of Sandalwood Absolute, Benzoin Resinoid and Cashmeran erupt into a rich drydown, while the sultry luxury of Vanilla and Tonka Bean Absolute interlace with Labdanum Absolute. With a surge of Patchouli Oil Indonesia, this climax extends Bitter Peach’s addictive power. Fragrance notes: Peche de Vigne. Blood Orange. Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau de Parfum Refillable 30ml
listings.description: Embark on an outdoor adventure with Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild, a bold and feminine fragrance for women. The scent: Jasmine, vetiver, and notes of banana blossom capture the irresistible essence of nature, sparking a sense of discovery. The new refillable Eau de Parfum exudes a fresh fragrance reminiscent of a wildflower bouquet. It inspires you to reconnect with nature and embody your young, free-spirited self. About the bottle: The fragrance bottle has been reimagined in a mesmerising shade of light green, adorned with pink and green signature Daisy flowers around the cap. Inside the bottle, flower stems peep through – a playful nod to the Daisy Wild blooming wilderness. On the perfume’s box is a charming ‘overgrown’ flower border, further playing on the untamed beauty of the juice. Refillable format: For the first time ever, the Daisy fragrance is fully refillable. All the Daisy Wild Marc Jacobs fragrances can be refilled with a 150ml sustainable refill format.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Perseus Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: "Perseus’s secret lies in the novel blending of very classic men’s fragrance ingredients — notably the brightness of grapefruit, which contrasts immediately with an elegant, woody facet." Julien Sprecher, founder and artistic director of the Maison. Perseus evokes early morning at the royal residence of Marly, at the moment when the sun’s first rays waken the château, warm its gardens and make its fountains sparkle. A sun-kissed perfume, it celebrates the radiance of citrus and boosts energy. A luminous and refreshing creation, combined with a long-lasting sillage, to revitalise both body and spirit. The fragrance is characterised by a pink grapefruit citrus accord and a vetiver heart that come to life the moment they meet. The former immediately invigorates, its freshness electrifying the skin. At the same time, the earthy facet of the vetiver is revealed, refined, comforting and sensual. Perseus’s trail is further enriched by ambergris and long-lasting dry woods. A unique morning ritual for a day of endless sunshine. Top notes: Bergamot, Grapefruit, Blackcurrant Bud Heart notes: Dry Woods, Cashmere Wood, Ambergris Accord Base notes: Balsam Fir, Woody Spices, Tonka Bean How to use: Best time to wear: In the morning for a boost of energy to last an entire summer's day.

listings.description: A mad idea: capture the scent of the shop at 34 Boulevard Saint-Germain and make it into a perfume. The olfactory soul of the boutique is there: a kaleidoscope of scents bringing together all of Diptyque's candles and fragrances. With the advent of advanced technology, Diptyque has become a thief of scents.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Florabloom Forte Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Florabloom Forte, a fragrance showcasing irresistibly addictive tuberose at sunset, a carnal Grasse Centifolia rose, and the warming notes of intensely powdery violet and iris. All amid an absolutely rich, multicoloured bouquet underpinned with bold sandalwood and velvety moss. Inspired by a rare natural phenomenon known as a superbloom, this creation evokes the multicoloured carpets of desert flowers that so spectacularly spring to life after heavy rainfall. "Florabloom is a celebration of the power and beauty of nature, that’s both wild and poetic." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. Aqua Allegoria Forte, the intense collection, is a warm and enveloping journey to the heart of the world’s wonders: Eaux de Parfum celebrating the intense beauty of nature, revealed by the golden rays of a setting sun. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria Forte fragrances contain more than 90% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The Aqua Allegoria fragrances are housed in a screw-top, refillable bottle made in France from at least 15% recycled glass. The 200ml refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75ml and 125ml bottles. *In accordance with ISO 16128, calculation including water. How to use: Create your own signature fragrance by combining Florabloom Forte with either Nettare di Sole, Pera Granita, Rosa Palissandro Forte or Santal Royal. For the ideal amount of fragrance, simply choose your preferred pairing from the collection and spray in equal quantities.

The 200ml refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75ml and 125ml bottles. *In accordance with ISO 16128, calculation including water. How to use: Create your own signature fragrance by combining Florabloom Forte with either Nettare di Sole, Pera Granita, Rosa Palissandro Forte or Santal Royal. For the ideal amount of fragrance, simply choose your preferred pairing from the collection and spray in equal quantities.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Mediterranean Honeysuckle Figue Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: The scent story: Celebrate the beauty of a dolce far niente moment. A Mediterranean summer day spent in a sun-filled garden surrounded by blooming fig trees. The sun’s warmth reveals the scent of sweet, sun-ripened Fig, deliciously blended with sparkling Italian Bergamot and blooming Honeysuckle. Infused with summery Musk and a touch of Jasmine, Mediterranean Honeysuckle Figue is a beautiful olfactory expression of a dreamy Mediterranean garden. The fragrance collection: AERIN's Fragrance Collection is a wardrobe of distinctive perfumes inspired by Aerin's own travels, experiences and memories. Mediterranean Honeysuckle Figue is a fruity solar fragrance inspired by the warmth of a leisurely summer day. Aerin's inspiration: "My newest fragrance, limited-edition Mediterranean Honeysuckle Figue, reminds me of relaxing in a garden during a late summer afternoon. With blossoming honeysuckles and sweet ripened figs, it truly captures the essence of a sun-drenched Mediterranean holiday." Aerin Lauder, Founder and Creative Director, AERIN. Fragrance Notes: Bergamot, Fig, Violet Leaves. Fragrance Family: Fruity Solar. How to use: Spritz Eau de Parfum over the body where desired.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Sì Passione Intense Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Passion. In everything that you do, passion comes from the heart. It is the driving force that ignites your soul and fuels your actions. This ambery-floral fruity fragrance showcases the many facets of jasmine, Mr Armani’s flower of passion. First, it shines bright with juicy pear notes, like a dazzling beginning. As the fragrance evolves, the jasmine takes on a new dimension, becoming intensely floral and captivating. Jasmine finally embraces warmth and sensuality, entwined with the comforting notes of vanilla, igniting a feeling of passion like never experienced before. Top notes: blackcurrant and pear Heart notes: jasmine super infusion Base notes: vanilla & woody moss This scent is encapsulated in the iconic Si bottle, specifically designed like a vibrant heartbeat. A bottle decorated with passion-red lacquering along with a gentle ombré gradient that mirrors the fragrance’s emotional rush and rise of passion. Crafted with a unique savoir-faire, this precious bottle is refillable, embodying a commitment to lasting beauty and sustainability. Discover the scent that makes your heartbeat. Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: Fragrance Du Bois Siberian Rose Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Created by perfumer Shadi Samra, Siberian Rose pays tribute to the wild rose that grows in one of the harshest landscapes on earth and is as soft and sensual as the velvety petals of this aromatic flower. Opening with fruity spicy top notes of cinnamon, juniper, crisp pear and pink pepper, the perfume then takes the wearer on a floral journey, led by a white Siberian rose paired with tuberose and sumptuous ylang-ylang. A rich and sensual touch of leather evokes a wintery Siberian landscape before a harmonious base of patchouli, amber and moss rounds out this rich, sensuous Floral fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Les Infusions de Prada Iris Cèdre Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Each Infusion fragrance in the Prada collection, is a poetic interpretation of a single, natural ingredient. Woody and spicy, Infusion de Cedre Eau de Parfum, delicately recaptures the beauty of Cedre, creating an elegant, modern and unique, unisex composition. This charming fragrance combines peppery Incense with a woody cedar, zesty mandarin and a warm benzoin base. The perfect gift for a loved one, or signature perfume for yourself.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Les Légendaires Mitsouko Eau de Toilette, 75ml
listings.description: For almost two centuries, Guerlain has been a story of fragrance and beauty, legacy and creation, daring and exploration, heritage and the future. Our roots enrich the present and inspire the future. With more than 1,100 fragrances created since 1828 by five generations of perfumers, our heritage is unique. The Legendary fragrance collection pays tribute to this exceptional heritage. Mitsouko is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by five generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Jacques Guerlain named his creation 'Mitsouko' after the name of the heroine in the bestselling novel of that time called La Bataille. Mitsouko, a beautiful married Japanese woman, secretly loves a British officer. In 1905, the Russo-Japanese war breaks out. Mitsouko awaits with dignity the outcome of the battle, nobly dominating her feelings. Jacques Guerlain had the incredible and daring idea of combining a chypre with a very fruity peach note, giving this fragrance all of its modernity. Designed by Georges Chevalier, its iconic 'inverted heart' bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Sel d'Argent Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Inspiration: 1 - Late afternoon on the beach, watching the silver reflections on the indigo water. 2 - A feeling of calm and voluptuousness, the smell of salt on the skin still warm. 3 - Southern air, transparent and marine. 4 - A Mediterranean getaway, an enchanted interlude. 5 - After the soothing feeling of spending a sweet moment, memories remain for eternity. Top notes: Essence of Italian Bergamot, Grapefruit, Salty Accord Heart notes: Moroccan Orange Blossom Absolute, Jasmine, Strawberry Neo Jungle Essence, Eucalyptus Essence, Immortelle Absolute Background notes: Ambroxan, Cashmeran, Timbersilk, White Musks

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani / Privé Orangerie Venise Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: Winner of The Fragrance Foundation UK 2020 Awards - 'Best New Men's Fragrance in limited distribution'. Discover Armani/Privé Orangerie Venise, a unisex, long-lasting cologne revolving around the bitter orange tree, inspired by an enchanting Venetian Orangery. Orangerie Venise is an invitation to discover an enchanted Venetian Orangery, a heaven of tranquillity protecting verdant and juicy treasures. Giorgio Armani wanted to create an elegant and long-lasting cologne, drawing on the different facets of the bitter orange tree. Its fruit is translated into fresh and bitter citrus notes, its flowers into luminous notes of Neroli essence and its wood into a distinguished drydown. Zesty facets supplemented by woody notes create a burst of freshness, conveying the opulence of nature. Citrus Woody Aromatic, Fresh, Fruity, Long-lasting, Elegant Key Notes: Bitter oranger, Neroli Essence, Wood The golden plate adorns the transparent glass, revealing a crisp and zesty yellow juice How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow or neck.

listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums Velvet Iris by Dominique Ropion Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: A green woody orris draped in carnal sensuality. The fragrance blossoms with a spicy herbaceous breath of buchu, pink pepper and turmeric, offering a vibrant and luminous opening. At its heart, a sumptuous orris unfolds its powdery petals elegantly contrasted by the crisp green facets of galbanum and lentisque. Softly, the orris softens into a velvety caress, seamlessly blending with a supple suede accord and the creamy embrace of amber woods. Labdanum enriches the composition, weaving a golden resinous depth into the trail.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Diamonds Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: The Perfume For Her. A perfume inspired by both the past and the present, the traditional and the modern. A perfume that reflects the sparkle, strength, brilliance and sexiness of the Emporio Armani woman. The sensory blend is a surprising gourmand perfume for women to give a stone a flavour and to a woman a self-confident and audacious feeling. The rose, a symbol of femininity is made edible and succulent through the addition of a touch of litchi and raspberry. Of course, an Emporio Armani sexiness is achieved through the combination of woods and amber. A sparkling, juicy, irresistible, absolutely feminine and assertive perfume for women is born. The precious scent is encased in a sculpted, sparkling block of glimmering glass. Engraved at its centre, the unmistakable Emporio Armani eagle. A diamond in your palm, accessible, immediate, truly a girl’s best friend. Discover the power of two with Emporio Armani Diamonds For Men Eau de Toilette. Looking for something fresher? Try Emporio Armani Diamonds Rose eau de toilette. Fragrance family: Fruity Floral. Top Notes: Lychee, raspberry Heart Notes: Rose, lily of the valley, patchouli, freesia Base Notes: Vetiver, amber, vanilla

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau de Parfum Refillable 30ml
listings.description: Introducing MY WAY; the new feminine fragrance by Giorgio Armani. Giorgio Armani, designer of timeless fragrances, unveils its new fragrance; MY WAY. Through meaningful connections to others, one finds the path to the truest version of oneself. I AM WHAT I LIVE: MY WAY is inspired by the genuine search for meaning and authenticity that lies outside oneself, ultimately creating a more profound way of being. Through the influence of serendipitous encounters and new experiences, one discovers one's own multifaceted depths. Intimate yet universal, “I am what I live” encapsulates this ethos. FINDING ON HER OWN PATH: A fragrance for a new generation, MY WAY encapsulates curiosity and connections, embodied by a woman looking for experiences that challenge her preconceptions and take her into new, unchartered territory. She seeks out meaningful, authentic ways of connecting with others. Through truly learning from others, she reinvents and finds herself. Embodied by authentic and unfiltered beauty, actor Adria Arjona. She is curious and open. Learning from others, whilst discovering the world is how she forms a stronger sense of self. “You can take anything away from me, but you can't take away what I've lived” Adria Arjona, Global Ambassador for MY WAY. CAPTURING MEANINGFUL ENCOUNTERS OF THE WORLD: MY WAY is a contemporary floral fragrance with a fusion of white flowers at its heart. The fragrance is composed of the finest natural ingredients: Vanilla is sourced from Madagascar through an inclusive program that benefits local communities, while the Tuberose is harvested in India. In creating the notes, craftsmanship meets innovation, as the Tuberose heart is extracted using molecular distillation, allowing the perfumers to select the creamy, velvety facets tailor-made for MY WAY. The Orange blossom note is extracted in Egypt using an innovative, exclusive and entirely natural enfleurage process, whose cold extraction method infuses the Orange flowers in Orange essence. The artisanal approach finally translates in the manual weighing and blending of the fragrance's concentrate in Grasse creates pure, highly-refined notes with enhanced radiance and naturality. Created by Master perfumer Carlos Benaïm and senior perfumer Bruno Jovanovic (IFF). CAPTURING LIVED EXPERIENCES IN A BOTTLE: MY WAY's sleek design and transparent glass, combined with vibrant pink juice, explore the multiple facets of femininity and gives light and luminosity. The deep blue rounded cap, a new interpretation of the iconic Armani stone, acts as a metaphor for the planet and encapsulates all of ones experiences with others. With a golden ring around the cap and real rich fabric around the collar, creating a timeless couture accessory. An elegant bottle of true Armani contrasts acting as a talisman as you find your own path. Storytelling and precious, but also responsible. Exemplifying Giorgio Armani beauty's commitment to the environment, the MY WAY bottle reinvents fine fragrance for a more sustainable future. Created with an innovative and seamless refill system, with all its components recyclable, MY WAY's bottle makes it effortless to both reduce waste and recycle more. CAPTURING A LIVED EXPERIENCE: Directed and photographed by Hunter & Gatti, the MY WAY campaign captures Adria Arjona's adventure, with the Spanish creative duo following her as she experiences meaningful encounters with people and places around the world. More than a campaign, the unretouched film is a live experience capturing Adria as she arrives at these authentic moments of connection with others, through the rituals of their diverse cultures. The introduction of MY WAY also reflects Giorgio Armani's long-standing commitment to sustainability, through actions such as its innovative, refillable and recyclable flacon, and opens a new era of sustainability with a new ambition: fight against climate change. Fragrance Family: Floral. Top Notes: Bergamot From Calabria & Orange Blossom From Egypt Heart Notes: Tuberose & Jasmine From India Base Notes: Cedarwood From Virginia, Vanilla From Madagascar & White Musks Key Notes: A bright floral bouquet of tuberose, jasmine and orange blossom enhanced by a vibrant cedarwood and a warm vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley-Paris Eau De Campagne Perfumed Bath and Shower Phytogel, 250ml
listings.description: Eau de Campagne Perfumed Bath and Shower Phytogel is a foaming gel enriched with softening and toning plant-based extracts (Red Vine, Pineappleweed and Carrot) that takes care of the skin: it cleanses perfectly without drying, leaving the skin soft and perfumed with the notes of Eau de Campagne. It gives a pleasant sensation of well-being. Usage tips: To be used as a shower gel or as a bath foam. A small amount is enough to obtain a delicate creamy lather. Results: The skin is clean, soft, toned and perfumed.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Black Orchid Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The most potent version of Black Orchid ever made, Black Orchid Parfum amplifies the iconic sensuality of the original. Its effect elevates the most elusive and darkest of flowers to powerfully seductive new heights – revealing a magnified signature of potent ylang-ylang flowers dipped in golden rum. Created exclusively for Tom Ford, the Tom Ford black orchid was born of his quest for “the perfect flower – luxurious, elegant, pure and sophisticated.” New Black Orchid Parfum offers an amplified presence of the precious essential oil – revealing new olfactive dimensions where hypnotic black orchid and ylang-ylang are heightened, and luscious black plum becomes even more pronounced. Celebrating the impact of the seductive innovation, the Parfum is presented with an all-over gold flacon, from plaque to cap. Striking since its inception, the fragrance continues to envelop all genders in a world of its own.

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Can’t Get Enough Eau de Parfum, 90ml
listings.description: A gourmand floral creation designed to trigger obsession and craving. At its heart, a shot of caramel and vanilla that hits like pure sugar, sweet, decadent, and addictive. An overdose of hedione intensifies the desire, wrapping each note in a sensual, irresistible embrace. Can’t Get Enough is a cycle of indulgence. Once you start, you always want more. Feel it. Want it. Again and again.

listings.rawTitle: Fresh Sugar Lychee Eau de Parfum
listings.description: A luscious and sweetened heart of fruity lychee. Find a serene moment to warm your soul with our Sugar Lychee Eau de Parfum, featuring a luscious and sweetened heart of fruity lychee. This warm, lightweight fragrance is infused with sandalwood and amber notes and enclosed in an apothecary-style glass bottle. "Dreaming of a serene moment after spring showers, fresh lychee glistens against the backdrop field of lime blossom as mottled light infused with amber comforts your soul." Lev Glazman, Fresh co-founder.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Higher Energy Eau De Toilette Spray, 100ml
listings.description: A young, urban fragrance created for the man who is always open to new perspectives and horizons, composed around a harmony of fresh, woody and spicy notes of grapefruit, pepper and vetiver. Luminous and vibrant.

listings.rawTitle: Memo Paris Eau de Parfum Discovery Fragrance Gift Set, 7 x 1.5ml
listings.description: This Discovery kit gathers seven of our key best-sellers for him to better approach the travelling soul that is specific to our brand. Set contains: Odéon Eau de Parfum, 1.5ml Palais Bourbon Eau de Parfum, 1.5ml Madura Eau de Parfum, 1.5ml Marfa Eau de Parfum, 1.5ml Irish Leather Eau de Parfum, 1.5ml African Leather Eau de Parfum, 1.5ml French Leather Eau de Parfum, 1.5ml

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin à Cythère Perfumed Hair Mist, 30ml
listings.description: Creation: Un Jardin à Cythère is reinvented as a perfumed hair mist, offering a multi-sensory tour of the Peloponnese. The light, airy texture delicately perfumes and enhances the hair. Olfactory notes: Un Jardin à Cythère is a woody citrus fragrance that combines an enveloping character reminiscent of grasslands with the power of olive wood and the tenderness of fresh pistachio. Formula: The formula is suitable for all hair types, with active ingredients that leave hair visibly shinier, softer and silkier without adding weight or drying it out. Object: The bottle was designed by Fred Rawyler and inspired by the lanterns on the horse-drawn carriages of days gone by. The glass features a lively frosted effect in yellow hues that evoke brilliant sunlight. It comes in a 30ml size: the ideal travel format, and a great way to prolong the scent of Un Jardin à Cythère throughout the day. How to use: Spray onto the hair from around 40cm, using a circular motion. Alternatively, spray onto a hairbrush For a more bespoke trail, nourish the lengths and ends of the hair with Un Jardin à Cythère hair and body dry oil before spraying For the full sensory experience, scent a few pulse points with Un Jardin à Cythère Eau de Toilette

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS The Scent Elixir Parfum Intense for Her 30ml
listings.description: The fragrance: Inflame the senses with BOSS The Scent Elixir for Her, a hypnotic, highly concentrated Parfum Intense that captures the strong, undeniable chemistry flowing between a power couple. The scent: Elevating the original BOSS The Scent fragrance to unparalleled levels of intensity, this rich ambery-woody-floral scent unites fiery contrasts to create an irresistible, captivating force. It opens with a fresh flourish of Pink Peppercorn, played against the exciting allure and mysterious depth of the Belladonna flower. The heated tension reaches its peak with a vibrant, sensual base of Amber, leaving an intoxicating trail. The bottle: BOSS The Scent Elixir for Her reinvents empowering sensuality in a striking flacon featuring the BOSS logo on deep-red lacquered glass and a Double-B monogrammed warm-gold cap. Capturing the spotlight, its multi-faceted shape and rich hue reflect the sensorial showdown within this charismatic, seductive fragrance, while echoing the many sides of a power couple. How to use: Spray BOSS The Scent Elixir for Her on pulse points around the body to increase the longevity of this addictive scent for women.

The bottle: BOSS The Scent Elixir for Her reinvents empowering sensuality in a striking flacon featuring the BOSS logo on deep-red lacquered glass and a Double-B monogrammed warm-gold cap. Capturing the spotlight, its multi-faceted shape and rich hue reflect the sensorial showdown within this charismatic, seductive fragrance, while echoing the many sides of a power couple. How to use: Spray BOSS The Scent Elixir for Her on pulse points around the body to increase the longevity of this addictive scent for women.

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS Bottled Parfum 100ml Holiday Fragrance Gift Set

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Carnal Flower Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A mesmerising fragrance by Dominique Ropion, Carnal Flower exalts the ambivalence of a natural tuberose absolute in very high concentration. Of all flowers, this is definitely the most deadly. The tuberose, extremely concentrated in this signature creation by Dominique Ropion, shows the full force of its seductive secret: its duality. The initial impression it leaves on the skin is one of innocence. The botanical freshness of a bouquet. Its more animalic aspect then follows it. With emphasis from camphor and the darkness of spices, the indomitable character of the tuberose is tempered by milky notes with the soft and mellow comfort of white musk. Partly respectable and partly challenging, Carnal Flower is a flower with a thousand faces, which becomes one with its wearer... and leaves nobody indifferent. Melon, tuberose, white musk, milky notes. Top notes: watermelon Middle notes: tuberose Base notes: musk

listings.rawTitle: Hermès 24 Faubourg Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Composed in 1996 by perfumer Maurice Roucel, 24 Faubourg Eau de Parfum creates a fragrance cloud suffused with its sunny sources of inspiration: the Mediterranean Sea and the Indian Ocean. With floral and amber notes, 24 Faubourg eau de toilette is bursting with the scent of white flowers, from radiant orange blossom and sunny jasmine to enveloping vanilla. Designer Serge Mansau created a sculptural bottle evoking a silk scarf flooded with sunshine and ruffled by a light breeze. 24 Faubourg is the legendary address of the first Hermès store, located on Rue du Faubourg-Saint-Honoré in Paris. A fusion of tradition and modernity, this ‘secret world’ is the place from which the house’s creative passion springs forth. A novel written by Maurice Roucel in 1995, 24 Faubourg is an invitation to travel, with the sun as a destination. A sparkle of white flowers in the top notes, the radiance of a floral heart enveloped in iris, wood and mystery, while vanilla and ambergris set the tone for the sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley-Paris Izia La Nuit Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Izia la Nuit is an ode to the night, another tribute to a mysterious and unique rose found in Isabelle d'Ornano's garden that only blooms once a year for a short time. Inspired by the original Izia, a bright, airy floral scent, Izia La Nuit offers a renewed intensity combined with the warmth brought by vanilla and amber blends with the sensuality of the rose. Izia la Nuit is a sophisticated and modern scent which combines fruity and colourful notes with deep woody and leathery facets for an elegant, long-lasting trail. The sculptural bottle created by artist Bronislaw Krzysztof is adorned with a mysterious, glossy lacquer. Its deep black shade contrasts with the delicate golden film that reflects the luminous juice.

listings.description: Caramel Days by CRA-YON is a grounding scent to leave you feeling empowered. It opens with cosy notes of caramel, before blossoming into a softly citrus blend of Brazilian orange and mandarin. Subtle notes of tropical coconut, jasmine and cacao lend sensual sunshine warmth that rounds out this feel-good fragrance. Welcome to the sweet life. Caramel Days by CRA-YON is inspired by those little moments that make us stop, breathe and engage every sense. The sound of birds chirping, laughter that makes your sides ache, the feel of the earth beneath your feet. And someone stopping you on the street to tell you that you smell amazing. listings.description: The strength of cedar surrounded by a supple climbing jasmine. Raw, voluptuous. “Upon this age-old tree, strong and graceful, I wanted to grow an embracing jasmine that coils around it.” - Christine Nagel. Fragrance notes: cedar wood, sambac jasmine.

listings.rawTitle: LOEWE Earth Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: LOEWE Earth Eau de Parfum is the first in a new family of fragrances to join the Botanical Rainbow, unifying the collection’s kaleidoscope of colour with its vibrant mauve bottle. LOEWE Earth is inspired by the elements that connect nature, propelling life above and below the ground, from the atmospheric to the tangible, the visible to the invisible, unifying inner and outer worlds. Floral, ambery and musky, LOEWE Earth reflects this connectivity with notes of truffle - a symbiotic wonder living below the ground - as well as pear, elemi, mimosa and violet. LOEWE Earth comes in a translucent glass flask in a bright shade of mauve.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin Sur Le Nil Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Un Jardin sur le Nil Eau de Toilette evokes an olfactory journey to the island-gardens of Aswan in Egypt. Created in 2005 by perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena, this composition tells the story of this lively and generous river. A green and woody fragrance, Un Jardin sur le Nil Eau de Toilette combines the tanginess of green mango with the delicacy of a lotus blossom and the elegance of sycamore. The bottle echoes the lanterns of horse-drawn carriages and was created by Fred Rawyler. Its glass is in a delicate green gradient, echoing the banks of the Nile. The box features a blooming lotus brought to life by artist Véronique de Mareuil. The Parfums-Jardins Collection: The Parfums-Jardins collection brings together the soul of a place, the perfumer's inspiration and the Hermès annual theme. They are olfactory strolls to indulge every desire for freshness, reverie or escape.
