As a result, the radiant fragrance is both woody and sweet, with bright notes of gardenia, vanilla and white peach, and earthy sandalwood and benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: NUXE Prodigieux® Le Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: The legendary fragrance of Huile Prodigieuse® has been encapsulated in this sensuous Eau de Parfum. Prodigieux Le Parfum is a feminine blend of sunshine and warm sand with notes of Orange Blossom, Magnolia and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: ARKIVE Future Bloom Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Introducing Future Bloom, a genderful fragrance that celebrates uplifting notes of florals and freshness in an unexpected blend. Opening with a burst of zesty mandarin, succulent cassis and tart rhubarb, the fragrance develops into heart notes of jasmine and lily of the valley. Finally, a warm base of vanilla and white musk add a comforting universal sweetness. Infused with Baobab Oil. How to use: Scent for Hair and Skin. For a moment of headcare, spritz into the air and walk into it, allowing the fragrance to envelope you.

listings.rawTitle: MALIN + GOETZ Bergamot Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Blooming during the winter months of southern Italy, bergamot is known for its uplifting and energising attributes for the mind and body. Our unique version of this heritage apothecary pillar expresses the full complexity of an orchard in bloom with a dynamic blend of elevated citrus notes and slightly spiced undertones. The sharp bitterness of the bergamot is balanced by an underlying floral aroma from orange trees, making it the easiest scent to layer from head to toe. Long believed to be a natural stress reliever, the scent of bergamot has been a brand (and customer) favourite for over 20 years. Our Eau de Parfum is formulated for everyday wear and gender-neutral appeal, infused with our signature bergamot fragrance; a bright and effervescent scent has been used throughout our best-selling products, from hand and body lotions to deodorant. Vegetarian. Cruelty-free. Fragrance notes: Top notes: bergamot, bell pepper, grapefruit Middle notes: ginger, muguet, cardamom Base notes: musk, sandalwood, amberwood

listings.rawTitle: Laura Mercier Ambre Vanille Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Laura's fragrance inspiration combines two of her favourite notes to create a unique interpretation all her own. The soft sensuality of Amber blends effortlessly with the warm comfort of Vanilla to create a fragrance of feminine elegance and sophistication. Infused with fresh floral notes of Tangerine, Tiger Orchid and Heliotrope, and enhanced by Almond, Brown Sugar, Coconut and musky Sandalwood, the effect is an intimate, personal fragrance that is rich, yet discreet. Benefits: Hypoallergenic Safe for all skin types, even sensitive Dermatologically tested and approved How to use: Hold fragrance 10-15cm away from skin and spray as desired. Technique: Do not rub the Eau De Parfum into the skin or dab the wrists together. The friction can cause the top notes to evaporate and the scent of the top notes to be lost.

listings.rawTitle: New Notes Cocktail Maracuja Extrait de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Capture the vibrant mood of an unforgettable party. Cocktail Maracuja is an exotic and stimulating fragrance that embodies the unbridled fun of endless aperitivos with friends. Bursting with bright fruits and warm, spicy undertones, it is the ultimate scent for joyous, energetic evenings you wish would never end. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Exotic Passion Fruit, Blackcurrant, Pear, Strawberry, Zesty Lemon Heart notes: Jasmine, Rose, Cinnamon, Cardamom, Pink Pepper, Ginger Base notes: Sweet Vanilla, Warm Amber, Creamy Lactonic Notes, White Musk, Patchouli, Cedarwood

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Barénia Perfumed Hair Mist, 30ml
listings.description: The Creation: Barénia is reinvented as a perfumed hair mist with a light, airy texture that delicately fragrances and enhances the hair. The Olfactory Notes: Barénia chypre Eau de Parfum blends exhilarating butterfly lily with delicate miracle berry and envelops them in oakwood and an intense patchouli. The Formula: A mist to suit all hair types, leaving hair shinier and silkier without weighing it down or drying it out. The Object: The glass bottle was created by Philippe Mouquet and inspired by the Collier de Chien bracelet. It has a frosted look and comes in a 30 ml size: the ideal travel format, and a great way to prolong the scent of Barénia throughout the day. How to use: Spray onto the hair from around 40 cm, using a circular motion. Alternatively, spray onto a hairbrush. For the full sensory experience and to intensify the trail, scent the pulse points of the body with Barénia Eau de Parfum and apply Barénia Perfumed Body Cream.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Zafferano Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: This Signatures of the Sun fragrance is an olfactory translation of the Venetian terrazzo’s compositional technique, where precious materials such as gold, marble and Murano glass come together as an object of art. Saffron, renowned as the ‘red gold’ of perfumery, is the starring ingredient, reimagined here with Italian brightness. The opening shines with mandarin, bergamot, coriander, and orange, creating a sparkling freshness that contrasts with saffron’s dark, resinous facets. At the heart, saffron takes centre stage, its fiery and textured character softened and enriched by a floral bouquet of jasmine sambac, geranium, rose, and orange blossom. The base brings depth and sensuality with vanilla and tonka bean, whose gourmand warmth enhances saffron’s richness, while patchouli grounds the composition with earthy intensity. The new transparent Signatures of the Sun fragrance bottle showcases the coloured jus and features a redesigned label. It is presented in a new hatbox with updated colour and finish.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Les Légendaires Samsara Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: For almost two centuries, Guerlain has been a story of fragrance and beauty, legacy and creation, daring and exploration, heritage and the future. Our roots enrich the present and inspire the future. With more than 1,100 fragrances created since 1828 by five generations of perfumers, our heritage is unique. The Legendary fragrance collection pays tribute to this exceptional heritage. Samsara is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by five generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Samsara is an elixir of seduction for a woman who has found harmony and balance, which is notably conveyed through the composition's raw materials: the sandalwood and a jasmine used only for religious offerings until then. Designed by Georges Chevalier, its iconic 'inverted heart' bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia C.L.U.B. Eau de Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Vibrant, contemporary, and radiant. Presented in a new restyled bottle, Colonia C.L.U.B. is an invigorating Eau de Cologne that embodies self-assurance and individuality. An all-embracing radiant Eau de Cologne, Colonia C.L.U.B. is a celebration of being exactly where you are supposed to be. Bergamot and lemon bring a sparkling opening to the cologne, while pink and black pepper notes invigorate the bright bond between aromatic shiso and rosemary in the heart. The fragrance closes with a warm base of cedarwood and musk. This Eau de Cologne comes in the quintessential Acqua di Parma bottle, an epitome of the Art Deco expression. The transparent glass allows the nuances of Colonia C.L.U.B. to be fully appreciated, while the classic black cap adds a touch of understated sophistication. The restyled minimal white labels also echo the refined aesthetics of the Colonia collection, while the matte-paper box, characterized by its cylinder shape, features the brand's signature vibrant yellow shade.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Refillable 50ml
listings.description: With muscled elegance and boxing gloves on, the new Scandal Pour Homme by Jean Paul Gaultier makes a spectacular, hard-hitting entrance with a masculine eau de toilette that's sensual, energising and extremely addictive. Intoxicating the senses and crowned with victories, this king of the ring seduces his fans with a bang, leaving a masculine trail contrasted by an intense Woody fragrance in a refillable bottle. Keep your guard up: his eco-friendly and athletic charisma knocks out all his opponents. Paris trembles before him and asks for more: let the show begin! The contrasting addiction of a Woody eau de toilette by Quentin Bisch, Nathalie Cetto and Christophe Raynaud. Redefining caramel with chic in his eau de toilette: how does he dare do it? In harmonious accord with the tonka bean, this atypical note blends with the clary sage and vetiver in an extravagant Jean Paul Gaultier fashion that seduces the senses by surprise. Its extremely addictive and sensual blue-grey juice attracts all victories to itself. A hart-hitting fragrance that creates a scandal.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle L'original Eau De Parfum 30ml Layering Routine Fragrance Christmas Set
listings.description: This holiday season, the table is set for festive moments overflowing with optimism. Lancôme reveals a limited gifting collection designed by French artist Octave Marsal, whose artistry welcomes you inside our Parisian palace, surrounded by the city's most beloved icons. Step inside and pull up a seat at our holiday gathering. Because there is always extra room for more. More love, more friends, more generosity - more happiness. Unwrap your gift and unveil your beauty icon. The gift set includes: La Vie Est Belle L’Original Eau de Parfum 30ml La Vie Est Belle Shower Gel 50ml La Vie Est Belle Body Lotion 50ml Your La Vie Est Belle Scent-Layering Routine Step 1: Cleanse & Awaken Shower Gel: This is a luxurious, lightly lathering body cleanser that gently refreshes the skin while leaving behind a delicate veil of iris and vanilla. It serves as the essential first step to prepare your skin for fragrance. Step 2: Hydrate & Prep Body Lotion: Enriched with royal jelly extract, this silky lotion deeply nourishes and hydrates the skin. When applied before your perfume, it creates a moisturised base that holds onto your scent for all-day radiance and extended wear. Step 3: Signature Finish L’Original Eau de Parfum: This is the ultimate scent of optimism. Created by three of the most renowned French perfumers, the brand's best-selling gourmand Eau de Parfum blends the nobility of iris with the depth of earthy patchouli and an alluring vanilla accord into an unforgettable, irresistible trail. It is encased in a refillable bottle designed to make happiness last. How to Apply Cleanse: Lather the Shower Gel over damp skin and rinse thoroughly to infuse the skin with a subtle fragrance base. Moisturise: Smooth the Body Lotion generously over clean skin to create a hydrated surface that helps to retain fragrance notes for longer. Enhance: Spray La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum onto pulse points – wrists, inner elbows, and neck – from about 20 cm away. Allow the fragrance to dry naturally without rubbing.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Zafferano Ambrosia Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the mythical elixir of the gods, Zafferano Ambrosia is a fragrance that captures the essence of eternity - an unmistakable composition defined by its intensity and greater concentration. A shimmering, luminous elixir heightened by the finest natural ingredients, Zafferano Ambrosia leaves an intensely singular, precious trail—a whisper of pure luxury. Zafferano Ambrosia, part of the floramber spicy olfactive family, opens with a vibrant blend of bergamot, red mandarin, and ginger notes. At its heart, orange flower nuances intertwine with saffron extract and jasmine sambac absolute, delivering a captivating floral intensity. The fragrance concludes with a deep and sensual base of patchouli accents, vanilla and amber accords. The 50ml fragrance is housed in a transparent glass bottle, highlighting the coloured jus with a precious decorated porcelain cap and is presented in the Maison's iconic yellow hatbox. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Italian Red Mandarin, Calabrian Bergamot, Ginger Heart notes: Saffron, Orange Flower, Jasmine Sambac Base notes: Vanilla, Patchouli, Amber accord

listings.rawTitle: CRA-YON x MANTLE The High Road Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: The High Road by CRA-YON is lush, smooth and quietly seductive. It opens with fresh fig leaf and a subtle cannabis accord, setting an elevated, herbal tone. A green floral heart of violet and sage blends into a creamy, slightly smoky base of palo santo and tonka. It's a scent that feels indulgent and mellow. Layered, unique, and hard to forget. Herbaceous, sensual, and infatuating notes of cannabis, fig, sage, cedarwood, violet, and musk make up this multilayered scent that enchants all senses and teases your mind to reminisce over illicit behaviour. This transportive fragrance will put you in an empowered and elevated state you’ll never want to come down from. Collaboration with MANTLE. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Fig leaf, Sage, Cannabis Note Middle notes: Coconut, Violet, Lily Base notes: Amber, Vetiver, Cedarwood, Musk

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Murakami Pink Limited Edition Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Welcome to the dreamlike world of Daisy Murakami Pink: a limited-edition Eau de Parfum that whisks you away to an enchanting garden where fantasy reigns, and flowers bloom. A creamy, gourmand twist on classic floral elegance, this scent invites you to experience the whimsical spirit of Marc Jacobs’ Daisy through the surreal lens of Takashi Murakami’s colourful universe. Belonging to the floral gourmand family with creamy, delicate, and playfully sweet notes, the fragrance opens with a soft, sun-drenched note of coconut, instantly transporting you to a place of warmth and escape. At the heart, a delicate white peony unfolds, adding airy, floral freshness and feminine grace. The base of smooth praline lingers with a gentle sweetness, grounding the scent in comfort and charm. Elegant yet unexpected, Daisy Murakami Pink is the fragrance equivalent of a pastel daydream. Ideal for daytime outings, brunches in bloom, or simply elevating the everyday with a playful, polished edge. The bottle is a collectable celebration of collaboration and creativity. It radiates luminous pink and is crowned with the perfect pairing: Murakami’s vibrant signature flower and Jacobs' iconic Daisy, reinventing the classic Daisy silhouette in a way that feels both timeless and electrifying. Co-designed by Marc Jacobs, Takashi Murakami, and Coty, this piece captures the essence of two artistic icons coming together in a supernatural bloom. More than a fragrance, Daisy Murakami Pink is a joyful expression of art, scent, and imagination. Let it charm your senses and colour your world. A delightfully gourmand invitation to enter Murakami’s surreal garden of blooming flowers, where creamy coconut is lifted by delicate white peony. Classic floral elegance with an unexpected, charming twist in limited-edition Pink. How to use: Spritz onto pulse points (neck, wrists, and décolletage) for a longer-lasting, more impactful scent. Wear alone or layer with your favourite Daisy scents to enhance and extend the fragrance experience. Reapply as desired to keep the surreal garden blooming all day.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Digital, 150ml
listings.description: A floral woody musky fragrance, Moncler Pour Femme opens with the crisp sensation of the exclusive Powdery Snow accord – reminiscent of the beauty of freshly fallen snow. Lifted with the radiance of Bergamot, it evolves through a bouquet of white florals – Jasmine Sambac and Heliotrope – to plunge headfirst into the embrace of the exclusive Mountain Woods accord. Its luxurious dry-down fuses with natural vanillin, for a feminine allure that lingers well after dark. The fragrance is showcased in a unique ‘borraccia’ flask-shaped bottle encircled with a ribbed silver case and cap – a utilitarian echo to Moncler’s mountaineering origins and the iconic quilted construction of a Moncler jacket. An LED screen adorns the bottle - a playful innovation that allows you to write a personal note that appears in scrolling red letters. LED screen with an illuminated message panel customisable via a Bluetooth-powered smartphone app Rechargeable - charging cable included

listings.rawTitle: ARKIVE A Kind of Floral Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Introducing A Kind of Floral, a fragrance that merges subtle blossoms with the comfort of a warm hug. At the top, notes of pink pepper, white peach, and lemon create a vibrant and refreshing sweetness. Delicate orris, tuberose and orange flower bloom into sophisticated grounding notes of musk and sandalwood. Infused with Baobab Oil. How to use: Scent for Hair and Skin. For a moment of headcare, spritz into the air and walk into it, allowing the fragrance to envelope you.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity For Women Eau de Parfum Intense
listings.description: A rich expression of eternal love, the Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum Intense for Her is a floral spicy perfume that is inspired by the passion of a romantic sunset encounter. This ultra-feminine CK scent is captivatingly sensual, paying homage to the original CK Eternity fragrance created in 1988. An intense heart of Turkish rose ultimate and jasmine absolute sambac creates a heady bouquet anchored by warm sandalwood and cashmeran. Top notes of Sichuan pepper impart spice to the expressive florals, creating a deeply intoxicating perfume for women. Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum Intense for Her is a vegan fragrance that incorporates upcycled ingredients of Turkish Rose Ultimate and sustainably sourced Jasmine Absolute Sambac. Housed in the iconic CK Eternity bottle, updated in a feminine shade of nude rose, this intense spicy scent evokes the most profound connection of passionate lovers. A floral spicy fragrance, Eternity Eau de Parfum Intense for Her is an intense fragrance inspired by the passion of a romantic sunset. A heady heart of Turkish rose ultimate and jasmine absolute sambac layers over a warm, rich base of cashmeran, sandalwood, and cedarwood. Spicy top notes of Sichuan pepper and turmeric root provide a captivating finish, imparting a lingering sensuality. How to use: Spirtz Calvin Klein Eternity Intense For Women Eau de Parfum liberally on pulse points and warm areas: wrist, elbow, neck – even behind the knees.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Extreme Parfum 60ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Montblanc Explorer Extreme is a bold tribute to the spirit of adventure, taking inspiration from the untamed, towering peaks and the desolate corners of the Earth. This fragrance captures the essence of a fearless explorer on a journey into the unknown. The fragrance opens with a vibrant burst of fresh bergamot, blending with green notes to create an invigorating and long-lasting freshness that mirrors the crisp mountain air. At its heart, rich patchouli unfolds, releasing a deep, woody aroma that resonates with strength and earthiness, evoking the raw beauty of untrodden paths. The base is anchored by a warm amber accord, merging with smooth leather notes for an added touch of sensuality and power. Together, these elements create a hypnotic, lasting presence that lingers in the air like the imprint of a bold adventure—capturing the essence of modern masculinity in a sophisticated and intense form. Set contains: Montblanc Explorer Extreme Eau de Parfum, 60ml Montblanc Explorer Extreme Shower Gel, 100ml

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Homme Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: The new DIOR Homme Eau de Toilette is intriguingly powerful and appealingly fresh. DIOR Homme holds the promise of an intensely woody masculinity that envelops and enfolds, leaving a lasting impression. "This new DIOR Homme has an unmistakably virile signature that does not prevent it from developing tender, sensual accents. It basically draws the portrait of a modern man." - François Demachy, DIOR Perfumer-Creator Olfactory description: Atlas Cedar: Atlas Cedar blows its dry and subtly leathery warmth through the trail of DIOR Homme. Combined with Vetiver, it leads a polyphony of woods filled with tension and dialogue Patchouli Heart: The Patchouli Heart is full and enveloping. It mingles with the virile woods to convey a caressing sensuality Vetiver: Native to India and Indonesia, but also found in Haiti and on Reunion Island, Vetiver is a perennial plant with an odorous root system. The essential oil is obtained by steam distillation. The persistent accords of Vetiver are used in woody, chypre and Amber compositions. Vetiver lavishes a boldly sophisticated base note on DIOR Homme

listings.rawTitle: Coach Gold Parfum 50ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Coach Gold is a sparkling, fruity fragrance that celebrates the richness of vanilla with an irresistible twist. The scent opens with a vibrant burst of pink peppercorn, leading to a soft, comforting heart of almond blossom. This delicate floral note blends beautifully with upcycled vanillin extracted from rice, creating a luminous, milky sweetness. The fragrance is anchored in a sensual golden amber accord, exuding warmth and depth. The result is a fragrance that is both eternally addictive and elegantly feminine, offering a perfect balance of harmony and contrast. Set contains: Coach Gold Parfum, 50ml Coach Gold Parfum, Travel Size, 7.5ml

A new creation, where the woody essence of patchouli is invited and brings depth to the sandalwood and tonka bean that reveal themselves more textured and warm. Voluptuous, vanilla underlines this trail with an ambery and smoked roundness. At the top, the freshness and vibrant cardamom combine with the delicacy of a fig with green and fruity accents. listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Chance Eau de Toilette Twist and Spray, 60ml
listings.description: A floral fragrance in a round bottle. Unpredictable, in perpetual movement, CHANCE sweeps you into its whirlwind of happiness and fantasy. The "Twist And Spray" slips easily into your purse and is the ideal way to revive your fragrance throughout the day...An olfactory encounter with chance. A floral fragrance that intertwines Pink Pepper, Jasmine and Amber Patchouli. An unpredictable, elusive, ever-changing fragrance—in turn floral, spicy, sensual and rich. The eau de toilette comes in a "TWIST AND SPRAY" purse spray to revive the notes of the fragrance throughout the day. A complete perfuming ritual for the bath and body is also used to enhance the fragrance trail.

listings.rawTitle: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Gardénia Pétale Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: The House of Van Cleef & Arpel's couture perfumery collection 'Collection Extraordinaire' is an exquisite collection of rare and luxurious fragrances. The beauty of nature, which is always a major source of inspiration for Van Cleef & Arpels High Jewellery, is elementary to these compositions. Gardenia is the captivating white flower that commands 'Gardénia Pétale'. Opulent and warm, the fragrance opens with fresh notes which are overtaken by the majestic flower. An enveloping and very feminine fragrance based on floral lightness. In this couture collection, bottles are sculpted in pure and slender shapes. Glass is heavy and precious. Like a jewel, the bottle is signed with a stamp on the bottom and topped with a black lacquered cap.

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum for Her Refillable 30ml
listings.description: The fragrance: Release the power of attraction with BOSS The Scent for Her, an iconic Eau de Parfum that captures the strong, undeniable chemistry flowing between a power couple. The scent: Inspired by the interplay of a bold pairing, this ambery-floral-fruity fragrance unites intense contrasts to create an irresistible, captivating force. It opens with a luscious natural Peach extract that radiates an ecstatic energy, set against a velvety, opulent Osmanthus bouquet at the heart. The heated tension is further enhanced with carnal White Musk notes, anchoring the trail in a compelling embrace that moves the senses. The bottle: BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum for Women reinvents empowering sensuality in a crystalline, refillable bottle featuring the BOSS logo on translucent glass and a BOSS Double-B monogram icy-gold cap. Capturing the spotlight, its multi-faceted shape reflects the sensorial showdown within this peachy-coloured scent, while echoing the many sides of a power couple. Refillable format: All sizes are designed to be refillable with the 150ml refill bottle, sold separately. Screw the 150ml refill onto the neck of the 30ml, 50ml or 100ml bottle and it automatically stops filling to deliver the optimal amount of fragrance. How to use: Spray BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum for Her on pulse points around the body to increase the longevity of this perfume for women that lasts all day long.

It opens with a luscious natural Peach extract that radiates an ecstatic energy, set against a velvety, opulent Osmanthus bouquet at the heart. The heated tension is further enhanced with carnal White Musk notes, anchoring the trail in a compelling embrace that moves the senses. The bottle: BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum for Women reinvents empowering sensuality in a crystalline, refillable bottle featuring the BOSS logo on translucent glass and a BOSS Double-B monogram icy-gold cap. Capturing the spotlight, its multi-faceted shape reflects the sensorial showdown within this peachy-coloured scent, while echoing the many sides of a power couple. Refillable format: All sizes are designed to be refillable with the 150ml refill bottle, sold separately. Screw the 150ml refill onto the neck of the 30ml, 50ml or 100ml bottle and it automatically stops filling to deliver the optimal amount of fragrance. How to use: Spray BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum for Her on pulse points around the body to increase the longevity of this perfume for women that lasts all day long.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Pegasus Exclusif Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: With distinguishing marks of serene virility and exhilarating power, this unique creation embodies the sensuality of the much-appreciated vanilla, fused with an Amber twist of amber, sandalwood, natural oud and guaiac. All combined with floral heart notes of jasmine, lavender, bitter almond and geranium, the scent boasts a fine balance of fruits and spices including bergamot, pink pepper, cardamom and heliotrope. Olfactive notes: Top notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Cardamom, Heliotrope Heart notes: Jasmine, Lavender, Bitter almond, Geranium Base notes: Vanilla, Amber, Sandalwood, Natural Oud, Gaiac Wood Nobler, with greater freedom, Pegasus Exclusif has set off in pursuit of new masculinity. With an image of deconstructed masculinity, as with the olfactory stereotypes, this fragrance's essence undeniably bears the stamp of the contemporary man. Captivating luxury in an original matte metallic bottle with dark brown tones, Pegasus Exclusif is a scent full of character, which gains momentum on the skin. The exclusive nature of each ingredient affords the formulation of intense alchemy for its wearer, as well as exceptional strength and resilience.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Buongiorno Gioco del Destino Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: An addictive and enveloping fragrance that evokes the rush of something unexpected, wrapping the senses in exuberance. Buongiorno Gioco del Destino captures the thrill of the unexpected, the exhilarating rush of chance that turns an instant into something unforgettable. A sophisticated twist on the modern gourmand palette, it introduces the surprising note of bran wheat absolute, with its toasted nuance that adds warmth and intrigue. Wrapped in the brightness of Italian green mandarin, yellow mandarin and Sicilian lemon, and deepened by musk, the fragrance balances freshness and comfort in a play of contrasts that lingers on the skin like a spark of destiny. The fragrance is presented in a bottle whose ridged glass form revisits and elevates a design drawn from Acqua di Parma’s archives. Its sculptural texture catches the light with a modern elegance, while the Crimson Red-coloured glass cap adds a luminous contemporary accent.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma x Laura Gonzalez Limited Edition Fico di Amalfi Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: A limited edition Blu Mediterraneo Fico di Amalfi Eau de Toilette featuring patterns by Laura Gonzalez evoking La Caletta; an ode to independence, the freedom of choosing one’s own rhythm, and finding elegance in restraint and gestures that are unmistakably authentic. Part of the La Caletta summer collection by Laura Gonzalez, this limited-edition celebrates the art of independent chic and effortless elegance. Vibrant, organic blue patterns adorn the label and hatbox, while the designer’s hot-stamped signature on the label adds a refined finish. An Eau de Toilette with a vitalising fig scent, Blu Mediterraneo Fico di Amalfi is characterised by notes of Calabrian bergamot, Italian lemon, grapefruit and cedar wood. At its heart, fig nectar notes come together with pink pepper scents and jasmine petal accords, while the base of this Eau de Toilette is rounded off with harmonious accents of fig tree wood, cedar wood and benzoin notes.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Coeur Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Coeur is a tribute to the house’s good-luck talisman: the Coeur Fétiche. Born from M. Saint Laurent’s childhood and his first declaration of love, this iconic heart-shaped jewel, first crafted in 1961 in diamonds and rubies, was worn by his dearest muses on every catwalk from his first collection in 1962 to his final presentation in 2002. A fetish scent for a fetish heart, Coeur is embodied by the smoky gourmandise of sacred amber complemented by the sensual warmth of myrrh and labdanum, and contrasted by the incisive coolness of Aldehydes. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Aldehydes, Cardamom Heart Guatemala Heart notes: Ourika Lavender, Orris French Butter, Floral Accord Base notes: Amber Accord, Almond Accord, Virginia Cedarwood Essence, Patchouli Essence Indonesia, Myrrh Essence, Cistus Absolu, Musks How to use: For light intensity: spray in a cloud around your head and shoulders, let the fragrance fall gently around you. For medium intensity: spray in a Y-shape across your body, beginning at one shoulder and finishing at the other. If you are wearing jewellery, it is a great alternative to spraying your neck. For added intensity: apply perfume directly to your pulse points and/or hot spots (wrist, inner elbow and lower neck). Here, the heat of your body will allow the fragrance to reveal its full trail. Include shoulders and back to intensify your perfume trail.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Bigarade Concentrée Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Marked by the lightness, transparency and freshness that are characteristic of an Eau de Cologne, this original composition by Jean-Claude Ellena is transcended by the addition of a novel bitter orange essence, obtained by molecular distillation. Built on a singular bitter freshness, an excess of citric notes, a touch of rose and a woody base of hay and cedar reinforce its unique and natural structure. More perfuming than Cologne Bigarade, Bigarade Concentrée exudes a lasting natural freshness. Key notes: bitter orange (bigarade); cardamom; pink pepper, cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Florabloom Eau de Toilette Refill, 200ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover the Florabloom refill, the easy way to refill your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle in one simple step. Florabloom is a joyful, multicoloured explosion of rainbow florals within a bouquet whose heart beams with true-to-nature tuberose. Set around dazzling white tuberose flower, roses, iris and violets come together against a mossy background to reveal sunny and bright creamy facets. Inspired by a rare natural phenomenon known as a superbloom, this creation evokes the multicoloured carpets of desert flowers that so spectacularly spring to life after heavy rainfall. "Florabloom is a celebration of the power and beauty of nature, that’s both wild and poetic." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria fragrances contain up to 95% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The 200ml refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75ml and 125ml bottles. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with ISO 16128, calculation including water. How to use: 1. Unscrew the spray pump 2. To start refilling, turn your refill upside down and screw onto your bottle 3. Refilling stops automatically once your bottle is full. Next, unscrew the refill and replace it with the spray pump

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Discover Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Toilette, the new Prada fragrance for men. A scent for the modern adventurer, gripped by a magnetic calling for discovery. Built on a conviction that with technology as an extension of ourselves, Luna Rossa Ocean can empower us to push ourselves beyond our limits, re-imagine what’s possible, and explore new horizons. Luna Rossa Ocean is a powerful Fougere fragrance. Fusing naturally inspired, fresh and aquatic accords. The masculine scent encapsulates refreshing bergamot, contrasted with the extreme sophistication of vetiver, tonka bean, and elegant notes of iris. A truly unique and addictive everyday scent. The Ocean adventurer: Jake Gyllenhaal, the Prada Luna Rossa Ocean ambassador, embodies the modern adventurer. An individual combining physical and intellectual strength, with an understanding of technology and innovation. Mastering it to better himself and his craft, in full awareness of his own limits, yet eager to push beyond them. The Ocean perfumers: Master perfumers, Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaim co-created the refreshing Luna Rossa Ocean fragrance, through technology, from both sides of the Atlantic - 6000km apart. A dialogue about men’s fragrances that crossed the ocean, formulating in real time between New York and Paris, through unique intelligence. The Ocean bottle: The Prada Luna Rossa Ocean bottle is a dive into the blue depths of the ocean, taking inspiration from the technological excellence, and sleek dynamic beauty of extreme sailing boats. Finished in a sophisticated and intense deep blue, a reference to the reflections of the ocean, and signed with the iconic red Prada line. Explore new horizons with Prada. Discover Prada's best-selling Luna Rossa collection: Luna Rossa Classic: A refreshing, modern masculinity Luna Rossa Sport: A spicy, sensual, and vibrant masculinity Luna Rossa Carbon: A woody, sophisticated and energising masculinity Luna Rossa Black: A ambery, seductive, charismatic, and sophisticated masculinity

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Extreme Eau de Parfum Intense
listings.description: The new Flowerbomb signature, now bolder. Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum is re-interpreted and pushed to the Extreme. This new powerful and liberating feminine fragrance unleashes a vanilla-amplified intense floral explosion. Embark on a sensorial journey with Flowerbomb Extreme, the new Eau de Parfum Intense. Opening with juicy and sweet raspberry notes, then developing with a voluptuous and suave explosion of flowers (made of Jasmine super infusion, Rose absolute, Orange Blossom absolute). Base notes of the most carnal and intense vanilla bean extract reinforce Flowerbomb Extreme’s ultra-addictive aura, leaving an intense signature on your skin. Viktor & Rolf revisited the iconic Flowerbomb bottle, pushed to overdose. Flowerbomb Extreme is the true quintessence of luxury. For such an unmatched and fearless floral explosion, the multi-faceted diamond-shaped bottle turns matte pink and is adorned with a bold, black Viktor & Rolf seal. How to use: For instant infatuation, spritz the perfume onto the pulse points (on wrists, behind ears and on the neck).

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 + Iris Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: Just like their Molecule siblings, EM's M+ fragrances zero in on aroma chemicals. But if Molecules celebrate the molecules in their solitary glory, M+ pairs them with naturals, just as singular and at the same time entrancingly complex. Molecule 01 + Iris consists of Iso E Super + Iris. Iso E Super is an abstract synthetic molecule characterised as a cedarwood note with a warm, velvety cocooning sensation. Iris is a natural extract from the root of several varieties of iris. M+ Iris, spring-fresh, sober and ephemeral. The robust routines of orris dances with the magnetic versatility of the molecule that started it all. Molecule 01 + Iris is the romance between iris absolue and Iso E Super. In this duo, the seductive quality of Iso E Super plays beautifully against the elegance of the iris. To add anything more would be to take away from their interplay. M+ Iris's beauty is shown through its simplicity as well as its complexity. It's not easy to describe iris' smell as such, but if you smell a fragrance without it and then with it, you understand immediately what it does. It adds a creamy powderiness, and it brings a physical dimension to a fragrance. "I have had a long-standing love affair with iris. Every Escentric fragrance has an iris note somewhere in there. To me, iris is luxury. The iris pallida absolue I've used here is one of the most expensive ingredients in perfumery. You can find iris extracts for way less than that. But they do not have the great and subtle beauty of this absolue. It's radical to put this much in a fragrance. The sillage is fantastic. This is a bomb, but a subtle bomb," says Geza Schoen. So, if you find yourself drawn to scents with the softness and elegance of a cashmere sweater, M+ Iris is the one for you. How to use: Spritz onto your pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind your ears, as desired, and let it dry naturally.

The base notes reveal ambery wood facets ranging from sweet and enveloping to powerful and dry. The woody, aromatic Gentle Fluidity Silver Eau de parfum is indulgent, free, and deeply moving. listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Uomo Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Born In Roma Uomo Intense is a seductive, ambery fougère fragrance, combining lavandin and vanilla infusion into a hypnotic, sensual aura. The Valentino Born In Roma fragrance collection is an outstanding tribute to Rome, intertwining Valentino’s couture elegance with edgy modernity, reminiscent of Rome’s street culture. The Born In Roma story continues with Born In Roma Intense. This fragrance is created to celebrate a night in the eternal city, amplifying the Born In Roma addiction with a powerful vanilla infusion. This unsweetened and leathery note is intensified by the Heart of Vetiver and lifted with the floral and aromatic freshness of lavandin. This creates a playful duel between an explosion of freshness and deep sensuality. Born In Roma Intense allows vibrant individuals to express themselves with intensity, abundance and duality. This Valentino fragrance for men is presented in an iconic studded bottle, a fashion signature of Valentino Couture, inspired by Roman architecture, and representing a rebellious new era for high fashion - led by the fashion house itself. The Born In Roma collection is created as a duo, to celebrate all magnificent personalities and pairings, with Uomo (for him) and Donna (for her). This iconic duo playfully challenges the rivalry between day and night, classic and intensity, and you and me. Fragrance family: Fougere Ambery. Fragrance Notes: Top note: Mandarin is lifted by notes of ginger and bergamot, oscillating between citrus and spicy notes. The audacious Born In Roma signature is pushed into addiction with this intense accord Heart note: Nutmeg is awakened by a salty accord, lifted by lavandin, and bringing a vibrant heart to the fragrance. A flaring aromatic note, creating a spicy and woody scent Base note: Smoked vetiver exploits the natural elegance of woody notes, contributing to the hypnotic aura of the fragrance. This ambery fougere makes the scent extremely addictive Key notes: Vanilla Infusion, Lavandin, Vetiver. How to use: Apply on each pulse point - wrist, inner elbow and neck, from a short distance. Discover the Born in Roma Collection: The spicy, woody Born In Roma Uomo Eau De Toilette The fresh, exotic Born In Roma Yellow Dream Uomo Eau De Toilette The warm, fruity Born In Roma Coral Fantasy Uomo Eau De Toilette The floral, ambery Born In Roma Intense Donna Eau De Parfum

listings.description: In this land where nature's grandeur lives untamed, we grow a rose like no other. Absolue Les Parfums, a radical collection dedicated to our rose, born in our domain. Our first-ever rose-dedicated haute-parfumerie collection composed of 11 scents unveils our exclusive centifolia rose like you've never smelled before. Reinventing perfumery's iconic ingredient. 6am Rose Eau de Parfum with Jasmine and Lily of the Valley. At dawn, the first rays of sun reflect on the morning dew, the rose shines with a lily-of-the-valley accord. She is optimistic like a brand new day as she dances alongside Jasmine from the domaine. Clean and bright, fresh and floral, reminiscent of the endless possibilities stretched out ahead. Meet The Perfumer. Fanny Bal & Dominique Ropion: "This composition is as clear as the morning dew. listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Rose Dune Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: This perfume is a sumptuous ode to the mysterious beauty of the Arabian Desert, with its floral-ambery bloom of spicy saffron, velvety rose and rich Oudh accord. Dark patchouli – the signature note of this scent – adds sophisticated depth and has been sustainably sourced from Sulawesi, Indonesia, for its strength and extraordinary quality. The fragrance: Top notes of saffron, green pepper, cassis, ginger, violet leaf and bergamot A heart of rose, geranium, lily of the valley, magnolia and raspberry A base of oudh accord, leather, sandalwood, musk and vetiver Olfactive Signature: Dark patchouli Sulawesi. Fragrance family: Floral-Ambery. Explore: A blooming mirage glistening among dusty-pink sand dunes at sunset. Shimmering hazes of golden saffron, tinged with rich cassis. The floral swirl of velvety rose and geranium, swept up in earthy patchouli Sulawesi – silent and sumptuous. Fall under its spell; get lost in the mystic beauty of the desert. Iridescent. Mystifying. Hypnotic.

Sicilian lemon, citron and grapefruit offer a lively freshness that is energised by the luscious accents of green mandarin. Juniper berries add a subtle aromatic touch, while cypress adds verticality and elegance. A luminous, natural fragrance that pays tribute to Italian beauty.

listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums Nice Bergamote by Antoine Maisondieu Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Nice Bergamote is a vibrant tribute to the aristocratic beauty of a Natural Calabrian bergamot. It is really the queen of this perfume. She is wrapped in a floral accord that features natural rose and jasmine petals, and most notably, a sustainable, natural Ylang Ylang from the Comoros Archipelago, with support locally dedicated to education and school supplies. This approach minimises the impact on the local ecosystem by extracting the Ylang Ylang sustainably and implementing a replanting program for trees. Its trail sillage wraps up in a precious natural cedarwood accord, softened by sustainable natural Tonka beans from Venezuela, in the region of the Caura River. Its sustainable sourcing program allows for the preservation of local fauna and communities in Amazonia, supporting local communities with an agreement to protect the local fauna.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Jasmine Absolute Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Bold and fearless, our bestselling Good Girl and Bad Boy fragrances are the ultimate power couple. Inspired by Carolina Herrera’s unique vision of modern femininity and masculinity, each of these iconic scents features a complex blend of dark and light notes that reflect the contrasting sides of our personality. Good yet bad, exuberant yet mysterious, strong yet sensitive – it’s in our contrasts that our true beauty lies. In the words of Carolina A. Herrera, Beauty Creative Director, "It’s so good to be Bad!" To celebrate 10 years of Good Girl, Carolina Herrera introduces Good Girl Jasmine Absolute, a bold new expression of the House’s signature jasmine and the original icon. This rich, floral gourmand scent enhances jasmine’s radiant sensuality and marks a decade of irresistible allure and fearless femininity. Good Girl’s duality shines through – intense yet refined, seductive yet sophisticated. It’s so good to be bad! Good Girl Jasmine Absolute Eau de Parfum is an ambery gourmand perfume for women – a rich, deeply decadent twist on jasmine. Bright mandarin and juicy blackcurrant open the scent, melting into a heart of jasmine and bitter almond. At the base, caramelised toffee and roasted tonka bean create an enveloping warmth and an irresistibly sensual trail. Dressed in black, the Good Girl Jasmine Absolute stiletto is topped with a pearl-white jasmine flower, a Herrera icon. With its sleek design, it channels Good Girl’s hyper-feminine attitude, confident, hypnotic and impossible to ignore. A razor-thin gold heel adds the final touch of seduction.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Jasmine Absolute Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Bold and fearless, our bestselling Good Girl and Bad Boy fragrances are the ultimate power couple. Inspired by Carolina Herrera’s unique vision of modern femininity and masculinity, each of these iconic scents features a complex blend of dark and light notes that reflect the contrasting sides of our personality. Good yet bad, exuberant yet mysterious, strong yet sensitive – it’s in our contrasts that our true beauty lies. In the words of Carolina A. Herrera, Beauty Creative Director, "It’s so good to be Bad!" To celebrate 10 years of Good Girl, Carolina Herrera introduces Good Girl Jasmine Absolute, a bold new expression of the House’s signature jasmine and the original icon. This rich, floral gourmand scent enhances jasmine’s radiant sensuality and marks a decade of irresistible allure and fearless femininity. Good Girl’s duality shines through – intense yet refined, seductive yet sophisticated. It’s so good to be bad! Good Girl Jasmine Absolute Eau de Parfum is an ambery gourmand perfume for women – a rich, deeply decadent twist on jasmine. Bright mandarin and juicy blackcurrant open the scent, melting into a heart of jasmine and bitter almond. At the base, caramelised toffee and roasted tonka bean create an enveloping warmth and an irresistibly sensual trail. Dressed in black, the Good Girl Jasmine Absolute stiletto is topped with a pearl-white jasmine flower, a Herrera icon. With its sleek design, it channels Good Girl’s hyper-feminine attitude, confident, hypnotic and impossible to ignore. A razor-thin gold heel adds the final touch of seduction.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Allegra Magnifying Musk Essence Eau de Parfum, 40ml
listings.description: The musky Magnifying Musk Essence expresses a notable and expressive luminosity of this gem of nature crafted by Master Perfumer Jacques Cavallier. A warm and sultry essence inspired by the intimate feel of a touch. Crafted with ambrette, the deceptively simple musk reveals a sophisticated radiance. The Magnifying Essences are made from precious, tailor-made ingredients to intensify magnificent Italian emotions. As their name suggests, these essences are highly concentrated, powerful and vibrant, an expression of true exclusivity. Beautiful worn alone, Bvlgari Allegra Magnifying essences also harmonise with any of the collection’s Eaux de Parfum to create a unique scent.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Le Gemme Onekh Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Discover Bvlgari Le Gemme Onekh, an exceptional ambery oud fragrance expressed through a mysterious oud essence and a smoked labdanum accord. A celebration of the precious mysteries of the Arabian Peninsula, its eastern riches and powerful black onyx. Its impenetrable black summarises all the qualities which have been ascribed to black onyx, a variety of chalcedony, since the earliest times. The Egyptians believed it helped pass from one shore to another, from the visible world to the invisible: the black onyx is the stone of Osiris, the god of the dead, but also of reincarnation. A powerful and mysterious black talisman dedicated to the strong-spirited who show determination and drive. Bvlgari Le Gemme Onekh is an exceptional ambery oud fragrance. To illustrate the ambivalence of black onyx, the perfumer chose the power of oud, a product that is more expensive than gold, and is one of the most beautiful and loved notes in the world. The contrast between a smoked labdanum accord and a mysterious oud essence, combining their power to capture the profound mystery of black onyx. Olfactive family: Ambery Oud. Olfactive pyramid: Oud Essence, Smoked Labdanum Accord.

listings.rawTitle: Van Cleef & Arpels Moonlight Rose Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: A Rose in the Moonlight... For this new Rose, Collection Extraordinaire is inspired by a Rose at its olfactory apogee, when its aromas are fully expressed... Its majestic floral heart composed of two exceptional qualities of Rose signs the singularity of this perfume... An intense and flamboyant Rose with intoxicating aromas of spices and honey. The Chypre signature composed of Moss and ethereal Patchouli underlines the elegance and timelessness of this fragrance. Fragrance Family: Chypre Floral. Fragrance Notes: Top Notes: Pink Pepper Essence, Geranium Essence Heart Notes: Bulgarian Rose, Taïf Rose, Raspberry Base Notes: Patchouli, Oak Moss

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle L’Original Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: La Vie est Belle Eau de Parfum, Lancôme's best-selling feminine fragrance. A declaration to the world that life is beautiful when we choose our own path to happiness.​ The scent: A floral ambery gourmand. Our first tasty Iris, created by three of the most renowned French perfumers, Olivier Polge, Dominique Ropion and Anne Flipo, after 5000 trials and over three years of work. A captivating, long-lasting fragrance that balances the nobility of Iris, the depth of Patchouli and an alluring Vanilla accord, creating the ultimate scent of happiness that celebrates femininity in all its forms. Iris, the signature scent of the La Vie est Belle collection, is illuminated by a bouquet of Jasmine Sambac and Orange Blossom. The gourmand Vanilla accord adds a touch of enveloping sweetness, and the heart of Patchouli amplifies its strength, potency and depth. A modern interpretation of a floral gourmand, La Vie est Belle Eau de Parfum is made to last and designed to turn heads from day to evening wear.​ Top notes: Pear, Blackcurrant Heart notes: Iris Pallida Concrete, Orange Blossom, Jasmine Sambac Base notes: Patchouli, Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Praline Why you'll love it: A long-lasting eau de parfum that leaves an unforgettable trail Carefully composed by world-class perfumers Designed to help women feel confident, feminine and remarkable An elegant, refillable bottle, crafted like a crystal smile The bottle: A crystal smile. The exquisite bottle is a re-imagined version of the legendary 'Crystal Smile' designed in 1949 by Lancôme founder Armand Petitjean. A design that has long stood in the archives assumed its full significance, almost 70 years later, with La Vie est Belle. Its curved silhouette captures a smile in crystal, while the delicate wings around the neck symbolise freedom. A timeless design that reflects the inner glow of every woman who wears it.​ ​ Refillable by design: The iconic Eau de Parfum is refillable across all formats. Refill and enjoy your fragrance again and again for happiness that lasts. ​ A 100ml refill contains 74% less glass, 63% less plastic and 62% less cardboard vs 2x 50ml. To refill your bottle: 1. Remove the cap 2. Unscrew the metallic pump 3. Position the refill on top of the bottle 4. Turn the refill 1/4 turn to the left to start refilling 5. After use, twist the refill cap 1/4 turn to the right to close it How to use: Spray La Vie est Belle Eau de Parfum onto your bare skin, focusing on the pulse points of your body: the inside of your wrists and along your neckline.​

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Old Fashioned Eau de Parfum Refillable
listings.description: Kilian Hennessy's inspiration: Only better with age, Old Fashioned is our new scent with whiskey accords inspired by the complex taste structure of an 18-year-aged single malt. This perfume transports directly to the Scottish Highlands, fireside inside a family estate, layered with generations, evoking the purest excellent whiskey: a single malt. Old Fashioned is a perfume from another era, a modern refinement in scent, like the taste of an exceptional Scotch whiskey in an old-fashioned delight. The perfume: The fragrance opens like an incredible sip of Wheat Absolute and the slightly floral liquored aspect of Davana Essence. It then leads into a complex of ultraconcentrated Cedarwood essence and Everlasting absolute, with long-lasting notes of Styrax and Tolu Balm to suggest ageing barrels and the misty wooded moors of Scottish lore. Perfume notes: Wheat Absolute, Cedarwood Hyper-concentrated Essence, Tolu Balm. Olfactive Family: The Liquors. The bottle of the perfumes of The Liquors collection is styled as a speakeasy essential, like an art deco glass to recall the most fabulous bars. The weighted glass is engraved with the emblematic K motif to throw and catch light at all angles, finished with a golden, diamond-shaped plaque signed in white serigraphy. These details bring to the KILIAN PARIS creation a guarantee of luxury, that should not be ephemeral but should last a lifetime. As such this perfume is refillable indefinitely.

listings.rawTitle: Tiffany & Co Tiffany Intense Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Tiffany & Co. introduces Eau de Parfum Intense, a richer and deeper interpretation of the original fragrance. Tiffany Eau de Parfum Intense is a new take on the original composition around the signature Iris flower, wrapped in a sensuality that adds depth and richness. A profusion or Iris butter echoes amplifies its predecessor with a rich new facet. The scent dries down on a voluptuous and opulent accord of luxurious amber and benzoin. Master Perfumer Daniela Andrier created once again this scent, inspired by Tiffany's core values of strength and joy. At Tiffany, all you need is love. The crystal bottle, gleaming with a deeper shade of the iconic Tiffany Blue®, recalls the iconic Tiffany diamond cuts and is embellished with a silver collar embossed with Tiffany & Co. logo. Like a jewelry creation, Tiffany Eau de Parfum Intense is presented in the signature Tiffany Blue Box® and makes the ultimate gift.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne FAME Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Discover Fame, the covetable women's perfume: A future classic by Rabanne. Fame Eau de Parfum captures the irresistible Parisian spirit of the Rabanne woman while paying tribute to a new era of femininity. Playful. Empowered. perfume. The Rabanne perfume crafts an avant-garde and distinctly luxury feminine signature. Composed of exceptionally pure jasmine, succulent mango and an addictively creamy incense. The fragrance: The quintessence of avant-garde luxury bursting with precious ingredients. Succulent mango, exceptionally pure jasmine, addictive creamy incense. Vegan perfume Made in France 90% natural origin. 100% crafted in Grasse from sustainable ingredients. The bottle: An ultra-desirable, daring piece of design. A quintessential expression of the brand’s avant-garde style, reprising some of Rabanne’s most iconic codes. As sentimental as a piece of jewellery. As covetable as the 1969 bag. As playful as the ultra-modern chainmail dress that has been worn by so many iconic women before her. Fame in a perfume bottle. Olfactive family: Chypre, Floral, Fruity. Top notes: Mango Bergamot Heart notes: Jasmine Base notes: Sandalwood, Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradigme Eau de Parfum Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Paradigme, the new signature masculine fragrance by Prada. A fragrance that transcends traditional preconceptions by asking — what if there's another way? A question as an invitation to experiment and open new perspectives. Confidence is redefined as curiosity, strength as finesse, and success as the freedom to create your paradigm. Another way to name a fragrance. Paradigme: [pa-ruh-dym] noun. A new perspective. A new way of thinking, doing, being. An augmented anagram of Prada creating a direct connection with the brand's feminine icon. Set contains: Paradigme Eau de Parfum, 10ml Paradgime Eau de Parfum, 7ml

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Apple Brandy on the Rocks Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the city of New York, KILIAN PARIS introduces its new addition to the Liquors olfactive family: Apple Brandy on the Rocks, an olfactive soundtrack to nightlife’s liberation to come. Apple Brandy has first conceived with perfumer Sidonie Lancesseur for the opening of KILIAN PARIS’s New York flagship eight years ago. The fragrance returns, featuring the original apple brandy core but, this time, with an added uplift - KILIAN PARIS’s signature 'on the rocks accord' blended into the opening for an ice-cold liquored delight expressing a uniquely KILIAN PARIS character. A blend of bergamot, apple brandy and cardamon, the accord cools down the original, adding excitement and modernity. The Perfume: This fresh opening of Apple Brandy on the Rocks unfolds into the perfume’s core personality: a distinctive apple brandy accord, in which a crisp fruity blend harmonises with brandy - recreated using notes of rum for the liquor aspect, moss and vanilla. Upon a core structure of cedarwood and ambroxan, the scent carries sophistication into the night. It captures the constant reincarnation and incontestable elegance of the ‘Big Apple’ - most especially that of its legendary nightlife. Perfume notes: Bergamot, Apple Brandy and Cardamon. Olfactive family: the Liquors. Perfumer: Sidonie Lancesseur. The bottle of the perfumes of The Liquors collection is styled as a speakeasy essential, like art deco glasses to recall the most fabulous bars. The weighted glass is engraved with the emblematic K motif to throw and catch the light at all angles, finished with a golden, diamond-shaped plaque signed in white serigraphy. These details bring to the KILIAN PARIS creation a guarantee of luxury, that should not be ephemeral, but should last a lifetime. As such this perfume is refillable.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Pamplelune Eau de Toilette Spray 75ml
listings.description: The radiant and tangy liveliness of grapefruit elevated by the vibrant, fruity note of blackcurrant bud. The patchouli imbues the scent with its intense sensuality. Create your own signature by pairing Pamplelune with Bergamote Calabria or Orange Soleia. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities. Pamplelune is also available in travel size, to slip into your bag and carry around with you.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Le Gemme Amunae Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Discover Bvlgari Le Gemme Amunae, a striking, radiant, floral, woody fragrance crafted around a splendid jasmine absolute and an intense, woody black musk accord. A journey to captivating Sri Lanka in search of the precious moonstone. Known as the gemstone of balance, the precious moonstone captures the power of the moon, bringing you inner clarity and trust in your intuition. Its pearly blue iridescence evokes the multifaceted nature of the self, strong and sensitive, masculine and feminine, in constant evolution. Amun in Arabic means “what is hidden”, just like the moon, whose power we can always feel even if we cannot always see it. Bvlgari Le Gemme Amunae is a striking, radiant blend, an ode to a true olfactive gem: the jasmine flower. Its floral, luminous, fresh, airy, and creamy facets reflect the vibrant hues of the moonstone. The blend of clear jasmine absolute with mysterious, woody black musk accord illustrates how softness can hide intense strength, and how contrasts are essential to inner balance. Olfactive family: Floral, Woody. Olfactive pyramid: Jasmine Absolute and Woody Black Musk Accord.

listings.rawTitle: L'OCCITANE Cédre Gingembre (Formerly Cap Cédrat) Eau de Toilette, 50ml
listings.description: This blend of vibrant, aquatic and citrus notes is set over an intriguing base of woody spices and captures the essence of a Cape peninsula, where the ocean meets the shore. Discover Cédre Gingembre Eau de Toilette (formerly Cap Cédrat), redesigned with a new, modern and minimalist look that reflects the cultural heritage of L'Occitane en Provence. Fragrance notes: Top note: Mint, Cedrat, Pink Pepper Middle note: Ginger, Violet Leaf Base note: Cedarwood, Musk, Amber Wood

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Fleur de Peau Refillable Solid Perfume, 3g
listings.description: Gentle magnolia, powdery iris, and cottony musk intertwine with subtle hints of ambrette. The quest for eternal love is embodied in the purest version of a fragrance that marries softness and strength. This solid perfume is endlessly refillable and alcohol-free, ready to grace the wrist, neck or décolleté when applied with the fingertips. A Diptyque fragrance gesture that combines delicacy and sensuality. How to use: For greater diffusion, apply the solid perfume on your pulse points, where your body gives off the most heat: on your wrists and inside your elbows, at the base of your neck, behind your ears and your décolleté. Once the perfume has been used up, reload the case with a solid perfume refill.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine For Her Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Enter a new dimension of unbound freedom with Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine Eau de Parfum for women. Bursting with sensual Grandiflorum Jasmine, this is the second Gucci fragrance to join the cheery world of #FloraFantasy. Its energy of inner joy is further enhanced by the elongated turquoise bottle, while the House’s distinctive Flora by Gucci pattern seals the design with a magical touch. Once again fronted by multi-platinum selling recording artist, songwriter and trailblazer Miley Cyrus, the latest #FloraFantasy campaign continues into a luminous bedroom, while scenes tinted in pastel hues create the film’s surreal spirit and draw the viewer into an anime dream.

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Black Phantom Memento Mori Eau de Parfum Refillable, 50ml
listings.description: Kilian Hennessy's Inspiration: On turbulent seas, an inescapably transient pirate ship braves black waters, leagues deep in mystery. Black Phantom 'Memento Mori' reveals its hidden treasures to the curious nose in waves. The Perfume: Rum accord from Martinique, akin to ‘pirates water’, spikes the scent of strong coffee at its heart, balanced by vetiver essence. A deadly bite of cyanide accord hides menacingly, like the smile from death itself. Smile back as sugar cane and dark, creamy sandalwood assures a trying journey holds a sweet reward. Perfume notes: Rum, Coffee, Cyanide. Perfumer: Sidonie Lancesseur.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Eau de Toilette Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: This holiday season, the Gaultier Tarot deck is laid out before you. In this festive game, the winning card has already been played even before the party has started. The sailor’s card from the Le Male Eau de Toilette gift set. As soon as he appears, the atmosphere hots up, promising end-of-year celebrations full of adventures. Fresh and sensual, this aromatic amber fragrance is both fearless and bewitching. Powerful mint adds freshness. Then comes soothing lavender, so typically Gaultier. Finally, sensual and warming vanilla. A gift that is sure to make an impression. Set contains: Le Male Eau de Toilette, 75ml Le Male Eau de Toilette shower gel, 75ml Le Male Eau de Toilette travel size, 10ml

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS The Scent Elixir Parfum Intense for Him 50ml
listings.description: The fragrance: Inflame the senses with BOSS The Scent Elixir for Him, a hypnotic, highly concentrated Parfum Intense that captures the strong, undeniable chemistry flowing between a power couple. The scent: Elevating the original BOSS The Scent fragrance to unparalleled levels of intensity, this rich ambery-leathery-woody scent combines fiery contrasts to form an irresistible, captivating force. It opens with a burst of complex, red-hot Pimento, set against the lively, fresh energy of Lavandin absolute. The heated tension reaches its peak with a warm, woody base of Caledonian Sandalwood, leaving an intoxicating trail. The bottle: BOSS The Scent Elixir for Him reinvents empowering sensuality in a striking flacon featuring the BOSS logo on deep-red lacquered glass and a Double-B monogrammed warm-gold cap. Capturing the spotlight, its multi-faceted shape and rich hue reflect the sensorial showdown within this charismatic, seductive fragrance, while echoing the many sides of a power couple. How to use: Spray BOSS The Scent Elixir Parfum Intense for Him on pulse points around the body to increase the longevity of this long-lasting masculine scent.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Eau de Toilette For Him 50ml
listings.description: The new chapter of Gucci Guilty signature fragrances revels in the notion of men who are truly liberated. A modern declaration of self-expression and fearlessness burns brightly in the new powerful statement #ForeverGuilty. An Aromatic Fougère, Gucci Guilty Pour Homme is a member of the first fragrance family invented, now worn by a new generation of scent lovers. Hedonistic and decadent, the scent opens with the piquant spice of Pink Pepper, a fragrance ingredient connected to intense flavour mixed with invigorating Italian Lemon. At the heart, the non-conformist ideals of #ForeverGuilty coincide with non-conventional fragrance-making using Orange Blossom Absolute, a scent traditionally used in female fragrances and known throughout history as a symbol of romance and innocence. White floral with honey tones enriches the scent’s other heart notes, Neroli and French Lavender - the very flower the original playboy Casanova used to fragrance his love letters. Completing this modern expression of sensuality, mystery and intrigue are conjected in Patchouli which develops with hints of leather, green, woodiness and incense-like qualities. The dry down is intensified with the masculine richness of Cedar Wood.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Energy Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Love, passion, beauty, and desire. Eros Energy is a citrus woody perfume that pays tribute to the Greek God of love through its joyful reincarnation of the original Eros eau de parfum. The powerful sillage and long-lasting presence of the fragrance symbolise the enduring power of love and beauty, while fresh waves of citrus pay homage to the breathtaking serenity of the Mediterranean coastline. Playfulness and intrigue are found at the heart of the fragrance through surprising and delicious notes of pink peppercorn and sharp blackcurrant. Finally, this spirited scent is rounded off with warm green notes of patchouli and oakmoss, providing a deep and earnest tribute to the natural world.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Les Sommets Collection Ciel D'Hiver Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the very essence of the brand and its unique connection to the mountain, Moncler introduces a new fragrance to the Les Sommets Moncler collection: Ciel d'Hiver. This new fragrance embraces the institutional codes of the collection. Encased in the iconic bottle inspired by the apothecary universe, the signature calligraphy delicately unveils its name. With the packaging reminiscent of precious woods, the fragrance embodies sophistication from every detail. A burst of radiant Neroli combined with the musky woody notes of ambroxan to reveal an elegant and sophisticated trail.

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Kologne Shield of Protection Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Founder Kilian Hennessy had been developing his own cologne for years, sparked by a desire to return to the roots and meaning of this unique genre of perfume. The result is a unique interpretation of Cologne which takes you on an incredible sensory trip across freshness, intensity and time. Kologne, Shield of Protection takes a classic out to party. With luminous citrus notes throughout, Kologne, Shield of Protection is a splash of freshness. The fragrance debuts with refreshing notes of green mandarin, bitter orange and mint leading into a heart of rosemary and neroli. A woodsy dry-down is built around cedarwood, cashmeran and a unique 'sap' accord of green vegetal notes. Created as a shield of protection, it is a fragrance to spray around oneself like an aura of purity and vitality. Perfume notes: Cedarwood, Rosemary, Green mandarin.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden Muschio Mineralis Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden reimagines the four stages of ancient alchemy. The Substratum stage: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden Muschio Mineralis Eau de Parfum. An anchoring Carnal Musk Accord infused with the sensual warmth of Vanilla Absolute and the mineral rawness of Ambrox accord. Carnal. Sensual. Enigmatic. Fragrance family: Musky, Ambery. Muschio Mineralis Eau de Parfum is rooted in the rich, mineral depths of earth. Anchored in the raw beauty of a Carnal Musk Accord, an infusion of Ambrox allows its sensual, mineral rawness to emerge. Sultriness is introduced through a Vanilla Absolute and Infusion. Solvent-extracted from raw bean pods, followed by a maceration treatment, this delicious duo of Vanilla notes boasts of warm, woody tones. A long-lasting sillage of supreme strength. The bottle: Muschio Mineralis Eau de Parfum is encased in a black glass bottle. It captures the fox’s mystery and intuition to awaken your own primal instincts. Olfactive alchemists: Two perfumers – the fiercely focused Mathilde Bijaoui and artistic soul Julie Massé – worked together to bring this sultry Musky Ambery story to life, conjuring the mystery of a fox with Carnal Musk Accord, mineral Ambrox, and soothing Vanilla. How to use: To enjoy the addictive notes of this Gucci perfume for longer, it is recommended to apply it to the body’s pulse points, including the wrists, neck, chest, and behind the ears. Designed to be layered with other fragrances, create your own unique scent with other Eaux de Parfum from the Gucci Alchemist’s Garden collection. Some natural ingredients, especially in high concentrations, may stain fabrics more easily. To protect your clothing and ensure the best experience, keep a sufficient distance when spraying and avoid contact with light-coloured fabrics.

listings.rawTitle: Laura Mercier Néroli du Sud Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Laura's fragrance inspiration combines two of her favourite notes to create a unique interpretation all her own. The sensual blend of Orange Zest and Neroli combined with Lavender and Verbena create a romantic and satisfying Floral Citrus fragrance that delights the senses. Eau de Parfum is a more intense concentration of fragrance oil yielding a richer and more lasting experience. Benefits: Hypoallergenic Safe for all skin types, even sensitive Dermatologically tested and approved How to use: Hold fragrance 10-15cm away from skin and spray as desired. Technique: Do not rub the Eau De Parfum into the skin or dab the wrists together. The friction can cause the top notes to evaporate and the scent of the top notes to be lost.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Intense Eau de Parfum Intense For Him 50ml
listings.description: At the first blow of the whistle, board the Scandal Express for a Jean Paul Gaultier journey that’s sure to be far more exciting than the destination. Aboard his train of pleasures, Scandal Pour Homme Intense invites passengers to take a trip to decadence — but leave your passport and respectability behind. Beneath his red velvet, this unruly male is instantly recognisable with his glittering crown and black-ribbed shoulders. Intensely aromatic and woody leather notes create an outrageously addictive fragrance trail. Desire is absolute and unlimited. All aboard!

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Eau de Parfum 60ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love is a radiant fragrance that exudes modern femininity, capturing the essence of joy and irresistible allure. From the very first spritz, it envelops you in a luminous pink aura that lingers from top to base. At the opening, a burst of fresh, tart raspberry dances with playful energy, setting the stage for a vibrant heart of delicate hibiscus. The fragrance evolves into a sensual yet light base where the red berry facets of musk harmonise beautifully with the smooth, addictive warmth of Madagascar vanilla. The result is a uniquely pink-toned scent, a deliciously sweet, modern vanilla that's both fun and feminine, radiating an air of confidence and charm. Inspired by the iconic pink of the Jimmy Choo brand, this fragrance celebrates joy, making it utterly captivating and impossible to resist. Set contains: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Eau de Parfum, 60ml Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Perfumes Body Lotion, 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Amarige Eau de Toilette
listings.description: Amarige from Givenchy is a radiant perfume composed of a beautiful bouquet of white flowers. Amarige opens with top notes of tangerine, violet and rosewood. The heart notes bloom at the centre, creating a pure floral with sweet, delicate notes of gardenia, a hint of a bouquet of fresh mimosa, red fruits and the warm, heady flowers of ylang ylang. The bouquet finishes with the vibrant and muted, yet extremely sensual notes of ambergris, precious woods, musk and vanilla. 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Forte Nerolia Vetiver Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Nerolia Vetiver Forte, a neroli radiated with light, enveloped by the generosity of a creamy fig accord, the warmth of vetiver and the almond notes of the tonka bean. "I created a neroli gilded by the rays of a setting sun, and awakened by the power of vetiver." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. Aqua Allegoria Forte, the intense collection, is a warm and enveloping journey to the heart of the world’s wonders: Eaux de Parfum celebrating the intense beauty of nature, revealed by the golden rays of a setting sun. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria Forte fragrances contain more than 90% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The 200ml refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75ml and 125ml bottles. *In accordance with the ISO 16128 calculation including water. How to use: Create your own olfactory signature by pairing Nerolia Vetiver Forte with: Bergamote Calabria, Orange Soleia, Mandarine Basilic or Pera Granita. Select your favorite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.description: The House of Van Cleef & Arpel's couture perfumery collection 'Collection Extraordinaire' is an exquisite collection of rare and luxurious fragrances. The beauty of nature, which is always a major source of inspiration for Van Cleef & Arpels High Jewellery, is elementary to these compositions. An olfactive interpretation of wonderful Patchouli between light and shade, Moonlight Patchouli is a Chypre, Floral, Leathery fragrance. Patchouli is the core of this scent, while soft moonlight tones reveal delicate floral notes of Rose and Iris. A precious warm suede accord, imbued with leather and fruity accents, completes this exceptional fragrance. In this couture collection, bottles are sculpted in pure and slender shapes. Glass is heavy and precious. Like a jewel, the bottle is signed with a stamp on the bottom and topped with a black lacquered cap.
