listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau de Parfum Over Red 30ml
listings.description: A thrilling sweet temptation. Dark black coffee and luminous white flowers are dipped in a juicy cherry accord. Experience YSL Black Opium, the rock couture fragrance for women by Yves Saint Laurent. Captivating, unparalleled in provocation, deliberatively seductive. Scent: Black Opium Over Red awakens the senses with a delectable rush of juicy cherry. With dark roasted black coffee and a smooth vanilla infusion, the now iconic Black Opium signature is re-interpreted with a playful twist. Sweet yet seductive, a burst of a red cherry creates the ultimate fragrance temptation. Paired with the bright floral notes of jasmine and orange blossom, the scent blooms with thrilling freshness. Top notes: cherry accord, mandarin essence Heart notes: jasmine flower, black tea, orange blossom absolute Base notes: black coffee accord, vanilla infusion, patchouli heart Bottle: In striking fashion, the Black Opium bottle goes Over Red. Translucent red lacquering dresses the glass, creating a precious jewel-like effect on the bottle. At the heart of the fragrance, its appearance intensifies, with a blacked-out window detail. Collection: Like the twisting of fabrics, colours and textures YSL Beauty mixes ingredients and proportions, constantly re-interpreting the gourmet coffee signature. Discover the YSL Black Opium fragrance wardrobe and indulge yourself or treat others to a YSL Black Opium gift. Black Opium Eau de Parfum. The original Eau de Parfum. Featuring adrenaline-rich black coffee and sensual vanilla. Captivating and energising Black Opium Eau de Parfum Illicit Green. A zesty take on the Black Opium signature. Green mandarin and creamy fig combine to create this ‘mocktail in a scent’. Energising and fresh Black Opium Eau de Parfum Over Red. A thrilling temptation, the signature coffee and vanilla notes of Black Opium Eau de Parfum are twisted with a juicy red cherry accord. Sweet and seductive Black Opium Eau de Parfum Extreme. The Black Opium signature taken to the next level. Extra-black coffee, ultra-white flowers, and an abundance of patchouli. Exhilarating and excessive Black Opium Le Parfum. Black Opium, at its most luxurious. A radical quartet of sumptuous vanilla notes, ultra-dark coffee, and luminous white flowers. Smooth, sensual, and uncompromising How to use: For light intensity: spray in a cloud around your head and shoulders, and let the fragrance fall gently around you For medium intensity: spray in a y-shape across your body, beginning at one shoulder and finishing at the other. If you are wearing jewellery it is a great alternative to spraying your neck For added intensity: apply perfume directly to your pulse points and/or hot spots (wrist, inner elbow and lower neck). Here the heat of your body will allow the fragrance to reveal its full trail. Include shoulders and back to intensify your perfume trail Other application tips: Hair & hair accessories: they can be fragranced for a gentle fragrance trail. For just a halo of scent, spray your hairbrush only Garments: perfume the inside of your jacket and coats for a medium trail. For added intensity of fragrance go further and perfume your blouse/jumper Scarves: for lighter fragrance, spray a scarf and wrap the scarf around your neck to transfer fragrance onto yourself gently Bathing: spritz perfume on warm bath water for an indulgent experience

Sweet yet seductive, a burst of a red cherry creates the ultimate fragrance temptation. Paired with the bright floral notes of jasmine and orange blossom, the scent blooms with thrilling freshness. Top notes: cherry accord, mandarin essence Heart notes: jasmine flower, black tea, orange blossom absolute Base notes: black coffee accord, vanilla infusion, patchouli heart Bottle: In striking fashion, the Black Opium bottle goes Over Red. Translucent red lacquering dresses the glass, creating a precious jewel-like effect on the bottle. At the heart of the fragrance, its appearance intensifies, with a blacked-out window detail. Collection: Like the twisting of fabrics, colours and textures YSL Beauty mixes ingredients and proportions, constantly re-interpreting the gourmet coffee signature. Discover the YSL Black Opium fragrance wardrobe and indulge yourself or treat others to a YSL Black Opium gift. Black Opium Eau de Parfum. The original Eau de Parfum. Featuring adrenaline-rich black coffee and sensual vanilla. Captivating and energising Black Opium Eau de Parfum Illicit Green. A zesty take on the Black Opium signature. Green mandarin and creamy fig combine to create this ‘mocktail in a scent’. Energising and fresh Black Opium Eau de Parfum Over Red. A thrilling temptation, the signature coffee and vanilla notes of Black Opium Eau de Parfum are twisted with a juicy red cherry accord. Sweet and seductive Black Opium Eau de Parfum Extreme. The Black Opium signature taken to the next level. Extra-black coffee, ultra-white flowers, and an abundance of patchouli. Exhilarating and excessive Black Opium Le Parfum. Black Opium, at its most luxurious. A radical quartet of sumptuous vanilla notes, ultra-dark coffee, and luminous white flowers. Smooth, sensual, and uncompromising How to use: For light intensity: spray in a cloud around your head and shoulders, and let the fragrance fall gently around you For medium intensity: spray in a y-shape across your body, beginning at one shoulder and finishing at the other. If you are wearing jewellery it is a great alternative to spraying your neck For added intensity: apply perfume directly to your pulse points and/or hot spots (wrist, inner elbow and lower neck). Here the heat of your body will allow the fragrance to reveal its full trail. Include shoulders and back to intensify your perfume trail Other application tips: Hair & hair accessories: they can be fragranced for a gentle fragrance trail. For just a halo of scent, spray your hairbrush only Garments: perfume the inside of your jacket and coats for a medium trail. For added intensity of fragrance go further and perfume your blouse/jumper Scarves: for lighter fragrance, spray a scarf and wrap the scarf around your neck to transfer fragrance onto yourself gently Bathing: spritz perfume on warm bath water for an indulgent experience

listings.description: A fragrance romantic like an afternoon stroll in the park. Wander in a sun-drenched flower garden where giant blooming peonies and roses refuse to be ignored. A Floral Fruity scent to wear alone or layer. Notes: Black Currant Buds, Strawberry, Passion Fruit, Peony, Rose, Plum, Cedar, Amberwood, Vanilla Style: Romantic. Floral. Infectious How to use: No rules. Wear alone or collect the other My Happy™ fragrances to layer.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Jour d'Hermès Eau de Parfum, 85ml
listings.description: Jour d’Hermès is a timeless, feminine composition that was created in 2012 by perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena: “I wanted to express the essence of femininity through flowers, and flowers alone.” Jour d’Hermès eau de parfum is a floral fragrance. It evokes the sensuality of gardenia and the delicacy of sweet peas in a perfectly orchestrated harmony. Created by designer Pierre Hardy, the bottle displays rounded, sensual curves. At the centre, a radiant drop of perfume hangs suspended. The bottle can be replenished using the 125 ml eau de parfum refill. A responsible gesture, integral to an object created to last. An essential tool for the artisan’s work, light is the primary material at Hermès. It energises objects and brings them to life, while revealing the beauty of the world. It is this light that inspired Jour d’Hermès, the most vital of fragrances./p> "I wanted to express the essence of femininity with flowers, nothing but flowers." Jean-Claude Ellena. Femininity in fragrance form! A celebration of the birth and rebirth of women, every day, Jour d’Hermès highlights female beauty while maintaining the mystery of each individual woman. A profusion of bouquets. From dawn to dusk, here is a floral that flowers, a blossom that blooms.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Lys Solaberg Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Let yourself be transported with this liberating gender-free Eau de Parfum, taking inspiration from Scandinavia travelling along the fjords to see the midnight sun. The floral Lily note at the heart of the fragrance has been given a unique smoky facet, blended with candied quince and woody oak barrels with an earthy peat and granite base. Olfactive Family: Floral, Woody, Spicy.

listings.description: The Elixir Cream is powered by Lancome's latest innovation Absolue Blackbiosis™, to help restore skin's youthful vitality. Now infused with our state-of-the-art Elixir Cream to envelop your skin in a velvet veil. After use, your skin’s youthful vitality is restored, skin texture is refined and skin’s density is revived, helping to improve your overall skin radiance and a reduction in the appearance of fine lines. Refill.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Refill, 150ml
listings.description: A floral woody musky fragrance, Moncler Pour Femme opens with the crisp sensation of the exclusive Powdery Snow accord – reminiscent of the beauty of freshly fallen snow. Lifted with the radiance of Bergamot, it evolves through a bouquet of white florals – Jasmine Sambac and Heliotrope – to plunge headfirst into the embrace of the exclusive Mountain Woods accord. Its luxurious dry-down fuses with natural vanillin, for a feminine allure that lingers well after dark. The fragrance is showcased in a unique ‘borraccia’ flask-shaped bottle encircled with a ribbed silver case and cap – a utilitarian echo to Moncler’s mountaineering origins and the iconic quilted construction of a Moncler jacket. God to know: This is a refill only.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau de Parfum 50ml Holiday Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Board first class this holiday season with Carolina Herrera and unwrap the Good Girl gift set, bringing together Good Girl Eau de Parfum, Body Mist and Mega Spritzer. This sensual ambery floral fragrance blends bright jasmine and creamy tuberose with roasted tonka bean, cocoa and almond for a confident, seductive scent. The Body Mist wraps the skin in a lighter veil of the iconic scent, while the travel-friendly Mega Spritzer is perfect for touch-ups on the go. A luxury fragrance gift for women, ideal for holiday gifting and special celebrations. Set contains: Good Girl Eau de Parfum, 50ml Good Girl Body Mist, 100ml Good Girl Eau de Parfum Mega Spritzer, 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Fragrance Du Bois Lovers Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Crafted for Lovers, this aromatic aphrodisiac reflects the unadulterated bliss of romantic interludes and shared pleasure, an uncontrollable smile kept for the person you desire the most. Reassuringly sensual and gratifyingly decadent, it is a softly seductive and potent fragrance that settles on the skin like the golden glow of new unions. Created by perfumer Shadi Samra, Lovers contains six different notes largely considered to be aphrodisiacs, starting with the aptly named passion fruit that combines with bright bergamot, juicy plum and fiery ginger in the top. The heart has a heady haze of jasmine, an intimate kiss of saffron, and a touch of classic rose, whose silky petals create a skin-caressing sensation at the heart of the fragrance. The comforting warmth of an entangled embrace emanates from the base of cedarwood, patchouli, cashmere wood, vetiver and creamy sandalwood, rounding out this voluptuous Fruity-Woody fragrance that settles on the wearer like a golden haze brimming with blissful passion.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Hermessence Vétiver Tonka Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: The strength of vetiver in Vetiver Tonka is softened by hazelnut. "The unrefined, rough, earthy scent of vetiver appealed to me. I felt a need to appropriate and reinvent it. I wanted a tender, enveloping, warm vetiver. What it needed was tonka bean! With its caramel, praline and blonde tobacco notes, tonka bean draped vetiver in softness and gave its woody notes a mellow roundness." - Jean-Claude Ellena. Fragrance notes: vetiver, tonka.

listings.description: A dive into the salty sea breeze and golden light of Capri. At its heart lies the vibrant and green soul of Capri Green Fig, while Patchouli lends a deep and magnetic elegance, encapsulating the Mediterranean island’s allure. The Design: The bottle, with its sinuous lines and enamelled cap, is embellished with decorative motifs of Caprese blue majolica.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Nuit Eau de Parfum Travel Spray, 10ml
listings.description: Bring on the night. Explore the depths of desire as the sun sets on a private island paradise. A sensational landscape of endless beaches illuminates under the stars. The twilight is yours for the taking. Dazzling reflections of Bergamot Essence dance across the delicate petals of Ylang Ylang-their spicy floral facets enhanced with smouldering Pepper. Salted Coconut notes recall the day's glowing Eau Fraiche, while a moonlit bouquet blossoms in the heat of the night. All heat. All desire. Bronze Goddess, all day long. Fragrance Family: Luminous Amber Floral. Fragrance Feeling: Radiant. Seductive. Enticing. Light up your night. How to use: Mist onto the pulse points from 5-7 inches away.

listings.rawTitle: Atelier Versace Santal Boise Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: The luxury fragrances embody the Atelier Versace absolute dedication to excellence, encompassing a studious approach to exceptional quality components, innovative techniques and hand-craftsmanship. Crafted from Srilankan sandalwood, the milky and balsamic fragrance is obtained from the roots and heart of the wood. Cypriol, a delicate flowering herb, adds a distinctive woody, smoky and slightly oud note to the perfume. The perfume boasts a hand-made black glass bottle enriched with the name of the fragrance written in a gold tone. The sculptural bottle is packed into a paper box embellished with a gold-tone Greek Key border painted by hand. The box reveals a mirror that features the Atelier Versace logo painted in a gold tone.

listings.rawTitle: MATIERE PREMIERE Crystal Saffron Hair Perfume, 75ml
listings.description: Nomadic, light and kind to your hair. Spray at arm’s length to leave the hair scented with the luminous and enveloping trail of Crystal Saffron.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum 75ml Festive Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: This festive season, Chloé draws inspiration from the Art Deco movement. The House revisits a period defined by effervescence. listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Terrible Teddy Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Teddy lives for the thrill of the chase, ensnaring unsuspecting hearts with his scent of leather, incense and ambroxan. A smooth operator, his sights are trained on Helen... until he meets the Duke. Key notes: incense, leather, vetiver. "A figure of mystery, Teddy is an enigma to most, dazzling and bold, yet subtle and shy at the same time, his fragrance follows a similar path."

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Afternoon Delight Eau de Toilette
listings.description: Afternoon Delight captures a moment of self-indulgence, transporting you to a Parisian café, where the uplifting aroma of warm madeleines fills the air. A sweet yet light, ambery gourmand fragrance whose delectable scent recalls moments of joyful escapism. At the heart of the fragrance is a Madeleine accord that evokes Afternoon Delight’s sense of comfort while conjuring a moment of 'me time,' in which the quotidian appears to fade away. This blends with the creamy and woody notes of Sandalwood, while the deliciousness of Madagascan Vanilla Pod lingers in the fragrance. These notes all capture the memory of an enveloping moment for oneself. To compose Afternoon Delight, master perfumer Carlos Benaïm looked to evoke the transporting feeling that famed French author Marcel Proust immortalised in his 1913 novel "À la recherche du temps perdu". In the novel, the narrator tastes a madeleine dipped in tea, taking him back to his childhood. The madeleine has since come to symbolise taking a moment to pause and recall the memory of a fleeting indulgence. Afternoon Delight is a fragrance that captures this delightful moment in a finely crafted artistic olfactory creation. Top note: The Madeleine Accord captures the essence of this beloved treat – warm and lightly sweet. It evokes a sense of comfort and escapism, inviting you to pause, indulge, and savour the simple pleasures in life Heart note: Creamy, warm, and subtly woody, Heart of Sandalwood forms the grounding base of Afternoon Delight. Its rich aroma evokes a sense of serenity and well-being, just like the embrace of a sun-drenched afternoon Base note: The Infusion of Premium Madagascar Vanilla Pod adds a touch of gourmand delight to the fragrance. Its delectable aroma is both comforting and alluring, like a whispered invitation to indulge. This precious ingredient adds a layer of irresistible sweetness and warmth to the fragrance, leaving a lingering trail of pure delight How to use: As damp skin locks in the scent, apply the fragrance straight after showering or bathing and before getting dressed. Apply the fragrance on your pulse points for a more seductive effect and stronger diffusion. Spray the fragrance from at least 15-20 centimetres from the area of application. For a more diffused effect, spray the fragrance in the air and walk through it. Wait until the fragrance has dried down on your skin before smelling it. Rubbing the skin after spraying the perfume will destroy the bond and alter the scent.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Eau de Grey Vetiver Eau de Toilette 10ml
listings.description: Discover Eau de Grey Vetiver, a fresh, citrus woody scent that embodies the refined elegance of a perfectly tailored grey suit. Eau de Grey Vetiver embodies the effortless style of a modern grey suit, a lightweight, breathable air of citrus woody elegance. Spicy grapefruit and green bergamot notes reimagine citrus sophistication. Lemon primofiore evokes the first-picked fruit of the Italian groves and adds a sparkling aldehydic quality, while basil-like fennel essential oil lends an aromatic sharpness. Smooth, velvety iris threaded with the scent of artemisia exudes refinement and precision luxury, while clary sage, sourced from Provence, radiates verdant earthiness. The sweet, green floralcy of orange blossom adds a touch of classic charm, perfectly suited for the modern day. All of these ingredients bend and curve, line for line, around vetiver. The note, obtained through a delicate process that captures vetiver’s molecules in their most luminous state, reveals the ingredient’s duality: a woody freshness and a dried, earthy warmth, structured but irresistibly smooth. Lined with amber woods and an oakmoss dimension, a clean musk accord punctuates the scent. The fluted flacon appears in a smoked grey hue with silver-toned metal accents. A soft, sculptural shape is defined by tailored lines that recall a TOM FORD suit. Fragrance family: Fresh Scent type: Citrus Woody

listings.description: A legend of first love, trembling with rose, iris and vanilla. From the head L’Initial sparkles with citrus zest and a highly perfumed shower of jasmine petals. The heart then blossoms around a rose absolute overdosed with iris pallida, while the soft, gourmand base delights in a combination of smooth vanilla topped with caramel and paired with delicately sweet tonka bean. All completed with a misty cloud of white musk.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Sublimage L'Extrait Pommade Or Golden Radiance Balm Jar, 15g
listings.description: SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait Pommade Or: the rejuvenating power of SUBLIMAGE Les Extraits, showcased in an exceptional balm that is enriched with sumptuous oils and light-reflecting pearlescent particles. The product of CHANEL laboratories' sensory and formulation expertise, this balm features a transforming texture and is enriched with polyfractioned Vanilla Planifolia and Swertia extract, two ingredients with rejuvenating powers. Its formula melts delicately upon contact with the skin, leaving behind a velvety feel and a sheer, subtly iridescent finish. SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait Pommade Or – a new beauty step and the sublime finishing touch to the SUBLIMAGE Les Extraits* skincare ritual – can be used in a variety of ways: When applied in small amounts to the entire face, it seals in the rejuvenating benefits of the ritual*, and protects and strengthens the skin barrier, for skin that is visibly stronger, more resilient and more luminous.When applied in a targeted way to areas that catch the light, it enhances the complexion with ultra-fine golden shimmer. Skin appears more beautiful and emanates sublime radiance. When applied using Le Rituel Relaxation, it promotes well-being and offers an opportunity to unwind, while smoothing the skin's surface imperfections. *L’Extrait de Lotion, L’Extrait de Nuit and L’Extrait de Crème. SUBLIMAGE L'Extrait Pommade Or completes the SUBLIMAGE Les Extraits skincare ritual, offering a variety of uses. L’APPLICATION SIGNATURE: To conclude the skincare ritual*, apply SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait Pommade Or all over the face as the final step. Warm the product in your hands, then dab a small amount on each cheek as well as on the forehead. Using both hands, smooth over the face in an upwards motion from the centre outwards. L’APPLICATION SUBLIMATRICE: At the end of your ritual, use SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait Pommade Or on targeted areas for bespoke radiance. First, warm the product between your fingers, then apply it to areas that catch the light: the top of the cheekbones and brow bone. A touch of true perfection, the balm illuminates the skin, leaving it emanating sublime radiance. LE RITUEL RELAXATION: For an exceptional and surprising experience that promotes well-being, discover this specific technique developed by CHANEL. Find a quiet place that is conducive to relaxation, and prepare your skin to appear rejuvenated and left looking sublime. With bare hands: - Apply pressure to the sinuses using the thumbs, then to the eyes using the palms of the hands. - Continue by massaging the temples in a circular motion.- Complete the technique with deep smoothing movements, first upwards on the jaw, then outwards on the trapezius.Next, using the spatula provided, place a small amount of L’Extrait Pommade Or on the fingertips, warm the product and apply it with deep smoothing movements: - Upwards between the eyebrows, then outwards above the eyebrows, and finally on the entire forehead towards the hairline.- Continue the movement by smoothing on either side of forehead wrinkles.- Finally, perform enveloping smoothing movements on the cheeks, followed by relaxing circular movements on the jaw. *L’Extrait de Lotion, L’Extrait de Nuit, and L’Extrait de Crème.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Sublimage L'extrait Baume Regard Ultimate Eye Balm - Reinvigorates And Nourishes Refill, 15g
listings.description: For the first time, the skincare expertise behind SUBLIMAGE Les Extraits has been extended to the eye area with SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait Baume Regard. Highly concentrated, it is the ultimate eye balm. It combines the powerful signature SUBLIMAGE active ingredients, Vanilla Planifolia and Swertia extracts, with a new remodelling complex to act on the skin's natural cycles. Swertia extract targets the skin's natural revival mechanisms, which are more intense at night. In addition, the remodelling complex helps visibly fortify the skin around the eyes, while polyfractioned Vanilla Planifolia nourishes the skin, for even more intense action during the day. From the very first morning, the eyes appear wider awake, as if transformed. Composed of 96% naturally derived ingredients*, this exceptional, velvety-textured eye balm drapes the eye area in a protective veil, offering a unique sensory experience. SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait Baume Regard comes in a refillable glass jar. Developed in partnership with a renowned French glassmaking House, it was designed to be a timeless design piece. *According to ISO 16128.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Granada Salvia Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: A delicious pomegranate accord transported by the freshness of blackcurrant, cypress, lemon and bergamot notes, with an elegant twist of sage and rose over a white musk, moss and patchouli background. Create your own signature by pairing Granada Salvia with: Bergamote Calabria, Herba Fresca, Rosa Rossa, Flora Cherrysia or Flora Salvaggia. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

Its formula is based on botanical safflower oil and does not contain drying alcohols... Enjoy! Take the rollerball and apply perfume onto the body where fragrance is wanted.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Santal 33 Eau de Parfum 15ml
listings.description: Drawing inspiration from the old Marlboro ads. A man and his horse in front of the fire on a great plain under tall, blue evening skies - A defining image of the spirit of the American West with all it implied about masculinity and personal freedom. This man, firelight in his face, leaning on the worn leather saddle, alone with the desert wind, an icon so powerful that every man wanted to be him and every woman wanted to have him. From this memory is born Santal 33: the ambition to create an olfactive form inspired by the great American myth still a source of fantasy for the rest of the world. A perfume that touches the sensual universality of this icon - that would intoxicate a man as much as a woman - that introduces a use of cardamom, iris, violet, ambrox which crackle in the formula and bring to this smoking wood alloy (Australian sandalwood, papyrus, cedarwood) some spicy, leathery, musky notes. It gives this perfume a unisex signature and addictive comfort. Santal 33 is an open fire. The soft drift of smoke. Where sensuality rises after the light has gone.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden Love at your Darkest Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Gucci fragrances opens a new story of magic and imagination in Luxury Collection: The Alchemist’s Garden. The singular unisex fragrances in The Alchemist's collection of Eau de Parfum, Acqua Profumata and oils become customisable and transformative when layered in a multitude of perfume combinations to construct a special enticing scent that stays with you all day. "The oils and Acqua Profumata create mesmerising individual statements. Personalise your beloved scent with a captivating oil or a floral water to build a unique scent. Just play with the scent to find your favourite, as an alchemist would work to find the gold formula," says Alberto Morillas. The scent: Born from Perfumer Alberto Morillas, Gucci Beauty unveils Love at your Darkest. Love shines through the darkness like a hawk cutting through the sky in a deep spicy perfume that is an enveloping combination of Black Pepper, Incense perfume and Cedarwood. The dry spiciness of Black Pepper represents the top note of this intoxicating Gucci scent, woody and warm. Its multifaceted characteristics are revealed through Incense, itself a balsamic sweet note wrapping the scent in its sensual richness. The bottle: The design of each Eau de Parfum bottle is inspired by the bottles found on the wooden shelves of a vintage apothecary and the first perfumery containers. Love at your Darkest is finished with the regal hawk representing strength and determination, urging one to embrace the darkest corners of love, to soar through its highs and lows. Appliqued with a decorative gold foliage pattern, it is finished with a green bow at the bottom. Gold lettering, decoration and secret symbols appear on the Eau de Parfum, contained in lacquered Gucci fragrance glass bottles with stoppers - covetable objects for lovers of mystery. How to use: Each Perfumed Oil and Acqua Profumata in The Alchemist's collection can be layered with each Eau de Parfum: experiment with combinations to build a unique scent of your beloved scent. Bottling the essence of nature into sublime distillations, the customisable compositions are designed to be layered together, each building from a hero ingredient that shifts and magnifies its character when paired with other Gucci fragrances. The beauty of alchemy is in the transformation: layered scents that become new expressions of art and unfold the magic of unseen worlds. Layer pure and highly concentrated perfumed oils with the Eaux de Parfum to intensify its strength and richness: Apply your choice of The Alchemist Perfumed Oil first on the wrist and neck Follow with your Eau de Parfum layered on top The Acqua Profumata can be applied over the Eau de Parfum to recharge top notes and refresh the overall impression of your signature scent A recommended layer combination for Love at your Darkest perfume, designed to bring out the different facets of its irresistible woody spicy scent: Magnify the warmth in Love at your Darkest Gucci perfume by pairing with A Nocturnal Whisper perfumed oil. The composition results in a spicy, intense oud fragrance Amplify the woodsy notes with Fading Autumn perfumed water. When layered with this water from the collection, the Cedarwood becomes intense and creamy

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Bal d'Afrique Absolu de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by founder Ben Gorham's personal connection to Africa, particularly his father's experiences travelling and living there, Ben Gorham crafted Bal d’Afrique as both an imaginary journey and a celebration of Africa's rich cultural impact on dance, art, and music. Intensifying the gourmand aspect of Bal d’Afrique, this reimagined composition heightens the contrast between vibrant lightness and addictive depth, offering a richer, more addictive experience. Notes of bergamot, lemon, and blackcurrant offer a bold vibrance, melting into the sweetness of praline, musks, and violet, and finishing on a dramatic base of cedar, vetiver, and warm black amber. Beyond the fragrance, the homage to craftsmanship is reflected in the newly redesigned Absolu de Parfum bottle. The textured cap, inspired by Yakisugi, the Japanese art of charring wood, embodies the deep intensity, transformation, and enduring strength that mirrors the essence of the Absolu. The silver and gold atomiser spray, with its industrial edge, complements the bottle’s elemental design and the clean curves of the glass. Within the bottle, the hue of the Absolu de Parfum is intensified, offering a visual hint at the rich concentration of fragrance inside. Woody Genderless Notes: Top: Bergamot, Lemon, Black Currant Heart: Musks, Praline, Violet Base: Black Amber, Cedarwood, Vetiver How to use: To be sprayed on the skin and/or clothes.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Caban Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent's pea coat – caban in French – is known for its fascinating sophistication and its role in defining the maison's signature style. The fragrance mirrors the coat's comforting warmth and sleek lines with tonka bean, which brings notes of almond, caramel, and tobacco to the forefront. The olfaction: Inspired by YSL’s sleek, empowering pea coat, Caban reveals the innate elegance and sophistication of a simple olfactory shape, built around warm, lush tonka bean absolute. Run through with boldly woody tones, this fascinating tonka is textured with bright spices. Airy, fresh, and electric with a fruity facet, pink pepper absolute reflects light like carved golden buttons on a couture YSL caban. Tactile and sleekly sophisticated, Caban embodies a modern look with a raw yet enveloping impact. Fragrance family: Woody Spicy. Top notes: Pink Pepper Oil, Black Pepper Oil, Elemi Oil Heart notes: Olibanum Resinoid, Osmanthus Base notes: Sandalwood Oil, Tonka Bean, Patchouli Heart The inspiration: It was the very first piece Yves Saint Laurent presented under his name, in 1962. Opening his fashion show, worn with white shantung pants and mules, the thick wool double-breasted overcoat worn by sailors to ward off the cold and the rain - the caban, or pea coat – was reinvented as a couture garment. And paved the way for Yves Saint Laurent’s signature style, which borrowed from menswear to make women feel comfortable and confident. Turning the simplicity of a practical garment into the ultimate form of refinement, YSL’s caban has shown its range throughout the years, asserting a marine-inspired look or nonchalantly worn over a sleek cream satin gown. The Caban is more than just a single garment; it's a symbol of the YSL style, its clean lines and structured shape contributed to the distinctive YSL silhouette. blending masculine tailoring with feminine grace, female empowerment, and timeless sophistication. The Caban conveys a sense of confidence and power. When a person wears a Caban, they adopt a garment that historically signified authority and strength. This creates a sense of self-assuredness and boldness without compromising its fascinating elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre L'Eau Nue Parfum de Peau 50ml
listings.description: Summer freedom in a scent for radiant skin. Libre L'Eau Nue is the first alcohol-free Parfum de Peau by Yves Saint Laurent. A sun-kissed, radiant and sultry scent of long Mediterranean summers on your skin. A unique sensorial experience that enhances the skin with a radiant glow.​ The bottle: Discover the iconic bottle of Libre in a new radical white couture piece. A shiny white finish that mirrors the sunlight and enhances the sparkling gold Cassandre. The slanted black cap adds a couture asymmetry to this sculptural bottle. A new it-bottle echoing the uniqueness of Libre L'Eau Nue. How to use: A new sensorial fragrance gesture to suit your mood. Smell it. Feel it. Experience the sensorial pleasure of Libre L'Eau Nue on your pulse points and skin. Sensually envelop your body for a lasting fragrance. Add a mist to your hair for a feel-good finishing touch. Control the intensity: a 30cm (12") spray creates a light, airy mist. For a more concentrated, sensual experience, spray closer and massage into the skin. Mist hair from 15cm (6") and lightly run your fingers through your lengths to evenly spread the product. Do not intentionally be exposed to the sun. Do not use it on the face. Avoid spraying towards the eyes. In case of contact, rinse immediately and thoroughly.

listings.rawTitle: TOCCA Lucia Eau de Parfum Travel Spray
listings.description: Lucia Eau de Parfum is TOCCA’s luminous fresh floral fragrance, light enough for daily wear. Lucia captures the essence of dolce far niente, the cherished Italian art of slowing down and savouring life’s simple pleasures. Sunlit lemon and woody vetiver slow-dance in quiet reverie with lush fig from the garden. Fragrance family: Fresh Floral. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Lemon Oil Italy Orpur, Grapefruit, Mandarin, Marine Accord Heart notes: Fig, Fig Tree Leaves, Upcycled Rose Water, Geranium Oil Egypt Orpur Base notes: Vetiver Oil Haiti Orpur, Cedarwood, Tobacco, Fig Tree Wood TOCCA fragrances are inspired by powerful feminine archetypes, both mythic and modern muses. Crafted by master perfumers with the world’s finest ingredients, each Eau de Parfum is housed in a fluted Italian glass bottle with a hand-finished cap — a graceful tribute to feminine beauty and confidence. How to use: Spray generously onto your wrists, neck, and pulse points.

listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums Rose Magnetic by Sophie Labbé Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Rose Magnetic sublimates the most sensual of flowers, the rose. All its facets are expressed in turn, with playfulness, addiction and modernity, thanks to the combination of the natural Rose Essential™ LMR and the natural Turkish Rose Absolute LMR, both certified 'For Life', produced with respect for the environment and helping the local communities get better and more stable revenues. The bitterness of grapefruit and the freshness of peppermint invite the sweet femininity of the queen of flowers to bloom freely. Its character becomes magnetic with the attraction of lychee, vibrating cedar natural woods, musks and natural vanilla bean.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Holiday Gift Set
listings.description: Celebrate the joy of giving with this Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum holiday gift set for women. This refined ambery floral fragrance features pink pepper, mandora, and bergamot top notes; lilac, violet, rose, and geranium heart notes; and amber and patchouli base notes. This gift set contains: Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women, 90ml (3.0oz) Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Perfumed Body Lotion for Women, 50ml (1.6oz)

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Rouge Hermès Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: A fragrance coloured by passion where the sensuality of vanilla mingles with rose and ylang-ylang.Sophisticated and unsettling, the most oriental of the Hermès fragrances. When it was created by Akiko Kamei, this fragrance bore the name Parfum d’Hermès. Reinterpreted and renamed Rouge Hermès at the turn of the third millennium, this semi-oriental, ambery floral reflects the emblematic colour of the house and is the very essence of sophistication. Its sillage is unforgettable as much by its richness as by its masterful style. A novel of love, a vividly poetic writing style, an oriental feel, expressing an assertive and sensual femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Addictive and irresistible, Daisy Love fills the air with a contagious love of life. Created by master perfumer Alberto Morillas, this gourmand radiant perfume for women reveals its first notes in a vibrant burst of sweet cloudberries. Delicate daisy tree petals mingle with sparkling cashmere musks and driftwood to create a lasting and memorable gourmand twist. An ode to the Marc Jacobs iconic daisy, Daisy Love blooms with an over-sized daisy that reflects over the warm glow of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Flora Luminare Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Transport the senses to languid mornings on an idyllic island with this fragrance. Solar notes of bitter almond soften into neroli and tiare absolute, culminating in a creamy trail of sandalwood and musk. The fragrance: Top notes of bitter almond, mandarin, petitgrain and olibanum A heart of neroli, tiare absolute, jasmine absolute and rose absolute A base of mate absolute, sandalwood, cedarwood and musk Olfactive Signature: Ylang-ylang. Fragrance family: Floral. Explore: London via Tahiti. Sheer turquoise lagoons gleam translucent with slivers of morning light. Coral gardens illuminated with incandescent clarity. Bountiful heads of pure white tiare and jasmine mingle with precious, golden ylang-ylang, trade winds waft their heady aroma to Pointe Vénus. Escape to an otherworldly atoll idyll. Utopian. Luminous. Solar.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Polka Paradise Eau de Parfum, 80ml
listings.description: A summer-ready collector’s edition of Good Girl Blush. Good Girl Blush turns pink into power. Bright, bold and ultra-feminine, she embodies a new kind of allure, flirty, sassy and strong. Vibrant and full of energy, she’s the Good Girl who glows with confidence. It’s so good to be bad.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Blanche Absolu de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Blanche Absolu reimagines the iconic scent with a heightened contrast between purity and warmth, paying tribute to Blanche’s story of intimacy, texture, and comfort. It further intensifies and reveals the sensuality of skin and touch, wrapping the body in lingering warmth. The crisp aldehydic notes are blended with black pepper and warm neroli, giving way to a more vivid floral heart. Rose, violet, and jasmine unfold with a stronger, subtly fruity nuance. The fragrance is anchored by sensual white musk, indulgent cashmere wood, and inviting ambroxan. The Absolu de Parfum is held in a redesigned bottle, an homage to craftsmanship. Embodying the deep intensity and transformation, the textured cap, inspired by Yakisugi, the Japanese art of charring wood, opens to reveal the silver and gold atomiser spray, complementing the bottle’s elemental design and the clean curves of the glass that show the intense colour of the fragrance within. Floral Genderless Notes: Top: Aldehyde, Black Pepper, Neroli Heart: Rose Absolute, Violet, Jasmine Base: Ambroxan, Cashmere Woods, White Musk How to use: To be sprayed on the skin and/or clothes.

listings.description: Velvety Rose is enveloped in elegant White Patchouli to create the new addictive floral perfume for women, Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Rose Velvet. A captivating fragrance in which tenderness is the new bold. Infused with top notes of succulent Blackcurrant, this graceful feminine fragrance reveals a heart of velvety Rose, Irresistible’s signature note. This new floral facet is embraced by the powdery softness of Iris, fusing with the warmth of Tender Wood and sensual White Patchouli. Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Rose Velvet is an irresistible fragrance that invites you to embrace your tender side.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A timeless icon evolves in 2026. Reimagined with a deeper, more enduring intensity, this classic Eau de Parfum preserves the unmistakable signature of The One, now with enhanced longevity. Crafted for the refined man with an elegant, distinctive character, the fragrance reveals a new olfactory depth. The reworked base with the addition of tobacco amplifies warmth and sensuality, and is designed to last up to 16 hours. The fragrance was created by Jean-Christophe Hérault exclusively for Dolce & Gabbana. Fragrance notes: Top notes: The opening is bright and refined: Tarocco Orange releases its natural sweetness, while the sparkling freshness of Grapefruit brings vitality to the composition Heart notes: At the heart, French Clary Sage adds aromatic elegance and depth Base notes: In the base, the fragrance reveals its full intensity: the addition of an enveloping accord of Tobacco, enhanced by the original amber and woody nuances, leaves a warm, sensual, and long-lasting trail

Set contains: CK One Eau de Toilette, 50ml CK One Shower Gel, 100ml

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Oud For Grace Eau De Parfum, 90ml
listings.description: OUD FOR GRACE from INITIO Parfums Privés reinterprets Oud through a refined, contemporary lens. This Eau de Parfum spray opens with luminous Bergamot and Black Pepper, revealing precious woods and Oud, softened by warm Vanilla and Praline.

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Moonlight In Heaven Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Kilian Hennessy’s Inspiration: A dazzling beam of pearlized light dances on the oceans belly, witnessed by two lovers who watch from a balcony draped in floating white opaque gauze that seems alive, responding to a warm wind that blows. The lovers, high above the world to almost touch the stars, with full hearts and bodies light as air. The Perfume: A true olfactory pleasure, the fresh perfume of tasty mango and the fresh scent of powdered sambac jasmine are mixed with coconut milk and rice, of a pallor similar to the moon, all wrapped in tonka bean and the delicacy of vetiver. Both unique and familiar, this fresh perfume with an exotic fragrance from Moonlight in Heaven pushes you to open the doors of paradise. Perfume notes: Grapefruit, Mango, Roasted Tonka Beans. Perfumer: Calice Becker.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Fantasies Ideal One Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Ideal One tells the fantasy of the magnetic intimacy between you and a dream partner, who has been conceived to be the perfect match, captured in a carnal and sensual skin scent. Each of the Replica Fantasies fragrances is shaped around a surreal ingredient, born from the imagination of Perfumers. Master Perfumer Christophe Raynaud has bottled this fantasy, crafting this new fragrance around a unique Skin Fusion Accord. Imagine feeling your essences intertwining in a singular, skin-to-skin, intoxicating moment. So intense that the boundaries between you and your ideal one begin to blur, to become one. With this powerful trail, dream of carrying the permanent imprint of your Ideal One close to your skin.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Muse Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: To draw the silhouette of his ideal, trace the iconic pieces his muses inspired, the couturier dipped his pen in the darkest of inks. Thousands of sketches embody the essence of the couturier’s aesthetics in fluid black lines. The ink blends all of his unforgettable muses, as captured through Yves Saint Laurent’s vision. The olfaction: To capture the essence of his muses, Yves Saint Laurent turned to ink. Thousands of sketches flowed from his hand, each fluid stroke revealing the inspiring silhouettes of his ideal. In those bold, black lines, he translated inspiration into tangible form, immortalising the essence of his muses and all the creativity he drew from them. Ink is the enigmatic accord chosen for Le Vestiaire des Parfums’s new fragrance: Muse. A strikingly streamlined composition crafted by Principal Perfumer Marie Salamagne: "The ink reveals enigmatic woody notes, intimate and elegant smoky facets. It veils the skin in subtle, dark, metallic tones, slightly iris-y, earthy. For me, the ink takes on the colours of creativity and mystery. It stimulates the imagination." The dusky note is etched onto a precious ingredient, Marie Salamagne compares both to paper and skin, for its softness. Carnal and supple, iris concrete offers powdery, buttery, woody and leather facets for a perfect blend. Empowered by a sensual Bourbon vanilla absolute pod – another sublime material crafted for YSL - the result is what Marie Salamagne calls "a skin scent that explodes." A fragrant tattoo with an impressive trail, as distinctive and memorable as YSL’s fascinating muses. Fragrance family: Woody Ambery. Top notes: Incense, Lavender Ourika, Clary Sage Heart Heart notes: Ink accord, Ambrette Absolute Base notes: Vanilla Bourbon Absolute, Iris Concrete and Ambery Woods Accord The inspiration: Elegant. Empowered. Androgynous. Yves Saint Laurent’s muses were like no other. Inspiring silhouettes – artists, models, actors, friends and loved ones, starting with his mother – who embodied the couturier’s style, spirit and ideal. At the heart of every Yves Saint Laurent creation lies the inspiration he drew from his muses. Their unique energy ignited Mr. Saint Laurent’s imagination and shaped his designs. More than just inspirations, they were the living embodiment of his vision. A vision that liberated the silhouette, redefined beauty, and ultimately, transformed an era. His muses were the epitome of the YSL style. They exuded a nonchalant elegance, a sense of effortless sophistication. They were often seen in simple yet impeccably tailored pieces, effortlessly donning tuxedos, embodying a chic silhouette. They were also the embodiment of the YSL spirit. They moved through the world with a captivating blend of purpose and individuality. They exuded an effortless confidence that defied convention by embracing androgyny, bold style choices.

His muses were the epitome of the YSL style. They exuded a nonchalant elegance, a sense of effortless sophistication. They were often seen in simple yet impeccably tailored pieces, effortlessly donning tuxedos, embodying a chic silhouette. They were also the embodiment of the YSL spirit. They moved through the world with a captivating blend of purpose and individuality. They exuded an effortless confidence that defied convention by embracing androgyny, bold style choices.

At the heart of the fragrance, the emblematic Cedarwood. Thanks to its soothing scent, it reveals itself and extends in the background its milky effect in combination with the Musk and Vanilla. listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Fantasies Celestial Whispers Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: A talismanic fragrance capturing the feeling of being surrounded by a protective, ethereal embrace. A chance to step outside of the pressures of everyday life, and to take a moment to pause and reflect. Celestial Whispers captures this contemplative mood in a powerfully smoky, fresh, and spicy olfactive trail. Each of the Replica Fantasies fragrances is structured around a surreal ingredient which stems from the imagination of Master Perfumers. At the heart of this new Eau de Parfum, Master Perfumer Daniela Andrier shaped a surreal fragrance accord, the Celestial Smoke. This imaginary treasure captures the fantasy sensation of being enveloped by delicate, fragrant swirls of bright white smoke as they rise in the air, sheltering you in a halo of positive energy. Celestial Whispers cloaks you in an aura of fragrant protection, as the warmth of incense smoke intertwines with the metallic brightness of aldhehydes. The fantasy of a fragrance imbued with protective virtues.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Nuit d'Oranger Eau de Parfum for Women 50ml
listings.description: In the Chloé Atelier des Fleurs collection, artist perfumers guide your eyes and your nose towards singular flowers. Capturing Nature’s hidden scents and revealing the beauty in the unexplored through women's fragrance. The Fleurs de Nuit women's Eau de Parfum collection unveils the unsuspected fragrance of three flowers whose perfume changes as night falls. During the day, these enigmatic flowers absorb the brightness and warmth of the sun. At dusk - only at dusk - they fully blossom and release new carnal, narcotic notes to create a sophisticated scent. Among this women's perfume collection is Nuit d'Oranger Eau de Parfum for Women. A symbol of the Mediterranean basin where the founder of Chloé, Gaby Aghion, was born, Orange Blossom has a fresh, delicate smell during the day. At night, it releases a generous, sensual scent that grows in intensity until dawn. In this fragrance composed by Alex Lee, Orange Blossom appears in two different forms: an airy Neroli gradually gives way to an opulent, honeyed Orange Blossom absolute. In the background of this fragrance for women, Mate and Patchouli form a herbaceous accord evoking the nature that surrounds the orange blossom. For the Fleurs de Nuit collection, the iconic Atelier des Fleurs bottle takes on a captivating shade of midnight blue – a deep mysterious colour inspired by the vastness of the celestial vault – and features an undulating glass silhouette, evoking the sunburst pleating so dear to the Maison, and a sand-colored cap. A floral scent from Chloé that is a concentrate of timeless elegance. Fragrance family: Floral. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance that stays all day, delicately spray this floral perfume on clothing and pulse points at the neck, chest and wrists.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Herba Mimosa Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Good to know: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs is being re-branded, the logo on your products may differ from the photos. The scent is still the same. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs invites you to compose your personalised Chloé fragrance as though arranging your favourite blossoms in a bouquet at a Parisian flower shop. Each perfume in the collection reveals a single floral, aromatic or woody scent rooted in the perfumer’s memory. Wear alone like a corsage or combine endlessly to create a lovely present or a perfume for all occasions. A flower, a perfumer, a story... Herba Mimosa, a luminous perfume for women by Amandine Clerc-Marie. This tender, powdery women's Eau de Parfum echoes a memory from Amandine Clerc-Marie's youth: the stirred emotions of discovering mimosas blooming in the hills of Grasse when she was 20. The powdery, woody and luminous facets of mimosa blossoms lend a botanical facet to the composition of this spring fragrance. This Chloé perfume is housed in an elegant pleated glass bottle topped with an ivory cap that appears to be carved in stone. Touches of gold at the neckband and label trim enhance the light hue of each beautiful fragrance. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists. Wear your favourite flower on its own to celebrate its vitality and intensity, or combine Herba Mimosa with other perfumes from Atelier des Fleurs to create a personalised fragrance bouquet. Disclaimer: Packaging may vary but scent remains the same.

listings.description: Bright and energetic, Burberry Her Blossom perfume fragrance for women is a love letter to London in bloom. The gourmand signature of the original Eau de Parfum is wrapped in luminous plum blossom notes. Sparkling mandarin, creamy sandalwood and comforting musk notes convey warmth and depth. The bottle is luxurious yet understated, inspired by an archival Burberry fragrance design. Fragrance Family: Floral Gourmand. Top Notes: Mandarin, Pink peppercorn Heart Notes: Plum Blossom, Peony Base Notes: Musk, Sandalwood

listings.rawTitle: Histoires de Parfums 1828 Eau de Parfum, 60ml
listings.description: JUles Verne. He was born in Nantes, at the beginning of that century of discoveries. The close ocean took him far away, inspiring in him extraordinary novels of adventure. Inspired by the father of literary science fiction, this Eau de Parfum breathes its aromatic Hesperides-like scents, just as a marine breeze over a wild heath. The scent of a treasure chest crafted from precious Wood and filled with spices from faraway lands, stowed on a boat sailing uncharted seas. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Grapefruit, Citrus, Tangerine, Eucalyptus Heart notes: Nutmeg, Pepper Base notes: Cedar, Incense, Vetiver, Pinecone

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS The Scent Parfum for Her
listings.description: The fragrance: Feel the power of attraction pull you in with BOSS The Scent Parfum for Her, an intense, addictive scent that captures the strong, undeniable chemistry flowing between a power couple. The scent: A rich, full-bodied interpretation of the iconic signature BOSS The Scent, this ambery-floral-woody fragrance unites intense contrasts to unleash an alchemy of attraction. It opens with an overdose of addictive Orange Blossom, played against the enveloping warmth of Vetiver. The heated tension is further heightened by mysterious, airy Akigalawood, weaving through the base in a mesmerising embrace that entices the senses. The bottle: BOSS The Scent Parfum for Her reinvents empowering sensuality in a striking flacon featuring the BOSS logo on deep-plum lacquered glass and a Double-B monogrammed rose-gold cap. Capturing the spotlight, its multi-faceted shape reflects the sensorial showdown within this powerfully evocative scent, while echoing the many sides of a power couple. How to use: Spray BOSS The Scent Parfum for Her on pulse points around the body to increase the longevity of this addictive scent for women.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Absolue Les Parfums Not Your Rose Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: In this land where nature's grandeur lives untamed, we grow a rose like no other. Absolue Les Parfums, a radical collection dedicated to our rose, born in our domain. Our first-ever rose-dedicated haute-parfumerie collection composed of 11 scents unveils our exclusive centifolia rose like you've never smelled before. Reinventing perfumery's iconic ingredient. Not Your Rose Eau de Parfum with Ambrette and moss. Hiding in the winter haze, she is not your rose. Cold and mysterious, she cannot be possessed. Almost impossible to reach, she belongs to nature. Surviving the winter frost, she is glistening with aquatic rose and enveloped in soft musk. Meet The Perfumer. Caroline Dumur: "Hiding in the winter haze, the rose is at the same time fresh, almost cold and sensual, shaded with mystery. [...] an enigmatic accord that takes us back to that ephemeral moment, just after the rain... highlighted with ambrette, gently iridescent." How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Hypnotic Poison Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Seeped in extreme natural tones, Hypnotic Poison Eau de Parfum draws its strength from powerful absolutes. The lush charm of sambac jasmine absolute mingled with a welcoming orange blossom absolute is wrapped in smooth, intensely evocative tonka bean. The round licorice note behind the seductiveness of Hypnotic Poison is boosted to new, bolder heights. It creates irresistible appeal empowered by the vanilla, an immediate sign of gratitude. An atmosphere of total deliciousness reigns supreme. The bottle of Hypnotic Poison-fragrance of mystery-is an absolute icon. A sultry incarnation of the forbidden fruit.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Escentric 01 Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Escentric 01 celebrates the hyper-abstraction of Iso E Super. Escentric 01 focuses on Iso E Super at 65% of the fragrance compound in an abbreviated formula designed to maximise the molecule's efflorescence. It contains lime peel, hedione (green jasmine bud), orris incense, balsamic notes, and fresh musk, producing a seriously lingering base note. Iso E Super does not exist in nature and was created in a laboratory at the IFF in 1973. This composition echoes the mystical power of Escentric 01 in a cult-scented formula that will add a dose of olfactory intrigue to your everyday. A unisex fragrance liberated from preconceptions of identity and form. We heard the best things come in small packages. How to use: Spritz onto your pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind your ears, as desired, and let it dry naturally.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden A Gloaming Night Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci fragrances opens a new story of magic and imagination in Luxury Collection: The Alchemist’s Garden. The singular unisex fragrances in The Alchemist's collection of Eau de Parfum, Acqua Profumata and Perfumed Oils become customisable and transformative when layered in a multitude of perfume combinations to construct a special enticing scent that stays with you all day - the amount the perfume lingers in the air when it is worn. “The Perfumed Oils and Acqua Profumata create mesmerising individual statements. Each oil or floral water of the collection can be layered with each Eau de Parfum. Just play with the scent to find your favourite, as an alchemist would work to find the gold formula,” says Alberto Morillas. The scent: A Gloaming Night continues the story of magic and imagination created by Maître Parfumeur Alberto Morillas with a Gucci perfume built around an aromatic combination. The irresistible scent, bewitching like no other, opens with the warmth of Cinnamon, reveals a deep woody Vetiver and falls into the Patchouli intensity. The bottle: The design of each Eau de Parfum bottle is inspired by the bottles found on wooden shelves of a vintage apothecary, curious pharmacy jars and the first perfumery containers. Gold lettering, decoration and secret symbols appear on the Eau de Parfum, contained in lacquered Gucci fragrance glass bottles with stoppers - covetable objects for lovers of mystery. How to use: Each Perfumed Oil and Acqua Profumata in The Alchemist's collection can be layered with each Eau de Parfum: experiment with combinations to build a unique scent of your beloved scent. Bottling the essence of nature into sublime distillations, the customisable compositions are designed to be layered together, each building from a hero ingredient that shifts and magnifies its character when paired with other Gucci fragrances. The beauty of alchemy is in the transformation: layered scents that become new expressions of art and unfold the magic of unseen worlds. Layer pure and highly concentrated perfumed oils with the Eaux de Parfum to intensify its strength and richness: Apply your choice of The Alchemist Perfumed Oil first on the wrist and neck Follow with your Eau de Parfum layered on top The Acqua Profumata can be applied over the Eau de Parfum to recharge top notes and refresh the overall impression of your signature scent A recommended layer combination for A Gloaming Night perfume, designed to bring out the different facets of its enticing woody spicy scent: Like sunset falling around you, deepen A Gloaming Night Gucci perfume with Nocturnal Whisper perfumed oil. The pair brings out a spicy oud, elegant and exquisite Add texture with delicate Fading Autumn perfumed water for a captivating, intense wood finish

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Florabloom Eau de Toilette
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Florabloom, a joyful, multicoloured explosion of rainbow florals within a bouquet whose heart radiates with true-to-nature tuberose. Set around dazzling white tuberose flower, roses, iris and violets accords come together against a mossy background to reveal sunny and bright creamy facets. Inspired by a rare natural phenomenon known as a superbloom, this creation evokes the multicoloured carpets of desert flowers that so spectacularly spring to life after heavy rainfall. "Florabloom is a celebration of the power and beauty of nature, that’s both wild and poetic." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria fragrances contain up to 95% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The Aqua Allegoria fragrances are housed in a screw-top, refillable bottle made in France from at least 15% recycled glass. The 200 mL refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75 mL and 125 mL bottles. *90% to 95% ingredients of natural origin, in accordance with ISO 16128, calculation including water. How to use: Create your own signature fragrance by combining Florabloom with either Flora Salvaggia, Nettare di Sole, Pera Granita or Flora Cherrysia. For the ideal amount of fragrance, simply choose your preferred pairing from the collection and spray in equal quantities.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau & Magnolia Eau de Toilette Intense
listings.description: While the heart of the fragrance boasts a floral bouquet bursting with water, notes of magnolia are enhanced by an aquatic freshness. A precious wood base brings the olfactory trail to its conclusion. The inspiration: It all started with water, source of life, original element, raw material, source of endless possibilities. A drop gave rise to the first Issey Miyake fragrance, which continues its journey now to encounter the aerial and delicately feminine magnolia flower. A new encounter between pure water and sensory nature. The bottle: Issey Miyake wanted to present L'Eau d'Issey in a bottle that could transcend the boundaries of time and fashion, and L’Eau d’Issey Eau & Magnolia pays tribute to this bottle in its own unique way. A minimalist bottle that gets back to the essential, adorned with a touch of beige and topped with a wooden cap echoing the raw, untouched nature that has inspired it. The bottle of L’Eau d’Issey Eau & Magnolia is made of 20% recycled PCR glass. Each wooden cap, made of ash, is unique in terms of its colour and its veins. The fragrance itself is vegan and made of 85% of natural origin ingredients.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Miss Dior Essence de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: A symbol of confident, liberated femininity imagined by Francis Kurkdjian, Dior Perfume Creative Director, the new Miss Dior Essence expresses its intensity in a high concentration through a trail saturated by colours, with gourmand and sensual accords. Miss Dior Essence will surprise and draw you in at the same time: the succulent blackberry and elderflower accord transcends a wildly luxurious jasmine bouquet. On a base of dense, enveloping woody oak accords, this mischievous chypre resonates like a bold brushstroke on Miss Dior's floral olfactory canvas. The new Miss Dior Essence becomes the manifesto of a new generation of women freed from social conventions. Miss Dior Essence asserts itself while staying true to its original identity, reinterpreting the heritage bottle designed by Christian Dior in 1948: a frosted houndstooth motif and a black grosgrain 'poignard' bow made in France, which adorns a precious glass cap.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez NARCISO Poudrée Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: With his line ‘NARCISO’, Narciso Rodriguez creates a set of perfumes that plays with the extremes of seduction and attraction. Enter NARCISO Eau de Parfum Poudrée: a feminine fragrance that channels its wearer’s beauty from within, building on this mystery of attraction. The Fragrance: Powerfully feminine, NARCISO Eau de Parfum Poudrée enwraps the body in an intensity that’s sweet and unique. The patented heart of musc, found only in Narciso Rodriguez fragrances, is combined with white jasmine at the top and woody vetiver at the base. This powdery fragrance, as the name suggests, is only strengthened with the addition of black cedar and vetiver. The Bottle: An original bottle, the lacquered glass cube matches its cap to the bottle, the lacquer contouring towards the base in a semi-oval shape. It sits beautifully on its own as well as alongside other fragrances from the NARCISO line. Top notes: White jasmine petals and Bulgarian rose Middle notes: A powdery heart of musk Base notes: White and black cedars, vetiver

listings.description: Since 1976, the Queens of Jean Paul Gaultier catwalks have dazzled us with their uniqueness and diversity in all of his creations. Boldly brilliant and fearlessly proud to be themselves. Celebrating their beauty in all its forms. Gaultier Divine Le Parfum honours their golden and radiant solar divinity in its iconic conical corset. Blessed with a new amber floral intensity, its aura radiates like no other beneath the star at its zenith. More powerful and more sensual than ever before. What could be more divine than being a woman? The fragrance: An intensely divine amber floral fragrance. Be your divine and sensual self with this Eau de Parfum that's even more intense and daring than the original. Spectacular lily and radiant frangipani bestow their dazzling solar energy. Gaultier Divine's salty kiss embraces the warm opulence of benzoin and the airy gourmand indulgence of an irresistible meringue. You'll be crowned with an all-new addiction that's as seductive as it is radiant. The bottle: Her glittering corset. Under a blazing sun, the famous corset scintillates with an unrivalled golden glow, irresistibly more intense and charismatic. The uninhibited curves and conical bust encased in flamboyant gold-ribbed metal celebrate a solar femininity with an untamed spirit. Her almighty power is divine and radiant.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL N°19 Poudré Eau de Parfum Spray, 100ml
listings.description: A powdery and silky interpretation of the original composition of N°19. A floral-powdery-green fragrance which blends the powdery notes of Iris with the softness of White Musks. A nuanced floral-powdery-green fragrance. The legendary Galbanum-Iris Pallida accord of N°19 is blended with smooth, soft White Musks. An incredibly soft, musky and voluptuous composition.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Limited Edition Cheeky Biquíni Perfume Mist, 90ml
listings.description: Cheeky Biquíni Perfume Mist is inspired by the playful freedom of Praia do Abricó, Rio’s legendary nude beach. Ripe and sun-kissed, this fragrance bursts open with mouthwatering apricot nectar, then entices with fresh orange blossom and sheer vanilla. Bare it all.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Intense 75ml
listings.description: L’Eau d’Issey pour Homme offers the right balance of strength sparkling notes. A freshness that lasts and surprises with an unexpected burst of tangerine and yuzu, Japanese lemon accord with a deep and vibrant aroma like a memory. At the heart, the Water Lily note gives an aquatic facet of L’Eau d’Issey pour Homme, subtly warmed by spicy notes. The base notes provide a marked masculine presence, with the assertive character of sandalwood, vetiver and tobacco amber accord. How to use: Warmth intensifies fragrance. Apply it to your body’s warmest points, such as the creases of your elbows and wrists for more strength and longevity. Avoid rubbing or dabbing after application, as this can break down the fragrance. For wrist application, apply the fragrance after hand washing which can rinse off the scent.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Intense 125ml

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Héritage Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: Created in 1992 by Jean-Paul Guerlain, Héritage celebrates the transmission of values from one generation to the next. With its secretive, discreet and refined scent, it illustrates nuanced masculinity. Inspired by yesterday's generations, Héritage is a fragrance dedicated to the men of tomorrow. It opens with aromatic freshness, succeeded by the subtlety of a warm spicy accord on a woody dry-down with shades of the East. Héritage, for a man who is at once a trustee for tradition and a herald of a new spirit. Spicy Ambery. Refined, warm, authentic. The exuberant freshness of lemon and bergamot top notes meets an aromatic breeze of lavender. Then, the heart is enriched with fresh, spicy notes such as coriander and pink pepper. Finally, with the patchouli there emerges a rich, ambery woody dry-down.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Very Irrésistible Eau de Parfum, 80ml
listings.description: Discover the iconic floral trail of Very Irrésistible Eau de Parfum by Givenchy in a new ultra-feminine redesigned bottle. The iconic floral fragrance: Composed of five roses of exceptional quality, aromatic Star Anis offers a vibrant contrast at the heart of Very Irrésistible Eau de Parfum, amplified by Patchouli wood and Vanilla. A sensual and feminine signature for those who embrace their individuality. A redesigned couture bottle: The prismatic lines of this restyled bottle exudes sophistication, beautifully contrasted by the freshness of its violet-coloured lacquer. Inspired by timeless elegance: Radiantly feminine, this floral fragrance is the promise of timeless elegance with a hint of fantasy. A unique contrast, enhanced by the trail of a captivating muse no one can resist.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Narciso Rodriguez celebrates spring through the striking beauty of flowers. This year, love blossoms as an ode to the art of the bloom. An addictive chypre ambery fragrance: Discover For Her Eau de Parfum Intense, the vegan perfume for women by Narciso Rodriguez. A story of introspection for the confident woman who expresses her innermost self with a striking intensity. This powerful new perfume takes the iconic for her sillage to intense new heights in a chypre ambery fragrance. Top notes of fruity peach are invigorated by the citrus spark of bergamot. At the core, the For Her heart of musc signature is enriched with a burst of a solar white flowers accord, creating a hypnotic bouquet. At the base, sensual vanilla and vetiver diffuse an ambery woody trail of exquisite depth. A 100% cardboard giftset, more responsibly crafted. Less is more: Giftset 100% cardboard. Narciso Rodriguez has designed its gift boxes in a more responsible way. We encourage you to give your gift boxes a second life by reusing or recycling them*. *Recycling guidelines may vary by location. Set contains: For Her Eau de Parfum Intense, 50ml For Her Body Lotion, 50ml

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Musk Therapy Body Cream
listings.description: This cream carries the restorative power of Musk Therapy. Emotions align and sensation flow, sit melts into the skin, amplifying sensation and bringing you to a heightened state of emotional freedom. Notes: bergamot, mandarin, white magnolia, cassis, white sandalwood, white musk, rose musk.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Vra Vra Vroom Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Dash it all and make haste! An energetic blast of mandarin and magnolia, enthusiastic spoonfuls of osmanthus absolute. Spritz your way to success. Nothing shall stop one now. All purchases will include a sample of the same scent to test before opening up the full-size fragrance. You lucky thing! Key notes: apricot, leather, osmanthus. "An invigorating infusion of magnolia and sage to unlock one’s imagination. Leathery floral notes revitalise and refresh."

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Cologne Collection Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Follow us into Gingerbread Land. Five quintessential Jo Malone London colognes in 9ml bottles wrapped in a gingerbread-inspired gift box. Includes Lime Basil & Mandarin and English Pear & Freesia, ready to pair or wear individually. Set contains:,/strong> English Pear & Freesia Cologne, 9ml Wild Bluebell Cologne, 9ml Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne, 9ml Lime Basil & Mandarin Cologne, 9ml Peony & Blush Suede Cologne, 9ml Your Jo Malone London order will be exquisitely wrapped in their iconic box, tied with a beautiful grosgrain ribbon. listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier La Favorite Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier has met his match. A woman who dares. A woman who defies. Gaultier's spirit incarnate: La Favorite. This floral amber Eau de Parfum mesmerises with its audacious aroma, where smouldering benzoin blends with the radiant allure of Queen of the Night. Addiction? Inevitable. For her, Gaultier has crafted a revolutionary bottle, its playful silhouette a wink to the iconic Fragile. She’s who we aspire to be, adored by all; she becomes our role model, our inspiring idol, our favourite. Her mantra? "Own the Light!" A rallying cry of self-assurance. An invitation to embrace audacity. Paris is her playground. The Eiffel Tower, her stage. The interior small figurine comes in the 50ml & 100ml formats. Fragrance description: A Floral amber of unparalleled audacity, quintessentially Gaultier. This Jean Paul Gaultier Eau de Parfum unveils an intense, addictive floral amber accord. At the heart of the scent lies an extraordinary benzoin duo, releasing rich, liqueur-like vanilla notes. Complementing this, Queen of the Night glows with a captivating brilliance. The base notes reveal tonka bean, cloaking the fragrance in a lingering sensuality. La Favorite never plays it safe. Neither does her fragrance. Your La Favorite bottle can be refilled in four steps, each executed with panache: 1. Unscrew the pump of your bottle with confidence, without hesitation 2. Screw the La Favorite refill onto your bottle and turn until you feel resistance: the filling begins automatically. The bottle fills. The intensity returns 3. When the bottle is full, refilling will stop automatically. Unscrew the refill tip 4. Screw the pump back on tightly. Your bottle regains its radiance. You're ready to take the stage again. Time and time again
