listings.description: Eau de Citron Noir expresses the joyful and generous freshness of the Colognes in the form of a hand and body cleansing gel. Another way to wear fragrance. Eau de Citron Noir combines the sharp and zesty freshness of lemon with the depth of black tea and the smoky notes of guaiac wood. The straight lines of the bottle are embellished with a radical deep blue, emblematic of Eau de Citron Noir, and two signature details: the H imprint of the base and the saddle nail engraved on the pump. The bottle is made of recyclable glass. The Eau de Citron Noir hair and body shower gel refill can be used to replenish the 300ml bottle. A responsible gesture, integral to an object created to last. A rich gel that forms a pleasant, easy-rinse lather. The skin is soft and delicately fragranced.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette Travel Spray, 10ml
listings.description: Feel the heat. The original cult fragrance now has an all-new look. Alluring and sexy. The velvety texture of the Tiare Flower is showcased along with creamy Coconut and the radiant warmth of Amber, Sandalwood and Vanilla. All heat. All desire. All woman. Enjoy sensuous notes of Vetiver and Myrrh, fused with warm Mandarin, Sicilian Bergamot and Lemon. Radiant notes of Jasmine and Magnolia petals will evoke your senses endlessly. How to use: Spray all over body whenever you want to surround yourself with endless summer.

listings.rawTitle: Clinique My Happy Peony Picnic Eau de Parfum, 15ml
listings.description: A fragrance romantic like an afternoon stroll in the park. Wander in a sun-drenched flower garden where giant blooming peonies and roses refuse to be ignored. A Floral Fruity scent to wear alone or layer. Notes: Black Currant Buds, Strawberry, Passion Fruit, Peony, Rose, Plum, Cedar, Amberwood, Vanilla Style: Romantic. Floral. Infectious How to use: No rules. Wear alone or collect the other My Happy™ fragrances to layer.

listings.rawTitle: Fragrance Du Bois Wild Orange Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Wild Orange is a revitalising symphony of spirited woody citrus notes, encapsulating the very soul of springtime blooms on an orange tree. A triumvirate of dominant fruity notes, mandarin, orange and bergamot, alongside the lively zest of lemon, creates a vivid and invigorating opening that evokes the force and vitality of the emerging blooms. The journey then delves into the untamed allure of wild orange blossoms and the gentle nodding heads of lily of the valley. The cool, resinous wood tones of cypress beautifully counterbalance these heady white florals, establishing a harmonious equilibrium. The fragrance's heart is further enhanced by a comforting, warm woody dry-down, where sandalwood's creamy warmth and cedarwood's aromatic embrace are grounded by the steadfast presence of vetiver and patchouli, rounding out this Citrus-Floral-Woody perfume that delights, revives and invigorates the senses. As refreshingly untamed as its namesake, it captures the essence of citrus freshness, floral elegance and woody depth, and is a perfect homage to the wide-ranging versatility of the orange family.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Les Infusions de Prada Iris Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Each Infusion fragrance in the Prada collection, is a poetic interpretation of a single, natural ingredient. Soft and elegant, Infusion D'Iris Eau de Parfum, delicately recaptures the beauty of iris, creating an elegant, modern, and unique, unisex composition. This charming fragrance combines subtle notes of powdery Iris with fresh mandarin, Tunisian neroli. The base is then warmed with subtly sweet notes of benzoin. Available in 30ml, 50ml and 100ml sizes. The perfect gift for a loved one, or signature perfume for yourself.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Mr. Burberry Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Introducing Mr. Burberry Eau de Parfum. An intense interpretation of the original Mr. Burberry, the fragrance captures the essence and anticipation of London at nighttime. A warm, sensual and woody scent with fresh and aromatic top notes of tarragon and comforting, spicy cinnamon, layered delicately on rich patchouli with a base of amber and smokey vetiver. The bottle honours the black Heritage Trench Coat and its signature design details. Bold and masculine, the weighted cap references horn-look buttons, while a hand-tied knot in English-woven gabardine sits around the neck, celebrating the innovative fabric invented by Thomas Burberry more than 100 years ago.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Aqua Universalis Cologne Forte Eau de Parfum
listings.description: The bergamot of Calabria and the softness of white musk are combined with the brightness of vaporous white flowers of sweet pea and seringa. Aqua Universalis Cologne forte Eau de Parfum symbolises pure white, transparency and a blooming and comfortable sensation of freshness. This pure breath of fresh, enveloping air is the expression of the palette of emotions induced by light. This musky citrus fragrance spreads its blooming and comfortable sensation of freshness through the oil of bergamot from Italy and the oil of rose from Bulgaria. Notes: Bergamot oil from Italy, Damascena rose oil from Bulgaria, white floral accord (mock orange, sweet peas), white musk accord. Family: Musky Citrus.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Allegra Magnifying Rose Essence Eau de Parfum, 40m
listings.description: The enchanting Magnifying Rose essence maximises the floralcy of your Eau de Parfum. The floral essence of Magnifying Rose entices with a velvety, voluptuous intensity. Unlike a classic, powdery Rose, this blend of Bulgarian and Turkish Roses boasts a remarkable radiance, thanks to a unique fragmentation of essential oils with an unusual distillation. With a sparkle refined by subtle woody notes, Magnifying Rose delivers a luscious bouquet full of the optimism of love. Reveal a new facet of your Allegra fragrance with Magnifying Rose. #MagnifyForMore Love

listings.rawTitle: New Notes Akigala Mandarino Extrait de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Discover the essence of serenity. Akigala Mandarino is a cheerful and invigorating fragrance that perfectly balances the bright zest of citrus with warm, spicy woods. It opens with a joyful burst of fresh fruits, transitions into a festive floral heart, and settles into a passionately warm and woody finish. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Zesty Mandarin, Passion Fruit, Fresh Raspberry Heart notes: Delicate Floral Bouquet Base notes: Spicy Akigalawood, Warm Amber

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Herod Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Herod is personified by its blend of diverse notes, exuding a smoky vanilla scent. This Eau de Parfum opens on spicy top notes of cinnamon and pepper to then show its powerful heart of tobacco leaf, incense, ciste and osmanthus. These peppery notes are further surrounded by vanilla pods, musk, patchouli and woody accord at the base. An elegant and discernible perfume, for both men and women, it is the epitome of old-world sophistication. Olfactive notes: Top notes: Cinnamon, Pepper Heart notes: Tobacco Leaf, Incense, Ciste, Osmanthus Base notes: Vanilla pods, Musk, Woody accord, patchouli Herod echoes the stunning reputation of its equestrian namesake and is presented in a rich earthy-toned bottle and angular stopper. An ode to vanilla, crowned with tonka bean and sublimated with a hint of cinnamon, Herod leaves behind a delicate sillage which is both warm and bold, classic and exotic.

To achieve these especially bright notes, Calabrian bergamot is harvested when it’s perfectly ripe. Fresh-picked, the bergamot contains sweet and crisp notes. The Magnifying Essences are made from precious tailor-made ingredients to intensify magnificent Italian emotions. As their name suggests, these essences are highly concentrated, powerful and vibrant, an expression of true exclusivity. Beautiful worn alone, Bvlgari Allegra Magnifying essences also harmonise with any of the collection’s Eaux de Parfum to create a unique scent.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder White Linen Eau de Parfum, 60ml
listings.description: The crisp, refreshing fragrance to live in all year long. White Linen captures the very essence of a perfect day: early Spring breezes tinged with the fragrance of fresh flowers and endless blue sky. It evokes the crispness of clean sheets, the coolness of white flowers and fresh greenery. Bulgarian Rose, Violet and Orris blossoms lend a kind of natural elegance that transcends the seasons. The Inspiration: "The more complex and pressured a woman's life becomes, the more she prizes simplicity and ease. White Linen is that calming element that can lift spirits and make a woman feel cool and calm." Estée Lauder, Founder. The name White Linen came about because Mrs Lauder envisioned the woman who would wear it as fresh, crisp and clean.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum, the new masculine intensity, by Prada. The fragrance of a powerful, transformative journey to open new horizons. Built on a conviction that we can push beyond our limits, reimagining what’s possible and augmenting our performances. Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum combines intense sophistication and sensuality. Opening with an invigorating burst of grapefruit essence, contrasted with the woody vibrancy of incense and a rich Vanilla Bean accord. The bottle, inspired by the technological excellence and sleek, dynamic beauty of extreme sailing boats, echoes the power of the fragrance that lies within. Lacquered in a sophisticated deep blue, alluding to the magnetic intensity of the ocean depths. Iconised by the iconic Prada red line. An elegant, night-black cap is finished with a red dot, a symbolic reference to Luna Rossa, the red moon. Jake Gyllenhaal, the face of Prada Luna Rossa Ocean. The incarnation of the modern adventurer. A man combining physical and intellectual strength with an understanding of technology and innovation. Mastering it to better himself and his craft, in full awareness of his own limits, yet eager to push them beyond.

listings.description: Dylan Blue is the essence of the Versace man today. It's a fragrance full of character and individuality, an expression of a man's strength and also his charisma. Highly distinctive with a fragrant woody aroma based on the unique olfactory properties of precious natural ingredients and the latest generation of molecules. New and exquisite qualities of natural citrus, bergamot and grapefruit combine with modern hints of fig leaf to give an incisive, Mediterranean freshness. Aquatic notes lend depth and round off the citrus tang. Violet leaves with a dash of black pepper add another virile dimension. But the sophisticated and innovative woody notes of ambrox, papyrus and organic patchouli form the perfume's powerful, pulsating heart.

listings.description: Introducing a new olfactive family, Kilian Hennessy pays tribute to his heritage, as heir to the renowned French cognac-making family, and to his choice olfactory intoxicants for driving the night towards dawn. Opening with cognac oil, upon a blend of oak absolute, cinnamon essence and tonka bean absolute, the scent’s long-lasting notes of sandalwood, praline and vanilla make for a delicious finish, a rare concoction only angels should experience. The cutting-edge dispenser will stop transferring the perfume automatically once the container is full. This innovative new 100ml refill allows an easy spill-proof process for your 50ml fragrance bottle, your travel spray, or your carafes.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Sauvage Spray Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: The UK'S best-selling fragrance.* A radically fresh composition, dictated by a name that has the ring of a manifesto. That was the way François Demachy, DIOR Perfumer-Creator, wanted it: raw and noble all at once. Natural ingredients, selected with extreme care, prevail in excessive doses. Radiant top notes burst with the juicy freshness of Reggio di Calabria Bergamot. Ambroxan, derived from precious ambergris, unleashes a powerfully woody trail. It is an act of creation inspired by wide-open spaces. An ozone-blue sky sprawled above a rocky landscape, white-hot beneath the desert sun. Now refillable, the 100ml bottle of Sauvage Eau de Toilette is part of the House of Dior's eco-design initiative. *Based on NPD Full Year 2024 in value.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Intense Marc Jacobs Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A declaration of self, Marc Jacobs Perfect Intense eau de parfum is a comforting floral perfume a vibrant clash of jasmine, daffodil, and toasted almonds. A moreish, rich scent with depth, texture and personality. About the scent: This long-lasting Marc Jacobs Perfect Intense eau de parfum sets the tone from the get-go, with creamy night-blooming jasmine releasing a honeyed sweetness that mingles beautifully with daffodil in an intriguing, solar bouquet. Earthy roasted almonds arrive in the heart for a toasted nuttiness that lends the flower notes a textured, edible feel, brightened by a dash of pink pepper for a vivaciousness that lingers into the dry-down. Sesame oil, cashmeran and sandalwood melt together in the base, enveloping the scent in a heavy veil of comforting woodiness for a fragrance that wraps around you like a second skin. Key notes: Top notes: Roasted Almonds, Pink Pepper, Pamplezest™ Heart notes: Daffodil Absolute, Jasmin Sambac Base notes: Sesame Oil, Sandalwood New Caledonia, Cashmeran™ About the bottle: This gorgeous rich gold juice is enclosed in an eccentric perfume bottle topped with a cluster of lucky charms: little fragments of Marc Jacobs himself to make your own. About the fragrance: Absolutely perfect just the way you are. With Marc Jacobs Perfect Intense Eau de Parfum for women, the designer sends the message out loud and clear: you don’t need to change a thing. A fragrant manifesto to inspire you to practice self-love, self-acceptance, and self-care by embracing all the unique quirks that make you who you are. As Marc Jacobs himself likes to say: "I’m perfect as I am." How to use: This perfume has been crafted to follow where you lead, a scented shadow and fragrant mirror image of yourself. Designed to be worn close to the skin to comfort and ground you, with personality and depth that make it perfect for night-time. Make Marc Jacobs Perfect Intense the finishing touch to your beauty routine, applying with care to your wrists, behind your ears, and over your heart to warm the scent and release its notes into the universe.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Orchidée de Minuit Eau de Parfum for Women 50ml
listings.description: In the Chloé Atelier des Fleurs collection, artist perfumers guide your eyes and your nose towards singular flowers. Capturing Nature’s hidden scents and revealing the beauty in the unexplored through women's fragrance. The Fleurs de Nuit women's Eau de Parfum collection unveils the unsuspected fragrance of three flowers whose perfume changes as night falls. During the day, these enigmatic flowers absorb the brightness and warmth of the sun. At dusk - only at dusk - they fully blossom and release new carnal, narcotic notes to create a sophisticated scent. Among this women's perfume collection is Orchidée de Minuit Eau de Parfum for Women. Only once in its lifetime, the white Orchid unfolds in the dark and exhales a sweet smell that attracts pollinating insects and enables the birth of Vanilla pods. Perfumers Mathieu Nardin and Cécile Matton captured this unique moment in this amber floral perfume. The delicate notes of the Orchid flower in this fragrance for women become almost animalic in contact with rum, benzoin and Patchouli. Their sensuality is heightened by an addictive Vanilla absolute as if the flower were suddenly transformed into a pod. For the Fleurs de Nuit collection, the iconic Atelier des Fleurs bottle takes on a captivating shade of midnight blue – a deep mysterious colour inspired by the vastness of the celestial vault – and features an undulating glass silhouette, evoking the sunburst pleating so dear to the Maison, and a sand-colored cap. A floral scent from Chloé that is a concentrate of timeless elegance. Fragrance family: Ambery. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance that stays all day, delicately spray this floral perfume on clothing and pulse points at the neck, chest and wrists.

listings.rawTitle: Fragrance Du Bois Milano Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Milan, where style icons rub shoulders with a wealth of history, art and culture, has an inimitable style of its own where modernity meets timeless style. An old-world fashion capital of romance requires a signature fragrance of note, and that fragrance is undeniably Milano, a liquefied expression of glamour, high society and impeccable class, paying tribute to the city’s fashion history. Created by perfumer Shadi Samra, this sumptuous fragrance opens with a burst of expressive Sicilian bergamot and orange, enhanced by bright saffron and thyme for the freshness of Italian springtime. A magic touch of a fruity accord alongside rich olibanum and jasmine in the heart, gives the composition an aromatic character, before long-lasting base notes of vanilla, musk and amber luxuriate in a generous and exclusive leather accord that rounds out this Citrus-Woody fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Tuberose Gardenia Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The scent story: Tuberose Gardenia captures two magnificent white flowers in a blooming bouquet. Notes of luxurious Tuberose come together with the scents of enchanting Gardenia and delicate Carnation over a base of Vanilla for a bold, multifaceted fragrance. A classic composition with a modern signature, this fragrance is a celebration of two beautiful white flowers embedded in Aerin’s memories of treasured moments. The feeling: Luxurious & Special. Fragrance family: Timeless Floral. Fragrance notes: Gardenia Tuberose Vanilla Aerin's inspiration: "My grandmother, Estée, launched the first Private Collection fragrance in 1973, with the idea of sharing a special scent she had originally created just for herself. While I was the Creative Director of Estée Lauder, I worked on Tuberose Gardenia – a scent that joined Private Collection and was a tribute to my grandmother and two of my favourite flowers, Tuberose and Gardenia. It is an honour to bring this timeless and beloved fragrance into the AERIN Fragrance Collection." Aerin Lauder, Founder and Creative Director, AERIN. The Fragrance Collection: AERIN's Fragrance Collection is a wardrobe of distinctive perfumes inspired by Aerin's own travels, experiences and memories. Tuberose Gardenia is an intricate floral fragrance inspired by treasured memories and heritage.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Black Saffron Absolu de Parfum Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Black Saffron Absolu reimagines the signature scent with opulent spicy and leathery facets, honouring the precious spice's enduring legacy as an ever-evolving red thread between cultural heritage and modern identity. Vibrant nutmeg and juicy blackcurrant introduce a bright, dynamic opening, which softens into a lush floral heart. At the base, bold notes of black leather, incense, patchouli, and agarwood bring depth, offering a richer, more addictive expression of Black Saffron’s signature. The Absolu de Parfum is held in a redesigned bottle, an homage to craftsmanship. Embodying the deep intensity and transformation, the textured cap, inspired by Yakisugi, the Japanese art of charring wood, opens to reveal the silver and gold atomiser spray, complementing the bottle’s elemental design and the clean curves of the glass that show the intense colour of the fragrance within.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Kurky Eau Parfumée, 70ml
listings.description: Kurky, the affectionate nickname of Francis Kurkdjian in his youth, evokes an insatiable desire for freedom. The next chapter in Kurky’s story introduces a new, alcohol-free interpretation: Kurky Eau Parfumée. In a creamy cloud of white musks with a subtle hint of vanilla, Kurky Eau Parfumée distils a deliciously nostalgic scent reminiscent of a tangy tutti-frutti accord, like the aroma of a candy box. Reinterpreted with a water-based formula, this new creation releases the same notes as the Eau de Parfum, leaving an enveloping, comfortable, and delicate sillage on the skin. A soft, sensory introduction to fragrance for little ones, and a joyful answer to those who never lost their inner child and are seeking a lighter perfume. Its new formula delivers fragrance that is both intense and natural while remaining gentle on the skin. Kurky Eau Parfumée is alcohol-free and suitable for the sensitive skin of children aged three and up. Olfactory family: gourmand musky fruity. Olfactory notes: tangy fruity accord with tutti-frutti notes, gourmand musky accord with white musk and vanilla.

A spectacular and uniquely Gaultier lily radiates with majesty at the heart of a bouquet of white flowers. Kissed with delicious meringue. And infused with an iodized breeze. Now you’re Divine! With this addictive and irresistible marine floral fragrance. The bottle: The gold of a liberating corset. An homage to women, Gaultier Divine proudly shows off her voluptuous and uninhibited curves. Gaultier's famous corset is much more than an item of lingerie, it is a precious jewel that honours women’s bodies and showcases their diversity. Covered in gold. Conical and already iconic. The 50ml and 100ml bottles can be refilled.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Sì Eau de Parfum Intense Refillable 30ml
listings.description: Sì (which means Yes) is the most powerful word. An open door to infinite possibilities. This single word captures life’s potential, whether you are saying Sì to passion, to freedom, to love or to yourself. Because yes after yes, sì after sì you move forward, and you become yourself. In 2023, Giorgio Armani invites women to feel the power of Sì with the new SÌ Eau de Parfum Intense. The contrasting and hyper-sensory fragrance is encapsulated in a unique bottle, crafted with glass-making savoir-faire. The new flacon is adorned by the golden Sì logo, embossed in the glass. It is a powerful statement to invite each woman to say Sì and to embrace every aspect of herself. Feel the power of Sì, embrace the infinite possibilities of life in an unforgettable sensory experience with its chypre ambery fragrance: The enveloping signature blackcurrant nectar from natural origin. The feminine symphony of rose damascena absolute and velvety davana essential oil. The sensual trail of overdosed bourbon vanilla infusion from Madagascar, sourced through a sustainable program designed to support local communities. The hint of aromatic black tea, with smoky and herbaceous accents, elevating the vanilla signature of Armani SÌ Eau de Parfum Intense. The fragrance is formulated with a vegetal-based alcohol, sourced in France. How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani I Will Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Discover I WILL, a bold, contemporary fragrance that captures confidence, ambition and quiet strength. Housed in a striking black and gold architectural bottle, it opens with an energising burst of bergamot from Calabria in Italy, blended with aromatic lavender and illuminated by vibrant violet leaf accords. At its heart, rich Madagascan vanilla absolute brings warmth and depth, contrasted by smooth woody leather created by a captive molecule called 'wood leather', which redefines masculine sensuality with an unprecedented magnetic depth, power and long-lastingness. The captive molecule amplifies vanilla absolute’s addictive depth and gives way to a warm, powerful signature with a noticeable presence. The composition evolves with intensity and refinement, leaving a scent that lasts all day* and an impression that feels powerful yet effortlessly wearable. Sophisticated and distinctive, I WILL is designed for the modern man who moves with purpose. A day-to-night-signature for men who possess the resilience and willpower to shape their own destiny. *Consumer test, 69 subjects.

All our fragrances are unisex and made in France.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum 50ml Holiday Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: A special delivery wrapped with care by Prada, featuring the fougere woody notes of Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum in a full-size bottle and a travel spray. This elevated gift set is decorated with the limited-edition 'OTTAGONO' pattern, reimagined for the Holidays from the Prada Fall/Winter 2003 fashion show. Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum is a warm and sensual masculine fragrance. This Eau de Parfum is a fusion of fresh grapefruit essence, sophisticated incense, and sensual vanilla bean accord. Built on a conviction that, with technology as an extension of ourselves, we can push beyond our limits. Set contains: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum, 50ml Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum Travel Size, 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The unmistakable beach-in-a-bottle scent, now more concentrated for a lasting impression that is simply unforgettable. Notes of Tiare Flower, Coconut, Amber, Sandalwood and Vanilla, made even richer. Glow anywhere. Your moment in the sun is more than a day, an hour, a picture-perfect instant. It’s an attitude. A way of carrying your confidence, wherever you go. And it’s yours for the taking whenever you want. Because it’s here, in Bronze Goddess. Everyone wants to be a goddess. To feel worship-worthy. Anywhere. Everywhere. Unbottle your inner goddess. Unbottle the power to glow anywhere. Bronze Goddess Eau de Parfum. The scent: More intense. More glow. The unmistakable magic of notes of Tiare Flower and Coconut, paired with notes of Amber, Sandalwood and Vanilla, is made even richer. Fragrance family: Woody Earthy. Fragrance type: Solar Floral. Did you know? In fine perfumery, Eau de Parfum scents are crafted with a higher concentration of fragrance oils, versus the lighter Eau de Toilette scents. That means an Eau de Parfum will give you a more intense, lasting, luxurious experience, while the Eau de Toilette will feel more carefree and casual. The feeling. Feel iconic every day. More sun-kissed scent. More warmth and radiance. It’s an icon in the making, just like you. Top notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Mandarin Middle notes: Jasmine, Lavender, Magnolia Petals, Neroli, Tiare Flower, Coconut Base notes: Myrrh, Sandalwood, Vetiver, Amber, Vanilla The packaging. With its deep magenta hue evoking the sunset sky, the bottle is crafted in glass with faceted corners. The wave-rippled cap is set off with a pop of turquoise blue. How to use: Spray all over body whenever you want to be a Bronze Goddess in the most sun-kissed, radiant, lasting way.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Les Infusions de Prada Infusion de Figue Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Vibrant and generous, Infusion de Figure Eau de Parfum explores the multiple facets of the fig, both green and woody, fresh and creamy. The addictive fig accord is enhanced by the green notes of lentisk blended with galbanum and energised by a vivid mandarin. Infusion de Figue is encapsulated in a sophisticated Prada heritage bottle. The fresh and subtle purple Saffiano leather cap evokes the feeling of the fig’s purple velvety skin. Olfactory family: Wood. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Green Mandarin, Lemongrass, Spearmint, Citron Heart notes: Accord Figue, Fennel, Lentisque, Orange Blossom Base notes: Galbanum, Incense, White Musk How to use: Fragrance is intensified by the warmth of your own body. This breaks down the fragrance, causing it to wear off more quickly. listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Delina Exclusif Parfum 30ml
listings.description: This new take on Delina is an unprecedented captivating floral creation. The fruity opening notes of pear, lychee and grapefruit provide intrigue. At the heart, a bouquet of rose Damascena paired with incense and vetiver captures the soiree in all its beauty. Set with a subtle base of vanilla, musk and Evernyl, this Parfums de Marly scent is luminous and passionate and uses only the finest ingredients. Top notes: Pear, Lychee, Grapefruit Heart notes: Turkish Rose, Incense, Vetiver Base notes: Vanilla, Musk, Evernyl A beautiful expression of femininity, Delina Exclusif is presented in a powdery pink attire and composed around a harmony of Turkish rose that encapsulates sensuality, freshness and luxuriousness. The Eau de Parfum takes aesthetes and connoisseurs on an impromptu stroll of an Amber garden flourishing with orange, palm, jasmine and olive trees. The overarching narrative is one of mystery and charm as the freshness of a fruity bergamot-pear-lychee trio grows into burnt oud notes before sinking into a bed of soft and heady amber.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum for Women 30ml
listings.description: The power within. Burberry Goddess tells a story of self-discovery. The new campaign follows Emma Mackey and a pride of lionesses. Radiating confidence, strength and kindness, Emma embodies the spirit of Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum. The scent: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum is a unique gourmand aromatic fragrance led by a powerful trio of vanillas. On top, a vanilla infusion with woody tonalities, at the heart a vanilla caviar with a rich sweetness, and at the base a vanilla absolute enriched with luminous lavender. The bottle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum for women is encased in an elegant square-shaped bottle designed to be refilled. Refill sold separately. Gabardine beige and gold packaging adorned with a medallion reference the brand’s rich heritage. Refillable format: Thanks to a sustainable and innovative refill system, all Burberry Goddess bottles can be refilled with ease. How to refill: Remove the bottle cap, then unscrew the fragrance pump, and screw the refill onto the bottle’s neck The refill will stop automatically once the perfume bottle is filled Unscrew the refill, screw the fragrance pump back onto the bottle and replace the cap Your refilled Burberry Goddess fragrance is now ready to be used How to use: Spray the Burberry Goddess perfume generously onto pulse points such as the neck, wrists and décolletage to increase the longevity of this refined Burberry scent. Gently press onto the skin to preserve the essence of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo De Los Santos Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A scent created in celebration of life, De Los Santos incants memories and acknowledges the fleeting. An aromatic cloud of musk is pierced by the clarity of sage. listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Eau de Parfum Cristal 30ml
listings.description: The Fragrance inspiration: Narciso Rodriguez introduces Narciso Cristal Eau de Parfum, the luminous and addictive new perfume for women in the iconic Narciso collection. The fragrance is a tribute to radiant femininity, reflecting the inner light of the Narciso woman, just as the facets of a crystal radiate light to reveal its natural beauty. The Fragrance notes: This new feminine perfume captures the essence of inner light through its radiant top notes, pure and delicate heart, and sensual base notes. As the scent awakens, a glowing halo of radiant bergamot illuminates the soft petals of blooming flowers, a lush bouquet of upcycled rose and white floral accords. The fragrance gradually unfurls to a voluptuous dry-down with the iconic heart of musc, the unmistakable signature of Narciso fragrances. The musc is enhanced with elegant woody and amber facets of sensuous cedarwood and cashmeran, giving the fragrance a mysterious, diffusive trail. A sublime alchemy of lightness and depth, the scent’s luminous halo counterbalances a deep intensity. Ingredients: Narciso Cristal Eau de Parfum for women introduces a new standard of naturality, with more than 85% of its ingredients from natural origin. With a bergamot ethically-sourced from Italy, and a rose note sourced using a new upcycling process of distillation, the fragrance recovers olfactive components from distillation water to create a floral note that evokes the smell of the fresh rose. The Bottle: The iconic Narciso bottle appears in its purest form, the transparent glass tinted in delicate pink, revealing the luminous scent within. Finished with a contrasting matte pink cap, the precious object radiates the same captivating luminosity as the Narciso woman.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Eau de Parfum Cristal 50ml
listings.description: The Fragrance inspiration: Narciso Rodriguez introduces Narciso Cristal Eau de Parfum, the luminous and addictive new perfume for women in the iconic Narciso collection. The fragrance is a tribute to radiant femininity, reflecting the inner light of the Narciso woman, just as the facets of a crystal radiate light to reveal its natural beauty. The Fragrance notes: This new feminine perfume captures the essence of inner light through its radiant top notes, pure and delicate heart, and sensual base notes. As the scent awakens, a glowing halo of radiant bergamot illuminates the soft petals of blooming flowers, a lush bouquet of upcycled rose and white floral accords. The fragrance gradually unfurls to a voluptuous dry-down with the iconic heart of musc, the unmistakable signature of Narciso fragrances. The musc is enhanced with elegant woody and amber facets of sensuous cedarwood and cashmeran, giving the fragrance a mysterious, diffusive trail. A sublime alchemy of lightness and depth, the scent’s luminous halo counterbalances a deep intensity. Ingredients: Narciso Cristal Eau de Parfum for women introduces a new standard of naturality, with more than 85% of its ingredients from natural origin. With a bergamot ethically-sourced from Italy, and a rose note sourced using a new upcycling process of distillation, the fragrance recovers olfactive components from distillation water to create a floral note that evokes the smell of the fresh rose. The Bottle: The iconic Narciso bottle appears in its purest form, the transparent glass tinted in delicate pink, revealing the luminous scent within. Finished with a contrasting matte pink cap, the precious object radiates the same captivating luminosity as the Narciso woman.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L’Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge Ultime 35ml
listings.description: The forbidden has never been so hard to resist. Give in to temptation with the new Givenchy perfume for women: L’Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge Ultime. Unleashing a new chapter in the L’Interdit Rouge collection, L’Interdit Rouge Ultime offers a deliciously warm and sensual addiction to complement the spicy, carnal notes of L’Interdit Rouge Eau de Parfum.​ Temptattion in a bottle: ​Crafted by a trio of Master Perfumers, this tantalising new fragrance is composed of a white flower bouquet of orange blossom, tuberose and jasmine, tinted red with an indulgent cocoa extract to create the ultimate temptation in a bottle. Usually discarded, cacao shells from Madagascar are upcycled and transformed to reveal all the power of the scent, magnified by a patchouli and vetiver accord. An alluring blend of floral notes and intense woody facets, this sensual new Eau de Parfum is finished with a hint of ambroxan for the most long-lasting and desirable fragrance trail.​ Dressed in red: Ever since the founding of the House, red has remained the signature colour of Givenchy. Symbolising the desire to break from convention and surpass limits, it has an intrinsic energy: red is the colour of absolute freedom. With L’Interdit Rouge Ultime, Givenchy dresses its iconic bottle in opaque red inner lacquering for the most enticing women’s perfume. Complete with red lace and a red couture 4G tassel, it acts as a defiant symbol of bold sensuality. ​ Experience the ultimate thrill with new L’Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge Ultime. All you can do is give in to temptation. Fragrance family: Floral Woody Warm. Top notes: Neroli from Tunisia, Orange Blossom Absolute from Tunisia, Sambac Jasmine Absolute from India Heart notes: Tuberose Absolute from India, Cocoa Shell Extract from Madagascar Base notes: Patchouli Heart Essence from Indonesia, Vetiver Essence from Haiti, Ambroxan How to use: Your complete L'Interdit fragrance ritual: 1. Cleanse and fragrance your body with the addictive L'Interdit Shower Oil 2. For lusciously scented, velvet-soft skin, massage L'Interdit Body Milk all over 3. Spray L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge Ultime on your pulse points 4. On-The-Go: Use the L'Interdit Solid Perfume for an addictive and on-the-go application throughout the day

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Hermessence Oud Alezan Eau de Parfum Refillable 100ml
listings.description: The Hermessence Oud Alezan was born when Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel encountered an extraordinary oud. "That feeling of being immersed in an incredibly intimate and sensual material revived a disconcerting memory I have of smelling the neck of a chestnut horse." Heady, subtle and majestic, Oud Alezan embodies an accord between an exceptional, enveloping oud and a striking duo of contrasting roses. An Hermessence suitable for both men and women. The bottle is showcased by a plum-brown-colored lacquer on the glass, contrasting with the chalk-colored leather adorning the cap. The 100ml and 200ml sizes can be replenished from the 200 ml refill. A responsible gesture, integral to an object created to last. The house’s emblematic 'lantern' bottle constitutes a unique and timeless signature. Its leather cap with saddle-stitch signature is topped with an engraved Hermès saddle nail.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau de Parfum Nectar 30ml
listings.description: My Way Eau de Parfum Nectar invites you on a sensorial journey, capturing a liberated and free-spirited vision of femininity. This fruity floral fragrance, born from the delightful encounter of succulent Pear and the radiant Tuberose, is encapsulated in a new pink bottle crowned with a translucent pink talisman cap. The fragrance opens with a burst of freshness, juicy Pear accord and vibrant, aromatic Rhubarb accord. These fruity notes harmonise with the zesty Bergamot Heart and the captivating Orange Blossom, creating an intense and invigorating blend. At its heart, a white floral bouquet, unveiling a creamy heart of Tuberose Absolute. A blend of white woods and warm cedarwood enhances the sensually comforting Vanilla Bourbon infusion at base, with the comforting second-skin effect of white musks. I AM WHAT I LIVE. How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums Patchouli Mania by Fabrice Pellegrin Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the deep and sensual notes of patchouli, Fabrice Pellegrin has composed a fragrance with sensual and mysterious lines. At the opening, the fresh, gourmand and aromatic notes of davana and green hazelnut blend with the spicy, woody note of coriander seed. The warm, gourmand heart offers an addictive dose of cocoa, balanced with the deep, woody notes of clearwood® and tea. Finally, the woody, warm and earthy base reveals a mysterious patchouli in harmony with the sensuality and roundness of vetiver and cetalox®, for a deep and bewitching trail.

Mingling with the woody earthiness of sage. Lively, spirited and totally joyful. Fragrance notes: Ambrette Seeds, Sea Salt, Sage. How to use: Spritz generously onto your wrists, neck and pulse points -your body heat will help to diffuse the fragrance as the day goes on. Wear alone or layer with another Cologne or your favourite Bath & Body products. Your Jo Malone London order will be exquisitely wrapped in their iconic box, tied with a beautiful grosgrain ribbon. listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Elixir de Parfum, 60ml
listings.description: An even more intense addition to the Hero family, Hero Elixir de Parfum balances softness and power. Honouring the hero within, the fragrance for men celebrates the strength and resilience that come from vulnerability and sensitivity. It captures the spirit of a man who boldly embraces life and faces challenges with courage and determination. The Burberry scent embodies the duality of masculinity with soft, sweet notes meeting deep, strong accords. It opens with an indulgent, enveloping tonka, followed by the warm softness of vanilla, juxtaposed with robust leather. The harmony is completed by a deep, vibrant trio of cedarwood. The exclusively designed bottle transitions from deep, dark tones to a warm amber hue. The angular shape is an abstract reinterpretation of a horse’s hoof, detailed with the Equestrian Knight Design at the cap. A mix of matte and glossy finishes on the outer box represents the fragrance’s duality and the interplay between strength and softness. Powerful and soft, courageous and sensitive, Burberry Hero, the Elixir de Parfum.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR J'adore Eau de Parfum Roller-Pearl, 20ml
listings.description: What it is: The new fragrance gesture by DIOR. J’adore Eau de Parfum is housed in a precious new travel bottle. A jewel-like bottle you can take wherever you go, the Eau de Parfum slips into your bag for light and easy travel. Its soft pearl rolls voluptuously over the hollow of the neck, the wrist and the décolleté, releasing the notes of the floral bouquet of J'adore with precision. Precise and controlled application: A glass bead tip delivers just the right amount of fragrance right where you want it, with no waste. Velvet touch: A luxuriously sensual, ultra-light and fresh texture. Travel-friendly: A 20ml bottle you can take anywhere. The bottle is hermetically sealed with a screw-on cap. "J’adore is an extraordinary fragrance because it achieves the feat of being an original signature that easily appeals. Sensual without being too heavy. It is a composition that brings opposites together, that makes iconic floral notes into an alluring, unique and mysterious ensemble. J’adore invents a flower that doesn't exist." François Demachy, DIOR Perfumer-Creator. What it does: The J'adore bottle is as feminine as its fragrance. Flaunting the sensual curves of the legendary amphora created by Christian DIOR, the roller-pearl is a precious, jewel-like travel bottle you can take wherever you go. How to use. For an intense sensorial routine: 1. Apply J'adore Huile Divine body oil 2. Apply J'adore Eau de Parfum roller-pearl on pulse points 3. Enhance with the J'adore Hair Mist

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Private Blend White Suede Eau de Parfum 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Eau des Merveilles Eau de Toilette, Refillable, 30ml
listings.description: CCreated by perfumers Ralf Schwieger and Nathalie Feisthauer, Eau des Merveilles Eau de Toilette showcases the wonders of Hermès. Where the extraordinary is brought into the light with a shower of stars. With its woody and amber fragrance, the Eau de Toilette invites you to take a stroll through enveloping benzoin, spicy elemi and sparkling bigarade orange. Designed by Serge Mausau, the star-spangled magnifying-glass bottle twinkles with an orange light. The cap is engraved with the house’s seal, the “clou de selle”. With its 30 ml format, you can let your imagination run wild anytime and anywhere. The refillable bottle is designed to last, an environmentally responsible gesture. The Eau des Merveilles Constellation: The first opus of Hermès’ Merveilles collection, the Eau de Toilette invites you to discover a world of enchantment. The collection highlights the house’s poetic view of the world.

listings.rawTitle: Atelier Versace Rêve De Myrrhe Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: The luxury fragrances embody the Atelier Versace absolute dedication to excellence, encompassing a studious approach to exceptional quality components, innovative techniques and hand-craftsmanship. Rêve di Myrrhe is a celebration of the luxury of myrrh, a bewitching resin that lends the fragrance a hypnotic depth. Top notes fuse incense with the lively freshness of mandarin and pink berries, creating a sensory journey into unexplored territories. In the heart, an elegant dance between iris and tuberose becomes entwined with akigalawood for a woody modernity. Base notes feature vanilla, fir balsam and cistus, and provide this fragrance with a majestic trail of assertive character.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Capturing the spirit of an intense love affair, YSL Beauté introduces Mon Paris perfume - a new expression of love today, inspired by the city of lovers; Paris. Mon Paris is a fragrance which urges you to seize the moment; transcend the present; and prepare to fall head over heels into the arms of a passionate love. A subversive reinvention of the traditional chypre, the new floral perfume turns the traditional model upside down, by introducing a brave, bold narcotic white chypre fit for love today. Spell-binding, head-spinning, Mon Paris perfume captivates from the very first time it is worn thanks to its ultra-pure radiance, which binds patchouli to luminous, white notes, and balances it with the sensuality of musk. • Top: Pear & Fruit: Be exhilarated with the exciting and vibrant juicy notes. • Heart: Datura Orchid & White Flowers: Feel the head-spin with the forbidden floral radiance. The signature ingredient Datura Orchid is a legendary and bewitching flower known to take on a more sensuality as the night develops. • Base – Patchouli & White Musk: Lose your senses with the narcotic white musk and rotating patchouli. The reminder that love is addictive however crazy and out of control.The iconic multi-faceted bottle with the cool black lavaliere and rock leather ties is a must for your dressing table - look into the Mon Paris perfume bottle and turn your world upside down.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Rosa Verde Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Rosa Verde, a vibrant rose bathed in freshness, that captures the feel-good effect of a dive on a summer’s day. The exhilarating aquatic freshness of cucumber evokes the invigorating frisson of skin plunging into water. The caress of rose soon unfolds, like the wave of pleasure that floods the body under the water’s surface. A vibrant green floral duo, accented with a crisp pear note and mellowed by a white musk accord. For the first time, Guerlain is exploring the emotions aroused by the fragrances in its iconic collection through the prism of the Science of the Emotions, which studies the close links between scents and emotions. At the heart of this approach, the Rosa Verde perfume offers an instant feeling of pleasure and relaxation¹. "Rosa Verde is the memory of an invigorating and relaxing dive. A rose bathed in freshness that unfurls on skin like a wave of well-being." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfume Creation Director & Perfumer. A real symbol of Guerlain’s commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria fragrances are composed of more than 90% naturally derived ingredients². The French beetroot alcohol contained in their formulas is sourced from suppliers committed to sustainable agriculture. The Aqua Allegoria fragrances are housed in a screw-top, refillable and recyclable bottle made in France from at least 15% recycled glass³. The 200 mL refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75ml and 125ml bottles. ¹Using the Rosa Verde perfume increases the feeling of pleasure (self-assessment on 37 subjects) and the feeling of relaxation (instrumental test on 34 subjects). ²Calculation based on the international ISO 16128 standard, including water. ³Only on 75ml and 125ml sales formats. How to use: Create your own olfactory signature by pairing Rosa Verde with: Rosa Rossa, Flora Salvaggia, Rose Amira or Granada Salvia. For the ideal amount of fragrance, simply choose your preferred pairing from the collection and spray in equal quantities.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica From The Garden Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: From the Garden is an uplifting fragrance that evokes the joyful feeling of a sunny afternoon spent in the garden. The grounding sensation of placing one’s hands in the earth; the pleasure of picking ripe, juicy tomatoes; the buzz of bees in the air. The fragrance’s Tomato Leaf accord combines with Green Mandarin notes to create a crisp, juicy effect. While green and uplifting, From the Garden’s notes of Patchouli and Geranium bring a humid, earthy quality. Contrasted with the fragrance’s freshness, the result is an elegant, crisp scent, conjuring the memory of a sunny afternoon spent in a garden. When creating this fragrance, perfumer Olivier Cresp was inspired by his memories of spending time in his childhood garden with his father, of taking in the plants’ scent, and years later doing the same with his own son, Sebastien. From the Garden’s green and earthy notes remind Cresp of this transporting moment and being immersed in the tranquillity of a sun-drenched garden. Olfactive family: Citrus, Woody. Top notes: Green Mandarin Essence, Grapefruit Essence, Blackcurrant Accord Heart notes: Tomato Leaf Accord, Geranium Bourbon Heart Madagascar, Rose Accord Base notes: Patchouli Indonesia, Cristal Moss, White Musks

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Delina Body Cream Refill, 200ml
listings.description: The Delina body cream refill fits inside your original jar for a sustainable approach. Leaving the skin scented with the floral accents of Delina, its minimalist formula of carefully selected ingredients delicately moisturises the skin for 8 hours*. *Instrumental test on 11 women. How to use: Massage the cream onto your body as part of your daily ritual.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Million Gold For Her Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Million Gold for Her perfume. A grand floral fragrance from Rabanne. A sensual scent with an exquisite symphony of feminine white flowers, sparkling rose and mineral musk. Encapsulated in a bottle masterpiece, where intricate design meets opulence. Embrace the essence of luxury. Million Gold for Her fragrance, by Rabanne. Million Gold for Her perfume is Rabanne’s fragrant crown jewel. Sleek and sophisticated, the bottle rises with a multi-faceted glass, magnifying the golden scent within. The fragrance is adorned with a new stand-out detail that remains embedded in the Maison’s rich History: the iconic XL link. A fragrance crafting jewellery and perfumery, a symbol of glittering confidence and success. Million Gold for Her comes alive through the Maison’s first-ever Grand Floral. An innovative duality opposing metallic rose oxide with feminine white flowers, contrasted with a salty mineral musk accord. Dive into a world of golden exhilaration with Million Gold for Her. This new feminine signature comes alive through the Maison’s first-ever Grand Floral. A rule-breaker like all Rabanne fragrances, the complex structure plays out through a disruptive search for a warm metal gold effect on a floral scent. An innovative duality opposing metallic rose oxide with feminine white flowers, contrasted with a salty mineral musk accord.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Mumbai Noise Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Mumbai Noise – a tribute to the sensorial multitudes and multifaceted modernity of Mumbai, anchored in Ben Gorham’s memories of its past. A scent crowded with contrasts: of rich, warm woods and amber blended with brightness; of plummy Davana positioned alongside leather; bitter coffee stirred with sweet tonka beans. The mesmerising abundance of Chembur’s streets – the smoky haze of incense interspersed with streetside coffee carts and cacophonous soundscapes – is explored through a contemporary lens. Intense Amber Genderless Notes: Top: Davana Heart: Coffee, Tonka Beans Base: Labdanum, Sandalwood, Agarwood\ How to use: To be sprayed on the skin and/or clothes.

listings.rawTitle: Travalo Milano Refillable Perfume Atomiser
listings.description: Travalo's Milano perfume atomiser is a refined, aircraft-approved design made with textured leatherette and polished hardware. It refills in seconds directly from most standard perfume bottles using an innovative Genie-S pump-to-fill technology that transfers without spills or exposure to air. Despite its small profile, Milano will provide you with up to 65 sprays of fragrance mist. You can also easily alternate your fragrances using Travalo's convenient U-change system that makes it possible to combine a removable inner bottle (or engine) with the brand's cases.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Le Parfum Refillable
listings.description: A dive into the blue depths of the ocean. Luna Rossa Ocean Le Parfum is the new fragrance by Prada, an invitation to go beyond, to surpass limits and open new horizons, built on a conviction that with technology as an extension of ourselves, we can re-imagine what is possible and achieve extreme performances. The fragrance opens with a vigorous and fresh lemon essence, contrasted by the magnetic and sophisticated saffron accord and the lashing notes of oakwood.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L’Eau d’Issey Eau de Parfum Intense Refillable 30ml
listings.description: Issey Miyake L’Eau d’Issey Eau de Parfum Intense. The new refillable perfume for women. L’Eau d’Issey Eau de Parfum Intense is the new women’s fragrance by Issey Miyake, inspired by the ocean. As nature’s most powerful expression of intensity, the ocean offers a unique perspective without borders — the immensity of infinite horizons and the promise of limitless possibilities. L’Eau d’Issey Eau de Parfum Intense is an ode to the ocean. A new odyssey, a new Eau d’Issey. An intense floral aquatic fragrance for women: For this intense new fragrance, perfumer Amandine Clerc-Marie created a new ocean-inspired scent. The emblematic L'Eau d'Issey floral aquatic notes are amplified by a Posidonia accord, inspired by the seagrass that acts as the ocean’s lungs. These soft floral green notes are enhanced by the radiance of ylang-ylang at the perfume’s heart. At the base, warm vanilla deepens the composition, for a bold and sensual fragrance trail. Made with 91% natural origin ingredients, including 100% natural origin vanilla. The 100% natural origin ylang-ylang is responsibly sourced and certified from the Comoros. L’Eau d’Issey Eau de Parfum Intense is a vegan-certified fragrance. An eco-design approach: For the first time, the iconic L’Eau d’Issey perfume bottle is refillable, with a special 150ml refill format. Unscrew the spray pump, screw on the refill, and the process will stop automatically when the bottle is full. The design aesthetics are inspired by the intense silvery reflections upon the ocean’s surface. Made with 20% post-consumer recycled glass, the transparent bottle embodies the fresh intensity of the fragrance. The silvery cap, shining with femininity, is made with 100% wood, in a patented innovation that removes the need for plastic and results -48% of CO2 equivalent emissions*. *ompared to L’Eau d’Issey Eau de Toilette 100ml cap: Values based on an analysis of the specific environmental impact at packaging level (following a change in packaging manufacturing location, packaging design, material change and material weight variation only).

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani / Privé Rose D'Arabie Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Discover Armani/Privé's Rose D'Arabie fragrance, a majestic ode to the voluptuous Damascena Rose, intoxicating and undulating like a desert melody. Rose D'Arabie was inspired by a royal rose, the most beautiful of all roses, and the incarnation of oriental sensuality for Giorgio Armani. The fragrance is an ode to the Damascena Rose as it unveils every shade of red in its corolla, from royal purple to sensual scarlet. Together, it is uniquely generous, incandescent and ostentatious. The rose reveals its unabashed sensuality as it blossoms from spicy notes of saffron into a heart of patchouli and dark woods before surrendering to the accords of golden amber. Top notes: Damascena Rose Heart notes: Patchouli, Woods Base notes: Golden Amber Accords How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Mesmerising Oudh Accord & Gold Eau de Parfum, 30ml
listings.description: A precious, heady Eau de Parfum, heightened with deep, rich saffron, black tea, vanilla and oudh notes from the East. Delve deep into the mysteries of Assam and experience a beautifully resinous, woody scent. Housed in a collectable glass flacon with a one-of-a-kind spherical resin cap. Fragrance notes: Top notes of davana, bergamot, black pepper and cardamom A heart of saffron, rose, black tea and vanilla A base of oud, honey, tobacco and styrax resin Olfactive Signature: Olibanum Resin. Fragrance family: Woody.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès 24 Faubourg Perfumed Body Cream, 200ml
listings.description: A smooth, generous moisturising cream that gives a real sensation of comfort. Nourished, the skin is soft, velvety and delicately perfumed. Another way to wear fragrance with 24 Faubourg. A novel written by Maurice Roucel in 1995, 24 Faubourg is an invitation to travel, with the sun as a destination. A sparkle of white flowers in the top notes, the radiance of a floral heart enveloped in iris, wood and mystery, while vanilla and ambergris set the tone for the sillage.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man Wood Essence Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Capturing the energy of nature for an urban man in tune with his environment, Bvlgari introduces its new fragrance creation, Bvlgari Man Wood Essence. When man reconnects with nature, he re-establishes his tie to it, recovers his inner strength, and is ready to master his urban environment. He’s reminded that he's a #citizenofnature. Bvlgari Man Wood Essence is a daring and unique olfactory signature created by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas. The fragrance opens with a bright spark of citrus and spice. This liveliness gives way to masculine notes of Cypress Wood and Haitian Vetiver. Like the hearth of a home, the fragrance’s foundation is thoroughly warm and inviting. Base notes of Cedar Wood and Ambergris provide a final rush of invigorating strength. Artfully blended, the Eau de Parfum is built like a tree: it’s colourful top notes dance like leaves in the wind, its earthy middle notes embody the strength of a tree trunk, and its robust bottom notes anchor the scent as well as any roots. Top notes: Italian Citrus Zests, Essence of Coriander Heart notes: Cypress Wood, Haitian Vetiver Essence Base notes: Cedar Wood, Ambergris Accords, Benzoin Siam

A new door opens in the atelier, where we discover new sensorial gestures and nomadic perfume rituals. The iconic fragrances of L'Atelier des Fleurs are being reinvented in the form of this elegant and refined solid perfume, allowing you to take the unique flowers of the collection everywhere with you. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Solid Perfume is infused with Magnolia Alba, one of the line's most emblematic fragrances, it elegantly scents the body with a unique interpretation of Chinese magnolia. listings.rawTitle: Hermès Twilly d’Hermès Eau de Parfum Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Joyful effervescence. This limited edition gift set illustrated by Jonathan Burton is your invitation to a festive celebration with a difference in the Hermès workshop. A surreal commotion filled with fantasy and illusion for unforgettable gifts. A spicy, floral eau de parfum with a cheeky personality expressed through fresh ginger, light tuberose, and milky sandalwood. Christine Nagel: "It is with young women in mind, by observing their lives, that I created Twilly d’Hermès. Free, bold, connected, mischievous and irreverent, they turn expectation on its head, swim against the tide, impose their own rhythm, invent a brand new tempo." It is in this spirit that Christine Nagel composed Twilly d'Hermès. Ginger, tuberose and sandalwood are given a new twist. An intensified woody-marine-leather perfume for men: For this new masculine fragrance, the original Le Sel d’Issey signature is enhanced with leather accents, adding depth to the infinite movement from the sea to the land. Fragrance notes: Top notes: A vivid salt accord meets a vibrant saffron accord Heart notes: The purity of natural-origin marine seaweed contrasts with the deep sensuality of black woody notes Base notes: A natural-origin amber accord envelops natural-origin oakmoss with warmth Two polarities are pushed to the extreme as the ultra-fresh sea encounters the incandescent land. Le Sel d’Issey Parfum is a long-lasting vegan perfume composed with 92% natural-origin ingredients. A bottle design embodying a new intensity: Evoking warmth and energy, the deep glossy black cap flows seamlessly into the dark gradient of the bottle, which is made with 20% recycled glass. How to use: Intensify your fragrance ritual. Refresh your skin with the Le Sel d’Issey Shower Gel and Deodorant Spray. Next, apply Le Sel d’Issey Parfum over your pulse points to amplify the scent’s long-lasting trail.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Absolue Les Parfums Rose On The Moon Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: In this land where nature's grandeur lives untamed, we grow a rose like no other. Absolue Les Parfums, a radical collection dedicated to our rose, born in our domain. Our first-ever rose-dedicated haute-parfumerie collection composed of 11 scents unveils our exclusive centifolia rose like you've never smelled before. Reinventing perfumery's iconic ingredient. At the heart of its formula are powerful active ingredients: Swertia extract, which supports natural repair mechanisms that are even more intense at night, and a fortifying peptide to help reinvigorate the lips. In addition, polyfractioned Vanilla Planifolia helps nourish and revive lip skin. Lips appear fuller and more youthful. As lightweight as it is comfortable, and as enveloping as it is imperceptible, this amber oil is composed of 97% naturally derived ingredients* and lays a veil of softness on the lips. From the moment you wake up, your lips appear smoother and more luminous. Sparkles of amber from the formula shine through its glass bottle, which has been developed in partnership with a renowned French glassmaking House. listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Escentric 03 Eau de Toilette,100ml
listings.description: Escentric 03 honours Vetiveryl Acetate, a natural root and synthetic hybrid. Vetiver's alluringly sensual aromatic flavour goes beyond composition. This accord has a clean crispness with a sharp effervescent quality that plays beautifully in the landscape of skin scents. Picture the scene. A gentle river runs through green plains. On the horizon, a plump orange sun rises behind a set of fluffy clouds. This isn't a pastoral painting or a picture-perfect seen ripped from the pages of a literary classic. This is an olfactory memory of Escentric 03. Vetiveryl Acetate could be described as a hybrid molecule, half-synthetic, half-natural. It is a fraction of vetiver oil distilled from the roots of an Indian grass, which is then 'crossed' with acetic acid to remove the bitter and leathery aspects of the root. Escentric 03 focuses on Vetiveryl Acetate in a formula that pays tribute to the three roots used in perfumery: vetiver, ginger and orris. "I wanted Escentric 03 to bring out the scent impressions of these roots and show how they harmonise with each other," says Geza Schoen. Ginger dominates the top note, which is vibrant, green and spicy with lime peel and green peppercorn. The heart is a rich, velvety orris with Egyptian jasmine and tea notes. The dry-down emphasises the complex earthiness of vetiver together with sandalwood, cedar, mellow balsams and musk. The result is a spicy but fresh and elegant chypre with woody, balsamic notes — that heady hit of dark green woodiness when you walk past tropical grass, but far smoother and softer. How to use: Spritz onto your pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind your ears, as desired, and let it dry naturally.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Sì Nude Bloom Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Sì Nude Bloom intertwines floral freshness and a skin-on-skin intensity in its fusion of a blackcurrant accord, May rose, and patchouli. Sì’s signature blackcurrant accord opens the fragrance, now crafted with sparkling mandarin, lemon, and bergamot essential oil, paired with the brightness of a black pepper extract. The florality intensifies at the heart, as a trio of roses, among them May rose absolute, convey a rich texture and density, as if the flowers’ petals, with their fruity, powdery, and floral facets, are caressing the skin. A daring, enveloping bloom then emerges at the base. Earthy, woody patchouli and vanilla bourbon, with its deep, balsamic tones, mingle with the scent’s floral femininity, creating an intense sillage. To perfectly capture the elegant twist on floral scents, the iconic Sì flacon is reimagined with a new luminosity. The SI Nude Bloom bottle is exquisitely crafted from radiant frosted glass, presenting a distinct nude hue, and crowned with Sì's organic, stone-shaped cap in soft nude pink. The signature 'Sì' name is artfully embossed directly into the glass in tactile, transparent lettering, adding a sophisticated touch. Discover Sì Nude Bloom, a radiant and silky chypre floral fragrance capturing the flower’s luminous and elegant sensuality. How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

White Tea Wild Rose and White Tea Vanilla Orchid expanded the experiential collection in 2019, and today, Elizabeth Arden introduces its latest scent – White Tea Mandarin Blossom. Mandarin Blossom combines citrusy sweet mandarin, delicate white tea, and warm luminous musks to create an energetic scent that instantly transports you to a bright meadow. Expertly crafted to evoke all of the different feelings you experience when taking a moment for yourself, Mandarin Blossom joins the White Tea collection to celebrates the pleasure of a life finely crafted. Discover the simple joy of defining a moment for yourself and savouring the personal reflection that comes with it. Citrus. Floral. Musk. listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Angels' Share Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The perfume Angel's Share is Kilian Hennessy's most personal fragrance creation yet, inspired by his eighth-generation inheritance of Hennessy savoir-faire in cognac making. The perfume goes deep into the cellars of the founder's mind and memory, and into its most mysterious dimension: 'la part des anges' or 'angels' share,' an evaporation of liquor in oak barrels that lifts, while ageing, like a silent offering to the gods. The Perfume: Much like a Master Perfumer who crafts accords and essences in a perfume, a Master Blender combines the eaux-de-vie in perfect proportions for an exceptional cognac. Angels' Share contains the essence of Cognac derived from the liquor to lend it a natural caramel colour. Opening with cognac oil, upon a blend of oak absolute, cinnamon essence and Tonka bean absolute, the scent's long-lasting notes of sandalwood, praline and vanilla make for a delicious finish, a rare concoction only angels should experience. Main notes: Cognac Essence, Tonka Bean Absolute, Oak Absolute. Top notes: Cognac Heart notes: Oak, Cinnamon Base notes: Tonka Bean, Sandalwood Perfumer: Benoist Lapouza. Designed to collect, curate, and carry your fragrances, the refillable spray bottle is a portable statement of style and elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Eleventh Hour Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: "I wanted to travel until I did not have to search anymore. Today I know that life is a journey that brings you to the end of the world, a return to the harmony we have lost." Thus speaks the great Swiss explorer Ella Maillart, who in 1951 was one of the rare Westerners to reach Nepal, the birthplace of Buddha. When oceans will rise, the highest places will be the last refuges and zones that were once considered hostile to humans will become shelters. Eleventh Hour is an exploration around the smell of things ending, a journey to the end of Time, the last perfume on Earth. Fruity Genderless Medium Intensity Notes: Top: Bergamot, Ban Timmur Heart: Rum, Carrot Seeds, Wild Fig Base: Tonka Bean, Cashmere Woods How to use: To be sprayed on the skin and/or clothes.

The clear, seductive top notes of crisp green apple, warming nutmeg and golden saffron unearth the scent to an elegant heart of rose, tonka bean, osmanthus and davana. Top notes: Green Apple, Nutmeg, Saffron Heart notes: Tonka Bean, Rose, Osmanthus, Davana Base notes: Vanilla, Patchouli, Opoponax Resinoid Housed in a jet black bottle with a silver stopper, the Carlisle blend distils its aura of Amber mystery through a delicate play on its accents of nutmeg, saffron and Tonka bean, which is a delectable signature able to distil a great variety of notes. Furthermore, the unexpected combination of sharp green apple with soft vanilla, reveals itself as irrepressibly joyful on the skin. The result is a surprising and explosive alliance. A fragrance for women and men.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures of the Sun Oud Ambrosia Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Oud Ambrosia is a meeting of worlds—Italian exuberance intertwined with Arabic magnetic warmth, captured in a single, immersive signature. Conceived as a true ambrosia, a nectar of heightened concentration, the composition magnifies every nuance. Richer and more enveloping, it settles on the skin with warmth and enveloping comfort. The Signatures of the Sun fragrance reveals the dual soul of Sicily—Italian light meeting Arabic shadow. The fragrance is heightened by a 30% pure perfume oil concentration of precious and radiant ingredients. It opens with the vibrant glow of Italian Blood Orange, Papaya accord and Clementine: juicy, sun-warmed and spirited. This luminous beginning gradually yields to a deeper register, where saffron and violet leaf introduce texture and intrigue, guiding the fragrance toward the resonant presence of oud. At its core lies a rare expression of agarwood: Oud Butter. Distilled from both the resin and the wood of the Aquilaria tree, it offers a creamier, more refined interpretation of the ingredient, allowing the most complex facets of agarwood to come to light. Spicy and subtly smoky at first, it unfolds into layers of woods and leather, softened by subtle magnetic undertones and enriched with hints of honey, amber and tobacco. Depth is present yet poised and shaped by intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Santalum Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs invites you to compose your personalised Chloé fragrance as though arranging your favourite blossoms in a bouquet at a Parisian flower shop. Each perfume in the collection reveals a single floral, aromatic or woody scent rooted in the perfumer’s memory. Wear alone like a corsage or combine endlessly to create a lovely present or a perfume for all occasions. A flower, a perfumer, a story... Santalum, a vegan perfume by Marypierre Julien. While composing her rich, velvety perfume for women, Marypierre Julien was inspired by a sandalwood fan that her grandmother brought back from a trip to Australia. She recalls how this precious item would perfume a room with each wave of the hand. Revealing woody notes and milky accents, this natural fragrance has turned sandalwood into an emblem of sensuality. Capturing all of its sweetness, smoothness and timeless elegance, Santalum is the perfect evening scent. Our Sandalwood is harvested in Australia using more responsible and sustainable practices. Our Santalum Eau de Parfum is vegan and formulated with 100% natural origin fragrance, alcohol* and water. Nothing more. Due to the natural origin of its ingredients, the colour of the fragrance may change over time. This does not affect its olfactory quality. This Chloé perfume is housed in an elegant pleated glass bottle topped with an ivory cap that appears to be carved in stone. Touches of gold at the neckband and label trim enhance the light hue of each beautiful fragrance. The design has been created in a more responsible way with 15% of the glass from the bottle and 40% of the paper from the box made from recycled materials. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists. Wear your favourite flower on its own to celebrate its vitality and intensity, or combine Santalum with other perfumes from Atelier des Fleurs to create a personalised fragrance bouquet. Disclaimer: Packaging may vary but scent remains the same.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani My Way Intense Eau de Parfum Refillable
listings.description: Discover My Way Intense, Giorgio Armani's new feminine fragrance. An amplified bright floral bouquet on an addictive woody trail, encapsulating intense experiences and authentic encounters around the world. Live your way, intensely. My Way intense is an invitation to a journey of self-discovery, meaningful encounters and amplified experiences. An amplified florality on an addictive woody trail, made of consciously sourced ingredients. The scent opens with bright notes of orange blossom from Egypt. A new intense heart of tuberose from India unveils a creamy and velvety facet of the floral signature. At the base of the fragrance, the sandalwood from New Caledonia takes an addictive creamy turn, as it meets a voluptuous Vanilla from Madagascar. A FRAGRANCE FOR THE FUTURE: Consciously sourced ingredients. My Way favours the use of natural ingredients, many of which are responsibly and sustainably sourced. The Vanilla from Madagascar is cultivated by local programs that support underprivileged communities based on fair trade principles. A refillable bottle, designed to last. My Way offers an innovative refill system, that allows any of the spray bottles – 30, 50 or 90ml – to be unscrewed and refilled seamlessly at home, reducing the carbon emissions by -60%* and the use of plastic by -64%*. A commitment to reduce environmental footprint. Giorgio Armani is committed to forest preservation programs in Madagascar, Zimbabwe, Peru & Brazil. More than 14,000 hectares of primary forest were preserved since My Way Launch to reduce its environmental footprint and preserve biodiversity. BOTTLE: The blue and gold jewel-like cap of My Way Intense bottle symbolizes a powerful talisman that captures all the experiences. Both the intensity and significance of these moments captured in the cap have infused the My Way Intense bottle, as its glass is now bathed in translucent blue reflections. The deep blue of the cap, metaphor of the Earth, is accented with a golden ring that lends a luxurious, gilded touch. The bold glass bottle displays MY WAY INTENSE’s new, striking pink juice. *Using a 50 ml + 150 ml refill instead of 4 x 50ml. ORANGE BLOSSOM FROM EGYPT: The bright sparkling start of the fragrance. The orange blossom note, extracted from hand-picked bitter orange fruits in Egypt, is now obtained using a modernized version of the artisanal enfleurage extraction process, by infusing the Egyptian orange flowers in bitter orange essence to unveil a more intense and enduring florality. TUBEROSE FROM INDIA: The new bright sensual and opulent heart of My Way Intense is now beating faster. A new intense tuberose heart absolute composed of creamy, velvety facets, enhances and amplifies the modern & solar signature tuberose absolute. These two tuberose hearts absolutes are composed of flowers sourced from India, hand-picked in the Indian region of Mysore. SANDALWOOD FROM NEW CALEDONIA & VANILLA FROM MADAGASCAR: An addictive and sensual woody base trail revealed through the blend of a creamy natural sandalwood with an intense enveloping Vanilla Bourbon Infusion.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum Intense 60ml
listings.description: Y Eau de Parfum Intense, a highly fresh, stirring fragrance for men. Vibrant lavender, fresh geranium, spicy juniper berries. Y Eau de Parfum Intense, the NEW amplified take on the iconic signature of the Y male fragrance. Long-lasting intensity, with crisp freshness and refined elegance. A men’s cologne that pairs cool French lavender, sensual patchouli, and a vivid blend of blue juniper berries, for a spicy, seductive twist. This powerful olfactive statement is underscored by the minty radiance of geranium and the sensuality of cedarwood. Starring YSL Beauty global fragrance ambassador Lenny Kravitz. Inspiration: Y is a testament to the YSL modern man. A man who dares to follow his passions and carve his own path. From inspiration, through hard work and collaboration, to self-accomplishment and success. A man confident to take all of life’s challenges. For the authentic and bold, YSL Beauty creates Y: the fragrance for those who dare to ask themselves ‘why not’. The YSL modern man is embodied by YSL Beauty fragrance ambassador Lenny Kravitz. Scent: Intensely cool, but spiked with a shock of spice, NEW Y Eau de Parfum Intense amplifies the strength of the Y signature for long-lasting wear. Deeply fresh and vibrant when first applied, a captivating reveal of elegant woody notes unfolds throughout the day. At the heart of this men’s cologne, cool French lavender sensual patchouli, and a vivid blend of blue juniper berries create a striking signature scent, highly fresh with a spicy, seductive twist. This powerful olfactive statement is underscored by the minty radiance of geranium & the sensuality of cedarwood. Created by master perfumer Dominique Ropion. Top notes: Bergamot, Juniper Berries, Ginger, Aldehydes Middle notes: Lavender, Clary Sage, Geranium, Iris Concrete Base notes: Cedarwood, Patchouli, Vetiver, Grey Amber Accord Bottle: The Y bottle is an expression of modernity. A masculine and sharp design, boldly cut out with the signature Y logo. Y Eau de Parfum Intense takes on a bold twist, with a translucent, deep, night-blue shade revealed through the glass, asserting the freshness and intensity the fragrance holds. Collection: Y Eau de Toilette: Bright & Fresh Y Eau de Parfum: Elegant & Bold Y Eau de Parfum Intense: Fresh & Spicy Y Le Parfum: Smooth & Intense How to use: For light intensity: spray in a cloud around your head and shoulders, and let the fragrance fall gently around you For medium intensity: spray in a y-shape across your body, beginning at one shoulder and finishing at the other. If you are wearing jewellery it is a great alternative to spraying your neck For added intensity: apply perfume directly to your pulse points and/or hot spots (wrist, inner elbow and lower neck). Here the heat of your body will allow the fragrance to reveal its full trail. Include shoulders and back to intensify your perfume trail
