listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Uncut Gem Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Uncompromising, bold, filled with enigmatic charm. Based on master perfumer Maurice Roucel’s personal cologne, Uncut Gem is an unapologetically manly scent, diamond-hard and absolutely fresh. Clear, spicy top notes of ginger, bergamot, mandarin, angelica root and nutmeg lead you to the sensual fire within: a leathery accord, vetiver, frankincense, generous amounts of amber, and a musk that vibrates with the skin. This is a scent that plays with the tired codes of masculinity while extracting their telluric force to create something beautiful and irresistible. Maurice Roucel started his career as a chemist at Chanel’s Fragrance Laboratory in 1973. A self-taught perfumer who describes himself as "an explorer wandering amidst formulas", his style is that of a sensuous aesthete and his signature is generous composition, in which he retains only what is essential.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bamboo Eau de Parfum, 30ml
listings.description: Bamboo, strong yet graceful, one of Gucci`s most recognizable design signatures, has defined references in today`s multi-faceted woman. The modern Gucci woman shares bamboo's characteristics of strength and confidence with her innate femininity and poise. She is feminine and sensual yet strong and commanding. Emanating her femininity, her confidence and her natural strength, the fragrance represents the essence of her character. Mirroring the Gucci Woman`s confident persona, the fragrance is soft and intense at once. The duality is expressed with strong notes that resonate through the heart and base. Deep Sandalwood, heady Tahitian Vanilla and unique grey Amber accords strike a complementary contrast with the inherent femininity found in exotic floral notes of sensual Casablanca Lily, feminine Orange Blossom and delicate Ylang Ylang. The bottle`s powerful shape features boldly cut art deco-style glass facets juxta-posed against the curved, feminine cap and the pale blush scent inside.

All of the natural elements come together to weave a gentle tapestry of feeling, scent and sound, in a relaxing, charming and exclusive location. Enhance your trail with one of the Bvlgari Allegra Magnifying essences; they blend perfectly with the Eaux de Parfum in the Bvlgari Allegra collection to create a unique scent.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Libre, a timeless grand floral scent by YSL Beauty. Starring Dua Lipa, Global Fragrance Ambassador for YSL Beauty. Inspiration: Libre, the French word for ‘free’, pays tribute to YSL’s enduring spirit of empowering people to live their lives as authentically and unapologetically as possible. Since 1961 authenticity has dressed the YSL woman: fierce, bold, unapologetic. A woman powerful like ocean waves crashing against the shore. With fire burning in her soul, like flames flickering in the breeze. Bestowing strength, like an eagle soaring through the sky. To embody Libre is British singer song-writer Dua Lipa. Scent: A grand floral Eau de Parfum with an unequivocal YSL twist. The burning sensuality of the orange blossom flowers from Morocco, twisted with the aromatic boldness of lavender from France. Lavender, traditionally used in male perfumery is given an ultra-sensual facet for a women’s perfume that is both fiery and couture, with that uniquely androgynous YSL attitude. Crafted by master perfumers Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaïm. Top notes: tangerine, neroli, lavender Heart notes: jasmine sambac, orange blossom Base notes: white musks, vanilla extract Key notes: orange blossom, lavender. Bottle: A covetable bottle, like a couture accessory stitched from fine materials. Structured yet unexpected, with tailored YSL craftsmanship. Sharp and elegant like a sculpted silhouette, the Libre bottle is embellished with the legendary YSL logo in gold-tone hardware, oversized, bending around the glass. Combining precision with sophistication, the glass on the bottle’s side showcases a V cut, a nod to the V neckline of the signature YSL tuxedo, contrasted by golden chains around the neck of the fragrance. The richly luminous juice is juxtaposed with the asymmetric black lacquered cap to create a design of impeccable cut. Feel free to love, and show your love. Pamper yourself with Libre and share it with those most special to you. An indulgent gift, suitable for all of life’s most celebrated occasions.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Ani Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Under the theme of 'No Boundaries', creative directors Murat Katran and Mert Guzel collaborated closely with the talented perfumer Cécile Zarokian to create Ani Extrait de Parfum, which took inspiration from a famous Anatolian folk song called ‘Sar Gelin’ (in Turkish) or ‘Sari Gyalin’ in Armenian. As the similarity of the name of the song in both languages suggests, both nations share a very similar culture as far as art, food or other aspects of life are concerned. The only boundary is in the imagination of the people themselves. Ani is the name of an ancient city situated near the eastern border of Turkey, across the Arpaçay River from Armenia. Founded more than 1,600 years ago on a plateau in the remote highlands of northeast Turkey, Ani was situated on several trade routes and was conquered hundreds of times by different nations. It now lies empty, and the eerie, crumbling site has been included on UNESCO's World Heritage List. As you walk among the many ruins, the only sound is the wind howling through a ravine that marks the border between Turkey and Armenia. This perfume is dedicated to the destruction of any border between people and to empowering the wearer to build their own empire, even in a situation when they are left with nothing but ruins. Top notes of bergamot, green notes, blue ginger and pink pepper give way to a heart of blackcurrant, Turkish rose and cardamom. A dry-down of patchouli, cedarwood, vanilla, benzoin, ambergris, musk and sandalwood rounds out this enchanting unisex Extrait de Parfum. Ani also means ‘memory’ in Turkish, and during the creation process, a beloved friend of the creators of Nishane passed away, so Ani is also dedicated to the loving memory of Cem Karabacak.

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Oud for Greatness Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Oud for Greatness breathes out a force of nature, the wake of Greatness. The natural essence of Oud Wood has been perfected to this pitch, handled with majesty (and brutality) in this bold formula, scarcely highlighted by Patchouli and Musk. Superbly textured, strikingly natural, Oud has been handled by the creator in a register that is astonishingly fresh (Lavender) and spicy (Nutmeg, Saffron). An enchanting, thrilling perfume that makes all our dreams of greatness possible. Spicy Woody. Made in France Unisex Cruelty-free Fragrance notes: Natural Oud Wood, Agar Wood Oil, Lavender, Saffron, Patchouli, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Gentle Fluidity Silver Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Once again Francis Kurkdjian disrupts the rules of fragrance creation with a disconcerting composition exercise. With Gentle Fluidity, he unveils two Eau de Parfum from two utterly different olfactory worlds (one features a woody, aromatic scent, the other musky, Amber notes), by drawing from the same list of ingredients and going beyond the concept of perfumery for women, men or mixed. When he overdoses some ingredients, he under doses others because fragrances, like all the things that move us, are essentially about balance and expected effects... No more feminine or masculine. There is a personality, a sensitivity, a 'Gentle Fluidity' between all gender identities. Ingredients: juniper berry essence, nutmeg essence, coriander seed essence, musks, ambery wood and vanilla accord. Olfactory family: Woody aromatic.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Wild Rose Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Coach Wild Rose is inspired by Coach’s prairie floral prints, a symbol of the house’s free-spirited attitude. The delicate yet bold scent opens with juicy, sparkling redcurrant and sunny, spicy bergamot. The heart opens onto a lush meadow of delicate rose and jasmine sambac before finishing on a woodsy, warm dry down of crystal moss and dusky Ambroxan. "Coach Wild Rose captures the free-spirited attitude of Coach. Bold and sensual, it evokes the untamed beauty of fields of wildflowers and a feeling of possibility." Coach Creative Director Stuart Vevers. The Coach Wild Rose bottle features an ombré burgundy gradient inspired by romantic summer afternoons and a matching burgundy hangtag - a symbol of lasting quality and craftsmanship.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Private Collection Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Precious and rare. Elegant and alluring. Introduced to the world in 1973, Private Collection had long been reserved by Mrs. Estée Lauder for her own personal use. In love with the floral richness of the scent, her friends finally insisted that this private masterpiece be made public. How to use: Spray onto the warm, moving places on your body, or anywhere you like to wear your fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: MATIERE PREMIERE Radical Rose Hair Perfume, 75ml
listings.description: Nomadic, light and kind to your hair. To be sprayed at arm's length, for an airy, captivating and lasting impression of Radical Rose, the perfume with the highest dosage of Rose Centifolia Absolute.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum 30ml
listings.description: LIBRE the signature scent, now at its most intense. LIBRE the signature scent, now at its most intense. Twisted with a spicy saffron accord. Starring Dua Lipa, Global Fragrance Ambassador for YSL Beauty. Inspiration: LIBRE, the French word for ‘free’, pays tribute to YSL’s enduring spirit of empowering people to live their lives as authentically and unapologetically as possible. Since 1961 authenticity has dressed the YSL woman: fierce, bold, unapologetic. A woman powerful like ocean waves crashing against the shore. With fire burning in her soul, like flames flickering in the breeze. Bestowing strength, like an eagle soaring through the sky. To embody LIBRE is British singer-songwriter Dua Lipa. For the untamed, the ones who dare to turn up the heat and embrace their power to the full, YSL Beauty introduces new LIBRE Le Parfum. An intense grand floral fragrance boasting spicy saffron top notes, an abundant floral bouquet at its heart, and a smooth, velvety base. Scent: The new LIBRE Le Parfum brings intensity and spice to the LIBRE floral signature. A fiery take on the orange blossom and lavender Libre signature, this new flamboyant fragrance makes an olfactive statement with its unapologetically spicy notes. Crafted exclusively for YSL, the saffron accord is at the heart of the fragrance and harvested directly from our Ourika Gardens in Morocco, a tribute to Mr Saint Laurent’s favourite ‘fleur de feu’, the saffron flower. The spice of the keynotes is set against a smooth and velvety base which fuses delicious vanilla and honey with warm vetiver for depth and intensity. Crafted by master perfumers Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaïm. Top notes: bergamot, mandarin, ginger, saffron accord Heart notes: orange blossom, diva lavender heart, lavandin heart Base notes: vanilla bourbon, honey accord, vetiver Bottle: The signature LIBRE bottle is designed to reflect the powerful character of the fragrance. Just like Yves Saint Laurent designed the first tuxedo for women. More powerful than ever, the bottle is set alight by the flamboyant red colour of the juice, a fiery shade that reflects the scent’s keynotes. Encased in the sharp bottle silhouette, the fragrance is embellished by the oversized YSL logo in gold-tone hardware. Collection: Feel free to love, and show your love. Indulge yourself with LIBRE and share it with those most special to you. A luxurious gift, suitable for all of life’s most special occasions. LIBRE Eau de Toilette. A lighter, fresher take on the Libre signature fragrance, twisted with White Tea. Fresh and sensual LIBRE Original Eau de Parfum. The original grand floral scent. A unique blend of sensual orange blossom and cool lavender. Bold and captivating LIBRE Eau de Parfum Intense. A richer interpretation of the Libre floral signature, enriched with a smouldering orchid accord. Rich and full-bodied LIBRE Le Parfum. The Libre floral signature, at its most intense, with spicy yet honeyed saffron accord. Vivid and unapologetic

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Refill, 150ml
listings.description: A woody aromatic fragrance, Moncler Pour Homme captures the vibrant natural beauty of an alpine forest. Starting with the exclusive Alpine Green accord for Moncler that, combined with the energising freshness of Clary Sage, lifts the fragrance through a leafy expanse of mountain pines. Warming directly through an overdose of Cedarwood, the exclusive Mountain Woods accord forms a cocooning, earthy dry-down when fused with the magnetism of Vetiver. The Moncler Pour Homme fragrance is showcased in a unique 'borraccia' flask-shaped bottle encircled with a ribbed silver case and cap - a utilitarian echo to Moncler's mountaineering origins and the iconic quilted construction of a Moncler jacket. Good to know: This is a refill only.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Le Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Black Opium, at its most luxurious. A radical quartet of sumptuous vanilla notes, ultra-dark coffee, and luminous white flowers. Smooth, sensual, and uncompromising. Experience YSL Black Opium, the rock couture fragrance for women by Yves Saint Laurent. Captivating, unparalleled in provocation, deliberatively seductive. Inspiration: In 1977 Yves Saint Laurent introduces Opium: a boundary-pushing perfume. A revolution in a bottle. A new idea of femininity: sultry, provocative, enthralling. Fast forward to 2014, and Opium’s legacy continues to dazzle: Yves Saint Laurent Beauty unveils Black Opium, re-inventing desire in a new, contemporary light, reshaped for the modern woman. For those seeking a luxurious, captivating fragrance that takes the signature of Black Opium to a new level of indulgence, YSL Beauty introduces Black Opium Le Parfum. Scent: Le Parfum takes Black Opium’s original floral gourmand scent and shines a spotlight on vanilla, it’s most precious facet. The iconic coffee accord has been twisted with an exceptional blend of four vanilla notes, each different yet complimentary. Ranging from the most delectable aromas to sensual woody notes, the diverse quartet of vanilla ingredients combines to create an unexpected smoothness, with uncompromising intensity. Bound to an exhilarating dark-coffee accord, and bright white florals, this new take on the classic Black Opium signature exudes a wildly powerful sensuality, equal parts bold and exquisite. An ultra-intense scent for those seeking the ultimate day-to-night olfaction. Top notes: pear accord, green mandarin Heart notes: orange flower petals, jasmine sambac, cinnamon essence Base notes: vanilla quarter, coffee accord, patchouli heart, ambrox Bottle: Unlike any other Black Opium bottle, this over-black jewel shines from cap to toe with a reflective gloss: like an expertly cut gem, chiselled from a precious dark stone. At its centre is a dazzling heart of glitter, emblematic of the vivid fragrance found within. Collection: YSL Beauty mixes ingredients and proportions, constantly re-interpreting Black Opium’s coffee signature. Discover the YSL Black Opium fragrance wardrobe and indulge yourself or treat others to a YSL Black Opium gift. Black Opium Eau de Parfum. The original Eau de Parfum. Featuring adrenaline-rich black coffee and sensual vanilla. Captivating and energising Black Opium Eau de Parfum Illicit Green. A zesty take on the Black Opium signature. Green mandarin and creamy fig combine to create this ‘mocktail in a scent’. Energising and fresh Black Opium Eau de Parfum Neon. A vibrant spin on the original Black Opium Eau de Parfum. The signature coffee notes meet luminous dragon fruit. Fruity and vibrant Black Opium Eau de Parfum Extreme. The Black Opium signature taken to the next level. Extra-black coffee, ultra-white flowers, and an abundance of patchouli. Exhilarating and excessive How to use: For light intensity: spray in a cloud around your head and shoulders, let the fragrance fall gently around you For medium intensity: spray in a y-shape across your body, beginning at one shoulder and finishing at the other. If you are wearing jewellery it is a great alternative to spraying your neck For added intensity: apply perfume directly to your pulse points and/or hot spots (wrist, inner elbow and lower neck). Here the heat of your body will allow the fragrance to reveal its full trail. Include shoulders and back to intensify your perfume trail Other application tips: Hair & hair accessories: they can be fragranced for a gentle fragrance trail. For just a halo of scent, spray your hair brush only Garments: perfume the inside of your jacket and coats for a medium trail. For added intensity of fragrance go further and perfume your blouse/jumper Scarves: for lighter fragrance, spray a scarf and wrap the scarf around your neck to transfer fragrance onto yourself gently Bathing: spritz perfume on warm bath water for an indulgent experience

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Hermessence Ambre Narguilé Eau de Toilette Refill, 200ml
listings.description: Creation: The Hermessence Ambre Narguilé was inspired by amber, a material reminiscent of Eastern culture. "I wanted to recreate my memory of the Orient, where swirls of smoke scented with fruit, honey, and spices diffuse a sweet sense of intoxication." Jean-Claude Ellena, perfumer. Olfactory notes: Smooth and enveloping, Ambre Narguilé combines sensual amber honey with toasted sesame seeds. A Hermessence suitable for both men and women. Ethics: The Ambre Narguilé refill can be used to replenish the 100ml and 200ml bottles. A responsible gesture, integral to an object created to last. "Amber, the Western expression of Eastern fragrances, has a warm, sensual, enveloping, almost carnal smell. I wanted to imbue this idea of amber with the memory of the East I love by recreating the ambiance of those lively places where tobacco – blended with the smells of fruit, honey and spices – is smoked in narguilés, or water pipes, and where swirls of smoke diffuse a sweet sense of intoxication." Jean-Claude Ellena.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Just Perfect Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Addictive. Striking. Rebellious. The fragrance: Discover the new Just Perfect Marc Jacobs, a fragrance that celebrates being entirely and boldly yourself. Whether you’ve always felt like a misfit or someone who refuses to settle for sameness, this Marc Jacobs perfume encourages you to own your differences and release your authentic self. The scent: A radical take on the original Perfect Eau de Parfum, Just Perfect blends sensual jasmine with melting vanilla and a sticky caramel accord, while a rush of strawberry and juicy fruits adds an irresistible edge. A timeless signature fragrance that empowers you, from extraordinary occasions to everyday moments. Perfect, just like you. The bottle: Encased in an iridescent opaque glass bottle with a soft and feminine silhouette, this women’s perfume is topped with a silver cap decorated with a glittery bow and white charms that nod to the daring, ambery fruity fragrance within. How to use: Apply Just Perfect Marc Jacobs to the pulse points on your wrists, neck, chest, and behind the ears. Avoid rubbing or dabbing the skin after application, as this breaks down the aromas of the ambery, floral-fruity fragrance, causing it to wear off more quickly.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Meant To Be Seen Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A scent that anchors the light when you feel unseen. There are moments when the world looks through you, when your presence is softened, your voice hushed, your radiance dimmed by self-doubt or silence. Meant To Be Seen is born from those moments. Not to mask them, but to transform them. It is a fragrance that acts as an anchor of light—a quiet yet powerful reminder that your essence deserves to be felt, noticed, remembered. Opening with the delicate brightness of bergamot and the tender grace of violet, the scent begins with a breath of clarity. At its heart, the rich creaminess of iris butter intertwines with moxalone and a soft animalic trace of civette, creating a sensation of vulnerability refined into strength, delicate yet unwavering. The base grounds this luminescence with unexpected warmth. Sesame and sandalwood bring a nutty, textured depth, while ambrettolide and akigalawood wrap the composition in a radiant, skinlike finish, soft, sensual, and lingering. Meant To Be Seen is not just a perfume; it is a declaration. For the quiet ones. For the daydreamers. For those whose glow has been dimmed but never lost. This is the scent that finds you in your stillness and reminds you: you were never meant to hide. You were always meant to be seen.

The luxurious bottle of Infusion de Gingembre is highlighted in a yellow-tinted hue, evoking the fusion of the signature ingredient in the fragrance. The light-yellow cap in iconic Saffiano symbolises the ginger and the liveliness of the fragrance. Fragrance family: Citrus, Woody​. Key notes: Green Mandarin, Ginger, Geranium, Vetiver​.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense, 9ml
listings.description: The aromatic notes of cypress trees unite with the warmth of grapevine and the sensuality of amber. A fresh and woody scent that leaves a lasting impression. Refined, distinctive and bold. Fragrance notes: Cypress, Grapevine, Amber. listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 + Mandarin Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: EM's M+ range is all about the best of the naturals + the best of the artificial. Morphing, intermingling, breaking apart, to rejoin in the dance that symbolises the relentless mechanism of modern existence. Molecule 01 + Mandarin consists of Iso E Super + Mandarin. Iso E Super is an abstract synthetic molecule characterised as a cedarwood note with a warm, velvety cocooning sensation. Mandarin is a natural extracted from the mandarin orange. Fruity and aromatic M+ Mandarin is all about the instant hit. The way it radiates off the skin with the citrus zestiness makes it a perfect scent for the sultry summer air. M+ Mandarin is a fragrance with a narrative that twists and turns. In the first act, Mandarin's hearty twang hits instantly and all at once. As the effervescent note starts to fade away, the second act sees Iso E Super sync in, intermingling with the freshness of citrus. In the final scene, Mandarin slowly departs the stage, giving the limelight to the erogenous solo number offered by Molecule 01. "That's unusual for a top note ingredient like Mandarin and a base note like Iso E Super to dance together naked like this, without other notes coming between them. That's what I love about Molecule 01 + Mandarin; it may be a dance of two, but the story changes completely from beginning to middle to end," says Geza Schoen. Douse yourself in the warm, erogenous feeling of Iso E Super dancing with the zinging freshness of mandarin. How to use: Spritz onto your pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind your ears, as desired, and let it dry naturally.

listings.rawTitle: Memo Paris Darling Point x Thomas Lélu Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Thomas Lélu is a French contemporary artist, photographer and author of fiction. His visual work has been exhibited in numerous galleries and museums. Darling Point: A neighbourhood on the shores of Sydney Harbour, facing the Opera House. Darling Point borrows its name from a place where the light never settles. Its Eau de Parfum ripens a perfectly sweet pear, brightened by a luminous orange blossom and an elegant rose absolute, over moss, cashmere wood and praline. An Australian encounter sculpted for infinite horizons.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Fico di Amalfi La Riserva Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: An intense and multi-nuanced fragrance from a two-month maceration process, in an ode to the rich aroma of fig pulp, which meets the unmistakable vibrancy of lemon, elements distinctive to the Amalfi coast. The fig’s natural lushness is elevated into an olfactory art form in the Fico di Amalfi La Riserva, where a two-month maceration process infuses the fragrance with depth and texture that results in a full, intense, and silky essence. The light is scintillating, golden, and radiant, where each note harmonises in a beautiful balance, thanks to the prolonged development. The top notes burst with the freshness of Italian mandarin, blood orange, grapefruit, and lemon essences, while the heart reveals a sophisticated blend of orris concentré, complemented by an infusion of fig and lemon, with a rich fig pulp accord adding depth. Finally, the base notes offer a warm finish with tonka bean absolute, ambrettolide, and orcanox, leaving a lingering trail of refined elegance. Fico di Amalfi La Riserva features a cap and bottle in a new, more intense shade of blue, embodying the long-lasting sillage of the fragrance. The fragrance comes in an enlarged hatbox, complemented by a refreshed label with updated finishings.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Pura Eau de Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Vibrant, pure, and simple, Colonia Pura illuminates the iconic Colonia with effortless bliss and ease. Presented in a new restyled bottle, it captures a straightforward way of living with simplicity. An Eau de Cologne with a contemporary kind of lightness, Colonia Pura captures a simple way of living with ease. The citrus woody fragrance comes alive with the crisp and sunny opening notes of bright bergamot, combined with juicy orange and delicate petitgrain. They give way to the vital energy of the floral heart, made up of jasmine sambac absolute and narcissus absolute. Blending into an unexpected balance with spicy notes of coriander, they harmoniously come together with the warm and sophisticated accents of patchouli, cedarwood, and musk in the base. The fragrance comes in the quintessential Acqua di Parma bottle, an epitome of the Art Deco expression. The transparent glass allows Colonia Pura’s nuances to be fully appreciated, while the classic black cap adds a touch of understated sophistication. The restyled minimal white labels echo the refined aesthetics of the Colonia collection, while the matte-paper box, characterised by its cylinder shape, features our signature vibrant yellow shade.

listings.rawTitle: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Orchidée Vanille Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: The House of Van Cleef & Arpel's couture perfumery collection 'Collection Extraordinaire' is an exquisite collection of rare and luxurious fragrances. The beauty of nature, which is always a major source of inspiration for Van Cleef & Arpels High Jewellery, is elementary to these compositions. In Asia, exotic orchids are often associated with the idea of beauty. The luscious bean of one of these orchids, the vanilla planifolia, is suave and intoxicating. The perfumer wanted vanilla that was not too sugary, but sweet like candied almond. Joyous fruity harmonies magnify the floral heart and melt within multi-faceted vanilla, tender and warm, cradled in dreamy musk. Feminine and sensual, absolute and bewitching: Orchidée Vanille. In this couture collection, bottles are sculpted in pure and slender shapes. Glass is heavy and precious. Like a jewel, the bottle is signed with a stamp on the bottom and topped with a black lacquered cap. 75ml

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Arizona Bloom Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: A dry floral amber. A sense of freedom and happiness — scented and bottled. This vegan perfume is for the sunny, euphoric nomadic and free-spirited. Arid wilderness, neon skies and eternal sunshine make for the ultimate natural high. Taking its inspiration from the flora and fauna of desert landscapes, this dry floral amber evokes a nomadic sense of freedom. Its subtle sprinkles of Balinese coconut blends with the Madagascan Black Pepper spices and the second skin feeling of Salted Musks. It's time we simply slowed down, reconnected with ourselves and nature. Key ingredients in Arizona Bloom vegan perfume: Balinese Coconut, Madagascan Black Pepper, Oak Moss, Salted Musks, Jasmine Petals, Fig leaves, Cashmere woods.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Q by Dolce & Gabbana Intense Eau de Parfum
listings.description: The iconic fragrance Q by Dolce & Gabbana becomes even more captivating in the new version, Eau de Parfum Intense. The perfume emanates a mixture of delicious, feminine, and distinctly sensual notes, all for an uncompromising sense of femininity. Q by Dolce & Gabbana fragrance takes on an even more captivating and audacious character in its latest iteration, Eau de Parfum Intense. It combines the warm essence of Dark Cherry with an exhilarating Heliotrope heart, but it's in its irresistibly sensual amber base that its true nature is revealed. The design: The bottle of the new fragrance echoes the original Q by Dolce & Gabbana, both in the cap, which depicts a regal gold and red crown, and on the glass that holds the essence of bold cherry hue. Q by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum Intense: a fragrance for a woman with distinctive energy. The fragrance was created by Daphne Bugey exclusively for Dolce & Gabbana. Top notes: The fragrance opens with the warm and deep note of Dark Cherry Heart notes: At the heart of Q by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum Intense lies the exhilarating note of Heliotrope Base notes: The Amber note adds a sensual touch A magnetic and sensual couple's connection takes centre stage in the new Dolce & Gabbana K & Q Eaux de Parfum Intense campaign. Rulers of their own worlds, their energies intertwine by instinct, forging a magnetising alliance driven by passion and intensity. These two new fragrances perfectly embody the free and daring spirit of a modern King and Queen.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Eau de Parfum Trio Fragrance Gift Set, 3 x 10ml
listings.description: 3 x 10ml sized spray bottles of favourite perfumes. Vegan, sustainable, unforgettable. Who will you be today? Because, we know, our taste in perfume can change as often as our shoes. Perfect for discovering your favourites, or for your handbag. Wonderland Peony: A light, fruity floral perfume. Sophisticated, not soft. Captivating, not cute. We don’t like to play favourites, but we have a thing for peonies. And this sweet floral perfume is stuffed full of them. Arizona Bloom: A dry floral amber, this vegan perfume is freedom and happiness in a bottle... think endless skies and eternal sunshine. Sunflower Pop: A citrus, fruity perfume. Joy-bringing and sun-soaked. Bursting with rays of optimism. A masterpiece in a bottle. Set contains: Wonderland Peony Eau de Parfum, 10ml Arizona Bloom Eau de Parfum, 10ml Sunflower Pop Eau de Parfum, 10ml

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL N°5 L'Eau Eau de Toilette Spray 35ml
listings.description: N°5 L’EAU is the N°5 of today. A vibrant abstract floral under the banner of modernity, with freshness at its core. N°5 L’EAU, in praise of simplicity. N°5 L’EAU, the obvious choice. Its minimalist packaging has the iconic silhouette of the fragrance embossed on the cardboard case. Inside, a second box protects the crystal-clear glass bottle. No component spoils this distinct impression. The supreme simplicity of the bottle further accentuated by the contents, gives free rein to the imagination of the woman who chooses this fragrance for her skin. Less abstract than its forebears, the composition of N°5 L’EAU radiates citrus like sun-drenched honey. Top notes of lemon, mandarin and orange soar skyward with the aldehydes. Like a second wind, you can hear the rustle of flowers. Rose melds with airy jasmine and a new fraction of ylang-ylang, more modern than ever. Behind this floral whirlwind, vetiver and cedar impart a novel dynamism, softened by white musks notes. Never has N°5 been so natural. So fresh. N°5 L’EAU is worn freely. With no preconceived ideas. Instinctively. Simply. Lavishly. Day. Night. For you. For others. Ritual? There is no ritual. N°5 L’EAU is worn non-stop.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Coffee Break Eau de Toilette
listings.description: The memory of a warm coffee shop on a cold winter's day. Take a break from the busy city with a fresh coffee. Feel the sensation of milk froth on your lips and the comforting ambience of coffee machines and quiet chatter. Coffee Break Eau de Toilette, by Maison Margiela, captures a comforting coffee break in a bottle. Coffee and Milk Mousse Accord bring a sweet warmth to the fragrance, like the first sip of a hot drink. Refreshing notes of Lavender and Spearmint Essence evoke the freshness and vibrance of a busy café, before developing into long-lasting, woody base notes of Sandalwood and Cedarwood. Smells like creamy coffee, milk froth, and sweet pastries. From Maison Margiela’s Replica collection: unique, unisex fragrances inspired by memories. Available in 100ml and 30ml sizes. Fragrance notes: Top Notes: Coffee, Red Apple, Lemon Essence Middle Notes: Lavender Essence, Spearmint Essence, Orange Flower Absolute Base Notes: Milk Mousse Accord, Sandalwood Essence, Cedarwood Essence Family: Fougere.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Café Rose Eau de Parfum 50ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: A sensuous haze of pleasure. Café Rose captures the untamed sensuality of a refined rose infused with the unexpected twist of dark coffee. This luxe gift set features a full-size Eau de Parfum bottle and a travel spray. The Gift of Café Rose, a floral chypre fragrance. Set contains: Café Rose Eau de Parfum, 50ml Café Rose Eau de Parfum, 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Tempo Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: During the 60s, a certain scent was changing the world: patchouli. It conveyed a sense of freedom and spirituality that was closer to nature, and the hopes of a generation that was reinventing the future. Tempo is a tribute to this olfactory icon. It is a nuanced composition of three patchouli extracts from the Indonesian Island of Sulawesi, that hovers between elegant and woody, enveloping and earthy. Elevated by violet leaf, Tempo vibrates on the skin with remarkable sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Costa Azzurra Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Costa Azzurra Parfum breathes an air of freshness through crisp Italian lemon, while the dense coastal forest is felt with magnified oakwood extract and cypress. Stunning cistus absolute and a harmony of ambers are illuminated – capturing the spirit of private, unfettered luxury. An escape into the hedonistic pleasures of the Mediterranean, Costa Azzurra Parfum deepens the original fragrance with magnified woods and aromatics.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Hacivat Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by lead characters in traditional Turkish shadow play, an ancient form of storytelling and entertainment, creative directors Mert Güzel and Murat Katran dreamed of bringing the legend of Karagoz & Hacivat into today’s world. Following this remit, perfumer Jorge Lee created the Shadow Play trilogy. Hacivat (shortened over time from ‘Hacı İvaz’, meaning İvaz the pilgrim) is a tribute to elegance, kindness, competence, and love of art. Inspired by the traditional shadow play character of the same name, this fragrance will help you live in your dreams due to the everlasting sparkles of its joyful structure! Fresh, fruity and stimulating top notes of bergamot, pineapple and grapefruit give way to a heart of jasmine, patchouli and cedarwood before a dry-down of clearwood, oakmoss and dry timberwood rounds out this Citrus-Chypre-Woody extrait de parfum. Enjoy being loved!

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Limited Edition Sauvage Spray for the Wild Parfum, 30ml
listings.description: To add a touch of couture to the 30ml Sauvage travel bottle, Dior has unveiled a new limited-edition case inspired by one of its most iconic designs. listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Pleasures Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: One of life's simple pleasures. Fresh as flowers after a Spring rain, this sheer, shimmering floral is a spirited blend of Lilies, White Peonies and Jasmine, all tingling with the rare essence of exotic Baie Rose. Never sweet, ever fresh, it delights your senses with pleasure after pleasure. Top Notes: White Lily, Violet Leaves, Green Accents Middle Notes: Black Lilac, White Peony, Karo-Karounde Blossoms, Baie Rose, Pink Rose, Jasmine Base Notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli The Inspiration: Created in 1995, Estée Lauder Pleasures set the trend for uplifting, airy fragrances and introduced the Sheer Floral fragrance type. Evelyn Lauder created it to have a sheer, elusive, luminous quality. It captures the clarity of flowers just after a spring rain. This wonderful fragrance has been one of the best selling fragrances for many years. "Whatever the fragrance was to be, I wanted it to have an elusive, textural quality," said Evelyn Lauder. "And we have achieved it with Estée Lauder Pleasures. For the first time, there is a fragrance that unfolds like a flower in the warmth of the sun, surrendering its scent little by little."

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Eau des Merveilles Bleue Eau de Toilette Refillable, 30ml
listings.description: In 2017, Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel created Eau des Merveilles Bleue. A new perspective on the Merveilles constellation, combining the magic of the ocean with the blue of the sky. A childhood memory etched in innocence, fantasy and glittering femininity. The mineral, woody Eau de Toilette blends bright juniper berry, warm patchouli and salty pebbles on the seashore. Designed by Serge Mansau, the star-spangled magnifying-glass bottle twinkles with a blue radiance. The top of the spray is engraved with the house’s saddle nail seal. Its 30 ml format is the key to letting your imagination run wild anytime and anywhere. The bottle is refillable. A responsible gesture, integral to an object created to last.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Miss Dior Rose N'Roses Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: The new sparkling floral eau de toilette. A profusion of fresh and colourful Grasse Rose petals, vivified by citrusy dew. For Miss DIOR Rose N'Roses, François Demachy crafted a fresh rose with bright, vibrant florality, vivified by citrusy notes. The sensation of an armful of fresh and colourful petals that sweeps you away to an endless field of blooming roses. The heart of this new fragrance swirls with a rose grown by the exclusive partners of the house of DIOR and harvested using traditional methods to preserve its most precious properties. "Make me a fragrance that smells love!" Christian DIOR. Miss DIOR is a hymn to love, emblematic of DIOR femininity with a Couture spirit. A hand-crafted trail of scent with a modern, rebellious and elegant personality. Absolute and essence of Grasse and Damascus Roses: Miss DIOR Rose N'Roses immediately sweeps us away to the middle of an endless field of flowers. Absolutes and essences of vibrant Grasse and Damascus Rose colour the composition. The freshness of an armful of petals Italian Mandarin, Bergamot and essence of Geranium: The fruity and juicy notes of Bergamot and Mandarin, upheld by the citrusy, minty and incisive note of a Geranium essence, set the composition sparkling White Musks: A base note of White Musk brightens the scent and sets the heart of roses

listings.description: SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait de Crème unites the power of all the active fractions of Vanilla Planifolia with Swertia extract in an exceptional skincare treatment. This one-of-a-kind combination helps rejuvenate skin and accelerate its natural reviving mechanisms. Featuring a high concentration of active ingredients and composed of 91% naturally derived ingredients*, its formula provides an addictive sensory experience. A double emulsion offers a sensuous texture in which the SUBLIMAGE L'Extrait serum meets SUBLIMAGE La Crème, for a two-fold effect. The cream initially feels rich to the touch. Upon application, it melts smoothly into the skin, absorbing instantly. The anodised aluminium refill fits into the SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait de Crème glass jar. A precious object that extends your skincare ritual in any setting. Proportion of natural ingredients and derivatives calculated according to ISO 16128. To further improve the skin-enhancing power of SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait de Crème, CHANEL has created the perfect skincare ritual, starting with the exceptional SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait de Nuit serum. The anodised aluminium refill fits into the SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait de Crème glass jar.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Sensuous Eau de Parfum Spray
listings.description: A modern definition of sensuality. Confident and elegant. A rich core of Molten Woods and Amber, surrounded by atmospheric florals, warmed by a hint of Pepper and a touch of Honey. Warm Notes: Molten Woods, Amber Feminine Notes: Jasmine, Ghost Lily, Magnolia, Ylang Luminous Notes: Black Pepper, Sandalwood, Honey, Mandarin Orange Pulp The Inspiration: Estée Lauder Sensuous was created to evoke the warmest, most feminine side of a woman. Her softness. Her confidence and grace. Her strength. Every woman wears it her way. Sensuous is subtly different on each woman who wears it. So from the minute it touches a woman's skin, Estée Lauder Sensuous becomes a natural reflection of her. Her grace, confidence and charm.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Intense 30ml
listings.description: Libre the signature fragrance, now bolder. Twisted with a smouldering orchid accord. Starring Dua Lipa, Global Fragrance Ambassador for YSL Beauty. Inspiration: Libre, the French word for ‘free’, pays tribute to YSL’s enduring spirit of empowering people to live their lives as authentically and unapologetically as possible. Since 1961, authenticity has dressed the YSL woman: fierce, bold, unapologetic. A woman as powerful as ocean waves crashing against the shore. With fire burning in her soul, like flames flickering in the breeze. Bestowing strength, like an eagle soaring through the sky. To embody LIBRE is British singer-songwriter Dua Lipa. For the untamed, the ones who dare to turn up the heat and embrace their power to the full, YSL Beauty introduces new Libre Eau de Parfum Intense. A full-bodied, grand floral fragrance boasting a burning-hot character and deep sensuality. Scent: The new Eau de Parfum Intense brings a fierce sensuality to the Libre floral signature. The structure of the original Libre composition celebrates the signature tension present in all YSL fragrances: tension between aromatic lavender from France and sensual orange blossom absolute from Morocco. The Eau de Parfum Intense is emboldened by a melting floral heart where a flamboyant orchid accord blazes with sensuality. The fragrance reveals creamy and smoky facets before unveiling a woody-ambery base that fuses smooth vanilla and vetiver for depth and intensity. Crafted by master perfumers Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaïm. Top notes: tangerine, bergamot, lavender Heart notes: jasmine sambac, orange blossom, orchid accord Base notes: tonka bean, vanilla, amber gris, vetiver Bottle: The signature Libre bottle is designed to reflect the powerful character of the fragrance. Just like Yves Saint Laurent designed the first tuxedo for women. More intense than ever, the bottle is set alight by the burning colour of the juice, a shade between fire and gold. Encased in the sharp bottle silhouette, the fragrance is embellished by the oversized YSL logo in gold-tone hardware. Collection: Feel free to love, and show your love. Indulge yourself with Libre and share it with those most special to you. A luxurious gift, suitable for all of life’s most special occasions. Libre Original Eau de Parfum. The original grand floral scent. A unique blend of sensual orange blossom and cool lavender. Bold and captivating Libre Eau de Parfum Intense. A richer interpretation of the Libre floral signature, enriched with a smouldering orchid accord. Rich and full-bodied

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Hibiscus Abelmoschus Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Good to know: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs is being re-branded, the logo on your products may differ from the photos. The scent is still the same. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs invites you to compose your personalised Chloé fragrance as though arranging your favourite blossoms in a bouquet at a Parisian flower shop. Each perfume in the collection reveals a single floral, aromatic or woody scent rooted in the perfumer’s memory. Wear alone like a corsage or combine endlessly to create a lovely present or a perfume for all occasions. A flower, a perfumer, a story... Hibiscus Abelmoschus, a radiant perfume for women by Domitille Michalon Bertier. With its sunny, slightly fruity scent and soft petals, hibiscus is the queen of the Polynesian gardens of Domitille Michalon Bertier's childhood. The warm luminosity of hibiscus blossom brightens the bouquet of this Eau de Parfum with opulent notes and musky, powdery lilts. A fresh women’s fragrance perfect for sun-dappled summer days. This Chloé perfume is housed in an elegant pleated glass bottle topped with an ivory cap that appears to be carved in stone. Touches of gold at the neckband and label trim enhance the light hue of each beautiful fragrance. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrist. Wear your favourite flower on its own to celebrate its vitality and intensity, or combine Hibiscus Abelmoschus with other perfumes from Atelier des Fleurs to create a personalised fragrance bouquet. Disclaimer: Packaging may vary but scent remains the same.

listings.description: A contemporary celebration of the timeless softness of lavender. Aromatic lavender, eucalyptus freshness, creamy veil of sandalwood. Extract of lavender from the south of France. Rediscover your iconic Lavande (Lavander) Eau de Toilette redesigned with a new, modern and minimalist look that reflects the cultural heritage of the Maison L'Occitane en Provence. Perfect and complete your fragrance ritual to enhance the unique scent of Lavande with the shower gel and body lotion. How to use: For optimum diffusion, apply your eau de toilette on your pulse points, neck and wrists; these are particularly warm spots of the body. To perfume the clothes, spray at a distance of 10cm.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL N°19 Eau De Toilette Spray, 100ml
listings.description: N°19, a daring, distinctive fragrance. A floral-woody-green fragrance with perfect balance. The last fragrance launched and worn by Gabrielle Chanel. An uncompromising composition, in the image of Mademoiselle. For a more generous application, the eau de toilette comes in a spray format allowing for an easy and fluent application on skin or inside clothing. A complete perfuming ritual for the bath and body is also available to enhance the fragrance trail.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Ambre Samar Eau de Parfum, 125ml
listings.description: Absolus Allegoria, the absolute fragrance collection, is an enchanting and mysterious journey to the heart of the world’s wonders once night falls: fragrance trails celebrating deep and powerful nature, revealed by striking contrasts in the moonlight. Discover Ambre Samar, a highly contrasting perfume that depicts the magic of a red moonlit night. Dark and mysterious wreaths of frankincense and ambergris are illuminated by a flamboyant amber accord with sensual vanilla and honey accents. A chiaroscuro creation, inspired by the spectacular light that bursts forth from the darkness during a lunar eclipse. "Ambre Samar is a homage to the flamboyant light that illuminates Nature during a night of a red moon. A chiaroscuro amber perfume that radiates sensuality." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfume Creation Director & Perfumer. A powerful symbol of Guerlain’s commitment to the planet, the Absolus Allegoria fragrances contain more than 90% natural-origin* ingredients. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Ambre Samar comes in the Allegoria collection’s emblematic bottle, which is made in France and crafted from 15% recycled glass. It boasts a flamboyant red shade, inspired by the colour of the moon during an eclipse. Its unscrewable spray and transparent lacquer allow it to be recycled more easily. *In accordance with ISO 16128. Calculation includes water.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Escentric 04 Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: Escentric 04 is an ode to the futuristic freshness of Javanol, a sheer sandalwood molecule. The award-winning Escentric 04 focuses on Javanol in a formula that highlights the grapefruit accent in the molecule. Javanol is a sandalwood-type molecule that retains the radiance and endurance of natural sandalwood but is sheer and transparent like no sandalwood in nature. This is a uniquely fresh interpretation of a sandalwood fragrance, fizzing with crisp, bitter top notes of pink grapefruit peel with an added zest of lime. Juniper and pink pepper give an extra shot of freshness, and marijuana brings out the softer quality of the grapefruit pith. The heart is orris with a 'fresh soft rose' composed of four different rose ingredients. The dry-down is balsamic and woody with Javanol combined with the somewhat sweeter sandalwood molecule, Polysantol. "In the other Escentric fragrances, I used a huge amount of the Molecule," says Geza Schoen. "But Javanol is like truffles, and a few slices of truffle shaved on top of your pasta are enough to transport you to heaven." Consequently, Javanol and Polysantol together make up 15% of Escentric 04. The by-product? A subtle yet seductive scent that surrounds the wearer in silvery freshness and woody desire that'll propel those around them into a hazy fantasy. How to use: Spritz onto your pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind your ears, as desired, and let it dry naturally.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Diorella Eau de Toilette Spray, 100ml
listings.description: Created in 1972 by Edmond Roudnitska, Diorella is the feminine counterpart to Eau Sauvage. A fragrance of freedom, independence, and youth, it reflects Christian Dior's joyful spirit. Its trail evokes the melody of jasmine and violet, enhanced by oakmoss and wrapped with fruity notes. Dioriginals brings together the House of Dior’s iconic fragrances, restored by Francis Kurkdjian, Perfume Creative Director. Faithful to the original fragrance compositions, they are presented in the iconic 1948 bottle that once housed Christian Dior’s very first creations.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Givenchy Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Irresistible Givenchy, a fragrance that definitely invites you to let go. listings.rawTitle: Byredo Future Memories Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Future Memories is the scent of something new: not simply a beginning, but the precise instant when life shifts and now becomes forever. It shows life as a sequence of quiet turning points, where the scent becomes a marker in time. Future Memories invites us to live fully, to choose deliberately, to imprint the present with intention. Held like a quiet mantra at the back of the mind, one question remains: What do you choose today, to remember tomorrow? An ambery green musky fragrance built around a modern, textured vanilla, Future Memories opens with the vivid green snap of galbanum and the juicy brightness of blackcurrant, diffused by a luminous veil of aldehydes; it's the instant fully inhabited, where sensation is heightened, and possibility feels infinite. At its heart, powdery iris unfolds alongside labdanum, resinous and warm, as the moment slows and engraves itself quietly into memory. The base belongs entirely to vanilla: rounded, enveloping, and radiant, infused with addictive Ambrofix and an intimate veil of musks that lingers close to the skin. Not a memory that fades, but one that lives on in subtle permanence.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Purple Melancholia Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Introducing new Valentino Born In Roma Donna Eau de Parfum, an ode to self-celebration. Edgy yet feminine, this modern floriental fragrance rewrites the perfume rules, inviting women to celebrate themselves every day. Born in Roma disrupts classic perfumery to create a modern haute couture harmony. Luxurious Jasmine notes and Vanilla Bourbon, one of the most expensive extracts in the world, are blended with a sensuous Woody base to create a captivating floriental perfume that reconstructs fragrance classicism with an edgy twist, reminiscent of Rome's street culture. The bottle is encased in the armour of Valentino’s iconic stud, a fashion signature of Valentino Couture inspired by Roman architecture and representing a rebellious new era for high fashion. Born In Roma Donna personifies this juxtaposition of old and new: Roma is where reverence for the past meets an irreverent attitude for now. To wear the Valentino stud is a symbol of strength; to wear Born In Roma is a symbol of celebration. Born In Roma celebrates where you have come from, and where you want to go. A statement of your personality, your heritage and your rules. Top notes: Bergamot Essence, Blackcurrant Accord Middle notes: Sambac Jasmine Absolute, Jasmine Grandiflorum, Jasmine Tea Base Notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Cashmeran, Guaiacwood Born in Roma Purple takes you on a journey, inviting you to rediscover memories that define you and make you unique. Born from the desire to enjoy life at its fullest, this fragrance opens with a chypre-fruity succulent note of plum, which blossoms into a flowery osmanthus and rich vanilla extract, and lingers like a memory, wrapped in a bottle, as timeless as the moments it recalls. Unlock memories with every wear, experience the irresistible blend of confidence and allure. A scent designed not just to be worn, but to be remembered.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Escentric 02 Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Escentric 02 explores the many faces of perfume's most prized aroma molecule. Escentric 02 is centred on the elusive power of nature-identical Ambroxan (13.5%), a sensual amber molecule with almost mineral smoothness, together with the aphrodisiac notes of green jasmine bud and a sparkling 'gin and tonic' accord, a hint of Almdudler, and "that specific smell you get when you unwrap a new Apple laptop". Ambroxan is a crystal-chemical structure identical to the ambrox derived from ambergris. For centuries ambergris was perhaps the most prized ingredient in perfumery. It is a somewhat mysterious substance expelled by the cachalot or sperm whale, which only attains its fine scent after a long maturation floating in the ocean. Ambergris is rarely found these days, and the 'amber' in a modern fragrance will be a lab-created equivalent of some of the aroma molecules that make up its scent. By far, the finest of these is the nature-identical molecule, Ambroxan. Ambergris was always valued for its refinement as well as its sensuality. This quality persists in Ambroxan. Ambroxan was isolated from plant sources in 1950. Geza Schoen describes the final effect as a "super long-lasting freshness into the dry-down, with a subtle sensuality". Anything but ordinary... if there were such a thing as an aromatic equivalent to a love potion, this fragrance would be it — long-lasting, crisp, seductive. How to use: Spritz onto your pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind your ears, as desired, and let it dry naturally.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Les Légendaires Jicky Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: For almost two centuries, Guerlain has been a story of fragrance and beauty, legacy and creation, daring and exploration, heritage and the future. Our roots enrich the present and inspire the future. With more than 1,100 fragrances created since 1828 by five generations of perfumers, our heritage is unique. The Legendary fragrance collection pays tribute to this exceptional heritage. Jicky is part of Guerlain's Patrimoine Collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by five generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Jicky is a magical fragrance that blends sparkling top notes with warm and delicate base notes. At the time of its creation, women may have found Jicky puzzling, but men adopted it immediately. Today, this fresh and vigorous fragrance is the delight of women and men alike. Why the name Jicky? From his student days, Aimé Guerlain kept the enamoured memory of a young woman named Jicky to whom he paid a beautiful homage with one of his most wonderful olfactory creations. By pure coincidence, the diminutive of his nephew Jacques was also Jicky. Designed by Georges Chevalier, its iconic 'inverted heart' bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden Rosa Sublime Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden reimagines the four stages of ancient alchemy. The Liquidum stage: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden Rosa Sublime Eau de Parfum. The pulsing heartbeat of Damascena Rose and spicy Saffron, flowing together. Seductive. Alluring. Voluptuous. Fragrance family: Floral Spicy. Contrasting energies are brought together with fluid harmony in Rosa Sublime Eau de Parfum. It sways between the opulence of a distilled Damascena Rose Superessence and the stimulating excitement of a spicy Saffron Accord. The Damascena Rose Superessence is captured using steam to distil the most desirable olfactory molecules while retaining the delicate and subtle aromatic facets lost in standard processes. Bringing a polymorphous and ever-changing aura through this method, the scent teases and entices between its contrasted rosy and spicy facets. A fragrance full of bold emotion designed to rouse attention. The bottle: Rosa Sublime Eau de Parfum is encased in a transparent gold glass bottle. Like the flowing movements of the fan it is adorned with, its trail pulses like a heartbeat. Olfactive alchemists: This floral, spicy musky scent owes its beautiful fluidity to perfumer Mathilde Bijaoui, who brought the movements of a fan and the image of a pulsing heart together to create this tantalising and emotive embrace. How to use: SUGGESTED USAGE:|To enjoy the addictive notes of this Gucci perfume for longer, it is recommended to apply it to the body’s pulse points, including the wrists, neck, chest, and behind the ears. Designed to be layered with other fragrances, create your own unique scent with other Eaux de Parfum from the Gucci Alchemist’s Garden collection.

listings.rawTitle: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Encens Precieux Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: A natural treasure. Van Cleef & Arpels has thoroughly captured the desert heat in this new and deeply mysterious fragrance. With ethereal top notes bursting forth, our senses are immediately awakened by a duo of black and pink pepper to reveal a crackling incense. In the heart notes, this flame burns to create an atmosphere full of character, blending myrrh and a leather accord. As we reach the base notes, the smoke has dissipated, leaving a trail of incense and tobacco to drift over an enveloping base of delicately vanilla-scented amber. A captivating fragrance with a strong signature.

BLEU DE CHANEL Parfum is an accomplished composition with a pure, deep character. An intensely masculine signature that exudes self-confidence. BLEU DE CHANEL Parfum is an aromatic, intensely woody fragrance. BLEU DE CHANEL is the fragrance of a man who refuses to be bound by rules. It reveals a character that asserts itself with independence and determination. The spirit of a man who chooses his destiny.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Absolu Parfum Intense 75ml
listings.description: Heatwave warning for the Gaultier ship. With the intensity of Le Male Elixir Absolu on board, sensuality is at its peak, and the ambient temperature is irresistibly torrid. With the oppressive haze of the machinery and the scorching metal of the case, his muscles contract with the sweat and effort, sculpting a golden torso bottle in a dazzling sailor top. Soon, his incandescent aura begins to radiate and set the pace, turning everything in his wake into gold. His precious charisma awes the crew and inflames the senses with such opulence. Le Male’s legendary lavender is intensified by sensual plum and flamboyant Tonka bean. Passionate desire pushes the emotions to the extreme. Let the fire of this indescribable passion sweep you off your feet. The dazzling intensity of Le Male Elixir Absolu Eau de Parfum by Quentin Bisch. The most precious Male sets the atmosphere on fire with his spicy amber aromatic intensity. From the bow, sensual gold notes of provocative plum carry us to the bewitching heart of Le Male’s legendary lavender. Overheated sensuality and inflamed senses are heightened to the extreme by the flamboyant ingot of tempting, powerful Tonka bean. The burning odyssey of this absolute elixir has only just begun. The precious charisma of the bottle. What a look! Gilded with a precious radiance and with a torso smouldering with sensuality, this flamboyant bottle ignites the senses with its prestige and sex appeal. Amber skin, sailor top and bulging muscles fuse into one torridly sensual torso. Desire has never been so intense! Hearts are aflame and spirits ablaze with such dazzling passion. How to use: Le Male Elixir Absolu eau de parfum is so precious and intense that one drop is enough to give your wrists and sailor top a resplendent aura. One final sensual touch behind the ear is sure to set the atmosphere alight. As soon as its spicy amber aroma fuses into your skin, your senses are set ablaze. Your movements are sexier, your gait is more distinguished. A scorching wind sets us on fire. A golden aura dazzles us. Nobody can resist this spicy amber aroma. Le Male Elixir Absolu’s fragrance carries us across the oceans to lands of uncharted sensuality and passion. A single desire — to capture the treasure of this elixir whose torso is as precious as gold.

listings.description: This season, celebrate with our curation of new Burberry Beauty gifts, each beautifully wrapped in our iconic Burberry Check. Discover thoughtful expressions of timeless luxury, designed to be gifted. This Burberry gift set features Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette, accompanied by the matching travel spray. Blending strength and subtlety into one woody fragrance, Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette is the scent of a forest growing by the English coastline and is characterised by a trio of cedarwood oils, invigorated by juniper and black pepper and brightened with bergamot. This Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette is housed in an angular, see-through glass bottle boasting the Burberry logo and crowned with an elegant black cap. Set contains: Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette, 50ml Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette Travel Spray, 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom Ambrosia d'Oro Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Unfurl blooming possibilities with the new Gucci Bloom Ambrosia d'Oro Eau de Parfum for women. Radiating light, this floral, musky nectar lifts the signature Gucci Bloom bouquet with gilded facets. Sensual and long-lasting, this scent shines with a Golden Queen Accord at its heart, enveloping the air with its luminous, fresh beauty and creamy, velvety richness. The fragrance: The scent blossoms into a floral symphony when paired with the signature white Gucci Bloom bouquet. Jasmine Sambac Absolute brings forth a green, fresh vibrancy with subtle facets, while the Tuberose Absolute infuses the composition with sensuality. Together, they create the intensely powdery texture all Gucci Bloom scents are known for. Perfect for any occasion, especially when looking to feel empowered. The bottle: Dressed in an ivory-coloured bottle adorned with a gold pattern, the design highlights the fragrance’s rich warmth and musky decadence. Ideal for those seeking a poetic scent of elevated elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden A Song for the Rose Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci fragrances opens a new story of magic and imagination in Luxury Collection: The Alchemist’s Garden. The singular unisex fragrances in The Alchemist's collection of Eau de Parfum, Acqua Profumata and Perfumed Oils become customisable and transformative when layered in a multitude of perfume combinations to construct a special enticing scent that stays with you all day - the amount the perfume lingers in the air when it is worn. “The Perfumed Oils and Acqua Profumata create mesmerising individual statements. Each oil or floral water of the collection can be layered with each Eau de Parfum. Just play with the scent to find your favourite, as an alchemist would work to find the gold formula,” says Alberto Morillas. The scent: A Song for the Rose Eau de Parfum connects to its notes as an expression of absolute femininity. Bulgarian Rose is presented in the Gucci fragrance as the eternal queen, embodying in alchemy the regeneration of separated essences and their resurrection on a new level. The beautiful flower note of rose is blended to an olfactive duality and melody with sweet Musk and strong Woods notes. The bottle: The design of each Eau de Parfum bottle is inspired by the bottles found on wooden shelves of a vintage apothecary, curious pharmacy jars and the first perfumery containers. The key reference of the collection, A Song for the Rose is housed in a blue bottle. Gold lettering, decoration and secret symbols appear on each eau de parfum, contained in lacquered Gucci fragrance glass bottles with stoppers - covetable objects for lovers of mystery. How to use: Each Perfumed Oil and Acqua Profumata in The Alchemist's collection can be layered with each Eau de Parfum: experiment with combinations to build a unique scent of your beloved scent. Bottling the essence of nature into sublime distillations, the customisable compositions are designed to be layered together, each building from a hero ingredient that shifts and magnifies its character when paired with other Gucci fragrances. The beauty of alchemy is in the transformation: layered scents that become new expressions of art and unfold the magic of unseen worlds. Layer pure and highly concentrated perfumed oils with the Eaux de Parfum to intensify its strength and richness: Apply your choice of The Alchemist Perfumed Oil first on the wrist and neck Follow with your Eau de Parfum layered on top The Acqua Profumata can be applied over the Eau de Parfum to recharge top notes and refresh the overall impression of your signature scent A recommended layer combination for A Song for the Rose perfume, designed to bring out the different facets of its enticing floral woody blend: Layer the noble heart note in A Song for the Rose Gucci perfume by pairing with A Forgotten Rose perfumed oil. The pair results in an evolution of the queen of flowers—a gorgeous rose, pure and concentrated Bring out the thorns with Moonlight Serenade perfumed water. When layered with this water from the collection, the rose becomes wild, for an aromatic and strong Gucci fragrance

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Angels' Share On The Rocks Eau de Parfum Refill, 100ml
listings.description: The perfect balance of icy freshness and luscious depth. A new way to surrender to temptation.​ The perfume: Inspired by the way Kilian Hennessy enjoys cognac—on the rocks, this creation reimagines the Angels’ Share indulgence. The exclusive On the Rocks accord, a defining signature of KILIAN PARIS, elevates the experience with a zesty cocktail of Bergamot, Grapefruit, and Aldehydes, bringing a crystalline chill to this luxurious elixir. This sparkling freshness unfolds into the slow warmth of Cognac Essence, enriched by Myrrh Resin and Tonka Bean Absolute, balancing frosty brightness with a smooth, amber allure.​ Perfume notes: On the Rocks accord, Cognac essence, Tonka bean absolute​. Collection: The Liquors​. Perfumer: Benoist Lapouza.

listings.rawTitle: MATIERE PREMIERE Vanilla Powder Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Vanilla Powder is a unique take on vanilla, built on the contrast between the dark richness of its main natural ingredient, Vanilla Absolute Madagascar, and an overdose of modern white powders. MATIERE PREMIERE Founder and Perfumer Aurélien Guichard has enriched the original Eau de Parfum with guest ingredient Tonka Bean Absolute Venezuela. Combined with a higher perfume concentration and an even higher dosage of vanilla absolute, the tonka bean is used as a natural powder ingredient to bring a voluptuous facet to Vanilla Powder and intensify its addictive character.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Les Légendaires Champs-Élysées Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: For almost two centuries, Guerlain has been a story of fragrance and beauty, legacy and creation, daring and exploration, heritage and the future. Our roots enrich the present and inspire the future. With more than 1,100 fragrances created since 1828 by five generations of perfumers, our heritage is unique. The Legendary fragrance collection pays tribute to this exceptional heritage. Champs-Elysées is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by five generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Champs-Elysées is a tribute to the City of Light and to Guerlain's flagship located at 68, Avenue des Champs-Elysées. This joyful floral fragrance celebrates mimosa. Designed by Georges Chevalier, its iconic 'inverted heart' bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Les Sommets Collection La Cordée Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: A woody, citrus perfume, La Cordée explores the elegant essences of Cypress wood. Evoking the sensation of being on top of the mountain and taking in the forest view, the woody notes are enveloped in sensual black tea and zesty bergamot. The scent is kept in an elegant apothecary-inspired bottle, while the packaging is crafted from dark paper embossed in a wood pattern - a further nod to the fragrance collection's forest-like influence.

listings.rawTitle: CRA-YON Young Air Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: The composition opens with a touch of matcha, bringing crisp green clarity. Hinoki wood adds calm structure and depth. Around it all is air. Space. Transparency. The scent stays close to the skin but travels through the air with a quiet, inspiring scent trail. It moves naturally with the body, cutting through the air and leaving a trail of confidence, elegance, and modernity. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Cypress, Matcha, Paper Ink Accord Heart notes: Fig, Clove Bud, Cinnamon, Hinoki, Leather Base notes: Sandalwood, White Musk, Cedarwood

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL La Pausa Les Exclusifs de CHANEL – Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Beneath the azure blue sky of Roquebrune, Mademoiselle Chanel's villa towered above the smooth Mediterranean waters, surrounded by lavender. The blue of the earth, the air and the sea. A play of textures illustrated by the precious iris pallida, whose delicate and powdery nuances reveal a radiant accord. LA PAUSA is a contrasting fragrance that explores the delicate and powdery nuances of the precious iris pallida, heightened with pink pepper and vetiver. A radiant accord.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Youth Dew Eau de Parfum, 67ml
listings.description: The fragrance. Absolutely captivating, with opulent flowers, rich spices, precious woods. It has been called one of the sexiest fragrances ever created, and more than 50 years after it was launched it continues to entice with its sensual, yet timeless appeal. The Inspiration: "Women still like to feel beautiful, pampered and loved, And that is what Youth-Dew is all about." Estée Lauder, Founder Estée Lauder wondered why women relied on the men in their lives to buy them perfume. And why they reserved fragrance only for special occasions. To change women's minds - and forever change the world of fragrance - Mrs. Lauder created Youth-Dew Bath Oil in 1953. Captivating, rich and exceptionally lasting, women bought it for the bath, but, as Mrs. Lauder predicted, soon began wearing Youth-Dew as their fragrance as well. Because it was sold as a bath oil, not perfume, women felt free to enjoy and wear it every day. Instead of using Youth-Dew by the drop, women used it by the bottle. Men loved it too, saying it was "simply the sexiest fragrance ever." Fragrance family: Amber Spicy. Fragrance notes: Top: Rose, Jonquil, Lavender Heart: Jasmine, Muguet, Spice Base: Moss, Vetiver, Patchouli

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Philosykos Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Philosykos, which in Greek means “friend of the fig tree,” is an ode to the entire tree: the green, pungent freshness of the leaves, the wood warmed in the sun, the milky flavor of the fruit.The sun is at its peak. The famous fig tree comes in a different guise, less fruity and warmed till white-hot by a mist of cedar. Wooded and racy, the nourishing accents from its bark and luxuriant foliage envelop the scent.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Marc Jacobs Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Perfect Marc Jacobs Eau de Parfum for Women is a unique celebration of difference and a tribute to self-love. A comforting floral perfume with rhubarb and daffodil mellowed out by almond milk, cedarwood and cashmeran. About the scent: This irresistible Marc Jacobs perfume features a sparkling, juicy facet clashing and intertwining with a deeply grounding fragrance. Our first-ever rose-dedicated haute-parfumerie collection composed of 11 scents unveils our exclusive centifolia rose like you've never smelled before. Reinventing perfumery's iconic ingredient. Storm And Roses Eau de Parfum with Blackcurrant and Patchouli. In a summer rainstorm, the air thick with humidity even long after the storm passes overhead. The rose is electrified. She stood strong throughout and now has a new edge. Beautifully blended with earthy patchouli and complimented with zingy blackcurrant, she tingles on the skin. Meet The Perfumer. listings.description: Maison Crivelli presents Ambre Chromatique, its third perfume extract, developed in collaboration with perfumer Quentin Bisch. Thibaud Crivelli, faithful to his approach, was once again inspired by a personal event, a moment during which he experienced a powerful, surprising, and intense shock to the senses. For this new creation, Thibaud Crivelli has chosen to work with one of the most iconic raw materials in perfumery: amber. He has taken inspiration from a trek through multicolored jungles in search of benzoin resin. Rainbow jungle, a spicy trek, vanilla vines, cut multicolored bark: a golden resin. Pointed flowers, a davana pigment, sunlike feathers, an akigala leaf. An amber colourama.

As Issey Miyake's first perfume for men, L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme has established itself as a signature reference in the world of men's perfumery and aftershave. Strength and balance – these are the two qualities that unite the fragrance. Upon first spritz, you're greeted with the vibrant freshness of yuzu, the iconic Japanese citrus, and tangerine. In the heart, water lily creates the aquatic facet of L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme, balanced by warm spicy notes. Tobacco, vetiver, and sandalwood channel an energy which evokes that of a powerful waterfall, making the fragrance assertive and masculine. The iconic bottle of L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme has transcended time as well. A couture accessory: On the case, the 'J’ADIOR' signature is affixed in golden metal letters, in a decidedly bold and feminine style. listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Gaultier Divine Couture Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Spectacularly Gaultier! Spectacular and daring! The much-loved 'enfant terrible' of Haute Couture made this his avant-garde and binding signature. For him and for her. Liberté, égalité, Jean Paul Gaultier! Distinctive features of the fragrances included the Classique corset and the Le Male sailor striped top. A sensuously addictive game of seduction. Gaultier Divine Couture: a goddess that reigns with style. In the effervescent ateliers of Jean Paul Gaultier, the silhouette of Gaultier Divine Couture takes shape: a sensual, fruity amber eau de parfum with a haute couture glow. Juicy raspberry, daring meringue, and intense benzoin mark her magnetic and unapologetic style. Her pink lacquered refillable bottle holds every gaze, a gold piercing and a braided corset sculpting her tailor-dreamt silhouette. This is more than a fragrance; it’s a statement piece worn on the skin. It’s stepping into your own divine power. A sensual and unchanging fruity amber Raspberry Meringue Benzoin Fruity Amber A bespoke sculpted bottle Wear Gaultier Divine Couture and watch the world succumb. Bright raspberry to turn heads. Audacious meringue to subvert expectations. Golden benzoin to leave your mark. This fragrance doesn’t accompany you; it embodies you. A signature and second skin. A couture suit of armour. How to use: Spritz this fruity amber on as if you were slipping into a tailored dress. On bare skin, your décolletage, neck, and wrists, each beat of your heart becomes a manifesto. With this Eau de Parfum, you don’t seduce. You reign.
