listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum, the new signature fragrance by Prada. For a woman impossible to frame. Prada’s new refillable feminine fragrance is an invitation to explore and express the multiple dimensions of your identity. A celebration of being never the same, always yourself. Discover a new floral ambery fragrance that embraces the paradoxes of iconic ingredients to re-invent a feminine classic. Prada’s new Eau de Parfum opens with delicate, light, and crisp notes of Neroli, extracted just as the flower blooms to capture the bud’s freshest dimension. Amber accords sit at the heart of the fragrance to reveal a vibrant warmth and re-invented sensuality. At the base, to bring a subtly intense, long-lasting, and unforgettable depth to Paradoxe, a new musk molecule has been developed, light enough to notice right from the first spritz. Feel empowered to explore the multiple dimensions of your identity with Paradoxe by Prada. The Prada Paradoxe Collection is also refillable with our 100ml Refill Bottle. The perfect gift for yourself or treat for someone special. The iconic Paradoxe bottle: Encapsulating the very essence of Prada, the refillable Paradoxe bottle reinvents the most iconic code of the brand, the triangle logo. Tilted yet powerfully grounded, the iconic shape of the bottle is softened with rounded angles, while the delicate coral pink colour of the fragrance contrasts with the deep black Prada coat of arms. Feminine, yet disruptive. Unique, yet immediately recognisable. The Paradoxe woman, impossible to define: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum, the new feminine signature fragrance for a woman impossible to frame. Our new fragrance celebrates the essential expression of femininity in all its forms. Paradoxe explores the unexpected reconciliation of contradictions to celebrate multi-dimensional self-expression and the liberation that comes with being never the same, always yourself. The Paradoxe perfumers: Master perfumers Nadège Le Garlantezec, Shyamala Maisondieu and Antoine Maisondieu collaborated with Creative Directors, Miuccia Prada and Raf Simons, to reconcile timelessness, avant-garde, and innovation. Prada embraces the paradoxes of iconic feminine ingredients to reveal the avant-garde signature of a timeless floral bouquet.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum, the new signature fragrance by Prada. For a woman impossible to frame. Prada’s new refillable feminine fragrance is an invitation to explore and express the multiple dimensions of your identity. A celebration of being never the same, always yourself. Discover a new floral ambery fragrance that embraces the paradoxes of iconic ingredients to re-invent a feminine classic. Prada’s new Eau de Parfum opens with delicate, light, and crisp notes of Neroli, extracted just as the flower blooms to capture the bud’s freshest dimension. Amber accords sit at the heart of the fragrance to reveal a vibrant warmth and re-invented sensuality. At the base, to bring a subtly intense, long-lasting, and unforgettable depth to Paradoxe, a new musk molecule has been developed, light enough to notice right from the first spritz. Feel empowered to explore the multiple dimensions of your identity with Paradoxe by Prada. The Prada Paradoxe Collection is also refillable with our 100ml Refill Bottle. The perfect gift for yourself or treat for someone special. The iconic Paradoxe bottle: Encapsulating the very essence of Prada, the refillable Paradoxe bottle reinvents the most iconic code of the brand, the triangle logo. Tilted yet powerfully grounded, the iconic shape of the bottle is softened with rounded angles, while the delicate coral pink colour of the fragrance contrasts with the deep black Prada coat of arms. Feminine, yet disruptive. Unique, yet immediately recognisable. The Paradoxe woman, impossible to define: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum, the new feminine signature fragrance for a woman impossible to frame. Our new fragrance celebrates the essential expression of femininity in all its forms. Paradoxe explores the unexpected reconciliation of contradictions to celebrate multi-dimensional self-expression and the liberation that comes with being never the same, always yourself. The Paradoxe perfumers: Master perfumers Nadège Le Garlantezec, Shyamala Maisondieu and Antoine Maisondieu collaborated with Creative Directors, Miuccia Prada and Raf Simons, to reconcile timelessness, avant-garde, and innovation. Prada embraces the paradoxes of iconic feminine ingredients to reveal the avant-garde signature of a timeless floral bouquet.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
listings.description: The fragrance: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion For Men Eau de Parfum celebrates unwavering and unconditional devotion, the power of love, and the joy of life. The fragrance, anchored by the timeless Sacred Heart, reflects the essence of a determined man, confidently guided by his instincts. The design: The Devotion For Men glass bottle features the same elegant silhouette as its female counterpart, reinterpreting its signature codes. The light gold fragrance is beautifully encased in a bottle adorned with the Sacred Heart in coordinating silver, complementing the cap. Dolce & Gabbana Devotion For Men Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that unveils a captivating woody spicy accord. The fragrance was created by Olivier Cresp exclusively for Dolce & Gabbana. Top notes: The fragrance opens with fresh and zesty notes of Lemon Heart notes: At its heart, the spicy and invigorating essence of Coffee comes to life Base notes: The earthy touch of Patchouli lends character and depth

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Safran Secret Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: "Perfume is all the more beautiful when there is a touch of mystery." It is with this in mind that Maison Crivelli invites you to embrace the unknown and experience perfume in an unprecedented and highly personal way, through a new collection of Olfactory Secrets. Safran Secret recalls a mysterious adventure lived by Thibaud Crivelli during which he discovered a saffron field shrouded in a very thick fog. This deep, sensual composition is as captivating as enigmatic. It sees the brightness of a comforting saffron contrast with the opacity of warm and highly diffusive woods. Maison Crivelli was created with the aim of surprising people with mixed, daring olfactory creations that defy conventions and stand out from the classics. Each fragrance encapsulates adventures experienced by the brand's founder, Thibaud Crivelli. Scents, colours, sounds and textures intermingle to capture the essence of surprise, a challenge to the ordinary and an invitation to explore new sensory frontiers.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Hermessence Osmanthe Yunnan Eau de Toilette
listings.description: Osmanthe Yunnan, a seductive game of tea, flowers and fruits. "During a visit to the Forbidden City in Beijing, I was captivated by an exquisite smell that led me by the tip of my nose to the Imperial Palace, where osmanthus bushes were in bloom. In November, despite their tiny size, the flowers exuded a strong scent of apricot and freesia. I imagined combining these blossoms with a tea from Yunnan, the most beautiful province in China…and the idea for the fragrance was born." - Jean-Claude Ellena. Fragrance notes: tea leaf, osmanthus flower, orange.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mitsouko Perfume, 30ml
listings.description: Her name was Mitsouko. It means “mystery”, a mystery of tenderness and softness. She is this enigmatic, disarming and determined woman who accepts her destiny with the courage of the greatest heroines in literature. A masterpiece of balance, this mysterious perfume is made of spices and wood with subtly fruity accents. Little by little, Mitsouko evokes the assertive scent of underbrush. Its tonality is warm and sensual, it makes its presence known softly and embarks on a long story… Fragrance description: Fruity chypre mysterious, balanced, velvety, a masterpiece of balance and originality, Mitsouko marries a fruity note of peach with jasmine flowers and May rose. The mysterious dry-down of the fragrance blends spicy notes with those of underbrush and vetiver. 30ml

listings.rawTitle: Hermès 24 Faubourg Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Composed in 1995 by perfumer Maurice Roucel, 24 Faubourg draws on the Mediterranean Sea and Indian Ocean as sunny sources of inspiration. With floral and amber notes, 24 Faubourg eau de toilette is bursting with the scent of white flowers, from radiant orange blossom and sensual jasmine to enveloping vanilla. Designer Serge Mansau created a sculptural bottle evoking a silk scarf flooded with sunshine and ruffled by a light breeze. 24 Faubourg is the legendary address of the first Hermès store, located on Rue du Faubourg-Saint-Honoré in Paris. A fusion of tradition and modernity, this ‘secret world’ is the place from which the house’s creative passion springs forth. A novel written by Maurice Roucel in 1995, 24 Faubourg is an invitation to travel, with the sun as a destination. A sparkle of white flowers in the top notes, the radiance of a floral heart enveloped in iris, wood and mystery, while vanilla and ambergris set the tone for the sillage.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Paris-Riviera Les Eaux de CHANEL – Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: A fresh fragrance with a radiant floral trail that evokes the soft, luminous atmosphere of the Côte d’Azur that Gabrielle Chanel loved so dearly. 1928. Gabrielle Chanel had her vacation villa La Pausa built on the Côte d’Azur, a few years after opening a new boutique in Cannes. With its breathtaking landscapes and exciting lifestyle, the French Riviera had become the new society hotspot. PARIS-RIVIERA evokes this sweetness of life with a radiant floral trail. A fragrance illuminated with a blend of citrus and white flowers. Soft yet lively, Sicilian orange highlights the note of neroli. A light bottle with a rounded shape that fits in the palm of the hand, a sleek sleeve designed with natural materials that evoke the waves lapping on the beach. LES EAUX DE CHANEL are available in a large misting spray bottle for full and generous perfuming.With a single spray, LES EAUX DE CHANEL fragrances procure a feeling of freshness so vivid it takes you on a journey.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Wūlóng Chá X Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Included in the first-ever NISHANE collection launched globally in the year 2015, Wūlóng Chá has reached a huge fanbase worldwide thanks to the journey it takes the wearer to the serene tea gardens of the Far East, where the delicate notes of oolong tea leaves and Mediterranean fig fill the air. The original Wūlóng Chá has been celebrated especially because of its robust power of refreshing notes. However, Wūlóng Chá X is designed to mute the sharp edges of the original formula and enhance it with the addition of florals, namely magnolia. This fragrance opens with a burst of zesty citrus notes of bergamot, orange, mandarin, and yuzu, transporting the wearer to the sunny shores of the Mediterranean. As the scent settles, the heart notes of magnolia, thyme oil and green tea weave a magical spell around you, evoking the tranquil stillness of a teatime. Finally, the base notes of musk and fig provide a warm and grounding finish to this fragrance that will keep the wearer feeling fresh and revitalised all day long. Wūlóng Chá X is a perfect choice for those who seek a refreshing and uplifting fragrance that can be worn all year round.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Sì Eau De Parfum Refill, 100ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Sì Eau De Parfum – The Perfume For Women. Armani Sì Eau De Parfum is a timeless perfume that is whole-hearted and grounded yet turns into a soft trail that lingers. Sì is Italian for 'yes' and reveals the contemporary femininity of Giorgio Armani, the Sì woman has the confidence to say yes to the values that define her life. This Eau de Parfum resembles fresh sheets that have dried outside in the summer air, soft and warm with a hint of sophisticated sweetness. Distinctive, creamy and catches attention, Armani Sì is a floral perfume for women who are strong and graceful. Fresh, green and addictive in its initial impression, the elegance of Freesia and the exquisite honey hues of Rose De Mai absolute make this perfume truly distinctive. The long-lasting and sensual notes of Oakmoss and Patchouli softly define this fragrance as a captivating modern chypre. Circling the neck of the Armani Si bottle is a gold ring that symbolises the promise of eternity, a perfect wedding, engagement, or anniversary gift. Looking for something lighter? Try Sì Eau de Toilette Looking for something more fruity and passionate? Try Sì Passione Eau de Parfum Looking for something more floral? Try Sì Fiori Eau de Parfum Fragrance Family: Modern Chypre. Top notes: Blackcurrant Liqueur Heart notes: Rose de Mai Absolute & Freesia Base notes: Patchouli & Oakmoss Notes: Patchouli & Oakmoss How to Refill at home using the 150ml refill format: Remove the cap and unscrew the pump from the original fragrance bottle Turn the refill bottle upside down and insert the neck of the refill into your perfume bottle Once inserted twist–on the refill cap to activate the flow of the refill Wait for the refill to stop automatically then twist-off the refill and remove Re-screw the pump and place the cap back onto your fragrance bottle Place the cap back onto your refill and store any remaining fragrance until your next refill is needed

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Taormina Orange Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Discover Taormina Orange, a fragrance that evokes a private hilltop resort atop sunlit cliffs. The citrus woody fragrance captures the blood orange groves, crisp winds and dramatic sea vistas of Sicily. The journey to Taormina starts with an exhilarating Ionian breeze charged with teeming blood orange groves, and the crisp, bitter-tinged sweetness of orange bigarade oil. Earthy oakmoss and salt-skin musks entwine with citrus, grounding the fruit in an alfresco warmth. The Taormina Orange bottle captures the view of the turquoise Ionian Sea from the cliffside town. Gold-toned accents echo the Sicilian warmth of sunlit citrus groves. Fragrance family: Fresh Scent type: Mediterranean Citrus

The dry-down reveals an overdose of majestic Sandalwood for a sensual and long-lasting trail. The iconic quilted case wears a radiant gold metal colour, beautifully reflecting light. The transparent upper part allows the light to pass through and shows the soft gold-colored juice creating a stunning visual effect. The dazzling gold bottle is showcased in sleek black outer packaging for a luxurious premium signature.

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Orphéon Refillable Solid Perfume, 3g
listings.description: Orphéon comes in a new solid perfume decorated with its iconic illustration. A gesture that is both portable and eco-responsible. Like the memory of a scent, Orphéon captures the warm atmosphere of an iconic nightclub bar in the Saint Germain quarter of Paris. In this fragrance gesture, woody, floral and subtly spicy, the softness of patinated woods meets the wisps of tobacco and the linger of makeup powder.

listings.rawTitle: OUAI North Bondi Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: This beautiful floral fragrance contains notes of bergamot, Italian lemon, rose de Mai, violet and white musk. Top notes: Bergamot, Apple Blossom, Raspberry Middle notes: Rose, Jasmine, Violet Dry-down: Sandalwood, Patchouli, Musk

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Empressa Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The Empressa leaves an impression. Her eau de parfum is laced with peach, vanilla and shimmering blood orange, as bright and stirring as the dawn. Her smile? Warm, lustrous, and unforgettable. Key notes: patchouli, bergamot, peach. "Empressa is inspired by the beauty of pearls, precious silks and fine fabrics transported through London to adorn women of power and influence." Penhaligon's scents are getting a refreshed wardrobe. You may receive your fragrance in either its previous or new design. Both are authentic and unmistakably Penhaligon's.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 71 Hair & Body Perfume Mist 90ml
listings.description: Decadent like cashmere. Warm and cosy, this amber gourmand fragrance tempts you with the cocooning comfort of sumptuous texture. Wrap yourself up in rich notes of caramelised vanilla, toasted macadamia, and tonka bean. Feels delectably indulgent. Cheirosa 71 Perfume Mist is inspired by our Brazilian muse Leila Diniz, who celebrated her bikini body at eight months pregnant on the beaches of Rio in 1971. Now that's the Sol spirit. Fragrance notes: Top: Caramelised Vanilla, Sea Salt Middle: Toasted Macadamia Nut, White Chocolate Base: Tonka Bean, Coconut Blossom

listings.rawTitle: TOCCA Giulietta Eau de Parfum 20ml
listings.description: Giulietta Eau de Parfum is TOCCA’s delicate floral fruity fragrance, perfect for everyday romance. Giulietta is graceful, romantic and quietly captivating. Giulietta opens with soft apple blossom and fresh green notes before unfolding into delicate pink tulips and white lilies. Resting on a comforting base of cedarwood and musk, Giulietta captures the feeling of wandering through Italian gardens where every corner reveals another beautiful discovery. Fragrance family: Floral Fruity. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Bulgarian Rose, Ylang Ylang, Green Apple, Pink Tulips Heart notes: Lily of the Valley, Iris Pallida, Vanilla Orchid, Lilac Base notes: Cedarwood, Musk, Amber TOCCA fragrances are inspired by powerful feminine archetypes, both mythic and modern muses. Crafted by master perfumers with the world’s finest ingredients, each Eau de Parfum is housed in a fluted Italian glass bottle with a hand-finished cap — a graceful tribute to feminine beauty and confidence. How to use: Spray generously onto your wrists, neck, and pulse points.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Montblanc Explorer Platinum expresses a different facet of the spirit of exploration. Montblanc is taking us towards adventures into the world's highest mountains. Discover this woody ambery Eau de Parfum which opens with vibrant green notes of grapefruit, violet leaves and clary sage, all wrapped by the intensity of cedarwood and an accord of ambery notes. The bottle is decorated with a precious and eye-catching textured silver sleeve inspired by the 1858 Geosphere Montblanc's watch paying tribute to the world s seven summit mountaineering challenge.

listings.rawTitle: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Musc de Soie Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: A prism of light, an olfactory mirror, this fragrance embodies the radiance of musk. Envisioned like a silk fabric, this fragrance brings infinite softness that follows our every move, always leaving a luminous and enveloping trail in its wake, like a veritable second skin. Aldehydes marks this luminous beginning, with the white warmth of Neroli petals. Gliding like silk over the skin, with enveloping notes of White Musk and Cashmeran. The base notes are warmed by sandalwood and its creamy facets and notes of benzoin give it character and sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Petit Matin Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Rise at dawn and escape into the delightful freshness of an early morning in Paris to rediscover a taste for beauty. Stroll through the empty streets and archways of a Paris still cast in the first light of day, before taking a rest. Let yourself be carried away by the luminous energy of litsea cubeba from Indonesia, lemon from Calabria, the floral softness of hawthorn and lavandin from Provence. Then, get lost in a labyrinth of musky and ambery notes. A fragrance for men and women.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Sublimage L'Extrait De Lotion Lotion Bottle, 125ml
listings.description: SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait de Lotion, developed specifically as a pre-serum and infused with Swertia extract and active fractions of Vanilla Planifola, is the first step that begins the SUBLIMAGE Les Extraits skincare routine. This lotion features a unique texture containing thousands of micro-droplets*. Encapsulated within them is a combination of powerful active ingredients and sumptuous oils, for an unparalleled sensory experience – the perfect balance of freshness and richness. Its precious formula, composed of 96% naturally derived ingredients**, rejuvenates the skin's appearance and optimises its natural repair mechanisms, which are more intense at night than during the day. Left more comfortable, hydrated and perfectly prepared, the skin is ready to receive the rest of the products in the ritual. Developed in partnership with a renowned French glassmaker, which lent its unique, long-established expertise, each glass bottle reveals the sumptuous amber texture within. *Approximately 128,000 micro-droplets – average value calculated for one 125 ml bottle of SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait de Lotion. **According to ISO 16128. How to use: Using the fingertips, apply SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait de Lotion to clean skin (face and neck) in the morning and evening as the first step in your skincare routine, then perform LE GESTE SUBLIME RÉPARATION. STEP 1: THE CHANEL APPLICATION Apply a small amount of SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait de Lotion to the cheeks, forehead and neck. With both hands, smooth over the face from the centre outwards. For the neck, follow your jawline. STEP 2: REPAIRING MOVEMENTS Using the entire surface of the palms and fingers, perform deep, enveloping effleurage strokes. Start on the T-zone and work up to the forehead, then move on to the cheeks, lip area, jawline and trapezius. Repeat the movement three times on each area. STEP 3: LE GESTE SUBLIME RADIANCE Bend the fingers and massage from the centre of the face outwards, performing deep circular movements under the jawline, along the jawline, and on the cheeks and forehead. The jawline appears redefined, wrinkles appear reduced and tension is eliminated.Skin is left soothed and smooth.> CHANEL has created the perfect skincare ritual to reinforce the skin-enhancing power of SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait de Lotion, pairing it with SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait de Nuit and SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait de Crème.

listings.description: Moscow Mule’s olfactory trail hypnotises its audience as if it were inviting everyone to share, over a glass of something. A timeless moment, where tongues are loosened and bodies scolding hot. A twist of ginger for the sexy side, a zest of lemon for the punch! A limitless pleasure to be consumed without moderation. Top notes: Lime, Bergamot, Ginger Heart notes: Apple Essence, Jasmine Bottom notes: Ambretolide, Ambroxan, Norlimbanol

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 39 Perfume Mist 90ml
listings.description: Coconuts straight from the tree. Hammock daydreams. Breeze in your hair. Cheirosa 39 Perfume Mist returns with even more coconut and vanilla than before, and it’s here for good. Inspired by 1939, when Brazilian performer Carmen Miranda made tropical style iconic, this scent captures that same playful spirit. Beachy and indulgent, it blends coconut cream and tropical orchid while toasted vanilla melts into warm praline. Find your paradise.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's The Tragedy Of Lord George Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Do come in, I’m sure we’ve met before... Noble patriarch, paragon of masculine elegance, Lord George welcomes with a scent of shaving soap and warming rum. But what secrets hide behind tradition? Key notes: Ambrox, Rum, Tonka Bean. "The head of the Portraits family, and quite the head he has. Lord George captures traditional masculinity and sophistication with a dash of mystery."

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L’interdit Absolu Eau de Parfum Intense 35ml
listings.description: Reinventing an icon, L'Interdit Absolu. Givenchy introduces L’Interdit Absolu, the NEW intense perfume that redefines traditional codes with a striking composition, blurring the boundaries with a more masculine sillage. A fragrance for anyone who dares to express their individuality and surpass their own limits. Beyond desirability, beyond freedom, beyond the forbidden. The ingredients: L’Interdit Absolu Eau de Parfum Intense reveals a floral woody ambery composition, a striking reinterpretation of an iconic scent. In this new signature, the white flower bouquet of L’Interdit Eau de Parfum is beautifully intertwined with Tobacco absolute to reveal a smoky and warm fragrance trail that captivates the senses. Similarly to all Givenchy fragrances, the new L’Interdit Absolu unveils a contrasted facet: the florality of Orange Blossom, rich Tuberose and pure Jasmine Absolute gives way to woody notes of vetiver and patchouli, bringing depth and elegance to the fragrance. An invigorating aroma of lavender combines with the captivating essence of cardamom and the unique touch of Neroli Essential, magnified by a smoky Tobacco absolute. A warm and woody signature, crafting an unforgettable fragrance experience that leaves a lasting impression. The bottle: L’Interdit Absolu revisits the original fragrance’s iconic silhouette, reinvented in a new sharpened design for a bolder impression. To amplify the luxurious shape, the bottle is dressed in black from head to toe, playing with the contrast between opacity and light. The lacing around its neck, sealed with the House’s signature 4G logo, is the perfect finishing touch to the bottle’s timeless design. Beyond the forbidden. Ever since its creation, values of boldness and liberation have been a cornerstone of the house of Givenchy. Daring. Breaking the rules. Freeing yourself. In this new iteration, Givenchy invites you to surpass your own limits and go beyond the forbidden. Floral Woody Ambery.

listings.description: Woody and spicy, Haute Montagne, transmits the energy of high-altitude blond woods. The cedarwood is wrapped up with warm Madagascar vanilla and white musks, creating an exciting, energetic fragrance. The scent is kept in an elegant apothecary-inspired bottle, while the packaging is crafted from dark paper embossed in a wood pattern - a further nod to the fragrance collection's forest-like influence.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Fico di Amalfi Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Blu Mediterraneo Fico di Amalfi offers a vitalising scent that continuously surprises just like the spectacular view of the Amalfi coast. An Eau de Toilette with a vitalising citrus scent, Blu Mediterraneo Fico di Amalfi is characterised by notes of bergamot, lemon, grapefruit and cedar wood. At its heart, fig notes come together with pink pepper scents and jasmine petals accords while the base of this Eau de Toilette is rounded off with harmonious accents of fig, cedar wood and benzoin. Fico di Amalfi comes in the iconic Acqua di Parma bottle, with Art Deco influences. The glass, which is pure, luxurious, and thick, is tinged with a deep blue in a play of reflections that evokes the transparency of the sea.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Jasminum Sambac Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Good to know: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs is being re-branded, the logo on your products may differ from the photos. The scent is still the same. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs invites you to compose your personalised Chloé fragrance as though arranging your favourite blossoms in a bouquet at a Parisian flower shop. Each perfume in the collection reveals a single floral, aromatic or woody scent rooted in the perfumer’s memory. Wear alone like a corsage or combine endlessly to create a lovely present or a perfume for all occasions. A flower, a perfumer, a story... Jasminum Sambac, an exquisite perfume for women by Louise Turner. Created by Louise Turner, this women’s Eau de Parfum was inspired by the beautiful jasmine sambac she smelled on Mother's Day in Bangkok, where it is the gift of choice. As though laced with dewdrops, the velvety jasmine petals infuse the bouquet with soft, sunny notes. A fresh springtime fragrance perfect for special occasions. This Chloé perfume is housed in an elegant pleated glass bottle topped with an ivory cap that appears to be carved in stone. Touches of gold at the neckband and label trim enhance the light hue of each beautiful fragrance. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists. Wear your favourite flower on its own to celebrate its vitality and intensity, or combine Jasminum Sambac with other perfumes from Atelier des Fleurs to create a personalised fragrance bouquet. Disclaimer: Packaging may vary but scent remains the same.

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Oud for Happiness Eau de Parfum, 90ml
listings.description: Can a scent make you feel happier? Oud for Happiness is a portal to modernity. It amplifies the benefits of oud through a puff of freshly-cut narcotic grass, energising and uninhibited. The composition provides an addictive means of relaxation that stimulates self-confidence. Better than an imaginary paradise, enter into a secret dimension where the experience of deep harmony can be lived. Woody Spicy. Made in France Unisex Cruelty-free Fragrance notes: Bergamot, Ginger, Licorice, Vanilla, Cedar Wood, Indian Oud, All Naturals, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley-Paris Eau du Soir Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A whirlwind of flowers, spice and chypre.An Eau de Parfum for women, from Sisley. Refined, elegant and timeless, Eau du Soir evokes a stroll through the gardens of Alcazar in Seville, in Spain, at dusk, when the Syringa flower exhales its fragrance. A refined eau de parfum, combining the freshness of citrus with the sensuality of florals, highlighted by an elegant chypre signature.It's love at first sight between Mandarin and sun-drenched Grapefruit. The intense absolute of Rose and delicate Jasmine boldly respond to the bewitching notes of Syringa and Ylang-ylang. The final touch: base notes of Amber and Patchouli embrace the fruity, floral notes, leaving a decidedly elegant scent in its wearer's wake.

listings.rawTitle: Tiffany & Co Rose Gold Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Tiffany & Co. Rose Gold Eau de Parfum Intense celebrates Tiffany’s expertise in precious metals, evoking the sleek and contemporary spirit of rose gold. Maintaining the core identity of Rose Gold Eau de Parfum for women, Rose Gold Eau de Parfum Intense evolves the story for a deeper, richer sensorial experience. This modern perfume immerses the wearer in a vibrant world of sparkling citrus and fruits, flawlessly balanced with radiant pink pepper. At its heart lies a bouquet of orange flower and jasmine sambac that are blended with Turkish rose oil and orris butter - each brings a new dimension that delivers a rich and captivating sophistication. The base of the fragrance adds a playful complexity, anchored by an elegant, sustainably sourced patchouli, warm woods, pink sugar and a marine accord for an extravagant beauty. This opulent perfume for women bestows a unique and sublime intensity: A timeless, sensual scent that is beautifully long-lasting on skin. How to use: Wear this perfume as you would a precious jewel. Apply Tiffany Rose Gold Eau de Parfum Intense for women to the pulse points at the neck, wrists and ears to warm and diffuse the fragrance and ensure long-lasting wear.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Coco Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: COCO expresses the intensity of Gabrielle Chanel's personality and her love of all things baroque. An Amber composition with floral and spicy notes, the eau de toilette is a lighter interpretation of the fragrance without losing any of its richness. An Amber-floral fragrance with fresh tones. The floral-spicy accord opens with a citrus note of Mandarin; its heart of Jasmine Absolute is heightened with a breath of Ylang-Ylang from the Comoros. A luxuriant yet light harmony that leaves behind a trail of scent tinged with Indonesian Patchouli. The eau de toilette comes in a spray for a more generous use, with easy and fluent application on skin or clothing. A complete perfuming ritual for the bath and body is used to enhance the scent trail of the fragrance.

listings.description: Montblanc Explorer Infinite captures the magnetic allure of sunset—where the desert’s intense warmth meets the cool mystery of night. listings.rawTitle: Moroccanoil Lumière du Jour Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Introducing Lumière du Jour Eau de Parfum by Moroccanoil, a romantic and magnetic fragrance; an idyllic escape for the senses. Inspired by light-filled, joyful Mediterranean days, it captures a moment of stillness before the world awakens. Lush fig leaf and sun-warmed jasmine bloom in harmony, while soft blonde woods and luminous musks add depth and quiet allure. This fragrance is a celebration of light, luminous, magnetic, and endlessly romantic. It evokes the sensation of strolling through a coastal garden at sunrise, where the air is sweet, the breeze gentle, and every breath feels like a secret waiting to be discovered. Let Lumière du Jour guide you to a place where time stands still, and the soul can wander freely. Unveil the secrets of the Mediterranean, one sunlit note at a time.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Meliora Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Meliora is a delicate cocktail of fruit and flowers that have an enchanting romanticism. Dreamy rose, jasmine tea and ylang-ylang release a clean floralcy that stirs and enchants the mind amidst an opening of fruity berries and lemon essence. The freshness of the blooms found at the heart are further enhanced through a flourish of sweet vanilla, musk and cedarwood essence at the base. Olfactive notes: Top notes: Red Berries, Raspberry, Lemon Essence Heart notes: Rose, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine Tea Base notes: Vanilla, Musk, Cedarwood When the innocence and softness of rose and lily encounter the fruity scents of raspberry and blackcurrant, Meliora, a delicate cocktail of fruit and flowers enchants with its romanticism. The artistic eau de parfum has been presented in a glass bottle with a glistening gold top and cream tassel. Embodying the discerning values of Parfums de Marly, Meliora douses the skin in romantic merriment.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Extreme Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Experience a sensory explosion with Spicebomb Extreme, the intense Eau de Parfum for men by Viktor & Rolf. Spicebomb Extreme reveals an intense explosion of heat in a fragrance. The sparkling grapefruit top notes are enhanced by notes of pimento berries along with black pepper to deliver a fresh opening. The aromatic heart is surrounded by the scent of warm spices; cumin, cinnamon and saffron, giving it a masculine yet sensual personality. The note of tobacco is strengthened by the balsamic notes of vanilla and bourbon which are contrasted with warm woody amber for an oriental experience. Spicebomb Extreme Eau de Parfum is available in 50ml and 90ml. Fragrance family: Ambery Spicy. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Bergamot, Cinnamon leaves, Pepper Heart notes: Lavender, Cumin, Elemi Base notes: Iris, Tobacco accord, Cistus labdanum, Vanilla How to use: For instant infatuation, spritz the perfume onto the pulse points (on wrists, behind ears and on neck).

listings.description: With a colourful, sunny and luminous freshness, Aqua Vitae Cologne forte is a caressing Eau de Parfum with a sun-kissed trail of sensual musks enriched by Indian sandalwood and exalted by the association of Italian mandarin and Calabrian bergamot. This floral citrus fragrance embodies a sensual and sun-kissed sensation of freshness, the radiance of the sun at its peak and a surge of hot air. This sensation of freshness is brought by the solar flowers accord and the sensual musky accord within the perfume. Notes: Bergamot oil from Italy, Mandarin oil from Italy, sunny floral accord, sensual musk accord. Family: Floral Citrus.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Velvet Mood Extrait de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: A fruity, woody perfume that interprets the softness and warmth of sand into an enveloping, mysterious, yet powerful unisex fragrance. Fascinated by the rarity, preciousness, and mystery surrounding oud, this Maison Francis Kurkdjian oud perfume draws inspiration from a journey through the desert, where soft sand heated under the midday sun evokes the sensual embrace of majestic velvet draped over the skin. Emanating surprising warmth and infinite softness, this oud perfume offers an elegantly balanced sillage that is luminous and carnal. Unfolding with the warm, slightly spicy facets of saffron, this luxury unisex fragrance reveals a heart where the profound decadence of a peach accord meets a jasmine perfume. This fruity woody blend is anchored by an enveloping, sensual base of oud and a supple leather accord, creating a magnetic and enveloping sillage. Key notes: Saffron: unveils a warm, leathery intensity Peach accord: brings a velvety, fruity carnality Jasmine: lifts the heart with airy luminosity Oud: anchors the composition with dark, resonant density Leather accord: grounds the trail with supple smoothness OUD velvet mood joins the OUD perfume collection, where each fragrance puts a spotlight on the incomparable beauty of oud wood and evokes the sensation of a rich fabric wrapped around the skin. Offering a unique exploration of this rich and multifaceted ingredient, this long-lasting fragrance brings to mind a scrap of velvet floating between oriental dunes that undulate in the desert winds.

listings.description: Warm, woodsy, sensually rich and boldly exotic. Inspired by the intensity, abundance, and passion of the Indonesian Island of Borneo. Ciste Absolute Incense and Indonesian Patchouli are lifted by Thyme, Rosemary and Bergamot, and anchored by Agarwood. Additional notes of Sandalwood, Cedar, Styrax and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum for Her Refill, 150ml
listings.description: The fragrance: Release the power of attraction with BOSS The Scent for Her, an iconic Eau de Parfum that captures the strong, undeniable chemistry flowing between a power couple. The scent: Inspired by the interplay of a bold pairing, this ambery-floral-fruity fragrance unites intense contrasts to create an irresistible, captivating force. It opens with a luscious natural Peach extract that radiates an ecstatic energy, set against a velvety, opulent Osmanthus bouquet at the heart. The heated tension is further enhanced with carnal White Musk notes, anchoring the trail in a compelling embrace that moves the senses. The bottle: BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum for Women reinvents empowering sensuality in a crystalline, refillable bottle featuring the BOSS logo on translucent glass and a BOSS Double-B monogram icy-gold cap. Capturing the spotlight, its multi-faceted shape reflects the sensorial showdown within this peachy-coloured scent, while echoing the many sides of a power couple. Refillable format: All sizes are designed to be refillable with the 150ml refill bottle, sold separately. Screw the 150ml refill onto the neck of the 30ml, 50ml or 100ml bottle and it automatically stops filling to deliver the optimal amount of fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Cole & Son Idyll Wallpaper, Eau De Nil
listings.description: A glorious Idyll, the English landscape garden flourishes into an expansive, romantic scene of rolling hills, blooming rose bushes, proud peacocks and mature trees as far as the eye can see. While away the hours as a light breeze rustles through the mature grounds, established wildflower beds and the meandering stream of this truly enchanting vista. Formed of 7 drops across a 2-roll set, Idyll's focus can be adapted according to any interior for a captivating feature or use in repeat for an enchanting, enveloping environment. Idyll's sample pack contains two different A3 sections of the panorama as well as an A6 sample of the roses along the bottom of the scene. All sample packs for this design contain the exact same areas of the panorama. Full panorama dimensions W4.9m x L4m. Have you thought about wallpaper accessories? Shop here.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Flora Cherrysia Eau de Toilette, Refill, 200ml
listings.description: Refill your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle in one simple step with the Flora Cherrysia refill format. As though blurred, a cherry blossom accord becomes evanescent with the fruity notes of nashi and watermelon, on a woody background delicately powdered by a note of violet. Create your own signature by pairing Flora Cherrysia with: Bergamote Calabria, Mandarine Basilic, Rosa Rossa, Granada Salvia, Pera Granita or Flora Salvaggia. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Berry Crush Fruity Floral Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Freedom has a scent. Libre Berry Crush is a fruity, floral indulgence. A delectable reinterpretation of Libre's iconic floral lavender, infused with the irresistible juiciness of raspberries. Sweet yet bold, indulgent yet exhilarating. The scent of freedom, freshly crushed. The scent: Freshly crushed berries, good enough to savour. Libre's floral heart now bursts with fruity intensity, dripping in deliciousness. Tangy raspberry is crushed into Libre's bold floral signature, complemented by invigorating lavender from France and sensual orange blossom from Morocco. This vibrant blend effortlessly melts into a creamy coconut accord, balancing freshness with irresistible warmth and indulgence. A fragrance good enough to savour. A reflection of the Libre woman's insatiable hunger for freedom. The bottle: A vibrant jewel, tinted in berry-red hues. The iconic Libre bottle is more daring than ever, embracing the vibrancy of juicy berries. Its sleek, tuxedo-inspired silhouette now radiates with scarlet hues, reminiscent of pulpy raspberries. Gold chains, an asymmetrical black cap and the iconic Cassandre logo seal this statement of unapologetic femininity.

Gold chains, an asymmetrical black cap and the iconic Cassandre logo seal this statement of unapologetic femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Delina Coffret Gift Set
listings.description: For this Festive Season, Parfums de Marly invites you on a celestial journey inspired by the first hot-air balloon ascent above the Marly domaine, through this exceptional Delina gift set. Addictive, sensual and generous, Delina opens with a vibrant, sweet and juicy lychee, unfolding into a Damascena rose heart and a trail of soft musks and cashmeran. This gift set contains the most intimate perfumed ritual with a 75ml Delina Eau de parfum, a 75ml Delina hair perfume and a 200ml Delina refillable body cream.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom For Her Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: The Gucci Bloom garden of dreams launched with the original Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum for women, which brought along a new vision of femininity and relentless authenticity. Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Intense, blended by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas, is an addictive deep floral fragrance that smells divine, weaving the signature of Jasmine Bud extract and Tuberose into an embodied essence. The Eau de Parfum Intense naturally expands into its full vital and mesmerizing expression, blooming like the individual who wears it. A nocturnal spell for awakening the magic of your inner self. Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Intense bottles the feminine force of creativity, revealing the most entrancing distillation in the Gucci Bloom garden yet. Its inspired fragrance intensifies the Gucci Bloom white floral blend with added sensuality, a go-to perfume for any occasion. The scent: A radiant top note of Orange Blossom Absolute opens the incantation while its floral heart of Jasmine Sambac and Tuberose unfurls with Lady of the Night - a night-blooming flower that heightens the heady bouquet. Grounded in a base of Patchouli Essence and Crystal Moss Accord, the essence of this Gucci scent invokes deep perception and echoes with a sensuous scent, a great smell that is sure to attract plenty of compliments. The bottle: The distinctive square bottle that holds this Eau de Parfum Intense is embellished with a red Toile de Jouy Herbarium Gucci print, radiating creative power and bold luminosity. How to use: Spray the Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Intense over skin daily, applying delicately to the wrist, neck and chest, for a gorgeous floral fragrance that lasts all day.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Eros is the God of love, able to make people fall in love in an instant with his bow and arrow. A fragrance created by Versace for a strong man. A passionate man who is a complete master of himself. The perfection of the male body is fused with the allusion to Greek mythology and classic sculpture. This is a sublime fragrance; a luminous aura with an intense vibrant and glowing freshness. With a combination of mint leaves, Italian lemon zest and green apple. At the heart there is Amber sensuality with enveloping tonka beans, amber, geranium flower and vanilla. Finished off with a racy virility of cedarwood from Atlas, vetyver and oak moss fueling intensity and power.

listings.rawTitle: LOEWE Crafted Collection Smoky Rain Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: The verdant energy of a summer storm. An olfactory journey that captures a fleeting, elemental moment, transforming the wild, raw aspects of nature into a compelling smoky fragrance. LOEWE Smoky Rain Eau de Parfum is a contemporary olfactory escape shaped through notes of bergamot and pink pepper, diffused through a soft, liquid haze. Incense brings a warm, smoky depth, grounded in amber, patchouli, and white musk. The resinous, ambery LOEWE Accord waves through the composition. As a multi-layered amber perfume, the blend settles on the skin with a deeply comforting, earthy scent, revealing a delicate balance of warm, smoky incense that lingers with quiet, meditative intensity. Inspired by the organic beauty of traditional handblown glass, this patchouli perfume from the LOEWE Crafted Collection arrives in a sculptural glass flask topped with a tactile granite cap, celebrating the collection’s innate artistry. This raw physical form beautifully bridges the gap between artistic expression and sensory memory, showing a profound connection to human craft.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Eau Parfumée Thé Impérial Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Created in 2017 by Master Perfumer Jacques Cavallier, the olfactory signature of Bvlgari Hotels & Resorts was originally composed exclusively for the discerning guests of these icons of Italian elegance. In 2026, in tribute to this storied legacy, Eau Parfumée Thé Impérial takes its rightful place within the Eau Parfumée collection. Beloved by travellers from around the world, this signature scent now steps beyond the hotel experience, deepening Bvlgari’s signature olfactory artistry—an inspired vision of nature as an endless source of emotion and refinement. Eau Parfumée Thé Impérial draws its captivating name from an era when empires flourished through the exchange of rare treasures. Tea and citrus—once reserved for royalty and the elite—stood as emblems of prestige and cultural connection. In China, tea blossomed as a sophisticated ritual and symbol of enlightenment, while in Rome, citrus fruits represented radiance and prosperity, adorning imperial banquets and gardens. The word 'Impérial' embodies the harmony of these two grand traditions—East and West—reflecting the fragrance’s power to transport the wearer to a world of emperors, opulent courts, and the timeless allure of these prized ingredients. In Eau Parfumée Thé Impérial, radiant accords of Sri Lankan Black Tea intertwine with the sparkling notes of Italian citrus, unveiling a bright and refined Citrus Musk composition. Inspired by the majestic grace of ancient Roman columns, its design is elevated by the iconic glass décolleté, an emblem of sensory indulgence as personal and opulent as fine jewellery. The cap features the distinctive BVLGARI BVLGARI round insignia inspired by the artistry of ancient Roman coins. It features a crackled golden inlay, echoing the refined tradition of celadon ceramics, originating in China a thousand years ago. The flacon unveils a luminous harmony of orange tones, radiating gently as though illuminated from within. This vibrant, uplifting hue conjures images of tea leaves kissed by golden sunlight and citrus fruits ripening in a sun-drenched garden, introducing a fresh colour story to the Eau Parfumée collection.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Amber Vanilla Eau de Parfum Intense 30ml
listings.description: Burberry Goddess Amber Vanilla Eau de Parfum Intense reflects a deeper, sophisticated femininity that continues to follow the journey of strength, confidence and self-discovery. In this new expression, it helps to reveal a more nuanced, assured sense of self, one that reflects her warmth, wisdom, sensuality and inner radiance. The fragrance: At the top of the fragrance, a luminous lavender essence meets a maple syrup accord, while the signature gourmand trio of vanilla extracts at its heart has a new, indulgent dimension: caramelised, roasted vanilla. When combined with an ambery accord base, the Burberry scent is sensual and captivating, leaving a lasting impression of sweet, sophisticated warmth. The bottle: Evoking the dusky, dark golden glow of a sunset, Burberry Goddess Amber Vanilla Eau de Parfum Intense is offered in a square glass bottle featuring an amber gradient that blends the deep orange of amber with the lustre of syrup. The bottle is finished with the collection’s signature golden cap and medallion. Burberry Goddess Amber Vanilla is designed to be refilled. Refill sold separately.

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Power Self Extrait de Parfum, 90ml
listings.description: The Hedonist Collection, a gradual experience toward self-accomplishment. Each fragrance represents a step, an ascent that amplifies inner harmony. Rehab soothes the physical body, opening the path to serenity Musk Therapy reconnects the emotional body, unlocking new sensations of softness and calm Paragon takes you to another dimension of fulfilment, aligning the physical, emotional, and spiritual bodies Power Self - reveal your super self. An exalted version of who you are. It is no longer about searching, it’s about being fully present. Dual in its essence, Power Self blends the softness of white florals with the vibrant intensity of musks and spices. This contrast creates a unique alchemy, instantly activating self-confidence and inner strength. With Power Self, INITIO ushers in a new era where science enhances the power of scent. By harnessing the direct connection between fragrances and the brain’s sensory receptors, this creation goes beyond mere olfactory pleasure: it measurably influences self-confidence and well-being. More than just a fragrance, Power Self transforms every gesture into an act of accomplishment and self-affirmation. Become your Super Self.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette
listings.description: Versace Crystal Noir introduces a a highly refined yet carnal fragrance. Based around the sweet yet subtle gardenia, this is a fresh and crisp yet sensual and seductive perfume.A sophisticated Amber scent which is light, rare and modern. Originally released in 2004. Top notes: Pepper, cardamom, ginger Heart notes: Coconut, peony, gardenia, African orange flower Base notes: Amber, sandalwood, musk

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Fleur de Peau Refillable Solid Perfume Refills, 2 x 3g
listings.description: Gentle magnolia, powdery iris, and cottony musk intertwine with subtle hints of ambrette. The quest for eternal love is embodied in the purest version of a fragrance that marries softness and strength. This solid perfume is endlessly refillable and alcohol-free, ready to grace the wrist, neck or décolleté when applied with the fingertips. A Diptyque fragrance gesture that combines delicacy and sensuality. How to use: Your refill comes with instructions to help you easily top up your fragrance when it runs out.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Galloway Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Galloway is the art of olfactory music. The shade and heat of pepper and citrus aromatics create surprise within this discerning perfume. The heart notes are an injection of sweet iris and heady orange blossom. At the base are a warm musk, honey-like amber and deep-wooded sandalwood, highly textured to curate a distinguished eau de parfum. Top notes: Citrus, Pepper Heart notes: Iris, Orange Blossom Base notes: Musk, Amber, Sandalwood Presented in a striking white bottle with a glistening silver stopper, this Parfums de Marly Eau de Parfum is a divine mixture of notes that bring out an elegant and forceful signature. Curated for the discerning Parfums de Marly gentleman Galloway stands out for its citrus and peppery notes, which are gradually concealed by subtle scents of amber and musk, conferring strength and intrigue.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 04 Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: Molecule 04 consists of Javanol, pure and singular. Javanol is a sandalwood-type molecule that retains the radiance and endurance of natural sandalwood but is sheer and transparent like no sandalwood in nature. Javanol does not exist in nature and was created in a laboratory at Givaudan in 1996. Javanol, in Molecule 04, oozes with clarity and spaciousness in an immersive experience that speaks to all five senses. "What I love about Javanol is its almost psychedelic freshness. It smells as if liquid grapefruit peel were poured over a bed of velvety cream-coloured roses," says Geza Schoen. Creamy, woody and radiant — this fragrance takes Javanol to a new metallic dimension and has a different kind of freshness that you'll come to crave. How to use: Spritz onto your pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind your ears, as desired, and let it dry naturally.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Men Pure Platinum Parfum 40ml
listings.description: Pure Platinum Parfum is the olfactory expression of strength refined, a scent for those who lead with confidence and leave a lasting impression. It channels the rare intensity and enduring allure of platinum, capturing the magnetism of a man at his most expressive. Opening with the vibrant freshness of Lavender Oil from Bulgaria LMR, the fragrance immediately asserts its energy, clean, sharp, and unmistakably masculine. At the heart, the warmth of Rum Absolute unfurls with depth and richness, evoking effortless sophistication and a hint of intrigue. Anchoring it all is the addictive pull of Ambrox, radiating sensuality and a modern edge that lingers on the skin like a second signature. Encased in a bottle adorned with platinum accents, Pure Platinum is more than a fragrance, it's a statement. Rare, powerful, and timeless, it celebrates the luxury of being unapologetically you.

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Vetyverio Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Vetiver's powerful woodiness gives it the immediate appeal of uncompromising virility. In Vetyverio, it does not become totally feminine, but rather goes beyond gender. Like inlaid wood, vetiver reveals unexpected facets: sometimes fresh, other times smoky or even subtly floral. There is a kaleidoscope of olfactory nuances in this single raw material, magnified here in an unusual interpretation. In the Eau de Parfum, vetiver from Haiti takes centre stage. Used in an overdose, it reveals itself in a pure state, without artifice, drawing its elegant, smoky nature from this volcanic rock.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Giò Parfum, 200ml
listings.description: ​The Acqua Di Giò fragrance collection is inspired by nature and the invigorating freshness of the ocean wave. A unique collection of scents which capture the essence and spirit of the Mediterranean. ​ Acqua Di Giò Parfum re-invents the legendary aquatic freshness with a new depth of woody, smoky warmth and intensity.​ Awaken your senses with the vibrant and energising burst of zesty Bergamot blended with spicy and peppery hues of Ginger extract complemented with the invigorating freshness of the iconic Aquatic accord. ​ At the heart of the fragrance, Geranium fuses with the aromatic and natural tones of Rosemary essence and captivating Clary Sage.​ Capturing the fragrance’s warmth and intensity are the base notes of powerful and smoky Incense combined with the woody sensuality of Patchouli creating a long-lasting and unforgettable impression. ​ Natural and authentic, crafted in a sleek and timeless signature bottle designed to last with all formats refillable. Top notes: Bergamot, Ginger Heart notes: Clary Sage Heart, Rosemary Base notes: Patchouli, Incense How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Le Parfum
listings.description: The show must go on! Making his triumphant entrance to the cheers of the crowd, this boxing legend is back. A champion of bravado simply oozing sex appeal. His greatest asset? A new Eau de Parfum intense with an even sexier and more outrageous punch. Watching his fists, the crowd holds its breath. The walls are crumbling. The senses are in turmoil. And of course, this handsome athlete plays it brilliantly. Check out the theatrical case and black lacquered torso. Ready to knock you out with the first spray of this woody amber fragrance. A high-voltage performance right up to his victory. A scandalously intense Eau de Parfum with warm woody notes. Woody amber Eau de Parfum Intense by Quentin Bisch, Nathalie Cetto and Christophe Raynaud. Scandal? This sexy boxer takes her by surprise. Knock ‘em for six with sweet geranium. Punch hard with an uppercut of delicious tonka bean. Finish with sensual sandalwood. His tactic always works! One little spray and it’s a knock-out. Overwhelmed by addictive woody amber notes. What a performance!

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de Parfum 70ml
listings.description: Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de Parfum is a flowery fragrance with amber and woody notes, born from the encounter between Maison Francis Kurkdjian and Baccarat to celebrate the crystal manufacturer’s 250th birthday. Unique amongst woody floral fragrances, this scent releases a poetic alchemy, a highly condensed and graphic olfactory signature. Breezy jasmine facets, radiant saffron boost the ambergris mineral notes and the woody tones of freshly-cut cedar. Bright and sleek, the soft floral fragrance of Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de Parfum caresses the skin like an amber and woody flowered whisper. To enjoy a moment of well-being and prolong the sillage of your fragrance, add these other Baccarat Rouge 540 scented creations and their distinctive floral musk fragrance to your beauty ritual: hand and body cleansing gel, body oil, hair mist and solid soap. Olfactory family: woody ambery floral. Top notes: Grandiflorum jasmine, Saffron Heart notes: Cedarwood Base notes: Ambergris accord

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Cairo Eau de Parfum
listings.description: The sun rising over Cairo brings warm saffron spice. Soon, all is life. Damascena rose and labdanum bloom above sensual patchouli. This city’s Eau de Parfum is ancient but born anew each day. Key notes: vanilla, rose, saffron. "The warmth of labdanum and vanilla blends beautifully with the roundness of rose and the softness of incense and sandalwood."

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Honeysuckle & Davana Cologne 30ml
listings.description: The wildness of honeysuckle, winding through the English countryside. Climbing. Twisting. Ever more alluring after dark. Fresh with rose and the aromatic, fruity twist of davana. Woody with moss. Warmed by sunshine. Top note: Davana Heart note: English Honeysuckle Base note: Moss How to use: Spritz generously onto your wrists, neck and pulse points – your body heat will help to diffuse the fragrance as the day goes on. Wear alone or layer with another Cologne or your favourite Bath & Body products. Your Jo Malone London order will be exquisitely wrapped in their iconic box, tied with a beautiful grosgrain ribbon. listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums Mon Vetiver by Bruno Jovanovic Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Mon Vetiver expresses a modern and charismatic elegance, built around the natural essence of Vetiver Haiti LMR, which is certified 'For Life', guaranteeing respect for the environment and producers, reducing the impact on the environment and improving the lives of vetiver farming communities in Haiti. Its character is enlightened by a surprising Gin accord, combining Mexican lime and juniper essence, while the aromatic accents of natural lavandin and natural gentian texture its personality. Its vibrant and passionate sillage intensifies its dark woody facets, between cashmere wood and natural Indonesian patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums Orange x Santal by Natalie Gracia-Cetto Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Orange X Santal opens on joyful, juicy, luscious facets of a natural bitter orange from Italy. Its character is enhanced by a green accord from a natural absolute Basil oil from Egypt, as well as the aromatic and balsamic notes with an oakmoss absolut from France. These notes are contrasted with the woody softness of a Natural cypress wood from France and the warmth of a majestic, sustainable natural Australian Sandalwood album. This sandalwood was developed as part of our Ethical Sourcing program with Aboriginal communities in Australia. Australian Sandalwood promotes a sustainable supply of sandalwood oil that is harvested by Aboriginal communities in the southern part of Western Australia.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Juniper Sling Eau de Toilette 30ml

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Trench Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Sensual, elegant, and utterly contemporary, Yves Saint Laurent’s trench coats are elegant and contemporary in all their shapes and colours. To embody its mystery, precious iris lends its sophisticated powdery, woody, and suede tones. The olfaction: As powdery-soft as the bare skin that wears it, the elegant ingredient unfolds its complex woody, violet and suede tones in Trench. In a radiant fragrant rainfall, drops of bright citruses add their sparkling notes to the sophisticated blend. Fragrance family: Floral Ambery. Top notes: Bergamot, Tangerine, Fig Accord Heart notes: Iris Concrete, Neroli Accord Base notes: Ambrette, Cedar Accord, Musky The inspiration: It is one of the most iconic looks in the cinema of the 1960s: Catherine Deneuve, clad in a black vinyl trench coat, in Luis Buñuel’s scandalous Belle de Jour. Designed by Yves Saint Laurent, this piece of subversive bourgeois chic, drawn from the 1966 Saint Laurent rive gauche collection, was another example of the couturier’s signature gesture. Initially worn in the trenches by English officers, hence its name, the trench coat was redesigned in 1962 by M. Saint Laurent to enhance the curves of a woman’s body. Worn over a suit, an evening dress, or, sexily, nothing at all, the assertive elegance of YSL’s trench coats contrasts a sharp and stately cut with intuitive sensuality. The trench's sensuality lies in its masterful play on duality. The structured silhouette, with its sharp lines and defined shoulders, hints at a powerful, almost masculine strength. Yet, the cinched waist creates a distinctly feminine curve, perfectly blending the iconic contrast that defines YSL style. Whether it's the traditional gabardine, supple leather, or fluid silk, the texture against the skin adds a tactile dimension; the couturier endowed it with a strong sensual charm that gave off a whiff of danger and of the forbidden.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: As a homage to the equestrian art, Jean-Paul Guerlain created the first Amber fragrance for men in perfumery in 1965. Habit Rouge refers to the famous red jackets worn by the riders. It is a fragrance mix of earth, warm leather and the forest... This is a high-flying figure, the reflection of mastered, refined and powerful instinct. Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette is a classic of elegance, glorified by the freshness of citrus notes. Created in 1965, Habit Rouge was the first Amber fragrance for men in perfumery. From the moment of its launch, this tribute to Guerlain's passion for the dressage of horses created an element of surprise with its scents of sensual and bold vanilla. With its modern geometry and mastery of form, Habit Rouge has an eternally elegant French appeal. Habit Rouge embraces a dandy man who dares everything, combining sophistication and refinement. He lives his life fervently and distinguishes himself with a trail of extreme sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Miutine Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Discover an intensely irreverent new chapter of Miutine with this bold berry floral fragrance by Miu Miu. Miutine Intense balances a brooding profile of rich blackberry pulp, fresh gardenia and the enveloping warmth of bourbon vanilla and patchouli oil, for the rebellious Miu Miu girl who wears fragrance without moderation. Olfactive Family: Floral Fruity Gourmand. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Blackberry Accord Heart notes: Gardenia accord Base notes: Bourbon Vanilla Infusion About the scent: An opulent berry decadence: Miutine Intense evolves the beloved berry-floral DNA of the original Eau de Parfum into a richer dimension. This version is noticeably deeper, taking the signature top note and drenching it in a macerated blackberry nectar and uplifting it with a feminine gardenia heart. The result is a bold, textured scent that captures the magnetic energy of an effervescent berry spirit. Miutine Intense is an uninhibited fragrance that drapes the skin in a golden, warm signature. As the base of bourbon vanilla and patchouli oil dries down, it weaves an indulgent blanket of chypre-gourmand notes that harmonises naturally with layered, seasonal styling and leaves an exquisite trail in the crisp fall-winter air. About the bottle: The striking bottle is a tactile tribute to Miu Miu's iconic bordeaux matelassé leather handbags and echoes the luxurious, dark-berry notes of the fragrance. The deep burgundy lacquered glass is sculpted in a retro-bourgeois silhouette that blends Miu Miu femininity with a moody coquette aura.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity For Men Parfum 50ml
listings.description: An intense expression of eternal love, the Calvin Klein Eternity Parfum for Him is a warm fougère gourmand fragrance. A splash of aromatic freshness tops the sensual base notes, creating a uniquely intoxicating blend with a powerful and addictive finish. Rich and multifaceted, Eternity for men bursts with an aromatic mix of organic lavender oil and spearmint oil, inspired by the original Calvin Klein Eternity scent. CK Eternity takes on an unexpectedly masculine sensibility by infusing those refreshing notes with a warm, woody base of cedarwood essence and Indonesian patchouli essence. Madagascan vanilla absolute and rum extract impart a finishing amber warmth, creating a lingering CK scent with an addictive fougère quality. This vegan fragrance incorporates upcycled cedarwood oil, responsibly and sustainably sourced ingredients, and is 71% biodegradable. Housed in a new cognac glass bottle, the luxurious spicy scent pays homage to the Eternity family and the rich passion of intimate lovers. Rich and multifaceted, Eternity Parfum for Him is a fougère gourmand fragrance with a powerful lingering scent. Bursting with refreshing organic lavender essential oil and mint, the base of sensual Indonesian patchouli essence and cedarwood adds warmth. Organic Madagascan vanilla absolute pairs with rum extract for an intense finish, rounding out the fragrance’s unique, addictive blend. How to use: Spirtz Calvin Klein Eternity Parfum for Him liberally on pulse points and warm areas: chest, elbow, neck – even behind the knees.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Eau de Parfum Refill, 150ml
listings.description: MYSLF, the new masculine refillable fragrance by Yves Saint Laurent. An expression of who you are, with all your nuances. A statement of modern masculinity, for embracing all your facets and emotions. My scent, MYSLF. Austin Butler is the proud embodiment of MYSLF, as Global Fragrance Ambassador for YSL Beauty. YSL MYSLF scent: MYSLF is Yves Saint Laurent’s first woody floral scent. A prominent orange blossom heart blooms throughout the scent, complemented by a fresh and vibrant accord and underpinned by layers of sensual, textured woods. The fragrance is characterised by its bright and authentic scent, which combines radiant freshness with earthy woods and patchouli, creating a provoking and ever-evolving aroma. Equal parts of light and depth, emblematic of modern masculinity and all the nuance it encompasses. My scent, MYSLF. Top notes: fresh and vibrant accord with bergamot heart Heart notes: orange blossom absolute heart Base notes: wood accord with patchouli and Ambrofix™ YSL MYSLF bottle: A YSL silhouette in a bottle – sleek, timeless, and expertly crafted. Dressed in black lacquer, a high shine finish reveals yourself reflected alongside the iconic YSL Cassandre logo, sculpted directly into the glass at the heart of the fragrance. There is subtlety in the varying shades of black that run the length of the bottle, showcasing exquisite craftsmanship, and emblematic of the many facets of masculinity. Atop the fragrance, the angular lacquered cap is finished with an engraved, brushed metallic detail. YSL Beauty is committed to reducing its impact on the environment. All formats of MYSLF are refillable, with the additional purchase of a 150ml perfume refill, reducing the amount of packaging materials used to replenish your masculine fragrance. How to refill: Once the spray bottle is empty, take off the cap and unscrew the pump Screw the refill onto the bottle neck, then unlock it by turning it to the ON position. The fragrance will refill and automatically stop when full Turn the refill into the OFF position, remove it and screw the pump back in place How to use: Apply fragrance to clean, dry skin. For added intensity, apply to your pulse points and/or hot spots (wrists, inner elbows and lower neck). Here the heat of your body will allow the perfume to reveal its full trail. Include the shoulders and back to intensify your fragrance further.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Radiante Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A fragrance that envelops you in a sensation of transparent purity. As it surrounds you in its soothing scent, the essence of tranquillity is unveiled. listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Musc Noir Rose Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Symbolising a new chapter in Narciso Rodriguez’s ‘for her’ story, Musc Noir Rose Eau de Parfum offers a more sensual olfactive experience than its deeper counterpart, Musc Noir. Unveiling the most personal side of femininity, the fragrance blooms with a voluptuous bouquet of tuberose. Sweet, fruity top notes of Italian bergamot oil, and sparking peppercorn give way to the signature heart of musk and plum, creating a sense of intimacy. The solar fusion settles into a base of creamy Amber vanilla, lingering on the skin to evoke an addictive sensuality. The Fragrance notes: Top notes of Italian bergamot oil, highlighted with peppercorn, bring a sweet fruitiness Solar notes fuse with the signature heart of musk and a hint of luscious plum to create a profound sense of intimacy Base notes of creamy Amber vanilla offer sensuality and addiction to this new Eau de Parfum for women The Bottle: Narciso Rodriguez takes his design philosophy to the bottle. The graphic lines and smoky black pink lacquering of the iconic for her bottle reveal a sensual pink hue in a dazzling play on transparency. The Art of Fragrance Layering: Discover the art of layering with Narciso Rodriguez’s iconic for her fragrance collection. Originating in the Middle East, layering is a technique that allows the wearer to further define their olfactive signature. When worn alone, For Her Musc Noir Rose Eau de Parfum is delicately sensual and sublimely addictive. When combined with For Her Pure Musc, the floral and fruity notes of each composition blend seamlessly together thanks to the common heart of musk, creating a new and bespoke scent. Pure Musc magnifies the voluptuous bouquet of Musc Noir Rose, enhancing its sumptuous glow with the quintessence of orange blossom, jasmine and ylang-ylang.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Jasmine Naturelle
listings.description: Driven by the allure of elsewhere, the Nomade woman soars away to new horizons, new encounters. Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Naturelle, is a fragrance celebrating the mingling of cultures and the poetry of encounters. Nomade Eau de Parfum Naturelle is a feminine and addictive perfume for women with a solar jasmine gourmand. Perfumer Caroline Dumur chose Egyptian jasmine, hand-picked at sunrise and responsibly harvested, to imbue this Eau de Parfum for women. The jasmine’s timeless elegance meets the smoothness of a date accord, while vanilla and sandalwood weave a warm, addictive base. Nomade Eau de Parfum Naturelle contains no artificial colouring. It is vegan and formulated with a 100% natural origin fragrance, naturally derived alcohol and water. Nothing else. The emblematic Nomade bottle is reinvented in ochre shades inspired by nature. A braid is tied around the neck of the bottle, representing the bonds established through travels and successive encounters. This symbolic motif is also engraved into the glass. Revamped to help to reduce the impact on the environment, this new design includes recycled materials, which make up 15% of the glass bottle and 40% of the cardboard box.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden 1921 Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci fragrances opens a new story of magic and imagination in Luxury Collection: The Alchemist’s Garden. The singular unisex fragrances in The Alchemist's collection of Eau de Parfum, Acqua Profumata and Perfumed Oils become customisable and transformative when layered in a multitude of perfume combinations to construct a special enticing scent that stays with you all day—the amount the perfume lingers in the air when it is worn. "The Perfumed Oils and Acqua Profumata create mesmerising individual statements. Each oil or floral water of the collection can be layered with each eau de parfum. Just play with the scent to find your favourite, as an alchemist would work to find the gold formula," says Alberto Morillas. The scent: 1921 continues the story of magic and imagination created by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas, in celebration of Gucci's 100th Anniversary. Blended with Limone Cedrato fruit from Florence, this special unisex perfume is a tribute to the beautiful city where Gucci was born a century ago. Radiant at heart, the distinctive floral scent of Neroli Flower is both intense and subtle with a fizzy green edge. It is blended effortlessly with sparkling fresh Limone Cedrato, a floral citrus perfume reminiscent of the woody verbena plant. Bringing richness, intensity, and an unrivalled long-lasting fragrance, Oakmoss provides a forest-like quality, a sophisticated signature note that justifies 1921 as a genderless scent for all seasons. The bottle: The design of each Eau de Parfum bottle is inspired by the bottles found on wooden shelves of a vintage apothecary, curious pharmacy jars and the first perfumery containers. Gold lettering, decoration and secret symbols appear on the Eau de Parfum, contained in lacquered Gucci fragrance glass bottles with stoppers - covetable objects for lovers of mystery. How to use: Each Perfumed Oil and Acqua Profumata in The Alchemist's collection can be layered with each Eau de Parfum: experiment with combinations to build a unique scent of your beloved scent. Bottling the essence of nature into sublime distillations, the customisable compositions are designed to be layered together, each building from a hero ingredient that shifts and magnifies its character when paired with other Gucci fragrances. The beauty of alchemy is in the transformation: layered scents that become new expressions of art and unfold the magic of unseen worlds. Layer pure and highly concentrated perfumed oils with the Eaux de Parfum to intensify its strength and richness: Apply your choice of The Alchemist Perfumed Oil first on the wrist and neck Follow with your Eau de Parfum layered on top The Acqua Profumata can be applied over the Eau de Parfum to recharge top notes and refresh the overall impression of your signature scent A recommended layer combination for 1921 perfume, designed to bring out the different facets of its enticing citrus floral blend: Magnify the forest-like atmosphere of 1921 Gucci perfume with the Ode on Melancholy perfumed oil. The pair results in an elevation of the zesty citrus tones, magnifying woody verbena and deepening the duo with Cedar, Cypriol, Patchouli, and Sandalwood Amplify the floral notes with lavender-toned Moonlight Serenade perfumed water. When layered with this water from the collection, the flower notes become fresher. Sage and Tonka Bean enhance the Neroli Flower at the heart of the Gucci fragrance, softening its character

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne PHANTOM Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Capturing the thrill of masculinity, Phantom Parfum by Rabanne fuels his passions and reveals his seductive aura. Embracing the seductive spirit of modern masculinity in all its charismatic complexity, Phantom Parfum by Rabanne is an ode to the man who dares to live on the edge. More dark and mysterious. More seductive. And more elevated than ever before. Transcend convention with the exceptional fragrance for the rule–breaker within who surrenders to the thrill of the Phantom nightcall. Crafted with the utmost refinement, Phantom Parfum by Rabanne is responsibly formulated with the most precious, ethically–sourced, potent ingredients. The fragrance: Phantom Parfum by Rabanne reveals the seductive side within of the modern man. Created to liberate the risk–taker with an edge of darkness, Phantom Parfum is an exquisite blend crafted with intense, pulsing lavender, vanilla and sensual vetiver. The bottle: Reimagined with accents of dark matte black to reflect the assertive facets of masculinity, the exceptional bottle of Phantom Parfum by Rabanne is a masterpiece in elevated design. Bold yet sophisticated, the iconic chest piece of the original evolves from chromatic silver to matte black. Olfactive family: Aromatic, Woody, Amber. Top notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Rhubarb Accord, Cardamom Heart notes: Lavender Trio, Geranium, Patchouli, Cedarwood Base notes: Vanilla Bean, Tolu Balm, Vetiver
