listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Oriana Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A gourmand, floral and fruity fragrance designed entirely as a variation on texture. A mille-feuille of flaky sweetness, softness, and sensuality. A sparkling and juicy opening of mandarin and Italian bergamot with a joyful orange blossom flower and blackcurrant heart leads to a flimsy delight of marshmallow and the airy sweetness of Chantilly cream that are addictive. The ambrette and musk base notes add a carnal touch to the composition. A glowing delight. Olfactive notes: Top notes: Mandarin, Bergamot, Grapefruit Heart notes: Orange blossom, Blackcurrant, Raspberry Base notes: Marshmallow, Ambrette, Chantilly cream, Musk On the skin, the noblest ingredients in perfumery unite with groundbreaking molecules in the exaltation of a deep pink bouquet, like its bottle. Chantilly cream, a signature note, brings softness and gourmandise. They say that the famous ‘milk cream’ was whipped up by Procopio, the inventor of gelato, in honor of the prince and future king Louis XV at another grand French castle – Chantilly. True to its passion for the 18th century, Marly has reinvented this very cosmetic note. Oriana, the story of a heroine with character and a hypnotic sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Nuit d’Egypte Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The scent: Chloé Nomade Nuit d'Égypte is a sensory masterpiece, carefully crafted with age-old inspirations in mind. Inspired by the ancient kyphi, the first-known perfume to humankind, this alluring Eau de Parfum weaves a timeless tale of age-old allure and modern refinement. Powerful accents of myrrh appear instantly, seamlessly blending with the spicy scents of cinnamon and ginger, followed by honeyed hues of broomflower nectar and supremely round, balsamic and ambery undertones of cypriol and opopanax. At the very heart of this Chloé Nomade Nuit D'Egypte Eau de Parfum for Women, the exquisite kyphi accord is paired with an opulent orange blossom absolute, sourced from the heart of Egypt itself. Finally, a sensuous touch of warm vanilla completes the base note of this beautiful fragrance composed with 90% naturally sourced ingredients. The bottle: The iconic bottle of the Chloé Nomade fragrance line takes on a brand-new braid tied around its mystery-tinged hue of deep blue, the famous 'Egyptian blue'. Reflecting Chloé’s commitment, the packaging includes recycled materials, which make up 15% recycled glass used for the bottle and 40% recycled cardboard used for the FSC-certified box. Background behind the fragrance: Driven by a constant yearning for discovery, Chloé celebrates authentic splendours both near and far. Embarking on a new adventure, Nomade Nuit d’Egypte Women’s Eau de Parfum pays tribute to Egypt. It was in Egypt that the first perfume known to humankind - kyphi - was created. To compose Nomade Nuit d’Égypte, perfumer Juliette Karagueuzoglou has revisited kyphi with a modern, refined approach, constructing it around a selection of base ingredients mentioned in ancient recipes for the elixir. Fragrance occasion: This Ambery Orange Blossom fragrance is a perfect high-intensity scent for any occasion. The perfect gift for an adventurous woman or a luxurious treat for yourself. How to use: Spray this Chloé Nomade Nuit d'Egypte Eau de Parfum for women onto your wrists, décolleté and neck and allow it to dry in naturally.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Nuit d’Egypte Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The scent: Chloé Nomade Nuit d'Égypte is a sensory masterpiece, carefully crafted with age-old inspirations in mind. Inspired by the ancient kyphi, the first-known perfume to humankind, this alluring Eau de Parfum weaves a timeless tale of age-old allure and modern refinement. Powerful accents of myrrh appear instantly, seamlessly blending with the spicy scents of cinnamon and ginger, followed by honeyed hues of broomflower nectar and supremely round, balsamic and ambery undertones of cypriol and opopanax. At the very heart of this Chloé Nomade Nuit D'Egypte Eau de Parfum for Women, the exquisite kyphi accord is paired with an opulent orange blossom absolute, sourced from the heart of Egypt itself. Finally, a sensuous touch of warm vanilla completes the base note of this beautiful fragrance composed with 90% naturally sourced ingredients. The bottle: The iconic bottle of the Chloé Nomade fragrance line takes on a brand-new braid tied around its mystery-tinged hue of deep blue, the famous 'Egyptian blue'. Reflecting Chloé’s commitment, the packaging includes recycled materials, which make up 15% recycled glass used for the bottle and 40% recycled cardboard used for the FSC-certified box. Background behind the fragrance: Driven by a constant yearning for discovery, Chloé celebrates authentic splendours both near and far. Embarking on a new adventure, Nomade Nuit d’Egypte Women’s Eau de Parfum pays tribute to Egypt. It was in Egypt that the first perfume known to humankind - kyphi - was created. To compose Nomade Nuit d’Égypte, perfumer Juliette Karagueuzoglou has revisited kyphi with a modern, refined approach, constructing it around a selection of base ingredients mentioned in ancient recipes for the elixir. Fragrance occasion: This Ambery Orange Blossom fragrance is a perfect high-intensity scent for any occasion. The perfect gift for an adventurous woman or a luxurious treat for yourself. How to use: Spray this Chloé Nomade Nuit d'Egypte Eau de Parfum for women onto your wrists, décolleté and neck and allow it to dry in naturally.

listings.rawTitle: ARKIVE Fragrance Discovery Eau de Parfum Gift Set, 4 x 10m
listings.description: Discover the new ARKIVE Makes Scents range with our Discovery Set of Scent for Hair and Skin, featuring our four pocket-sized scents. It begins with a lively blend of ginger and bergamot, unfolding into a captivating heart of saffron and palo santo. Future Bloom: Introducing Future Bloom, a genderful fragrance that celebrates uplifting notes of florals and freshness in an unexpected blend. Finally, a warm base of vanilla and white musk add a comforting universal sweetness. Infused with Baobab Oil. A Kind Of Floral: Introducing A Kind of Floral, a fragrance that merges subtle blossoms with the comfort of a warm hug. At the top, notes of pink pepper, white peach, and lemon create a vibrant and refreshing sweetness. Delicate orris, tuberose and orange flower bloom into sophisticated grounding notes of musk and sandalwood. Infused with Baobab Oil. listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Profondo Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The new Acqua di Giò Profondo Parfum captures the addictive and intense attraction of the sea’s unknown depths. Conveying a sensation of deep freshness, the fragrance encapsulates the experience of being immersed in the ocean’s mysteries. A sparkling, luminous sensation and marine freshness, just like the intensity of a wave, emerges with the first burst of the fragrance. This is captured with bergamot notes, which create a warm, solar effect, while lemon essence brings a light, tangy brightness. Lending a salt-water intensity is Acqua di Giò’s signature aquatic accord, which fuses a salty, iodine effect with green facets. Infusing the heart with intense richness and density is everlasting essence. The plant’s essence is extracted using steam distillation, creating a warm, spiced scent that takes the Acqua di Giò signature to new, fathomless depths. Intensifying the fresh facet of fragrance’s heart is a touch of violet leaf absolute , whose natural and green note combines with lavandin heart’s powerful, aromatic and floral scent. And to further amplify the powerful depths of Acqua di Giò Profondo Parfum is the ambery, fruity cistus absolute at the fragrance’s base. Extracted from a shrub that grows along the Mediterranean coastline, the note is obtained from the plant’s twigs and leaves via solvent extraction. This creates a note that is both ambery and woody, lending a deep, warm dry-down effect to Acqua di Giò Profondo Parfum. Blending with the cistus absolute is resinous vetiver essence, with a smoky effect, and a woody mineral accord that brings a powerfully aquatic and resinous aspect. Fragrance family: Aromatic Aquatic. Fragrance notes: Top notes: marine, bergamot Heart notes: violet leaf absolute Base notes: cistus absolute, patchouli

listings.description: A special delivery wrapped with care by Prada, featuring the woody, ambery notes of Paradigme Eau de Parfum in a full-size bottle and a travel spray. This elevated gift set is decorated with the limited-edition 'OTTAGONO' pattern, reimagined for the Holidays from the Prada Fall/Winter 2003 fashion show. Paradigme is the new signature masculine fragrance by Prada. A fragrance that transcends traditional preconceptions by asking – what if there’s another way? A question as an invitation to experiment and open new perspectives. Paradigme Eau de Parfum expresses sophistication and avant-garde in an unexpected masculine ambery woody scent. Opening a new olfactive paradigm, oscillating between enveloping warmth and exhilarating freshness. The warm sensuality of ambery woods is entwined with a green Bourbon Geranium, uplifted by a fusing Calabrian Bergamot Heart. The Paradigme bottle immediately invites curiosity. An architectural silhouette of radical elegance and an avant-garde statement through the tactile tilted Prada triangle. listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Rose 31 Eau de Parfum 15ml
listings.description: The perfume's aim is clear: to transform the famous Grasse Rose, a symbol of voluptuousness and unqualified femininity, into an assertively virile fragrance that can be worn by men and women. The result - an alternating feminine/masculine with the disturbing ambiguity of the Centifolia rose, quickly picked up by a chorus of warm, spicy and woody notes such as cumin, olbanum, cedar and a touch of amber. In the background, the declared sensuality of Gaïac wood and cistus highlighted by a distinctly physical animal note, give this perfume a disconcerting sense of mystery.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by water, L'Eau d'Issey embodies this source of life, an element of infinite possibilities... L'Eau d'Issey is a simple and innovative creation; a delicate, pure, and fresh scent. At the top floats a duo of flowers: the lotus and the rose. The heart develops a light sensuality, combining a bouquet of lilies and fresh flowers, while the precious wood base concludes the scent trail brilliantly. Synonymous with simplicity and essential beauty, Issey Miyake has sought for the L'Eau d'Issey bottle and scent to transcend time and fashion. One night in Paris, he saw the Eiffel Tower lit up by the moon, which thus inspired the slender silhouette, topped by a seemingly suspended ball. A harmony of simple and subtle forms. Perfume Ritual: 1. Spray the perfume directly onto the skin at the pulsation points (neck, wrists, and inner elbows) or as generously on the entire upper part of the body 2. Complete the scent with the L'Eau d'Issey bath line: shower cream, body cream What makes L'Eau d'Issey an iconic perfume? When it was launched in 1992, L'Eau d'Issey was an olfactory and design revolution on the market. The first aquatic floral fragrance for women, L'Eau d'Issey quickly became an essential in every woman's collection. Fragrance family: Fresh floral aquatic Top notes: Lotus, freesia, cyclamen, rose water Heart notes: Carnation, white lilies, fresh peonies Base notes: Musk, amber seed, tuberose, osmanthus, sandalwood, cedarwood

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d'Issey Eau de Toilette 50ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: This holiday season, explore the unexpected wonders of the light-filled Issey Miyake fragrance gift sets. Designed in collaboration with creative director Yorgo Tloupas, the exclusive boxes echo Issey Miyake’s iconic aesthetic, captivating the senses through refined geometric patterns. A fresh and elegant woody marine fragrance for men. Experience a sensory awakening inspired by the energy of salt. A timeless masculine fragrance with a bold trail. Fragrance notes: Top notes: A salt accord combined with natural ginger Heart notes: Natural marine seaweed blended with sand vetiver Base notes: Cedarwood and natural oakmoss This vegan, woody marine scent is crafted from 95% natural ingredients, expressing the movement from the sea to the land. A 100% cardboard gift set, more responsibly crafted. Issey Miyake has designed its packaging to minimise its environmental impact. We encourage you to give a second life* to your gift boxes by reusing or sorting them. *Sorting guidelines may vary by location. Set contains: Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Toilette, 50ml Le Sel d’Issey Shower Gel, 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne PHANTOM Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense
listings.description: Discover Phantom Elixir: the most rock and roll masculine signature by Rabanne. Inspired by the exhilarating energy of a night out, Phantom Elixir is made for the rock and roll night owl, who lives by his own rhythm, and revels in the contrast between shadows and light. More intense than ever before, Phantom Elixir is a clash of a fresh marine accord, vibrant mineral oud, and warm vanilla, celebrating the duality of Rabanne masculinity. Inspired by Paris at night, where the shadows meet the light, the elegant bottle of Phantom Elixir comes in an intense glossy black-to-silver gradient to reflect the olfactive contrast inside. More daring, more seductive; it embodies the clash of freshness and warmth within for the rock and roll night owl who embraces the duality of masculinity.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Created in 2006 by Jean-Claude Ellena, Terre d’Hermès Eau de Toilette connects man to his origins, to the sources of his creative power. It tells the story of man’s relationship with the earth and his dialogue with nature. Since 2016, Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel has been exploring new aspects of this fragrance. A woody, mineral composition, Terre d’Hermès Eau de Toilette combines the power and radiance of cedar and grapefruit notes with a vibrant touch of flint. The base of the bottle is marked with an orange H, as if to leave its imprint on the earth. Its metal shoulders highlight the transparency of the fragrance. The Terre d’Hermès Eau de Toilette bottle unveils a range of details: the Hermès saddle nail, the sliding cover used to release the spray, etc. Designed by Philippe Mouquet, it is inspired by a bottle in a travel vanity case that is conserved at the Emile Hermès museum.

listings.description: Acne Studios by Frédéric Malle is an Eau de Parfum with a vibrant, magnetic and radical profile. It is an intense thrill of fresh aldehydes, concealed by the sweetness of flowers, peach and vanilla, warmed by creamy sandalwood and white musk.​ Frédéric Malle wanted to capture the spirit and create an olfactory reflection of the bountiful aesthetics of Acne Studios. He turned to the young prodigy of perfumery, Suzy Le Helley, to compose this powerful manifesto.​ Top notes: Aldehydes Middle notes: Rose, violet, orange blossom, peach notes Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Frankincense, Musks

listings.rawTitle: New Notes Latte Mimosa Extrait de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Encapsulate a moment of pure serenity. Latte Mimosa captures the ethereal beauty and sweet, powdery allure of the golden mimosa flower. Imagine a serene morning where dew-kissed blossoms mingle with the velvety softness of fresh milk. Opening with a vibrant burst of sunshine, this fragrance unfolds into a lush floral bouquet before settling into a warm, comforting, and lasting trail. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Vibrant Bergamot, Golden Mimosa Heart notes: Delicate Jasmine, Ylang Ylang, Soft Powdery Iris Base notes: Warm Sandalwood, Subtle Musk, Comforting Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Forte Nerolia Vetiver Eau de Parfum Refill, 200ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Nerolia Vetiver Forte, a neroli radiated with light, enveloped by the generosity of a creamy fig accord, the warmth of vetiver and the almond notes of the tonka bean. "I created a neroli gilded by the rays of a setting sun, and awakened by the power of vetiver." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. Aqua Allegoria Forte, the intense collection, is a warm and enveloping journey to the heart of the world’s wonders: Eaux de Parfum celebrating the intense beauty of nature, revealed by the golden rays of a setting sun. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria Forte fragrances contain more than 90% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The 200ml refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75ml and 125ml bottles. *In accordance with the ISO 16128 calculation including water. How to use: Create your own olfactory signature by pairing Nerolia Vetiver Forte with: Bergamote Calabria, Orange Soleia, Mandarine Basilic or Pera Granita. Select your favorite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Scented Hair Perfume, 70ml
listings.description: The Baccarat Rouge 540 hair perfume delicately perfumes the hair while leaving it soft, thanks to its light and airy texture. At any time throughout the day, spray onto your brush or directly onto your hair for a freshened look and a beautifully delicate scent. A graphic and highly condensed signature, Baccarat Rouge 540 lies on the skin like an amber, floral and woody breeze. The aerial notes of jasmine and the radiance of saffron elevate the mineral facets of ambergris and the woody tones of freshly cut cedar wood—an irresistible combination. Castor oil–based, the Baccarat Rouge 540 hair perfume is held in the House’s iconic glass bottle, adorned with a frosted finish and topped with a cap inspired by the original fragrance. An exceptional feel-good olfactory gesture to savour every day. To enjoy a moment of well-being and prolong the sillage of your fragrance, add these other Baccarat Rouge 540 scented creations to your beauty ritual: hand and body cleansing gel, body oil and solid soap. Olfactory family: Woody, Ambery Floral Top notes: Jasmine Grandiflorum, Saffron Heart notes: Bitter almond, Mossy woody accord Base notes: Musky woody accord, Ethyl-maltol, Ambroxan™

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Uomo Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Masculine elegance meets a modern edge in Born in Roma Uomo Eau de Toilette, the fragrance for men by Valentino. Born in Roma Uomo intertwines Valentino's couture elegance with edgy modernity, reminiscent of Rome's street culture. This woody aftershave contrasts sophisticated and aromatic Clary Sage, Violet Leaves, and Vetiver Essence, against cool Mineral Salt, warm Modern Wood, and spicy Ginger. The glass bottle is encased in the armour of Valentino’s iconic stud, a fashion signature of Valentino Couture inspired by Roman architecture and representing a rebellious new era for high fashion. Born In Roma Uomo personifies this juxtaposition of old and new: Roma is where reverence for the past meets an irreverent attitude for now. To wear the Valentino stud is a symbol of strength; to wear Born In Roma is a symbol of celebration. Born In Roma Uomo Eau de Toilette celebrates where you have come from, and where you want to go. A statement of your personality, your heritage and your rules.

In a special festive design finished with a bow. How to use: Spritz generously onto your wrists, neck and pulse points. Your body heat will help to diffuse the fragrance as the day goes on. Wear alone or layer with another cologne or your favourite bath & body products.

listings.description: Enriched with shea butter, it perfumes the body intensively while leaving it softened and invigorated. Musk, with nuances of iris and ambrette seed, enhances the skin with a timeless fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: MATIERE PREMIERE Vanilla Powder Hair Perfume, 75ml
listings.description: Nomadic, light and kind to your hair. Spray at arm's length and scent your hair with the powerful, fluid and sensual notes of Vanilla Powder.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: What makes it different: The iconic smile of La Vie Est Belle is reinvented by the renowned artist Catherine Krunas, making way for a sculpted rose at the heart of the bottle. Each petal pays tribute to all the facets of women. In the hands of three French master perfumers in pursuit of the perfect rose, La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire emerges as a modern interpretation of the iconic flower of perfumery. "La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire is a modern interpretation of the Rose, the iconic flower of perfumery," as beautifully put by Anne Flippo, perfumer. It's a testament to the dedication and artistry of those who crafted this extraordinary fragrance. What else you need to know: Inspired by rose petals, the wings of La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire transition from white to pink, accentuated with a touch of silver glitter. Ingredients: Fresh Rose Water, Space Rose Accord, Rose Damascena absolue: A synergy of three different roses, united, to create the perfect one. Each extract highlights a different facet of the rose, from vegetal freshness to sensual opulence Iris Concrete: The iconic signature of La Vie Est Belle, the iris heightens La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire with its rich, floral and noble powdery note Woody Musk: Woody Musk is a sophisticated and timeless fragrance note, known for its warm, earthy, and sensuous qualities. It lends depth and longevity to perfumes, creating an indulgent scent experience An extraordinary trio of roses: La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire, the new scent of blooming happiness. Orchestrated by three French master perfumers, this scent celebrates the rose in all its forms. A rose made of crystal: The epitome of our savoir-faire. Discover a new blooming interpretation of our iconic crystal smile bottle. Sculpted like a crystal rose, the La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire precious bottle is an invitation for every woman to blossom into her extraordinary self. The perfumers of La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire: Anne Flipo: "This Extraordinaire version retains the codes of La Vie Est Belle, a gourmand iris. This main accord is shaped to make it brighter, more modern, with an added touch of magic" Dominique Ropion: "This formula celebrates the rose in all its forms" How to use: Spray La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire onto your skin, focusing on the warm areas of your body: the inside of your wrists, below your earlobes and behind your neck.

The Shower Gel cleanses and refreshes the skin with a subtle trace of the electrifying scent, creating the first step of a complete fragrance ritual. A luxury fragrance gift for men, ideal for holiday gifting, birthdays and special celebrations. Set contains: BAD BOY Cobalt Eau de Parfum, 50ml BAD BOY Cobalt Shower Gel, 100ml

listings.description: This dazzling bergamot combines freshness, sweetness and sensuality with acrobatic talent. All these qualities were encompassed in the perfume's initial code name: Fire Cologne. It's the delicate floral character of petit grain, the bitterness of grapefruit, as well as the flamboyant sweetness of amber and musk with a virile touch of vetiver, which gives Bergamote 22 its unique personality. Can't leave home without us? We know how hard the separation can be, so we've created a vintage, metal Le Labo travel tube to protect your new 10m spray.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Halfeti Eau de Parfum 100ml Christmas Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Beloved Halfeti. An adventure of rose, spice, and fruits, leaving a trail of oud accord behind. The journey begins with an Eau de Parfum and body wash. The destination? Delight. It's just the ticket. This year, Penhaligon's Christmas collection is inspired by vintage travel trunks and the golden era of train travel, when the journey home was as important as the destination. Set contains: Halfeti Eau de Parfum, 100ml Halfeti Body & Hand Wash, 500ml

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée Eau de Parfum Refillable 50ml
listings.description: Created by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel, Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée explores a new facet of Terre d’Hermès, where freshness and power interact. Reinterpreting the mineral, woody notes of Terre d’Hermès caught in an icy breeze, Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée Eau de Parfum combines the vibrancy of citron, the incisive freshness of juniper berry and the assertiveness of Timut pepper. Like a block of ice, the sleek and limpid bottle is marked with the iconic H on its base. Its frosted glass and brushed aluminium evoke the idea of a frost covering the earth. The refillable and recyclable bottle is made from glass and aluminium. Terre d’Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense can be sprayed onto clothes or skin for an enveloping trail.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Le Gemme Kobraa Eau de Parfum, 125ml
listings.description: Discover Bvlgari Le Gemme Kobraa, a timeless freshness, blended with the spiritual force of its black incense heart essence and the depth of its oud essence. A journey through the landscapes of Zealandia, a hidden continent where Snakeskin Jasper can be found. Zealandia, a hidden continent discovered only at the end of the 21st century, is an enigmatic part of the Earth where Snakeskin Jasper can be found. Used as an antidote for snakebites in ancient times, this gemstone is a symbol of powerful regeneration and life force that features a stunning green colour filled with contrasts. Bvlgari Le Gemme Kobraa contains a mysterious and timeless harmony between the spiritual force of its smoked black incense heart essence and the deep elegance of its oud essence. Black incense, a sacred raw material, inspired this fragrance. This rare ingredient allowed Jacques Cavallier to keep the clean, fresh facets of white incense while adding powerful smoky notes. Olfactive family: Ambery, Woody. Olfactive pyramid: Black Insense Heart Essence, Oud Essence.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Opium Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Natural Spray, 100ml
listings.description: A fresh, fruity and dynamic opening with a rich and intense character and a woody and softly spicy structure.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Leite Néctar Perfume Mist, 90ml
listings.description: Leite Néctar Perfume Mist captures the irresistible comfort of Brazilian pavê de pêssego, a creamy peach dessert delicately layered with biscuits. Milky and fruity, this indulgent fragrance opens with notes of juicy peach, then melts into creamy coconut milk and sweet cream for a delicious scent that satisfies every craving. A dreamy escape you’ll want to wear again and again.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Les Légendaires Champs-Élysées Eau de Toilette, 75ml
listings.description: For almost two centuries, Guerlain has been a story of fragrance and beauty, legacy and creation, daring and exploration, heritage and the future. Our roots enrich the present and inspire the future. With more than 1,100 fragrances created since 1828 by five generations of perfumers, our heritage is unique. The Legendary fragrance collection pays tribute to this exceptional heritage. Champs-Elysées is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by five generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Champs-Elysées is a tribute to the City of Light and to Guerlain's flagship located at 68, Avenue des Champs-Elysées. This joyful floral fragrance celebrates mimosa. Designed by Georges Chevalier, its iconic 'inverted heart' bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Under the Lemon Trees Eau de Toilette
listings.description: The memory of a sunny escape to the countryside. Take a nap under the lemon trees while you indulge sparkling citrus scents, refreshing green leaves and the warm Mediterranean breeze. Maison Margiela’s Under the Lemon Trees is a combination of invigorating citruses complemented by the earthy freshness of green tea extract, coriander and woody extracts from both cedarwood and white musks. A perfectly light, everyday, unisex fragrance. From Maison Margiela’s Replica collection. Made In France. Top Notes: Kalamansi Lime Accord, Cardamon Essence Middle Notes: Coriander Essence, Green Tea Extract Base Notes: Cedarwood Essence, Cistus Absolue, White Musks Family: Citrus

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Athalia Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Athalia boasts a highly floral, woody and musky olfactory signature. Top notes of bitter orange and incense lead the wearer to the heart of this feminine Eau de Parfum, which combines powdery iris and delicate orange blossom enveloped in mysterious amber and caressed by white musk. It is an intriguing fragrance with a delicate opulence. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Bitter Orange, Incense Heart notes: Orange Blossom, Iris, Cashmeran Base notes: Musk, Vanilla, Amber

listings.rawTitle: Juliette has a Gun Vanilla Vibes Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: Vanilla Vibes is the fusion of two opposites, an aphrodisiac natural Vanilla twisted with Sea Salt. Heart notes of natural vanilla absolute and orchid absolute combine with bottom notes of sandalwood absolute, tonka bean absolute, brown musk, benzoin absolute. Vanilla Vibes, the expression of sensual, powerful, and free femininity. Enjoy the trip. Top note: Fleur de sel Heart notes: Natural Vanilla Absolute, Orchid Absolute Bottom notes: Sandalwood Absolute, Tonka Bean Absolute, Brown Musk, Benzoin Absolute A fragrance for men and women.

listings.description: In 2018, Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel brought a new perspective to Terre d’Hermès and created Terre d’Hermès Eau Intense Vétiver. An unprecedented expression of power. An intense, woody composition, Terre d’Hermès Eau Intense Vétiver is underpinned by the depth of vetiver combined with the liveliness of green bergamot and Sichuan pepper. The Terre d'Hermès Eau Intense Vétiver refill is designed to replenish the 30ml travel bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Rosa Damascena Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Good to know: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs is being re-branded, the logo on your products may differ from the photos. The scent is still the same. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs invites you to compose your personalised Chloé fragrance as though arranging your favourite blossoms in a bouquet at a Parisian flower shop. Each perfume in the collection reveals a single floral, aromatic or woody scent rooted in the perfumer’s memory. Wear alone like a corsage or combine endlessly to create a lovely present or a perfume for all occasions. A flower, a perfumer, a story... Rosa Damascena, a floral perfume for women by Amandine Clerc-Marie. A crisp and spontaneous rose inspired by the concoctions of petals and crinkled leaves Amandine Clerc-Marie would brew in her family garden when she was a little girl. Exuding a sense of botanical purity and a lightly spiced floral signature, this Chloé for women Eau de Parfum is perfect for day and night. This Chloé perfume is housed in an elegant pleated glass bottle topped with an ivory cap that appears to be carved in stone. Touches of gold at the neckband and label trim enhance the light hue of each beautiful fragrance. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists. Wear your favourite flower on its own to celebrate its vitality and intensity, or combine Rosa Damascena with other perfumes from Atelier des Fleurs to create a personalised fragrance bouquet. Disclaimer: Packaging may vary but scent remains the same.

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Sacred Wood Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Sacred Wood is a portrait of Sandalwood, especially the most coveted variety from Mysore with its spicy, woodsy and milky facets that are simply incredible. The fragrance opens with Ambrette Seed Absolute and Carrot Seed Essence for spicy and earthen elements, only to unfold into a multi-layered Sandalwood Accord with Cedarwood Oil Atlas sourced in Morocco and Amyris Oil from Dominican Republic. Copaiba Balsam Oil adds warmth with an animalic aspect of Apricot. A malted milky vapor rises like incense, for an exceptional and long-lasting sillage. The Perfume notes: Amyris, Sandalwood, Tolu and Copahu balm. Olfative Family: The Cellars. Each KILIAN PARIS bottle is transformed into a precious object. The perfume bottles of the cellars family are adorned with a distinctive black lacquer and meticulously engraved on each side, with the representation of the Achilles shield. These details bring to the KILIAN PARIS creation a guarantee of luxury that should not be ephemeral, but should last a lifetime. That's why the bottle of this cellar perfume can be refilled indefinitely.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: As a homage to the equestrian art, Jean-Paul Guerlain created the first Amber fragrance for men in perfumery in 1965. Habit Rouge refers to the famous red jackets worn by the riders. It is a fragrance mix of earth, warm leather and the forest... This is a high-flying figure, the reflection of mastered, refined and powerful instinct. Habit Rouge Eau de Parfum reveals the intense and sensual signature of woody and leather notes. Habit Rouge has an eternally elegant French appeal. Habit Rouge embraces a dandy man who dares everything, combining sophistication and refinement. He lives his life fervently and distinguishes himself with a trail of extreme sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley-Paris L'Eau Rêvée d'Hubert Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Dreams inspire our creativity, they nourish us with images, memories and sensations. Les Eaux Rêvées express this imaginary place where inspirations collide, join together and become one – the inspirations of different generations of the d’Ornano family, the creators of Sisley. This collection is made up of six mixed fragrances, olfactory odes with a perfect, ambivalent nature. Two-sided two-tone Geranium: Considered as a masculine rose: this geranium emits an intense, aromatic breath of peppermint, clear green notes and moist earthy accents. This wealth of ingredients giving the perfume a refined, natural sillage. Designed in collaboration with two artists, Elżbieta Radziwiłł et Bronisław Krzysztof, L'Eau Rêvée d'Hubert transports us in the dream world of the d'Ornano family. Canson paper case and glass bottle made in France. Case and bottle are recyclable. listings.description: Passion, love, tenderness and joy - all emotions that are awoken by the unequalled femininity and beauty of the centifolia rose.An all-italian fragrance true to the brand's heritage, Rosa Nobile is born from the essence of the centifolia rose which is carefully grown and cultivated in a small rose garden in Piedmont, Italy. Each bud is hand-picked at dawn when they are still fresh and dressed with the morning dew during 40 days between May and June.Poetic in its complex beauty, Rosa Nobile is the embodiment of femininity and elegance.Originally released in 2014. Top notes: Pepper, bergamot, mandarin orange Heart notes: Rose, violet, lily-of-the-valley, peony Base notes: Musk, ambergris, cedar

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Eau De Mandarine Ambrée Eau de Cologne, 100ml
listings.description: Perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena created Eau de Mandarine Ambrée in 2013. It is a vibrant Cologne, as gentle as it is mischievous, that interprets the freshness of a sunlit orchard. A citrus, amber composition, Eau de Mandarine Ambrée Cologne combines fresh mandarin, juicy passion fruit and velvety amber. The iconic lantern bottle is adorned with a joyful, sparkling hue. Around the orange box, a vividly contrasting band recalls its colour. The Hermès Colognes Collection: Hermès Colognes explore the sensory nature of materials. Unifying beyond genres, ages or seasons, they bring immediate and abundant pleasure and offer a playground that is as infinite as it is masterly.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Bright Crystal Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Sheer sensuality, crystal transparency, and luminous brightness. Bright Crystal Parfum is an enthralling and inviting new fragrance. Its fresh and floral notes create a timeless scent distinctly designed for the strong, confident and sensual Versace woman. The delicious opening to the fragrance centres around a dazzling feast of sweet and juicy pomegranate, yuzu and red fruits before leading into the soft and feminine floral heart of delicate magnolia, peony and lotus flower. The voluptuous parfum is rounded off with an intense blend of sophisticated woody and amber base notes, ensuring an enriching and long-lasting scent.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden A Chant for The Nymph Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Crafted from pure natural plants and flowers layered with modern molecules, each fragrance and formula in the Alchemist’s Garden is inspired by the science of alchemy, telling the story of a place, a moment, or a memory. The singular scents in the eaux de parfum, acque profumate and oils are customizable and transformative when layered in a multitude of ways, allowing each wearer to curate a distinct identity from their combinations, which linger in the air when worn. A Chant for the Nymph is an ode to tropical forests filled with sublimating solar flowers. The fragrance is inspired by the Frangipani, which symbolizes immortality for the heavenly and enduring smell that it releases on warm nights. With its enchanting beauty, the Frangipani embodies the story of a mythical nymph who appears on a summer’s night in a long-forgotten dream. Hiding behind the intoxicating Ylang Ylang and sensual Tiare flower, the nymph invites you to exotic lands, where seasonal clusters of long-lasting flowers are warmed by soft Vanilla. For daily use.

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Fleur de Peau Eau de Parfum Holiday Limited Edition Size, 200ml
listings.description: Intense musks. To celebrate the holidays, an exceptional new format. Fluffy, cottony, intensely mellow. Alongside iris and ambrette seed, musks reveal their carnal softness in Fleur de Peau Eau de Parfum. An ideal fragrance to give or to keep.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Cinnabar Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Cinnabar is warm, mysterious, endlessly appealing spicy scent. Jasmine, Orange Flower, Clove and Patchouli blend intriguingly into an intense, sensual experience. Fragrance family: Spicy Amber. Top: Bulgarian Rose, Jasmine, Muguet Heart: Violet, Orris Base: Vetiver, Moss, Amber The Inspiration: "Cinnabar is a fragrance that fulfils every woman's yearning for the exotic and mysterious," said Mrs Lauder. "Its rich Amber notes provide a lingering warmth and sensuousness." Estée Lauder had always been fascinated with the mystery and opulence of the East. In 1978, she decided the time was right for an Eastern-influenced fragrance. Cinnabar marked the beginning of a worldwide wave of exotic Amber fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Santal Royal Eau de Parfum, 125ml
listings.description: The Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Santal Royal, a rare and precious wood majestically rising up in the penumbra. A fragrance trail that unfolds in a play of subtle contrasts between dark leather notes, the oud accord and the luminosity of floral notes of jasmine and rose. "In addition to its elegant woody and light facets, sandalwood has a certain freshness, that’s at once creamy and richly deep. Its intrinsic suppleness allows it to meld freely with certain spicy or floral notes, to which it lends body and soul." Thierry Wasser, Guerlain Master Perfumer. Absolus Allegoria, the absolute fragrance collection, is an enchanting and mysterious journey to the heart of the world’s wonders once night falls: fragrance trails celebrating deep and powerful nature, revealed by striking contrasts by moonlight. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, Absolus Allegoria fragrances contain up to 90% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Santal Royal comes in the Allegoria collection’s emblematic bottle which is made in France using 15% recycled glass. Featuring a removable spray pump and transparent lacquer finish, its design can be easily recycled. *90% to 94% of ingredients are of natural origin, in accordance with ISO 16128. Calculation includes water.

listings.rawTitle: Memo Paris Inverness Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Its very name is intriguing, languorous: Inverness. A land of peat, heather and golden rain, beyond the senses, aptly known as the capital of the Highlands, the largest region in Scotland. Nature reigns free, unspoilt, extraordinary, and the River Ness forges its curves and mysteries. listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Sì Eau De Parfum – The Perfume For Women. Sì is Italian for 'yes' and reveals the contemporary femininity of Giorgio Armani, the Sì woman has the confidence to say yes to the values that define her life. listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum for Women 30ml
listings.description: Feel empowered by your spectacular creative forces with Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Refillable Eau de Parfum for women. The vibrant warmth of Vanilla notes in this perfume for her is infused with the fresh marine Ozonic Accord to enhance the luminous sensuality of Vanilla Orchid at its heart. Its addictive and enticing trail is lifted by a disruptive fresh air that creates the perfect balance between floral gourmand richness and a bracing breeze. The Bottle: The perfume bottle, dressed in a radiant yellow and adorned with the iconic Gucci Flora pattern, rouses the powerful enchantress within you to express yourself in full. The Fragrance: A love letter to your creative spirit, the luminous sunshine floral bouquet of this Eau de Parfum overflows with exquisite ingredients to inspire your mind to roam freely, weaving your fantasies into a place where anything is possible. Live powerfully in your own unique way with the floral scent of Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid. Floral. How to use: The perfect perfume for all occasions, this Gucci scent can be applied delicately to the wrist, neck and chest for a long-lasting gorgeous fragrance.

To give depth and boldness to the fragrance, the base is all built around notes of Sandalwood. Made in Italy: the fragrances are manufactured with care and love in Italy.

listings.rawTitle: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Oud Blanc Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Van Cleef & Arpel’s Collection Extraordinaire revisits the legendary Oud Wood with Oud Blanc. A more transparent and crystalline Oud. An Oud accord enveloped in a composition that mingles aldehydic white Musks, tender Rose and a creamy base of Vanilla suffused by cool Incense. Part of the Matière Blanche collection, creative and dreamlike fragrances that play with the sensations and textures conjured up by the colour white. Symbolising purity, softness, and perfect balance, whose values are based on minimalism and olfactory excellence. To echo the material, Oud Blanc comes in an immaculate bottle in a deep and luminous white.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Discover L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme, a truly timeless fragrance. As Issey Miyake's first perfume for men, L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme has established itself as a signature reference in the world of men's perfumery and aftershave. Strength and balance – these are the two qualities that unite the fragrance. Upon first spritz, you're greeted with the vibrant freshness of yuzu, the iconic Japanese citrus, and tangerine. In the heart, water lily creates the aquatic facet of L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme, balanced by warm spicy notes. Tobacco, vetiver, and sandalwood channel an energy which evokes that of a powerful waterfall, making the fragrance assertive and masculine. The iconic bottle of L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme has transcended time as well. Inspired by waterfalls as well, the slender, contemporary glass widens at the base and stands in contrast with the light grey hood.

listings.description: Delicate Floral. Effortless. Ethereal. Les Jardins Botaniques Wisteria is inspired by a leisurely stroll through garden paths filled with draping vines of Wisteria. The air is fresh and filled with the delicate scent of Wisteria's fragrant blooms. Radiant notes of Honeysuckle blend with the unexpected warmth of Ylang Ylang to create a light and ethereal fragrance evoking crisp morning air. Velvety Musks and subtle Woody notes linger on the skin like the embrace of a day spent in the magic of a beautiful garden.

listings.rawTitle: Guilty Absolu de Parfum For Him, 60ml
listings.description: Every guilty pleasure has a scent. What’s yours? Gucci Guilty Absolu de Parfum for men and for women is a duo of rare Millésimes. Guilty Absolu de Parfum for men is an intense woody ambery assemblage curated as a guilty pleasure. At its heart, the Rum Accord brings a warm aroma evoking the faceted savour of a fine aged spirit. Gently stirred with the sulfurous Orange Flower Absolute, it brings substance to the composition, while the fiery Red Chilli Pepper Accord spices it up. The result is a perfume for men that lasts for hours, a shot of sophistication, sensuality and mystery that is perfect for any occasion, especially a night out in the dim glow of an intimate space. The vibrant green flask of this Gucci fragrance unveils an absolutely Guilty scent made for a bold, confident and seductive man who embraces temptation.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Beach Blossom Cologne 50ml
listings.description: A summer escape to the idyllic palm-fringed beaches of the Seychelles to encounter the rare coco de mer. Basking in tropical sunlight, the sea coconut’s sculptural form inspires a fresh solar scent. A refreshing twist of coconut water is carried on the breeze, meeting the sparkling clarity of lime and mint, wrapped in the allure of tonka bean. How to use: Spritz generously onto your wrists, neck and pulse points – your body heat will help to diffuse the fragrance as the day goes on. Wear alone or layer with another Cologne or your favourite Bath & Body products. Your Jo Malone London order will be exquisitely wrapped in their iconic box, tied with a beautiful grosgrain ribbon. Percival is a fresh fragrance that is as bold of a character as the man who wears it. The sensual and refined scent opens on aromatic bergamot, pink pepper and mandarin notes and settles to a heart of lavender, geranium and cardamom, holding true with a woody base.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: The Mon Guerlain fragrances are a fragrant manifesto of today's femininity. A multi-faceted woman: strong, free and sensual. Discover Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum Intense, a sensual and unique woody amber. The vanilla tincture, artisan-produced by Guerlain, blends with vanilla Tahitensis and smouldering patchouli. They accompany lavender and sandalwood, forming a unique and sensual woody amber composition. "Mon Guerlain Intense is a confident sensual enveloping signature, that no one forgets. It is this heavy dose of lush vanilla that creates an addictive quality while offering up plenty of elegance and mystery" Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. The 'quadrilobe' bottle, created in 198, established itself as one of Guerlain’s iconic bottles. Simple and graphic, it echoes an alchemist’s bottle and owes its name 'quadrilobe' to its stopper, which is formed from one piece to obtain a shape resembling four lobes. One century later, beautifully enhanced by a luxurious glass weight and a golden adornment, this bottle offers a contrast between strong taut lines and sensual curves, expressing contemporary femininity.

listings.description: Created from lemon tree flowers, oranges from California, Amyris from Jamaica, Iris from Florence, Vetiver from Haiti and a woody musky amber. Like the flamboyant warmth of a sunset Amyris kindles a flame that never dies. It's smooth bright and soft floral fragrance. Amyris is a genus of flowering plants in the citrus family. The generic name is derived from the Greek word which means "intensely scented" and refers to the strong odour of the resin. Members of the genus are commonly known as Torchwoods[4] because of their highly flammable wood.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Tubéreuse Lazuli Eau de Parfum for Women 50ml
listings.description: In the Chloé Atelier des Fleurs collection, artist perfumers guide your eyes and your nose towards singular flowers. Capturing Nature’s hidden scents and revealing the beauty in the unexplored through women's fragrance. The Fleurs de Nuit women's Eau de Parfum collection unveils the unsuspected fragrance of three flowers whose perfume changes as night falls. During the day, these enigmatic flowers absorb the brightness and warmth of the sun. At dusk - only at dusk - they fully blossom and release new carnal, narcotic notes to create a sophisticated scent. Among this women's perfume collection is Tubéreuse Lazuli Eau de Parfum for Women. In the early hours of the morning, the perfume of Tuberose in this floral woody perfume is green and fresh. As night approaches, it becomes increasingly dense and heady. To convey this powerful sensuality, perfumer Jean-Christophe Hérault has combined Indian Tuberose with voluptuous Jasmine. Through this fragrance for women, deepest facets of the flower are enhanced by a textured base accord where a refined white Oud blends with the creamy notes of Sandalwood and the smoked facets of Patchouli. For the Fleurs de Nuit collection, the iconic Atelier des Fleurs bottle takes on a captivating shade of midnight blue – a deep mysterious colour inspired by the vastness of the celestial vault – and features an undulating glass silhouette, evoking the sunburst pleating so dear to the Maison, and a sand-colored cap. A floral scent from Chloé that is a concentrate of timeless elegance. Fragrance family: Woody. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance that stays all day, delicately spray this floral perfume on clothing and pulse points at the neck, chest and wrists.

Created by Givaudan and infused with Happy&BlissfulTM technology, Ô Oui delivers a fresh, petal-like scent that’s irresistible, designed to awaken positive emotions, lift your mood and infuse your day with optimism. A radiant fruity-floral creation by master perfumers Quentin Bisch and Louise Turner, it shines with the vivid juiciness of lychee accord, blooms into centifolia rose, and lingers in the soft embrace of creamy musks and ambrette, evoking pure, luminous euphoria. Why you'll love it: Instant mood boost: Helps spark a feeling of joy, lightness, and euphoric positivity from the very first spritz A burst of juicy euphoria: Vibrant lychee accord delivers an immediate fruity freshness, capturing the feeling of peak summer in a bottle A luminous, floral heart: Centifolia rose unfolds at the core, adding soft femininity and radiant elegance Sensual, skin-like warmth: Creamy musks and ambrette create a soft, irresistible trail that feels comforting, modern, and effortlessly sensual Created with expert artistry: Crafted by world-class master perfumers for a long-lasting scent that delivers perfect harmony between freshness, florality and warmth The bottle: A sculpted floral signature. listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin à Cythère Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Created by Hermès’ perfumer Christine Nagel, Le Jardin à Cythère Eau de Toilette is a surprising garden that it's neither green nor floral, but... blond. It is the expression of an olfactory quest through Greece that leads to Kythira, an unspoiled island that has inspired many artists. A citrus and woody fragrance, Un Jardin à Cythère Eau de Toilette combines enveloping notes of grasses with the strength of olive wood and the tenderness of fresh pistachio. Designed by Fred Rawyler, the bottle is inspired by the lines of the horse-drawn carriage lanterns of yesteryear. The luminous graduated yellow glass echoes the sunny fragrance. On the box, artist Elias Kafouros sketches a colourful landscape of his homeland: golden grasses, green olive trees, fresh pink pistachios and, in the background, the blue of the sea. The Parfums-Jardins collection brings together the soul of a place, the inspiration of the perfumer and the theme chosen by Hermès each year to illuminate its creation. An olfactory stroll to share for every moment, to indulge every desire for freshness, reverie or escape.

Refill your travel tube with the fragrance of your choice. Includes 3 x 10ml spray bottles.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Rouge L'Interdit Elixir Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A floral woody gourmand fragrance blending luscious Black Cherry with a White Flower Bouquet. More magnetic, sensual, and bold than ever, L'Interdit Elixir by Givenchy unveils a striking new facet of femininity with its intense, captivating trail. A fragrance with magnetic power: From the very first notes, indulgent dark Black Cherry reveals a vibrant and sensual intensity. At its heart, the iconic L'Interdit signature white floral bouquet of Orange Blossom, Tuberose and Jasmine Sambac blends elegantly with Pure Oakwood Extract, giving the fragrance a deep intensity, enhanced by notes of Rum, Davana and Vanilla. A deeply sensual fragrance for women who seek to leave a lasting impression. A bottle crafted like a jewel: Inspired by the ruby, the L'Interdit bottle glows in an incandescent red that fades into black, designed to magnify the aura of the fragrance and evoke the rarest, most intense shade of the precious stone. How to use: For a light touch: mist a cloud of fragrance around your head and shoulders, letting it fall gently over you For a medium intensity: spray in a Y-shape across the body, starting from one shoulder and finishing at the other For a richer intensity: apply directly on pulse points and warm areas (wrists, inside of the elbows, base of the neck). The warmth of your skin will reveal the full intensity of the fragrance

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: GOOD GIRL is inspired by Carolina Herrera’s unique vision of the duality of the modern woman: audacious and sexy, elegant and enigmatic, good and bad. Forever pushing and crossing the limit, the mysterious sensuality of GOOD GIRL makes for a modern yet sophisticated fragrance. For: Her When: All Day Type: Powerful & Daring POWER OF THE HEEL SHE’S GOOD ON ONE SIDE AND BAD ON THE OTHER The complex duality of modern femininity is captured in this sophisticated yet multifaceted women’s perfume. Reveal your good side – or your bad side – with the luminous facet of tuberose and best quality Sambac Jasmine contrasted with the dangerously addictive notes of roasted tonka beans and Cocoa. WELL BEHAVED GIRLS RARELY MAKE HISTORY Powerful, playful and a lady on the edge, the GOOD GIRL is never afraid to be herself, challenging the expectations of everyone she meets. Her magnetic sensuality captivates men and women alike as she knows exactly where and when to reveal her true self; good and bad. Informal elegance: Bulgarian rose, Jasmine sambac, Orange blossom, Praline, Cinnamon Freshness: Bergamot, lemon Comfort: Sandalwood, cedarwood, cashmere, Patchouli, Amber notes, Transparent musk POWERFUL, PROVOCATIVE AND UTTERLY COMPELLING: CAROLINA HERRERA CAPTURES THE NEW DIMENSIONS OF FEMININITY. GOOD GIRL, a boldly sophisticated scent in an astonishing new bottle that expresses women’s delicious duality. Complex and seemingly contradictory, this is a fragrance where sensibilities collide. She is the master of her own duality; ultra-feminine and powerful; sensual and irreverent; independent and fearless; and ultimately, brimming with intrigue. Women’s thrilling duality, which is brought to roaring life by the city that never sleeps, inspires a fragrance signed Carolina Herrera New York. The GOOD GIRL is unforgettable; she captivates us with her confidence, mesmerises us with her contemporary elegance, charms us with her unbridled, untamable spirit. Carolina Herrera celebrates the exquisite power of femininity and the beautiful contradictions of a woman today in the most alluring of ways.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR J’adore Eau de Parfum Infinissime Roller-Pearl, 20ml
listings.description: J'adore Eau de Parfum Infinissime is available in a roll-on Roller-Pearl format, a travel-friendly bottle for an infinitely sensual perfuming gesture. The glass bead tip of the J'adore Roller-Pearl bottle delivers a soft and voluptuous application of the J'adore Eau de Parfum Infinissime. The velvety-soft pearl rolls over the pulse points: neck, wrist and décolleté, releasing its sensual and enveloping notes: centifolia rose, jasmine sambac, ylang-ylang, Grasse tuberose and creamy sandalwood. As the J'adore Roller-Pearl sensually glides over the skin, the flowers of J'adore Eau de Parfum Infinissime unfurl and exalt their scent infinitely.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Baie 19 Eau de Parfum Travel Refill, 3 x 10ml
listings.description: Truth is...Baie 19 should have been called Water 19. Not that it smells like nothing (though nothing smells like it), but it has this crisp, wet, drenched effect that water gives to the earth after the rain...And there’s a word for that, by the way: petrichor. It’s that magical feeling during heavy rain after a long dry spell, and it’s one of the most beautiful olfactive phenomena in nature. There are many reasons for this, including the ozone in the air, the negative ions, but most importantly the release of oil secretions from certain plants, accumulated after a long dry period. This is what Baie 19 is about: the dry juniper berry, the patchouli, the green leaves... all soaked by a beautiful, luminous, magnetic rain after a long drought. And the joy that comes with it... Refill your travel tube with the fragrance of your choice. Includes 3 x 10ml spray bottles.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Eau de Parfum Refillable 50ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani unveils Armani Code Eau de Parfum, a new compelling and vibrant intensity, encapsulated in the iconic Armani Code refillable bottle. A new fougère ambery spicy fragrance that opens with a faceted freshness with notes of green mandarin and unfolds into a spicy and woody heart of nutmeg essence. A masculine sensuality emerges from the fragrance’s base through a rich and warm tonka bean absolute. Armani Code Eau de Parfum opens with a fresh and vibrant green mandarin essence, sourced from Italy, which brings a distinctive tangy effect to the fragrance. This essence is obtained by grating the zest of the mandarin fruit under running water, with the essence then separated from the water. The heart of the fragrance is composed of a warm and spicy nutmeg essence. The nutmeg essence, derived from the fruit of the nutmeg trees, is obtained via a meticulous drying and steam distillation process, to create its warm, spicy, and woody note. A warm, sensual masculinity is revealed in the fragrance’s base notes, which spotlight the richness of tonka bean absolute. Creating a honeyed tobacco note with milky undertones, the tonka bean absolute is derived from the fruit of the Dipterix odorata tree. The fruits are harvested just as they fall from the tree and undergo a drying process to allow the development of the coumarin molecule, that lends tonka its scent. The absolute is then obtained using a solvent extraction method. How to use: Spray on wrists and neck. To obtain a long-lasting trail, complete by spraying in a double ring-gesture around your head and towards your shoulders.

listings.description: Soleil Neige is a ray of solar light, a breath of winter air that conjures sun on fresh alpine snow. Radiant and exhilarating, it captivates with bright citrus, white florals and musk. TOM FORD’s winter world conjures the thrill of a day on the slopes that melts into the celebratory warmth of après-ski. A cool burst of bright and green citrus gives way to a bouquet of winter-white florals and rose absolute. Fragrance family: Citrus Scent type: Citrus Musk
