listings.description: Entice the senses with the delicately floral notes of this alluring eau de parfum. Fresh ginger and cardamom intermingle with tuberose and lily, deepened with an olfactive signature of hyacinth. How to use: Spray all over the body as desired. Use on pulse points for a longer-lasting scent.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Him Musc Santal Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: The For Him collection by Narciso Rodriguez is a tribute to the strength of modern masculinity, in all its duality. For Him Musc Santal Eau de Parfum Intense reveals a new intensified masculinity, in a story of contrasts where assertive self-confidence meets sensitive authenticity, for the man who attracts with his natural charm. An understated force, with a powerful aura. Working alongside Narciso Rodriguez, renowned perfumer Florian Gallo has crafted a woody musky perfume for men, composed around the magnetic sensuality of musk. This vegan fragrance opens with the clear freshness of clary sage and juniper top notes. At the core, the powerful character of the Narciso Rodriguez heart of musc signature reveals its paradoxical nature: clean yet animalic, pure yet mysterious. At the base, woody notes of cedarwood and sandalwood create extra contrast. A perfume that juxtaposes the duality of warm and cold to create an addictively seductive tension. A design contrasting cool grey with warm wood: For this masculine perfume, the geometric bottle is infused with the subtle strength of frosted grey, and the cap is crafted from natural wood. The outer box features a textured wood-grain effect.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Like the cut of a dress, this fragrance is shaped with all of Guerlains’ finesse. Its simple signature enhances and romances several exceptional materials in a bold overdose. Black cherry blinks the first wink. It is illustrated by a clever blend that extends exquisite almond and delicious berries. The second wink takes place as rose enters the stage. Finally, the shadowy temptations of licorice and smoky black tea reveal more of me and lead to irresistible seduction. For the ultimate temptation, the entire creation is wrapped in Guerlinade. Fresh, enigmatic and exhilarating… Mischievous and captivating… I am the warm spark beneath the sweetness. I am absolutely essential and utterly irresistible. I am the chic and very seductive, perfumed creation by Guerlain.

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Tilbury Love Frequency Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: “A flash of addictive pink pepper, rose ultimate and spicy, sultry saffron feels like a warm embrace that attracts the purest love to you and everyone around you! “Blended with sensual musks, alluring ambery woods and intoxicating patchouli heart, it elicits feelings of love to make your heart dance, leaving a love scent trail in its path that lasts up to 18 hours! “Love Frequency wholly encapsulates the encounter of the romantic rose, queen of the flowers, dancing in perfect harmony with the euphoric and spicy facets of pink pepper! “A vibrant union between bold patchouli, sensual woody notes, and velvety addictive musks, Love Frequency is the alluring and perfect scent of eternal and all-encompassing love. Boost your feelings of love with the emotion-boosting molecules of love frequency!” Charlotte Tilbury. This is a love portal in a bottle. Discover Charlotte’s vision of a modern rose, the flower of love! Powered by love emotion-boosting molecules, hypnotic rose essential and warm cashmere wood, that bathe you in the glow of love. Floral, soft and delicately hypnotic, this enchanting fragrance radiates love. It’s that all-encompassing, comforting feeling of being in love and being loved. How does Love Frequency enhance feelings of love? Charlotte had a specific vision in mind - working with scientist Céline Manetta at IFF, the IFF Scentcube™ algorithm was able to identify the perfect combination of notes to create a fragrance that helps boost feelings of universal love - from friendship to romance to familial love and self-love. Love Frequency emanates that all-encompassing feeling of being loved and being in love. 84% agree the fragrance enhances feelings of love 82% agree the fragrance enhances feelings of romance 81% agree the fragrance enhances feelings of inner love *Tested on 104 people over 1 week. Emotion-boosting molecules: Hypnotic rose essential Warm cashmere wood Olfactive family: Floral Woody. Magic fragrance notes: Top notes: Addictive Pink Pepper Heart notes: Sultry Saffron, Romantic Rose Ultimate Extract, Hypnotic Rose Essential Base notes: Sensual Musk, Warm Cashmere Wood, Captivating Ambery Woods, Intoxicating Patchouli Heart

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Mandarine Basilic Forte Eau de Parfum 75ml

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Pure Musc Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A supremely addictive scent, For Her PURE MUSC Eau de Parfum teases the senses and envelops the body. It is a provocative play on purity. Worn alone, For Her PURE MUSC Eau de Parfum is pure addiction. When layered with other For Her fragrances, For Her PURE MUSC Eau de Parfum is more personal and most memorable. The Fragrance: Narciso Rodriguez’s signature musc is reinterpreted and refined with a disarming purity and a rich depth. With For Her PURE MUSC, the sublime heart of musc is enhanced with a white floral bouquet. Cashmeran added to the base lends warmth to the perfume. Witness a fragrance that maintains a sophisticated delicateness amidst all of its strength. The Bottle: The black and white bottle echoes the exquisite artistry and beauty of the fragrance within. The frosted white lacquer against a strong black cap continues its story of strength mixed with softness. Olfactory Family: Musky Chypre. Top Notes: Jasmin and Orange Blossom Heart Notes: Heart of Musc Base Notes: Cashmeran, Amber and Patchouli The Fragrance Ritual: Combine For Her PURE MUSC with For Her Eau de Parfum. Live an addiction of musk and white flowers to feel sophisticated Combine For Her PURE MUSC with For Her fleur musc. Live an addiction of musk and spicy rose to feel daring

listings.rawTitle: Sisley-Paris L'Eau Rêvée d'Eliya Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Dreams inspire our creativity, they nourish us with images, memories and sensations. Les Eaux Rêvées express this imaginary place where inspirations collide, join together and become one – the inspirations of different generations of the d’Ornano family, the creators of Sisley. This collection is made up of six mixed fragrances, olfactory odes with a perfect, ambivalent nature. A tropical bouquet after the rain: L’Eau Rêvée d’Eliya revisits a tropical forest and imagines a utopian jungle, vibrant after the rain: a new and innocent garden, filled with mythical birds and unknown sounds. Its atmosphere intriguing, warm and perfumed, is the starting point for a radiant juice combining exotic flowers with tuberose and violet. Designed in collaboration with two artists, Elżbieta Radziwiłł et Bronisław Krzysztof, L'Eau Rêvée d'Eliya transports us into the world of unknown, distant and mysterious dreams. Canson paper case and glass bottle made in France. Case and bottle are recyclable. Top notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Exotic Flowers accord Middle notes: Tuberose, Violet, Jasmin Base notes: Amber, Cedarwood, Patchouli

listings.rawTitle: Hermès H24 Eau de Parfum Natural Spray, Refillable 50ml
listings.description: Created by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel, H24 Eau de Parfum reveals a new energy that is characterised by its intensity. A woody aromatic, H24 Eau de Parfum unfurls the rich, botanical power of enveloping sage, the density of high-tech moss and the warm vibrancy of sclarene. To echo the fragrance’s olfactory notes, the bottle with its aerodynamic lines designed by Philippe Mouquet is adorned with moss-green lacquer. The intense grey of the box is defined by a fine lime-green line that opens up the space. The bottle is refillable and made from recycled glass. The box is made entirely of untreated paper and is also composed of recycled fibres. H24 opens up a new space. H for Hermès, Homme and Hours. 24 to evoke a relationship with time and a link to the house’s flagship address of 24 rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré.

listings.description: The Suede Vanilla home fragrance from our Private Collection has a warm and aromatic scent of fresh sage, soothing vanilla, and creamy sandalwood, filling any room with a sense of serenity. Beautifully presented in a reusable glass bottle, specially designed to complement our scented candles and reed diffusers. How to use: Diffuse a few sprays in the air and enjoy a delightful fragrance. When the bottle is empty, simply refill it with your favourite home fragrance refill.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Mon Guerlain fragrances are a fragrant manifesto of today's femininity. A multi-faceted woman: strong, free and sensual. Discover Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet, a smiling fruity fresh amber. The fragrance impression of a radiant personality. A fragrance faceted like a jewel, which revisits Mon Guerlain’s essential ingredients in a fruity and intensely luminous register. The essential lavender-vanilla duo is beautifully enhanced by a sparkling pear note and a luminous Sambac jasmine. A captivating fruity fresh amber sillage with a magnetic charm. "It’s a pear-lavender sorbet which melts onto burnt vanilla." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. The 'quadrilobe' bottle, created in 1908, established itself as one of Guerlain’s iconic bottles. Simple and graphic, it echoes an alchemist’s bottle and owes its name 'quadrilobe' to its stopper, which is formed from one piece to obtain a shape resembling four lobes. One century later, beautifully enhanced by a luxurious glass weight and a golden adornment, this bottle offers a contrast between strong taut lines and sensual curves, expressing contemporary femininity. How to use: Spray Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet on pulse points.

listings.rawTitle: Fresh Cannabis Santal Eau de Parfum
listings.description: A woody blend of earthy cannabis and patchouli. Let a seductive memory linger with our woody fragrance Cannabis Santal Eau de Parfum, featuring sensual notes of earthy cannabis, patchouli, and vetiver. This intoxicating, forbidden fragrance is enclosed in an apothecary-style glass bottle. The smell of smoky woods and sensual patchouli still lingers in the air, transporting you back to the night before. A seductive cannabis accord sprinkled with the rind of an orange has become your obsession. Lev Glazman, Fresh co-founder. Fragrance notes: Top: Plum, Bergamot, Italian Orange Middle: Patchouli, Earthy cannabis, Rose Bottom: Vanilla, Musk, Dark Chocolate, Vetiver How to use: Spray on the inside of your wrists, the back of your neck, below the centre collarbone, or on either side of your shoulders. When layered with another fresh fragrance, alternate the location of each scent.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum intensifies the radiance of the three auras found in this woody, ambery floral perfume, without betraying the original inspiration of the eau de parfum. The perfumer’s mastered craft and the wisdom gained with time gave birth to this woody perfume extract, an ultimate accomplishment for Francis Kurkdjian. The Grandiflorum jasmine perfume creates head notes that gently underscores the craftsman’s voice. The hint of fire is enhanced with powdered epicurean facets of bitter almond. Lastly, the mineral note built around ambergris is tamed with a musky and woody accord. Adding to the intensity of this bouquet perfume, the bottle also plays with light. Its aesthetic dons a brilliant red robe reminiscent of Baccarat red. Baccarat Rouge 540 Maison Francis Kurkdjian Extrait de Parfum embodies the profusion and fusion of elements that can only be tamed by the art of the perfumer and the wisdom gained with time. Olfactory family: woody ambery floral. Top notes: Grandiflorum jasmine, Saffron Heart notes: Bitter almond, Cedarwood Base notes: Musky woody accord, Ambergris accord

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Eau d'Orange Verte Cologne, 50ml
listings.description: Hermès' first cologne: the bright and green freshness of orange combined with woody undertones. The founding cologne, created by Françoise Caron in 1979 and inspired by the smell of undergrowth moist with morning dew, Eau d'Orange Verte has since asserted itself as an emblem of Hermès, standing out by its distinctive freshness. Conceived as an explosion of citrus notes, orange plays the principal role, supported by zest and leaves, lemon, mandarin, mint and blackcurrant bud. The fragrance reveals its complexity in a unique sillage composed of oak moss and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Love Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Coach Love is inspired by the vibrant and universal feeling of love and all of the unique ways we express it. The floral, fruity eau de parfum opens with an invigorating top note of wild strawberry, accentuated by a rich and velvety heart note of red velvet rose, before drying down to warm cedarwood. It is finished with the house’s iconic turnlock top, and classic gold hardware, including a sweetheart charm. Featuring Coach’s iconic Horse and Carriage logo, the outer pack is finished with a subtle leather texture in a rich red hue - a reference to the house’s heritage in leathercraft. Created in collaboration with director and photographer Juergen Teller, the campaign is a celebration of love in all its different forms and expressions. The campaign captures unique love languages, reminding us that love is a distinctive attitude.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The original Eau de Parfum. Featuring black coffee and sensual vanilla. Captivating and energising. Over 16,000 5* reviews. Experience YSL Black Opium, the rock couture fragrance for women by Yves Saint Laurent. Captivating, unparalleled in provocation, deliberatively seductive. Inspiration: In 1977 Yves Saint Laurent introduces Opium: a boundary-pushing perfume. A revolution in a bottle. A new idea of femininity: sultry, provocative, enthralling. Fast forward to 2014, and Opium’s legacy continues to dazzle: Yves Saint Laurent Beauty unveils Black Opium, re-inventing desire in a new, contemporary light, reshaped for the modern woman. Scent: The original Black Opium Eau de Parfum. A captivating floral gourmand scent, twisted with dark, roasted notes of black coffee, for vigour and vitality. Energy and sensuality married with the unique YSL edge.The signature black coffee accord is paired with sensual vanilla, enriched by the softness of white flowers and orange blossom, set against a base of patchouli and comforting white musk. A daring contrast of light and dark, for a women’s fragrance that bewitches with its trail. Crafted by Marie Salamagne, Nathalie Lorson, Olivier Cresp and Honorine Blanc. Top notes: pear accord, mandarin essence Heart notes: vanilla, orange blossom, white flowers Base notes: black coffee accord, cedarwood essence, white musk, patchouli Bottle: Feminine, sleek, dazzling. The Black Opium bottle is decorated with black glitter, as if dressed in sequins. The shimmering black of the bottle is contrasted with the pink hue of the centre and the radical contours of the bottle silhouette, for a design that is both edgy and glamourous. Collection: YSL Beauty mixes ingredients and proportions, constantly re-interpreting Black Opium’s coffee signature. Discover the YSL Black Opium fragrance wardrobe and indulge yourself or treat others to a YSL Black Opium gift. Black Opium Eau de Parfum. The original Eau de Parfum. Featuring adrenaline-rich black coffee and sensual vanilla. Captivating and energising Black Opium Eau de Parfum Illicit Green. A zesty take on the Black Opium signature. Green mandarin and creamy fig combine to create this ‘mocktail in a scent’. Energising and fresh Black Opium Eau de Parfum Neon. A vibrant spin on the original Black Opium Eau de Parfum. The signature coffee notes meet luminous dragon fruit. Fruity and vibrant Black Opium Eau de Parfum Extreme. The Black Opium signature taken to the next level. Extra-black coffee, ultra-white flowers, and an abundance of patchouli. Exhilarating and excessive Black Opium Eau de Parfum Intense. A bold interpretation of the Black Opium’s coffee note, enhanced by the thrilling aura of blue absinthe for intensity. Deep and seductive

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 + Champaca Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: The most minimal fragrance is a single aroma-molecule: Molecule 01. The next most minimal adds 1 to 01: 01 + 1. This is Molecule +. The M+ line adds +1 to Iso E Super, the super aroma-molecule that turned the cloistered world of perfumery upside down. Molecule 01 + Champaca consists of Iso E Super + Champaca. Iso E Super is an abstract synthetic molecule characterised as a cedarwood note with a warm, woody, velvety cocooning sensation. Champaca is an absolute extracted from the red champaca flower, found only in India. One of the most expensive ingredients in perfumery, champaca absolute is one of the richest, most faceted floral materials in perfumery, with shades of jasmine and orange blossom, touches of tea, and a soft creaminess that unfolds in waves. Together, Iso E Super and champaca form an unexpected harmony: the weightless transparency of Iso E Super against the intricate opulence of champaca. A radiant opening with hints of orange blossom brightness gives way to a heart that is lush, floral, woody, and quietly exotic, before settling into the smooth, woody embrace of Molecule 01. "I was overwhelmed when I first smelled champaca absolute with Molecule 01. Champaca absolute and Iso E Super form an amazing amalgamation, because they are very contrary. Champaca absolute has so many facets. It's so rich. There's so much happening in it. The complexity of champaca absolute complements Iso E Super exceptionally well on its own. Because Iso E Super has these very woody yet transparent, very velvety, very cocooning, soft aspects, and then you have champaca, giving it all this complexity, all these different olfactory sensations," says Geza Schoen. M+ Champaca is an opulent yet weightless fragrance, where the multidimensional facets of champaca entwine with the velvety ease of Iso E Super, leaving a luxuriously luminous trail that lingers with quiet elegance.

The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75ml and 125ml bottles. ¹Using the Rosa Verde perfume increases the feeling of pleasure (self-assessment on 37 subjects) and the feeling of relaxation (instrumental test on 34 subjects). ²Calculation based on the international ISO 16128 standard, including water. ³Only on 75mL and 125mL sales formats. The powerful sillage and long-lasting presence of the fragrance symbolise the enduring power of love and beauty. At the same time, fresh waves of citrus pay homage to the breathtaking serenity of the Mediterranean coastline. Playfulness and intrigue are found at the heart of the fragrance through surprising and delicious notes of pink peppercorn and sharp blackcurrant. Finally, this spirited scent is rounded off with warm green notes of patchouli and oakmoss, providing a deep and earnest tribute to the natural world. listings.rawTitle: Hermès Calèche Soie de Parfum Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Created by perfumer Guy Robert in 1961, Hermès’ first fragrance for women, Calèche, was reinterpreted in 1992 as Calèche Soie de Parfum, the name of which refers to the horse-drawn carriages that are emblematic of the house and its silk métier. Floral with aldehyde aromas, Calèche Soie de Parfum combines the refined notes of aldehyde with opulent jasmine and generous rose. The bottle, inspired by the lanterns of horse-drawn carriages, has a black cap reminiscent of a riding hat. The back label is illustrated with a design by Philippe Dumas, indicating that it belongs to the Parfums-Fondateurs collection. The Parfums-Fondateurs Collection: The Parfums-Fondateurs collection draws inspiration from the house’s heritage. Each creation encapsulates Hermès’ imaginary world in a name, a fragrance and a colour. Over the years, Hermès has pioneered a bold style of perfumery, resulting from encounters with exceptional perfumers. Written in 1961 by Guy Robert, Calèche was Hermès' first fragrance for women. A highly feminine, woody, chypre floral, its name refers to the horse-drawn carriages that are emblematic of the house. Calèche is a novel that dazzles with the beauty of its raw materials, from the joyfulness of citrus fruit to the modernity of aldehyde notes; from the floral heart embellished with ylang-ylang, rose and jasmine to the woody, chypre sillage underscored by the nobility of the iris.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne PHANTOM Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Crafted to reveal the mysterious facets of masculinity, Phantom Eau de Toilette by Rabanne reveals an intriguing aura for the man who refuses to be constrained by the limits of convention. As an undeniable enigma, he lives by the essence of self-confidence and forges his own elusive path. Revealed to the world at nighttime in Paris, the bewitching city of lights, he is boldly non–conformist yet vulnerable, leaving an enchanting aura in his wake. Powered by the most mysterious facet of you, Phantom Eau de Toilette is unapologetically bold, yet sophisticated, combining a hypnotic blend of creamy lavender, energising lemon and addictive vanilla. Blended to perfection with the utmost refinement, Phantom Eau de Toilette by Rabanne is responsibly formulated with the most precious, ethically–sourced ingredients. The fragrance: Blended for mysterious masculinity, Phantom Eau de Toilette by Rabanne harnesses exceptional creamy lavender, energising lemon and addictive vanilla. The bottle: Catching the eye with its bold and elevated design, the Phantom Eau de Toilette bottle captures the essence of enigmatic masculinity in an iconic black and silver signature. The unmistakable Phantom aesthetic combines brilliant metallic silver with the dark glossy black of the glasses with a graphic transparent signature monogram at the centre. Sharp yet sophisticated, the bottle harnesses an aura of darkness to bring out the Phantom inside of you. Olfactive family: Aromatic, Woody, Amber. Top notes: Energising Fusing Lemon Heart notes: Sexy Woody Vanilla Base notes: Addictive Creamy Lavender

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Vétiver Eau de Toilette Intense 50ml
listings.description: Issey Miyake’s Eau de toilette intense, l’Eau d’Issey pour Homme. Discover L’Eau d’Issey pour Homme Vétiver, the new vegan-certified Issey Miyake men’s eau de toilette intense. Water, calm, the purist expression of what is essential, meets matter, dense, textured, evolving. The impulse created by the union of the elements gives birth to l’Eau d’Issey pour Homme Vétiver. Fragrance: The woody notes of vetiver, lifted by spicy ginger and warm sage. A streamlined formula composed only of essentials, like an ode to the elements, triggers an instant addiction. The vetiver comes from Haiti and is 100% of natural origin. It is ethically grown and harvested by local farmers. In this new Eau de toilette Intense, vetiver root exudes its woody generosity. Design: With L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme Vétiver, Issey Miyake offers a new take on the brand’s iconic perfume bottle by infusing it with a brown tone reminiscent of vetiver root. The refined glass perfume bottle contrasts with the brown ash cap, symbolising the encounter between the absolute purity of water and the sensory and authentic nature of wood. Committed to nature: The bottle for the Eau de toilette Intense L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme Vétiver is made from 20% PCR glass and its cap is plastic-free and made entirely from natural wood. The fragrance is vegan and composed of 93% ingredients of natural origin. Top notes: Ginger Heart notes: Clary Sage Base notes: Vetiver How to use: Spray the fragrance directly onto pulse points (neck, wrists, inner elbows).

Delightful and indulgent, this musky-woody floral preludes with crisp, sparkling Italian Mandarin and sensual notes of Sea Breeze Accord. With Atelier des Fleurs Vert Soleil, perfumer Quentin Bisch reveals a leafy and juicy lentisque, exalted by green mandarin, over its traditional resinous nuances. The Mediterranean Essences Eau de Parfum bottles embrace the iconic codes of Chloé, with an undulating glass shape recalling the plissé soleil, a warm green hue, and a textured sand-coloured cap. How to use: For a beautiful, long-lasting citrus green woody fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Chamade Eau de Toilette, 75ml
listings.description: For almost two centuries, Guerlain has been a story of fragrance and beauty, legacy and creation, daring and exploration, heritage and the future. Our roots enrich the present and inspire the future. With more than 1,100 fragrances created since 1828 by five generations of perfumers, our heritage is unique. The Legendary fragrance collection pays tribute to this exceptional heritage. Chamade is part of Guerlain's Patrimoine Collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by 5 generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library, that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Chamade is a hymn to love that unfurls like the spring with equal grace, feminity, independence and attraction. With flowers in a thousand nuanced shades, this perfume speaks of a romantic and audacious woman who serenely accepts the inclination of her heart. Designed by Georges Chevalier, its iconic 'inverted heart' bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

Chasing Sunsets, a woody fruity scent evoking the memory of capturing the last ray of sunlight. listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Cedrus de Nuit Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Les Fleurs de Nuit by Chloé Atelier des Fleurs draws inspiration from the nights of the Rive Gauche, a timeless setting where creative effervescence meets Parisian audacity. True to the philosophy of the Maison Chloé and its founder Gaby Aghion, this collection offers a sensual portrait of iconic flowers that transform at nightfall. By day, they absorb the warmth and luminosity of the sun. By night, they fully bloom, revealing the richness and singularity of secret notes, voluptuous and narcotic, that emerge only in the shadow of night. With Atelier des Fleurs Cedrus de Nuit, perfumers Quentin Bisch and Louise Turner reinvent Cedrus by highlighting a flower both rare and ephemeral: the Queen of the Night, which sets ablaze the woody heart of the iconic perfume. Once a year, this white flower awakens and blooms in darkness, releasing a voluptuous aroma like a warm exhale in the cool night air. Through an unprecedented extraction process that faithfully captures the essence of a flower in its environment, its honeyed and subtly spiced scent is immortalised in all its intensity. Amplified by an amber base, then enhanced by a dark vanilla absolute and a resinous benzoin, the sensual intensity of the flower meets the enveloping warmth of woods. The Cedrus de Nuit bottle features a deep cobalt blue, evoking a midnight sky. Its undulated glass shape pays homage to the plissé soleil, the signature of Atelier des Fleurs fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Intensa Eau de Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Vibrant, charismatic, and confident. Colonia Intensa exudes the essence of Italian light and life. Presented in a new restyled bottle, it is an exciting fragrance that combines traditional and contemporary sophistication. An olfactory style that conveys confidence and determination. The citrus woody fragrance opens with the classic citrus notes of Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian lemon. Spicy hints of cardamom and ginger lend a self-assuring character to the aromatic accents of myrtle and artemisia and the sunny notes of neroli, to then reveal the singularity of this Eau de Cologne in the base. listings.rawTitle: Gucci the Alchemist's Garden Lignum Idealis Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden reimagines the four stages of ancient alchemy. The Ignis stage: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden Lignum Idealis Eau de Parfum unisex perfume. Lignum Idealis Eau de Parfum: A fragrant ode to two glorious trees, Sandalwood and the Giant Sequioa, captured through modern technology. Majestic. Serene. Everlasting. Fragrance family: Woody. This fragrant vision of a forest’s soul captures the lactonic, woody glory of the Giant Sequoia. The tree’s spicy essence is preserved through an exclusive extract obtained with modern headspace technology. Utilising a biotechnology fermentation process, the creamiest parts of Sandalwood are unveiled, contrasted by the spicy, aromatic edge of a Juniper Berries Essence. A strong trail of maximum power. The bottle: Lignum Idealis Eau de Parfum’s red glass bottle is adorned with a golden deer: a creature that guards the realm of these grand trees. Olfactive alchemists: Perfumer Alexis Grugeon created this exceptional Woody Gucci scent through the mysterious technique of headspace. Gathering only the fleeting molecules surrounding the Giant Sequoia, its woody essence transports the senses while leaving the forest unharmed.

listings.description: A precious, heady Eau de Parfum, heightened with deep, rich saffron, black tea, vanilla and oud notes from the East. Delve deep into the mysteries of Assam and evoke a beautifully resinous, woody vision. The fragrance: Top notes of davana, bergamot, black pepper and cardamom A heart of saffron, rose, black tea and vanilla A base of oud, honey, tobacco and styrax resin Olfactive Signature: Olibanum Resin. Fragrance family: Woody. Explore: London via Assam. The burnished sienna façade of Talatal Ghar palace commands the golden twilight. listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin Sur La Lagune Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Un Jardin sur la Lagune Eau de Toilette was created in 2019 by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel. A secret garden in which nature has stood the test of time, it evokes a mysterious place in the city of a thousand contrasts: Venice. A floral and woody composition, Un Jardin sur la Lagune Eau de Toilette blends radiant magnolia, enveloping pittosporum and a carnal Madonna lily. The bottle echoes the lanterns of horse-drawn carriages and was created by Fred Rawyler. Its glass is in a delicate Venetian ochre gradient, echoing the wall that surrounds this garden. On the box, lush nature, observed from the lagoon’s waters, emerges in touches of colour, painted by artist Safet Zec. The Parfums-Jardins Collection: The Parfums-Jardins collection brings together the soul of a place, the perfumer's inspiration and the Hermès annual theme. They are olfactory strolls to indulge every desire for freshness, reverie or escape.

listings.description: Molecule 05 consists of Cashmeran, pure and singular. Cashmeran is one of the greats of synthetic chemistry. Warm and woody, with a resinous pine note. Cashmeran was created in a laboratory at the IFF in the late 1970s. A smooth and musky scent that merges with your skin chemistry, Molecule 05 is a scent that glorifies fragrance's undefinable magnetism and gives it its rightful due as a subtle yet requisite element in our lives that stimulates all the senses. listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Fantasies Soul of the Forest Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Let yourself be drawn into the deepest whispers at the heart of the forest. Be absorbed by Soul of the Forest’s sylvan fantasy, to search for and find the forest's soul through this powerful trail. Born from the imagination of Perfumers, each of the surreal ingredients within the Replica Fantasies fragrances fuses together refined raw materials to create a new, imaginary olfactory note. Soul of the Forest’s evocative scent is defined by a surreal ingredient at its heart, the Mystical Wood. Its deep woody note captures the intangible sensation of connecting with the soul of an otherworldly woodland, and the sense of eternity elicited by encountering this enigmatic forest’s essence. The new Replica Fantasies bottle is now dressed in an opulent, graduated black lacquering. This rich hue evokes nightfall, symbolic of how the REPLICA FANTASIES fragrances usher you into a world of dreams and fantasies. Fashioned in weighted glass, the flacon is sealed at its neck with a deep black rope. A gleaming, textured silver label adorns the bottle, with its shifting iridescence conjuring how night creates a transformative passage to dreams. Key ingredients: To create this surreal ingredient, Master Perfumer Quentin Bischhas has drawn on his creativity to shape some of the finest olfactory ingredients. Cedarwood Atlas essence, whose dry, vertical wood structure evokes a mood of grandeur and wisdom. Its scent captures wandering amongst imposing, ancient trees that soar toward the sky. Then, patchouli essence, an earthy scent with rich, woody inflections and camphorous notes, echoes the inherent mysticality of a forest, adding depth to the fragrance. Finally, a moss accord, created by the perfumer himself to evoke the forest sensation of the earthy, almost damp, moss-covered ground beneath your feet, creating a profound connection with nature.

Then came The Only One 2 Eau de Parfum, which conjures addictive notes with a red roses heart. Now, with this latest edition, The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense celebrates the most fascinating qualities of The Only One woman with an irresistible and hypnotic fragrance. The gold ring detail evokes the radiant elegance of The Only One woman, while the sinuous cursive script conjures her seductive silhouette. Fragrance Family: FlAmber. listings.description: In the hands of a Master. Discover a mystical fragrance that showcases the precious oud wood and oud oil of the Middle East. To preserve their unique characteristics, Giorgio Armani decided to work with oud oil in a luxury fragrance the same way he would approach a rich gold and silver brocade. "With Oud Royal, I wanted to capture the spirit of Eastern alchemy by elevating oud wood, the precious symbol of the Orient itself. Treating it as a piece of jewellery is the only way to do justice to its magnificent richness."

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Earl Grey & Cucumber Cologne, 100ml
listings.description: A British tradition... afternoon tea. A fragrance with a burst of bergamot, distinct to Earl Grey, and the cool succulence of crunchy cucumber. Counterpoised with a sweet base of beeswax, vanilla and musk. Reviving and refined. How to use: Spritz generously onto your wrists, neck and pulse points – your body heat will help to diffuse the fragrance as the day goes on. Wear alone or layer with another Cologne or your favourite Bath & Body products. Your Jo Malone London order will be exquisitely wrapped in their iconic box, tied with a beautiful grosgrain ribbon. Looking to find your new favourite scent in person? Visit our Jo Malone London boutiques inside selected John Lewis & Partners shops: Cheadle Chelmsford Cribbs Causeway Edinburgh Exeter High Wycombe Horsham Milton Keynes Oxford Street Reading Southampton Stratford White City

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Under the Stars Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Under the Stars evokes the memory of a starry night spent in the wild. Its timeless blend of Oud essence and Labdanum resinoid notes recalls a dark, mystical night. Oud captures the night’s mysteries, as this precious wood creates an otherworldly effect when burning. Labdanum, meanwhile, is a warm and ambery ingredient that conjures the warmth of a summer wind caressing the skin. A raw and wild leather accord brings an element of untamed nature to Under the Stars. And Black Pepper essence highlights the captivating experience of immersing oneself in nature. How to use: As damp skin locks in the scent, apply the fragrance straight after showering or bathing and before getting dressed. Apply the fragrance on your pulse points for a more seductive effect and a stronger diffusion. Spray the fragrance from at least 15-20 centimetres from the area of application. For a more diffused effect, spray the fragrance in the air and walk through it. Wait until the fragrance has dried down on your skin before smelling it. Rubbing the skin after spraying the perfume will destroy the bond and alter the scent.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Parfum Boisée 60ml
listings.description: Noble iris is enveloped in burning woods to create the most sensual fragrance for men. Gentleman Eau de Parfum Boisée embodies the unexpected contrast between passionate strength and smouldering seduction. The olfactory encounter begins with a spicy touch of black pepper and coriander. Followed by the richness of cocoa and sophistication of iris, this composition is enhanced by notes of sandalwood wrapped in an Amber accord for the warmest trail. Givenchy Gentleman, the ultimate in timeless elegance and refinement.

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Angel's Share Paradis Extrait de Parfum Refill, 100ml
listings.description: The ultimate interpretation of Angels' Share in an intense extrait de parfum, an irresistible ode to the finest spirits. The perfume: Inspired by an exceptional liqueur aged in oak barrels, Angels' Share Paradis captures the Maison’s incomparable savoir-faire and founder Kilian Hennessy’s legacy. The emblematic essence of Angels' Share unveils a new, daring intensity with tantalising raspberry liquor and exquisite Bulgarian rose oil orpur. A lavish dose of praline accord, enriched with warm amber notes of Venezuelan tonka bean absolut, blends seamlessly to linger on the skin, leaving a captivating, sensual trail. Perfumer: Benoist Lapouza. True luxury should last a lifetime, and as such, all by KILIAN PARIS fragrance bottles are designed to be refilled. How to use: Start refilling your bottle by carefully removing the atomiser. Plug your refill bottle into your flacon and make sure to hold it vertically. The cutting-edge dispenser will stop transferring the perfume automatically once the container is full. This innovative new 100ml refill allows an easy spill-proof process for your 50ml fragrance bottle, your travel spray, or your carafes.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Intense Refillable 30ml
listings.description: We are Chloé. Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Intense captures the emotion and energy of Chloé through four inspiring women who embody the values of the brand. Of different ages and from different backgrounds, they are beautiful, strong, and free. Surrounded by lush nature, they change the direction of the wind itself. A breath of feminine energy spreads to the four corners of the world. A wave of joy, optimism, and freedom. The expression of the power of women according to Chloé. The Fragrance: Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Intense is an addictive floral fragrance for women that opens with vibrant, juicy raspberry notes, underlining the sensuality of the rose that lies beneath. As alive as if captured at any moment of the day, its strong fragrance evokes at once the fresh morning rose, green and slightly crisp, the open midday rose, rich and deep, and the honeyed evening rose, with its sensual, addictive accents. Then, a bouquet of warm and ambery woods unfolds, each more concentrated than the last. Ambrox brings its musky, woody notes, Cashmeran offers its voluptuous sensuality, and cedar reinforces the fragrance’s unique character. A Chloé fragrance that's perfect for any occasion and lasts all day long. The Bottle: For L’Eau de Parfum Intense, the famous pleated Chloé perfume bottle has been given a new look, now stamped with a sleek black and ecru label for an even more modern and refined style. Its ribbon has also taken on a new, deep garnet hue, echoing the fragrance's composition and the flower at its heart. This fragrance has a vegan formula and is available in 30ml, 50ml or 100ml refillable bottles. Refill sold separately.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Glimmer Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: An amber floral Eau de Parfum fragrance with a gourmand twist. Notes of Macaron Rose Accord, Shimmering Patchouli and Amber Embrace Accord—reimagined through modern craft into a luminous, radiant scent. Fragrance family: Rich Floral. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Raspberry Mousse Accord, Orange Flower, Mandarin Oil Middle notes: Macaron Rose Accord, Rose, Vanilla Bean, Cashmeran Base notes: Shimmering Patchouli, Amber Embrace Accord, Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Tonka Bean What does Glimmer Eau de Parfum Spray smell like? First 10 seconds: Bright, sparkling and mouthwatering. Fruity-rosy raspberry, a fresh lift of mandarin, and a soft orange flower glow As it develops on your skin: Warmer and more enveloping. Macaron Rose Accord comes forward with its gourmand impression, wrapped in the radiant depth of Amber Embrace Accord and Shimmering Patchouli, with a smooth, skin-warmed softness Well into the wear: The fragrance settles into a lingering, addictive trail, a glowing blend of Amber, Patchouli, Woods and Tonka Bean notes. Still warmed by a whisper of sweetness that stays close and feels unforgettable The experience: This is the fragrance for life’s most extraordinary moments. It’s a scent not just to be worn, but to be felt, remembered, and shared. Because when you find what makes you glimmer, it lights up everyone around you. The bottle: A beautiful rectangular bottle embodies femininity and strength. Sculpted semi-circles catch and reflect each ray of light. A circular gold-tone cap adds a luminous finish.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Idôle Peach’N Roses Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Discover the new Lancôme Idôle Peach’N Roses Eau de Parfum, a juicy, bold, and feminine fragrance that celebrates the vibrant confidence of modern women. Perfect for any occasion, this long-lasting fruity floral perfume leaves a radiant trail of peachy sweetness on the skin. The scent. Peachy sweetness. This irresistible scent opens with a burst of sparkling Red Berries Accord, awakening the senses with a lively freshness. At its heart, the exclusive Peach Orpur™ extract, an innovation by Givaudan, captures the luscious essence of a perfectly ripe peach - tangy, sweet, and utterly alluring. Finally, the velvety Damascena Rose Absolute envelops the composition with sensual warmth, reimagining the iconic Idôle floral signature with a juicy twist. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Red Berries Accord Heart notes: Peach Orpur™ Base notes: Damascena Rose Absolute The bottle: The elegant bottle, finished in glowing peach tones, embodies the spirit of optimism and light. Lancôme Idôle Peach’N Roses is the fragrance that makes every moment feel just peachy. How to use: 1. Apply to pulse points, wrists, neckline, and behind the ears, to let the fragrance bloom naturally 2. Allow the fragrance to develop naturally on the skin, and reapply as desired for more intensity 3. Perfect for day or evening wear and ideal for layering with other Idôle fragrances

listings.description: Building upon the timeless, sensual legacy of Eternity Calvin Klein, new Eternity Calvin Klein Eau de Parfum is a celebration of the masculine and multifaceted modern man. The sophisticated aftershave fragrance for men reinterprets the original fougère scent by introducing a new woody note. A powerful and elegant base of suede and vetiver is layered with a heart of warm geranium and cypress. Top notes of alluring sage and apple impart crisp freshness to the lingering and compelling scent. A vibrant emerald juice shines from within the iconic bottle, radiating freshness and power. Rugged yet refined, Eternity Calvin Klein Eau de Parfum is the essence of today’s confident, contemporary man.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Burberry Her Parfum opens with delicate cherry notes. This fruity yet profound gourmand fragrance then evolves through warm amber to an elegant and enveloping vanilla complex full of contrasts. Burberry Her Parfum is the most intense fragrance in the family – daring and sophisticated. Burberry Her is the essence of freedom: the thrill of open skies, the joy of self-expression, the empowerment of following your own path. A bold scent that becomes the signature of the woman wearing it. The iconic Burberry Her bottle is presented in an opaque deep pink colour with a fully matte finish, representing the intensity and boldness of the fragrance. The packaging is adorned with more ribbons, also picking up this tone of pink and relaying the scent's intensity. How to use: Spray onto pulse points to increase the longevity of this refined Burberry Her scent, gently pressing into the skin to preserve the essence of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d’Hermes Pure Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Terre d’Hermès tells the story of man’s relationship with the earth, his humble and harmonious dialogue with nature and the elements. Jean-Claude Ellena created Terre d’Hermès Parfum in 2009, giving Terre d’Hermès a new density. Woody and warm, Terre d’Hermès Eau de Parfum combines enveloping cedar and sparkling grapefruit with a radiant note of shiso. To leave its imprint on the earth, the bottle rests on an orange H, echoing the colour of the fragrance. Its strong lines and metal shoulders reflect the light. Created by designer Philippe Mouquet and inspired by a bottle in a travel vanity case, the Terre d’Hermès Eau de Parfum bottle unveils a range of details: Hermès’ iconic saddle nail, the sliding cover, etc.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Wonderland Peony Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: For the delicate, dreamy, radiant and thoughtful. We don't like to play favourites, but we have a thing for peonies. And this sweet floral is stuffed full of them. Armfuls of peonies, pink berries and violets. A shot of cedarwood lends a woody-balsamic warmth while vetiver injects the tiniest hint of hazelnut. Sophisticated, not soft. Captivating, not cute. Ingredients: Sicilian Lemon, Pink Berries, Pink Guava, Violet, Peony Accord, Raspberry Flower, Vanilla Bean, Pink Cotton Candy, Cedarwood, Vetiver. The hero flowers: Peony, Violet, Raspberry Flower.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Barénia Perfumed Body Cream, 200ml
listings.description: Barénia is the scent of a skin, where strength and softness come together. It expresses the instinctive and captivating facets of a woman. An unstoppable woman. The embodiment of freedom. A derivative of the Eau de Parfum, the melting and enveloping texture of Barénia perfumed body cream comforts and hydrates the skin and leaves it delicately fragranced. The intoxicating signature of the butterfly lily is intertwined with the delicacy of the miracle berry. The warm trail of oakwood and the depth of patchouli underline the magnetic uniqueness of the composition.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Les Légendaires L’Heure Bleue 1912 Eau de Toilette, 75ml
listings.description: Heir to Guerlain’s exceptional heritage, the Les Légendaires collection pays tribute to legendary creations composed by five generations of perfumers since 1828. Inspired by a series of love stories, both real and imagined, each fragrance infused with raw materials leaves a glorious scent of emotion in its wake. Discover L’Heure Bleue 1912, the fragrance of suspended time. It’s that time of day when day embraces night and silence fully envelopes the world. An expression of harmony, a moment of stillness and grace tinted with deep blue echoed in L’Heure Bleue, composed in 1912. Painting an impressionistic olfactory canvas, Jacques Guerlain merged the accord of violet and iris with the creamy ivory of vanilla, leaving a bewitching fragrance trail of both fresh and warm nuances. Through this ambery floral, a tale of eternal love is told. In this moment of suspended time, when the night is "yet to find its star" as Jacques Guerlain described it, L’Heure Bleue marks the meeting of two soulmates destined to become one in the frisson of eternity. "The sun has just set, but night hasn’t yet fallen. Time is suspended... in a moment when man finally finds himself in harmony with the world and with light." Jacques Guerlain. With their emblematic, gem-like bottles, the famous inverted heart designed by George Chevalier, Les Légendaires transcend the passing of time, serving as immortal inspiration for the future.

listings.rawTitle: Fragrance Du Bois NY 5th Avenue Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by one of the most exciting and diverse cities in the world, this sweet and woody fragrance is an expression of the world's most upscale street, evoking the intrigue and allure of New York’s 5th Avenue in wintertime. Created by perfumer Shadi Samra, New York 5th Avenue is an unforgettable fragrance of energy and warmth where luxurious ingredients sparkle, imitating the twinkling lights illuminating dusk like fine gems. Top notes of bergamot and rose introduce the smooth, floral and spicy heart notes of sweet caramel, cold violet and woody cypriol, before a sumptuous base of vanilla, musk, cashmeran and guaiac wood envelops the wearer in an embrace of the finest ingredients to round out this energetic and inspiring Woody-Gourmand fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Sì Eau de Parfum 30ml Holiday Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: This Holiday Season, the Armani gift set dresses in silver with a magnetic red touch and a festive bow. Open your Holiday gift set and experience Armani’s timeless signatures. This Gift Set includes a full-size Sì Eau de Parfum and a travel size. Sì Eau de Parfum is soft and warm with a hint of sophisticated sweetness. Fresh, green and addictive in its initial impression, the elegance of freesia and the exquisite honey hues of rose de mai absolute make this perfume truly distinctive. listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden Ambrosia Del Deserto Unisex Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden Ambrosia del Deserto is an indulgent Chypre Fruity fragrance that draws inspiration from the ignis alchemical phase, where Gucci perfumers use disruptive techniques and exclusive ingredients to unearth a transcendent treasure, allowing retro-olfaction to ignite the senses and reveal daring new olfactory dimensions. A scented sustenance that burns with infinite delight, this long-lasting unisex perfume embraces the sweetness of Candied Date entwined with velvety Rose through the intricate art of retro-olfaction. Refined and elevated via molecular distillation, citrusy Blood Orange then bursts with sparkling vibrancy, while Patchouli grounds it in an earthy depth. This Gucci fragrance is enclosed in a red glass bottle, its design reborn under the fiery power of the golden dragon that adorns it – a symbol of enduring greatness and keeper of its glorious secrets. How to Use: Spray Gucci The Alchemist's Garden Ambrosia del Deserto Eau de Parfum onto clean, dry skin, focusing on pulse points such as the wrists and neck to reveal the Chypre Fruity aromas. Create your own signature fragrance by layering Ambrosia Del Deserto Eau de Parfum with other perfumes in the collection, such as Gucci Muschio di Luce, Gucci Tears from the Moon, Gucci Lignum Idealis, Gucci Rosa Sublime, Gucci The Heart of Leo, Gucci A Reason To Love, Gucci A Floral Verse, Gucci The Voice of the Snake, or Gucci Osmanthus Nectar. When finished, recycle the outer packaging and dispose of the perfume bottle according to local guidelines.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Jour d'Hermès Absolu Eau de Parfum Refillable, 85ml
listings.description: Jour d’Hermès Absolu was created by perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena in 2014. Its formula is quintessentially floral and feminine. “I wanted to create an assertive signature that took us as close as possible to the body of a woman. You can see her shoulders, her neck; you can touch her and breathe in her scent. A floral fragrance, Jour d’Hermès Absolu eau de parfum reveals sensual gardenia, sun-drenched sambac jasmine and velvety apricot blossom. Created by designer Pierre Hardy, the bottle displays rounded, sensual curves. At the centre, a drop of pink amber light hangs suspended. The bottle can be replenished using the 125 ml Jour d’Hermès Absolu eau de parfum refill. A responsible gesture, integral to an object created to last. An essential tool for the artisan’s work, light is the primary material at Hermès. It energises objects and brings them to life, while revealing the beauty of the world. It is this light that inspired Jour d’Hermès, the most vital of fragrances. "I wanted to express the essence of femininity with flowers, nothing but flowers." Jean-Claude Ellena. Femininity in fragrance form! A celebration of the birth and rebirth of women, every day, Jour d’Hermès highlights female beauty, while maintaining the mystery of each individual woman. A profusion of bouquets. From dawn to dusk, here is a floral that flowers, a blossom that blooms.

Héritage, for a man who is at once a trustee for tradition and a herald of a new spirit. Spicy Ambery. Refined, warm, authentic. listings.rawTitle: Sisley-Paris L'Eau Rêvée d'Alma Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Dreams inspire our creativity, they nourish us with images, memories and sensations. Les Eaux Rêvées express this imaginary place where inspirations collide, join together and become one – the inspirations of different generations of the d’Ornano family, the creators of Sisley. This collection is made up of six mixed fragrances, olfactory odes with a perfect, ambivalent nature. An Iris between water and ice: If it was a picture on the wall, L'Eau Rêvée d’Alma would be a French countryside brimming with reeds, rivers and ponds. It has the silky clear depths of fresh waters, it’s like a crystalline song that grasps and awakens you. A blend of delicate aquatic iris and frosty cardamom, L'Eau Rêvée d'Alma is a crystalline and joyful fragrance. Designed in collaboration with two artists, Elżbieta Radziwiłł et Bronisław Krzysztof, L'Eau Rêvée d'Alma transports us to the world of dreams imbued with lightness. Canson paper case and glass bottle made in France. Case and bottle are recyclable. listings.description: Bright and delicate, Iris Ukiyoé interprets the virtually unknown fragrances of the iris flower. "I collect prints and have a mental picture of irises in the ‘floating world’ (the ukiyo-é in Japanese) in the works of Hokusai or Hiroshige. They inspired me when I was composing this divertimento based on floral iris. I felt like foiling the classic approach to the iris by working on the flower’s fragrances, which are virtually unknown. Its perfume is delicate but very much there, shifting between different notes: rose, orange blossom and mandarin, all expressed by small, impressionistic touches." - Jean-Claude Ellena. Fragrance notes: iris, orange blossom, rose.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Les Légendaires Jardins de Bagatelle Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: For almost two centuries, Guerlain has been a story of fragrance and beauty, legacy and creation, daring and exploration, heritage and the future. Our roots enrich the present and inspire the future. With more than 1,100 fragrances created since 1828 by five generations of perfumers, our heritage is unique. The Legendary fragrance collection pays tribute to this exceptional heritage. Jardins de Bagatelle is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by five generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Jardins de Bagatelle is for women who always perfume themselves for the pleasure of seduction as well as for their own pleasure and enjoyment. These gardens are redolent with a multitude of white flowers, varieties of rose, hyacinths, daffodils and narcissus of exceptional luminosity, to the great delight of anyone who loves nature. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Pour Monsieur Eau de Toilette Spray, 100ml

The only men's fragrance created while Mademoiselle was still alive, in 1955. An elegant and refined fresh-chypre fragrance. A fresh citrusy burst with notes of Sicilian Lemon and Tunisian Neroli, revealing a deep, spicy heart. The sober, subtle presence of a woody trail.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Forte Oud Yuzu Eau de Parfum Refill, 200ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover the Oud Yuzu Forte refill format and refill your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle in one simple step. Oud Yuzu Forte, the unexpected contrast between the sacred whorls of oud wood and the mischievous acerbity of yuzu. Wood and citrus meet to give a fragrance that plays with light and shadow. "Oud Yuzu Forte is the surprising illumination of sacred and mysterious oud wood, shot through with the tangy freshness of yuzu." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. Aqua Allegoria Forte, the intense collection, is a warm and enveloping journey to the heart of the world’s wonders: Eaux de Parfum celebrating the intense beauty of nature, revealed by the golden rays of a setting sun. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria Forte fragrances contain more than 90% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The 200ml refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75ml and 125ml bottles. *In accordance with ISO 16128, calculation including water. How to use: Create your own olfactory signature by pairing Oud Yuzu Forte with Bergamote Calabria, Orange Soleia, Pamplelune or Nerolia Vetiver. Select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

It reaches an ultimate balance by lying on a bed of natural Sandalwood and Musk perfecting a modern fougère olfactory experience. Woody Aromatic. listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Ombré Leather Parfum Travel Spray, 10ml
listings.description: Building on the untethered, tactile sensuality of the original scent, Ombré Leather Parfum intensifies the distinctly rich, luxurious leather signature with surprising new additions. Violet leaf absolute orpur breathes a powerful, intensely green air, giving way to the elegant, woody sensuality of cedarwood. Harvested before the monsoon season to produce an elevated extract, jasmine sambac absolute India orpur offers an intense, fruity-floral facet recalling honeysuckle. Deep leathery and woody notes laced with green tobacco undercut the floralcy, stoking a creamy sensuality – while a double concentration of orris heart pulses beneath, releasing a captivating, addictive pull.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Blouse Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: A fragrance as impertinent as Yves Saint Laurent's iconic transparent blouses, challenging conventions with a blend of sheer delicacy and bold sensuality. Like a graceful rose peeking through a veil of silk, this scent blends delicate floral notes with a captivatingly bold heart, leaving an aura of undeniable impertinence. The olfaction: To express the fluid movement and impertinent sensuality of Yves Saint Laurent’s iconic see-through blouses, perfumer Quentin Bisch selected the lush, luminous Damascena rose, one of the two species of flower showcased in fine fragrance. "I chose to work on a rose because I wanted to capture its inherent sophistication and natural intensity, particularly at dusk. This approach allows me to create an elegant olfactory veil that subtly evokes the delicate texture of Yves Saint Laurent’s original blouse." Not just delicate but also assertive and vibrant, the precious rose breaks free from classic elegance to take on the very modern sheerness of chiffon. "Just as the fabric drapes delicately and gracefully, herbal, musky angelica adds a layer of depth and intrigue to the fragrance, creating an experience that is both airy and profound," the perfumer adds. The gauzy, green floral blend is enhanced by yet another musky note: warm, sensuous Cashmeran™. Fragrance family: Floral Green. Top notes: Galbanum Essence, Bergamot Essence, Pink Pepper Heart notes: Rose Essence Rosifolia Base notes: Angelica Essence, Musk Cashmeran™ The inspiration, 1968: The year Yves Saint Laurent unveiled the See-Through Blouse and redefined the boundaries of fashion and femininity. It was a garment that sparked a revolution, its diaphanous fabric a symbol of liberation, its audacity a challenge to convention. The blouse became an instant icon, anchoring its place in fashion history as a tribute to Yves Saint Laurent’s unparalleled ability to fuse impertinent sensuality. Despite its sheerness and provocative nature, the blouse is an emblem of the YSL style. The masterful tailoring, the impeccable drape of the fabric, and the minimalist design perfectly embody the couture's commitment to luxurious simplicity. By daring to reveal the female form in a way that was both impertinent and elegant, the blouse challenged conventional notions of femininity. It embodied the YSL spirit: strong, confident, and in control of her sexuality.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain L’Heure Bleue Perfume, 30ml
listings.description: The perfume both suggests and imposes the memory of she who wears it… she is an elegant, tender woman of secret sensuality. An armful of suave and delicate flowers enveloped in a breath of powder takes wing toward Amber notes. Floral, aromatic and very romantic, L’Heure Bleue can be qualified as a true masterpiece, a monument in the history of perfumery.Fragrance description:Floral. Endearing, unsettling, captivating the top notes of the fragrance sweeps you into the freshness of bergamot and the audacity of an aniseed note. The heart’s carnation and neroli accord intoxicates with a little spice, a little freshness and a lot of sensuality. Most troubling is the powdery, Amber dry-down that gives L’Heure Bleue its suave fragrance, in the powdery note of iris and violet, and the gourmand note of vanilla, benzoin and tonka bean. The perfume, enveloped in velvety warmth takes on a texture so soft and captivating, it’s like a silk veil on a woman’s bare skin.30ml

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Intense Eau de Parfum 30ml

This captivating scent is inspired by the unique and surprising findings deep in the woods – vibrant, colourful, and unexpected. This beautiful interpretation of nature ignites the wearer’s sense of adventure and wanderlust. The bottle: Housed in a clear glass bottle, the light green hue of Daisy Wild Eau So Intense shimmers beneath the iconic Daisy crown, adorned with flowers in a palette of rich, colourful hues. The fragrance: Evoking a fragrant escape to a place where adventure blossoms, Daisy Wild Eau So Intense is designed for the daring and free-spirited. Perfect for spring and summer days, each spritz of the perfume captures the spirit of wanderlust and a world full of colour and unexpected beauty. How to use: Apply this Marc Jacobs fragrance to the pulse points on your wrists, neck, chest and behind the ears.

listings.rawTitle: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Precious Oud  Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: The House of Van Cleef & Arpel's couture perfumery collection 'Collection Extraordinaire' is an exquisite collection of rare and luxurious fragrances. The beauty of nature, which is always a major source of inspiration for Van Cleef & Arpels High Jewellery, is elementary to these compositions. The perfumer has chosen to interpret Oud essence and associate it with flowers. The top note is bright and sparkling bergamot set off with pink peppercorn whilst already hinting at the tonality of the perfume with the scent of opulent incense. The heart note is a vibrant bouquet of the most beautiful flowers - sensual jasmine accompanied by tuberose. There is a woody note of patchouli, and the base notes, opulent, rich and precious, surround the mythical Oud with woody notes of sandalwood and vetiver and enveloping it in accents of amber. listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Lavande 31 Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Lavender? Perhaps you conjured up an image of your grandmother’s wall-papered bathroom, with a bar of purple soap sitting next to the sink. Or an old-fashioned barbershop, with whiffs of lavender mixed with oak moss floating in the air. In true Le Labo form, Lavande 31 knocks all preconceived notions of lavender on its head. Its bergamot and neroli essential oils give it a fresh lift-off to reveal a lavender of the greatest purity, where only the flower buds are distilled, giving the creation verticality and richness. Its foundation is pure Le Labo: ambery, dirty, and musky notes, blended with notes of Tonka to give the perfume a regressive classic style that is both clean and dirty, recognizable yet truly unique. Nope, this isn’t the lavender you thought you knew. Welcome to a new reality.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Cedrus Solid Perfume Refills, 2 x 3g
listings.description: The perfumer-artists of Chloé Atelier des Fleurs fragrances guide your eyes and nose toward some utterly singular flowers, revealing their imperfect charm. Paying tribute to the pioneering vision of Gaby Aghion, they shed light on the unknown facets of well-known flowers, all to reveal the beauty of the unexplored. Chloé presents Atelier des Sens. A new door opens in the atelier, where we discover new sensorial gestures and nomadic perfume rituals. The iconic fragrances of L'Atelier des Fleurs are being reinvented in the form of this elegant and refined solid perfume, allowing you to take the unique flowers of the collection everywhere with you. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Solid Perfume refill is infused with Cedrus, one of the line's most emblematic fragrances. For Cedrus, Quentin Bisch reinvents the typically dry cedar into a supple, enveloping cloth. The silky wood brightens thanks to a refined trio of cedar, vetiver and sandalwood, in contrast to an abstract floral note. Its melting balm texture allows you to scent your skin in one smooth gesture, easily applied to pulse points. Whether used alone for a more intimate Chloé fragrance experience or layered with your perfume so it lasts all day, it becomes the perfect companion for quick touch-ups. Its vegan formula contains at least 93% naturally derived ingredients. How to use: Scent your skin by applying Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Cedrus Solid Perfume melting balm texture on your pulse points with one smooth gesture.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Plage du Figuier Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Mediterranean Essences by Atelier des Fleurs explore unknown facets of well-known ingredients from the South of France, drawing on the Mediterranean heritage of Gaby Aghion, Chloé's founder. With Atelier des Fleurs Plage du Figuier, perfumer Ane Ayo unveils a warm and sun-drenched fig, revealing its fleshy, pulpy facets. The Mediterranean Essences Eau de Parfum bottles embrace the iconic codes of Chloé, with an undulating glass shape recalling the plissé soleil, a warm green hue, and a textured sand-coloured cap. How to use: For a beautiful, long-lasting fruity, floral fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists.

An energising scent, brimming with the season's optimism.

listings.description: A heady and distinguished combination of Musk and Coffee, this fragrance captivates the senses, unsettling all around you. A fragrance for the initiated on a quest for transcendent experiences. Amber Spicy. Made in France Unisex Cruelty-free Fragrance notes: Coffee, Musk, Vanilla, Patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS Bottled Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Be the Man of Today: Every hour of every day, with BOSS Bottled. BOSS BOTTLED unveils the next chapter of the Man of Today campaign with a new mission: to inspire men to show the world who they are through their actions, and the values by which they live their lives. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Cuir Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Sublime and refined, yet with a timelessly rebellious edge, nothing spells YSL better than leather. Its provocative signature finds its most elegant expression with the ultimate luxury in fragrance: Oud wood, as deep, dark and intense as the blackest leather. The olfaction: Today, with Cuir, the precious couture material expresses its innate power through an ingredient more precious than gold: sublime oud. Deep, dark and intense as the blackest leather. The epitome of refinement and animal magnetism. To fully express the rebellious elegance of YSL leather, Master Perfumer Fabrice Pellegrin has selected "a true gem." This priceless oud has leathery, animalic, elegant, woody and ambery facets. "Because I was born in Grasse, I have a special relationship with these sorts of ingredients", he explains, "and I am always seeking out new olfactory profiles. When I first discovered it years ago, oud was a true revelation. For me, it is the woody note of tomorrow." With Cuir, he has given the classic ingredient a strikingly edgy twist, matching it with a wholly unexpected partner: violet leaf. "The texture and patina of oud are lightened and enhanced by the violet leaf note, whose sensation is tinged with floral softness," Fabrice Pellegrin explains. Strikingly elegant, modern, CUIR feels just as sleek, tough and sexy as a sharply tailored black leather blazer or trench. Fragrance family: Woody Leathery. Top notes: Mandarine Essence, Cardamom Essence, Violet Leaf Absolu Heart notes: Clove Essence, Oud Assafi Essence, Suede Accord Base notes: Patchouli Heart, Cedarwood Heart, Bourbon Vanilla, Sandalwood Heart The inspiration: In 1960, Yves Saint Laurent, playing by his own rules, was the first to send a black leather jacket on a couture runway, in a disruptive collection. From the Swinging Sixties to the 21st century, leather has remained one of Yves Saint Laurent’s most provocative signatures. A sex symbol that can hug skin erotically or sheath the body like armour. Playing on the tension between tough masculinity and feminine sensuality. Morphing from rock icon to timeless elegance without losing any of its rebellious edge. Leather embodies the captivating duality of the YSL style. Tough yet tender, rebellious yet elegant, resulting in a look of powerful grace. From innovative cutting techniques to unexpected colour palettes, YSL sublimes this classic material, ensuring its relevance in the ever-evolving world of fashion. Leather is more than just a material for YSL; it is the incarnation of the brand's spirit: innovation and empowerment. It's the perfect medium for expressing the sublime, elegant, and rebellious attitude that defines Yves Saint Laurent.

listings.description: Enriched with rose wax, the new Miss Dior Eau de Parfum Mini Miss solid perfume, is a fragrance stick that leaves a trail of velvety floral notes on the skin. A new fragrance application by Dior, as elegant as it is practical. Apply this fragrance stick on pulse points – wrists, neck and décolleté: its soft and comfortable texture leaves only the scent of Miss Dior on the skin with no sticky residue. Composed of 82%* natural-origin ingredients, this fragrance stick’s alcohol-free formula keeps skin moisturised. Easy to take with you anywhere, this incredibly practical solid perfume is housed in a case woven with the iconic Dior houndstooth pattern. The allure of a true fashion accessory dressed in the colours of Miss Dior. The ideal stick fragrance for touch-ups that complements the Miss Dior Eau de Parfum spray, for a scent trail that stays with you all day long. *Amount calculated based on the ISO 16128-1 and ISO 16128-2 standard. The remaining 18% contribute to the formula’s performance, sensory appeal and stability. How to use: Apply the fragrance stick on pulse points - wrists, neck and décolleté - alone or as a complement to the Miss Dior Eau de Parfum fragrance. The texture leaves no colour on the skin, only the velvety and sensual scent of Miss Dior Eau de Parfum.

Created to define a new world order for a defiantly rebellious tribe, Rabanne Beauty inspires new generations to push the limits of creativity. Truly. Madly. Deeply in love. listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Rose Amira Eau de Parfum, 125ml
listings.description: The Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Rose Amira, a nocturnal tribute to the queen of flowers, an essential scent and perfumery icon. In this journey to the heart of a Persian garden, rose reveals its most sensual fragrance. Shot through with the sacred swirls of frankincense and the warmth of patchouli, the majestic flower unfolds with a blend of strength and softness in a halo of musks. "Rose Amira is my vision of rose, sumptuous and sensual within the secrecy of the night. A rose stood upright, turned towards the moon, within a poetic, nocturnal fragrance." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. Absolus Allegoria, the absolute fragrance collection, is an enchanting and mysterious journey to the heart of the world’s wonders once night falls: fragrance trails celebrating deep and powerful nature, revealed by striking contrasts by moonlight. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, Absolus Allegoria fragrances contain up to 90% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Rose Amira comes in the Allegoria collection’s emblematic bottle which is made in France using 15% recycled glass. Featuring a removable spray pump and transparent lacquer finish, its design can be easily recycled. *90% to 94% of ingredients are of natural origin, in accordance with ISO 16128. Calculation includes water.

listings.rawTitle: GP & J Baker Oriental Bird Made to Measure Curtains or Roman Blind, Eau De Nil
listings.description: Flowers and small exotic birds perch on branches on this linen fabric from the GP & J Baker archives. Because it’s made just for you... As this product is made to order according to your requirements the image above is there as a guide and may not be representative of the finished item. We've reproduced the product as best we can but pattern placement and texture of the fabric will vary depending on your measurements. If the width of your window is greater than the specified width of this fabric we'll join pieces together and pattern match the seams. Made by us at our textile factory in Lancashire Since 1953, our expert Partners have designed and manufactured a range of high-quality textiles at our UK factory, Herbert Parkinson. This includes our naturally filled bedding and our Made to Measure service for curtains, blinds and cushions. Combining traditional handmade processes with state-of-the-art technology, our skilled Partners see each product through the entire creation process, ensuring it meets the design and quality standards we’re known for. It takes up to 17 Partners to make a pair of curtains or a roman blind as each is experienced in a particular part of the process, including everything from cutting and joining, to pinning and hemming, to inspecting and packing. You can be assured that your curtains or blind are being made by true experts. We want you to be as proud of it as we are.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Addict Purple Glow Eau de Parfum 30ml

Its trail unfurls Tuscan iris with crystallised petals, enhanced by candied raspberry accents and enveloped in a creamy vanilla and musk base.
