listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Gabrielle CHANEL Essence Eau de Parfum Refillable Purse Spray, 3 x 7ml
listings.description: The limited-edition GABRIELLE CHANEL ESSENCE Purse Spray offers an irresistible, intuitive fragrance experience. Its golden case, adorned with a double chain strap, presents as a piece of jewellery that can be worn around the wrist. A 7ml format that can be taken anywhere on the go to refresh the floral, solar notes of the fragrance throughout the day. Thanks to its double chain strap, this jewellery accessory can be worn around the wrist or slipped into a bag, allowing you to take the refillable 7ml fragrance anywhere with you on the go. The GABRIELLE CHANEL ESSENCE Purse Spray comes with two refills. A set of three refills is also available.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden Rosa Incandescente Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden reimagines the four stages of ancient alchemy. The Ignis stage: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden Rosa Incandescente Eau de Parfum. Forged like a fire in the ocean from honeyed Damascena Rose and salty Red Seaweed. Incandescent. Mystical. Transcendent. Fragrance family: Floral, Marine. Like a powerful storm rolling off the ocean towards a fire-loving land, Rosa Incandescente Eau de Parfum transports you beyond your wildest imagination. An undiscovered treasure forged through the blazing chaos between shore and sea, salty Red Seaweed crashes into honeyed Damascena Rose. The pure essence of Red Seaweed is revealed through a modern supercritical fluid extraction technique that preserves its marine beauty. A truly unique sillage of extreme and unusual beauty. The bottle: Rosa Incandescente Eau de Parfum’s red glass bottle is adorned with a seahorse. Guided by the creature’s mystical presence, the scent transcends your spirit by burning the boundaries between art and science. Olfactive alchemist: Perfumers Cecile Matton and Ralf Schwieger created this exceptional Floral Marine jewel by bringing together their respective skills for utilising imperfections and enhancing the imagined colour of an olfactive ingredient. Freeing their minds from the usual constraints, they worked in tandem to bring these two free-spirited ideas into one, a fascinating combination rarely seen before. How to use: To enjoy the addictive notes of this Gucci perfume for longer, it is recommended to apply it to the body’s pulse points, including the wrists, neck, chest, and behind the ears. Designed to be layered with other fragrances, create your own unique scent with other Eaux de Parfum from the Gucci Alchemist’s Garden collection.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Absolue Les Parfums I Flamed A Rose Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: In this land where nature's grandeur lives untamed, we grow a rose like no other. Absolue Les Parfums, a radical collection dedicated to our rose, born in our domain. Our first-ever rose-dedicated haute-parfumerie collection composed of 11 scents unveils our exclusive centifolia rose like you've never smelled before. Reinventing perfumery's iconic ingredient. I Flamed A Rose Eau de Parfum with Patchouli and Amber. Burning with fire, the rose is fearless and dangerous. Riding with deep patchouli, she becomes untameable. Her defying spirit is only equalled by her legendary beauty. Encountering deep masculine vetiver, perfectly paired with earthy patchouli, our rose is sensual yet balanced and harmonious. Meet The Perfumer. Daphné Bugey: "Between the elegance and carnal extravagance, a rose dressed in the depths of woods and amber... I was inspired by the duality of the rose, between its elegance and its sensuality." How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man In Black Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Man in Black Parfum is a darker, more enigmatic expression of Fire, unveiling a deeper and mysterious intensity. From the first bright spark to the smouldering embers, this fragrance captures the untamed power of a flame, revealing its duality, bold yet mysterious. The elemental force is part of a deeper inspiration that unites the entire Bvlgari Man collection. At its heart lies the Circle of Nature: a visual and narrative journey through the geometry of nature, capturing the eternal essence of the elements. For Bvlgari Man, the Circle of Nature holds profound meaning. More than just a shape, it is a force that governs all life, the eternal essence of nature, timeless and ever flowing. The circular symbolism also echoes the refillable design of the Bvlgari Man flacon and the Bvlgari Bvlgari engravings on the cap, reinforcing a connection to nature and timeless craftsmanship. The Bvlgari Man flacon reflects the Maison’s unmistakable style, where the geometric precision of Roman architecture meets the bold modernity of Italian design. With its clean lines, structured silhouette, and refined finish, it embodies both audacity and elegance. Moreover, the matte black of Man in Black evokes lava stone polished by Fire. Beyond design, the packaging also encompasses the use of sustainable materials. Overall, the newly designed Bvlgari Man in Black flacon features 34% PCR (post-consumer recycled) materials, including 40% recycled glass and 28% recycled plastic. To enhance usability, the new packaging features a removable cap that protects the atomiser and reveals a circular aluminium plate engraved with the Bvlgari Bvlgari logotype. Reinforcing its commitment to making the flacon last longer, the collection embraces a fully refillable design. Each fragrance in the collection is offered in a dedicated 200ml refill, compatible with all flacon sizes: 60ml, 100ml, and 150ml.

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Lift Me Up Eau de Parfum, 90ml
listings.description: Lift Me Up captures the force of the sun, from the first golden ray to the last lingering glow. This floral-amber fragrance channels the sun’s revitalising energy to awaken your senses and uplift your spirit. Whether you’re seeking stress relief, a burst of summer vibes, or simply a brighter outlook, Lift Me Up is your gateway to an instant lift in mood. A scent that soothes and empowers, elevating your mindset to a sunnier, more luminous version of yourself. Notes of Ylang-Ylang, Bergamot, and Magnolia burst with intensity, while an overdose of Musk fuses with the skin, releasing waves of warmth and vitality. The richness of roasted Tonka beans and Vanilla adds addictive depth, creating a sun-kissed perfume that feels like a never-ending summer. Backed by science. Driven by emotion Designed to energise, empower, and connect Let the sunshine in, and keep summer alive all year long All our fragrances are unisex and made in France

Top notes: Mandarin oil (Sicily), Cinnamon oil (Ceylon) Heart notes: Saffron accord Iris oil (Florence) Base notes: Amyris oil (Caribbean), Vanilla accord, Tonka beans absolute (Brazil) Ambery. Woody.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Spirit Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: A new chapter for Montblanc unfolds with LEGEND Spirit. The heritage brand, well known for its sophistication and pursuit of excellence, has created a fragrance for a man with a truly independent spirit. Inspired by modern shades of white, LEGEND Spirit is a breath-taking composition, a fresh, intense fragrance. The top notes are sparkling with pink peppercorn, bitter grapefruit and zesty bergamot. Its powerfully aromatic heart beats wildly, with intense lavender and cardamom. A sensual blend with oak moss, the unique signature scent of Montblanc LEGEND, softened with a cocktail of white musk, cashmere and blonde woods.

Discover the Givenchy Post Office and send the most precious present to your loved ones. listings.rawTitle: Hermès Voyage d'Hermès Parfum Refillable, 100ml
listings.description: A lively, giving fragrance in which the freshness of juniper berries blends with the milky warmth of sandalwood and the sensuality of amber. "An invitation to discover, meet and share." Jean-Claude Ellena. A novel that feeds on the imagination, Voyage d’Hermès expresses the long-standing and unusual relationship between the house and travel. An interplay of paradoxes, complements and unexpected alliances supports the premise of woody notes that are fresh yet musky, familiar yet surprising, hovering between impulsive and comforting, equally at ease with men as with women. Hermès designer Philippe Mouquet created a travel object bottle for Voyage d’Hermès, designed for journeys and symbolic of movement. How to use: A wide gesture draws out the intense and lingering sillage of the Voyage d'Hermès fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Eau de Parfum Refillable 60ml
listings.description: MYSLF, the new masculine refillable fragrance by Yves Saint Laurent. An expression of who you are, with all your nuances. A statement of modern masculinity, for embracing all your facets and emotions. My scent, MYSLF. Austin Butler is the proud embodiment of MYSLF, as Global Fragrance Ambassador for YSL Beauty. YSL MYSLF scent: MYSLF is Yves Saint Laurent’s first woody floral scent. A prominent orange blossom heart blooms throughout the scent, complemented by a fresh and vibrant accord and underpinned by layers of sensual, textured woods. The fragrance is characterised by its bright and authentic scent, which combines radiant freshness with earthy woods and patchouli, creating a provoking and ever-evolving aroma. Equal parts of light and depth, emblematic of modern masculinity and all the nuance it encompasses. My scent, MYSLF. Top notes: fresh and vibrant accord with bergamot heart Heart notes: orange blossom absolute heart Base notes: wood accord with patchouli and Ambrofix™ YSL MYSLF bottle: A YSL silhouette in a bottle – sleek, timeless, and expertly crafted. Dressed in black lacquer, a high shine finish reveals yourself reflected alongside the iconic YSL Cassandre logo, sculpted directly into the glass at the heart of the fragrance. There is subtlety in the varying shades of black that run the length of the bottle, showcasing exquisite craftsmanship, and emblematic of the many facets of masculinity. Atop the fragrance, the angular lacquered cap is finished with an engraved, brushed metallic detail. YSL Beauty is committed to reducing its impact on the environment. All formats of MYSLF are refillable, with the additional purchase of a 150ml perfume refill, reducing the amount of packaging materials used to replenish your masculine fragrance. How to refill: Once the spray bottle is empty, take off the cap and unscrew the pump Screw the refill onto the bottle neck, then unlock it by turning it to the ON position. The fragrance will refill and automatically stop when full Turn the refill into the OFF position, remove it and screw the pump back in place How to use: Apply fragrance to clean, dry skin. For added intensity, apply to your pulse points and/or hot spots (wrists, inner elbows and lower neck). Here the heat of your body will allow the perfume to reveal its full trail. Include the shoulders and back to intensify your fragrance further.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani / Privé Les Eaux Thé Yulong Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Discover Armani/Privé's new unisex fragrance, Thé Yulong, taking you on a sensory journey through the legendary Chinese mountains, echoing the contrasting natural sensations of smoked black and vivacious green tea extracts. This unisex fragrance absorbs all facets and contrasts of tea as black and green tea are brought into subtle contact. The black tea evokes the hazy Yulong Mountains, while the green tea and sparkling citrus notes refresh the fragrance and evoke the snow-capped peaks that surround them. The combination results in a smoky, woody, yet fresh and citrusy fragrance. The new fragrance is encapsulated in the iconic Armani/ Privé squared bottle, which unveils a more modern and luminous look for the whole "Les Eaux" collection. A black shiny lacquered cap, creating contrasts between its curves and the sleekness of the squared bottle. The colour itself reveals the fragrance personality, like an infusion of tea, almost like a cloud. Key notes: Black & Green tea extracts Fragrance family: Citrus woody How to use: Apply on pulse points: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Musc Nude Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: For Her Musc Nude Eau de Parfum by Narciso Rodriguez. The sensual new perfume for women. Discover For Her Musc Nude Eau de Parfum — the new vegan perfume for women by Narciso Rodriguez that’s filled with sensuality. Enveloping the body in a soft breeze, the fragrance wraps around you like a protective armour that’s as tender as a second skin. A celebration of eternal femininity, it’s a peaceful breath of perfume that brings a gentle rhythm to your inner symphony. A hidden secret to form part of a caring daily ritual like a most precious treasure. A soft and gentle floriental musk perfume: With For Her Musc Nude, renowned perfumer Sonia Constant — nose for some of the most iconic For Her scents — has created a new interpretation of the chypre fragrance family. The Eau de Parfum is composed around an elegant and timeless olfactive structure, enhanced with solar facets and the signature Narciso Rodriguez heart of musk. A piquant pink peppercorn accord meets an abstract floral bouquet of delicate white flowers as the fragrance gently caresses the skin. At the perfume’s core, the For Her heart of musk is infused with floral notes of precious rose oil and orange blossom. As the fragrance dries down, rich tonka bean absolute blends with the softness of cedarwood and patchouli, embracing you in a feeling of caring warmth. A nude pink perfume bottle: For Her Musc Nude revisits the iconic for her bottle with an all-over nude pink in a frosted finish and a matte cap in a matching shade — for a design that is as softly enveloping as the fragrance within. Reflecting the perfume’s elegance, the bottle’s sophisticated lines create a precious object of aesthetic harmony. A more eco-conscious approach to fragrance: For Her Musc Nude takes a more eco-friendly approach to perfume. The packaging is also eco-conscious, with no internal lacquering for the bottle and a box made from 100% FSCTM paper. Top notes: Pink Peppercorn, Abstract floral bouquet, Fresh jasmine Heart notes: Heart of Musc, Rose oil, Orange flower Base notes: Tonka bean, absolute cashmeran, patchouli How to use: The sensual art of the perfume ritual: The art of musk perfume ritual is a sensorial moment to be cherished every day as part of your self-care routine. The key to making your perfume last longer begins with skincare. Start by hydrating your skin so that your fragrance can bind to the moisture molecules and last all day Customise your fragrance with the art of layering. Combine For Her Musc Nude with Narciso Rodriguez For Her Pure Musc to create a unique signature scent that expresses your authenticity. Start by spraying an enveloping mist of For Her Pure Musc onto your skin Then, spray For Her Musc Nude to your pulse points — your wrists, inner elbows, décolleté, and behind the ears — to allow it to gently diffuse as it is warmed by your body

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 + Cistus Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: The most minimal fragrance is a single aroma-molecule: Molecule 01. The next most minimal adds 1 to 01: 01 + 1. This is Molecule +. Molecule 01 + Cistus consists of Iso E Super + Cistus. Iso E Super is an abstract synthetic molecule with a cedarwood tonality and a warm, velvety cocooning sensation. It is one of those scents that makes you want to nestle into it. Cistus is derived from the resin of the Mediterranean Cistus ladanifer shrub, with a warm, resinous, and slightly smoky aroma. In Molecule 01 + Cistus, Iso E Super meets the raw sensuality of Cistus. The result? Radiant depth. A haze of warmth, sheer and lasting. Cistus is a note that lingers like heat on the skin. Cistus is resin tapped from a wild Mediterranean shrub. Sticky, golden, intense. It smells of labdanum but brighter – amber with a sunlit edge. Smoky, mineral, with leathery undertones that ground the sweetness. Cistus is a cut of labdanum, a plant which grows everywhere in the Mediterranean, which we've also used in Escentric 05 for that alternative summer impression. Here, with M+ Cistus, it gives you this particular leatheriness with all its sweet and salty aspects. We use 4% of that Cistus absolute. That's a lot, which is why you can smell it throughout the fragrance from top to bottom. Cistus is one of the supra accords; it's powerful. For people who like strong expressions, you can't go wrong with it. "When pairing just one ingredient with Iso E Super, it's hard to tell what happens. This stuff is really a miracle. And with Cistus, I thought the result was beautiful," says Geza Schoen, co-founder and master perfumer at Escentric Molecules. The latest M+ offering, M+ Cistus, is a study in contrast - sweet and leathery, smooth and animalic, quiet and insistent.

Perfectly balanced with soft accents of nutmeg, violet, cardamom, and rose. Compelling and dynamic, CK One is a dialogue between the masculine and feminine. CK One is revolutionary, rejecting traditional gender stereotypes and harmonizing feminine floral and masculine musk into one unisex scent, appealing to men and women alike. listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Oud Maracuja Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Oud Maracuja is a highly concentrated vegan perfume extract developed in collaboration with perfumer Jordi Fernandez. Inspired by the moment Thibaud Crivelli discovered Oud, a powerful, surprising and intense shock to the senses. Oud Maracujá opens with a fruity, luminous accord that features bright, exotic accents of passion fruit and ebelia (blackcurrant). The radiance of the top notes is accentuated by saffron, which provides a sensual, spicy twist, as well as Turkish rose absolute, which completes the accord with its fruity, honeyed, full-bodied qualities. The heart is defined by the power and complexity of an oud wood accord and its deep, voluptuous nuances. This woody oud facet is enhanced by the earthy notes of Indonesian patchouli, while the extraordinary softness of benzoin from Laos contributes to its well-rounded feel. The creation's base notes revolve around leather, incense, an amber vanilla and labdanum accord, and a touch of akigalawood (patchouli and agarwood) that reinforces the power and long-lasting wear of the fragrance. Unisex. Fragrance family: Citrus, Floral, Leather. Top notes: Mandarin, cardamom, pink peppercorn Middle notes: Orange blossom, neroli, petitgrain Base notes: Saffiano leather, vetiver

listings.description: Fame Parfum. Reveal the most glamorous facets of modern femininity with an intensified edition of the original Fame fragrance by Rabanne. The intense woody chypre fragrance captures the essence of evenings in Paris, as precious jasmine and rich incense combine and mesmerize with a hypnotic effect. listings.description: Eau Capitale is the first Diptyque Chypre. It opens with the freshness of “vert de bergamote” tempering its consummate voluptuousness. Fruity, yes, yet lively and zesty. Was it studded with pink peppercorns to recall the pomanders - oranges pricked with cloves - once brought back from England by Desmond? Or to orchestrate the eagerly awaited “olfactory accident”? Between the flower and the spice is like an exclamation mark, a Capital letter.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by today’s bold young girls, Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel created Twilly d’Hermès in 2017, embodying the free spirit of a tribe of girls. With its spicy, floral fragrance, the Eau de Parfum expresses its impertinence with the vigour of fresh ginger, the light-heartedness of delicate tuberose and the milky notes of sandalwood. Designed by Florence Manlik, the lantern-shaped bottle has a square silhouette and coral pink colour. A unique, hand-tied silk ribbon playfully embellishes it. Twilly d’Hermès is a name that evokes the know-how of Hermès silk on two fronts: it calls to mind the house’s silk twill scarf as well as the twilly, a small, colourful silk ribbon that can be worn in countless ways.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Vanilla Planifolia Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Good to know: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs is being re-branded, the logo on your products may differ from the photos. The scent is still the same. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs invites you to compose your personalised Chloé fragrance as though arranging your favourite blossoms in a bouquet at a Parisian flower shop. Each perfume in the collection reveals a single floral, aromatic or woody scent rooted in the perfumer’s memory. Wear alone like a corsage or combine endlessly to create a lovely present or a perfume for all occasions. A flower, a perfumer, a story... Vanilla Planifolia, a floral perfume for women by Quentin Bisch. As a budding perfumer, Quentin Bisch learnt that vanilla comes from a rare orchid. Ever since he dreamt of crafting an Eau de Parfum around this rare flower. Vanilla Planifolia is his ideal composition, evoking delicate, deliciously spicy petals that reveal the alluring mysteries of an enveloping, almost carnal flower. Sweet, sensual and addictive, this enticing women's fragrance is good enough to eat. This Chloé perfume is housed in an elegant pleated glass bottle topped with an ivory cap that appears to be carved in stone. Touches of gold at the neckband and label trim enhance the light hue of each beautiful fragrance. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists. Wear your favourite flower on its own to celebrate its vitality and intensity, or combine Vanilla Planifolia with other perfumes from Atelier des Fleurs to create a personalised fragrance bouquet. Disclaimer: Packaging may vary but scent remains the same.

Floral Musk and Ylang Ylang from the Comoros underline its floral facet.

listings.rawTitle: MATIERE PREMIERE Neroli Oranger Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The purity of orange blossom is the starting point for MATIERE PREMIERE's Neroli Oranger eau de parfum. The brand takes great care in sourcing its ingredients, drawing the fresh, vibrant heart of this fragrance from Italian bergamot and neroli oil from Lebanon. Floral Musk and Ylang Ylang from the Comoros underline its floral facet.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Springtime in a Park Eau de Toilette
listings.description: The memory of spending springtime in the Park. Take a stroll past the cherry trees as the warm sun peaks through the clouds. You’re surrounded by the fresh, vibrant scent of blossom. Springtime in the Park is a delicate, floral and fruity fragrance. Transport yourself to a beautiful spring afternoon. A perfectly light, every day, unisex perfume. From Maison Margiela’s Replica collection. Made In France. Top notes: Pear accord, Bergamont Essence, Blackcurrant Accord Middle Notes: Lily of the Valley Accord, Jasmine Grandiflorum Absolute, Rose Damascena Absolute Base Notes: Musks, Vanilla Accord Family: Fruity

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Eucalyptus 20 Eau de Parfum 15ml
listings.description: Picture a place so vast, so remote you can journey weeks without encountering another soul. Endless miles of rolling red sand, endless miles of sky. In the unforgiving heat, a lone white tree on the next horizon can feel like an illusion. But the eucalyptus is the oasis, a waystation where tumbleweeds and rusting dust come to settle in the hallowed shade of silver leaves. This is the inspiration for Eucalyptus 20, the unambiguous scent of vastness, where the freshness of eucalyptus and cedarwood is softened by the leathery warmth of labdanum and grounded on a bed of musk notes and frankincense. And so, with this scent comes an invitation: Get off the grid. Go walkabout. Scent Notes: Eucalyptus, Cedarwood, Red Thyme, Olibanum, Labdanum, Gurjun Balsam, Hyssop, Musk. Available in: 15ml, 50ml & 100ml.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Sauvage Eau Forte Parfum 60ml
listings.description: The legendary freshness of Sauvage strengthened and prolonged by the power of water. A strength made possible by an innovative alcohol-free formula exclusive to Dior. Inspired by the symbolic power of water, Francis Kurkdjian, Dior Perfume Creative Director, imagined Sauvage Eau Forte, an olfactory composition as fresh as an eau de toilette and as intense as a parfum. This creation explores the uncharted territory of a fresh and spicy fougère. Strengthened by the freshness of water that 'drenches' the ingredients, the scent of the fragrance is composed around notes of cool spices, blanched lavender and musky woods. Sauvage Eau Forte, a striking and invigorating scent powered by water. How to use: Spray Sauvage Eau Forte generously for an intense trail and long-lasting freshness. Its revolutionary alcohol-free composition is characterised by a cloudy-coloured formula, which disappears upon contact with the skin or fabric.

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque L'Ombre Dans L'Eau Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Poetically named L’Ombre dans l’Eau, “The Shadow in the Water,” it is a fragrance that recalls a lush garden at water’s edge and a brief glimpse of life.Tuberose asserts itself, expressing all its sunny, hazy, creamy, indolent seductiveness. Anyone with blood in their veins will succumb to the irresistible temptation of this insolently seductive white flower.

listings.rawTitle: Polo Ralph Lauren Blue Eau de Toilette Spray, 75ml
listings.description: For Polo Blue Eau de Toilette, Ralph Lauren wanted to bottle the freedom of the blue sky, the energy of the open waters and the warmth of the sun on your back in one unique fragrance. Initially fresh, Melon and Cucumber bring to this fragrance an invigorating burst of freshness; lush, masculine and energising. The aromatic heart notes of Sage, Geranium and Basil create a natural, aromatic sensuality. Finally, the warm and enveloping base notes of Suede, Patchouli and Sheer Musk ensure that this perfume has a long-lasting and unique trail. Fresh, invigorating and clean.

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Tilbury Cosmic Power Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: “This is empowerment in a bottle. “Discover a blend of empowering emotion-boosting molecules - mystical amber accord, bold black pepper oil, divine cinnamon bark oil and enchanting vanilla bean extract – that help connect you to your inner self, and invite feelings of empowerment. “This fragrance is like a portal of protection that lets your frequency cascade! it’s like setting your intention for the day, aiding feelings of empowerment! “Balanced with frankincense accord, bergamot oil, musks, elemi oil and opulent rose ultimate, these floral spicy notes help supercharge your senses, leaving you feeling energised! It feels like being transported to a higher frequency! “This fragrance is like pure Unicorn energy!” Charlotte Tilbury. Cosmic Power is a luxurious and opulent symphony of spices! Its unique and distinctive trail derives from the powerful combination of bold black pepper oil, divine cinnamon bark oil and fresh, woody elemi oil. The exquisite union of precious rose ultimate, mystical amber, ancient frankincense accord and enchanting vanilla bean extract create the warm, spicy and addictive signature of the fragrance. Cosmic Power is the perfect empowering scent that transports you on a magnetic journey into your inner self. Boost your feelings of empowerment and confidence with the emotion-boosting molecules of cosmic power! How does cosmic power enhance feelings of empowerment? Charlotte worked with scientist Céline Manetta at IFF, who used the IFF Scentcube™ algorithm to identify the perfect combination of notes to create a fragrance that helps boost feelings of empowerment! 89% agree the fragrance enhances feelings of empowerment** 84% agree they instantly felt more empowered** 85% agree the fragrance has an empowering effect** **Tested on 104 people over 1 week. Emotion-boosting molecules: Bold black pepper oil Divine cinnamon bark oil Captivating clove oil Mystical amber accord Enchanting vanilla bean extract Olfactive family: Ambery, Spicy. Magic fragrance notes: Top notes: Bold Black Pepper Oil, Divine Cinnamon Bark Oil, Uplifting Bergamot Oil, Fresh Woody Elemi Oil Heart notes: Opulent Rose Ultimate, Empowering Frankincense Accord Base notes: Mystical Amber Accord, Enchanting Vanilla Bean Extract, Powdery Musks

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette
listings.description: Bloom into your true self with the new Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette. Inspiring a journey of self-discovery built on the empowering notion of connecting through difference, the floral fragrance for women stays true to the original Bloom signature. The newest addition to the Bloom bouquet is a lighter, more luminous interpretation of the Bloom signature that gently encourages women to Bloom into the truest version of themselves. Characterised by a trio of Jasmine, Tuberose and Rangoon Creeper, it is now enlightened by a sweetened Neroli accord. Just like the scent unfurls as its name suggests, Gucci Bloom women flourish in a natural, expressive and individual way, without conventional limitations. The perfume for her is presented in a frosted and luminous square-shaped pink glass bottle to bring freshness and vitality. The Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette for women celebrate the vitality and diversity of those who identify with the House’s modern philosophy.

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Orphéon Perfumed Hair Mist, 30ml
listings.description: Orphéon: The spirit of the first moments of an evening at a historical Parisian bar. In 1960s Saint-Germain, the three Diptyque founders would meet at the Orphéon jazz club to dance, laugh, and converse in an atmosphere as vibrant as it was elegant. A beloved bar brimming with the effervescence of artistic possibility in a Parisian quarter that has always been cosmopolitan, spontaneous, and lively. Leaves a gentle layer on the hair. Whenever you move, Orphéon hair mist diffuses its notes of Juniper Berries, Tonka Bean and Cedar. With nourishing, protective camellia oil, as much a beauty gesture as a fragrancing gesture.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums La Decouverte Matieres Discovery Fragrance Gift Set, 3 x 10ml
listings.description: Each perfume in this collection turns the spotlight on one of the principal raw materials, whether natural or derived from synthetic molecules. The Collection Matières emphasises the importance of the choice of raw materials and of their origins, which is why travel and discovery are at the core of this collection. The starting point for the inspiration for each one of the fragrances is found in the raw material itself. From this raw material emerges distinctive and unexpected dimensions. Set contains: Tubereuse Imperiale Eau de Parfum, 10ml Oud Abramad Eau de Parfum, 10ml Crème de Cuir Eau de Parfum, 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Grand Soir Extrait de Parfum Roll-On Fragrance Gift Set, 4 x 4ml
listings.description: Discover the captivating Grand Soir Extrait de Parfum with this Precious Elixirs set. Presented in an elegant, travel-friendly 4ml roll-on bottle, this precious elixir can be applied to the inside of the wrist and crook of the elbow, the nape of the neck, the hairline, or the cleavage, revealing the sensual and luminous sillage of Grand Soir. Olfactory family: Ambery Woody. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Cistus Labdanum Heart notes: Lavandin, Cinnamon leaf Base notes: Vanilla amber accord Set contains: Grand Soir Extrait de Parfum Roll-On, 4 x 4ml

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Re-charge Black Pepper Eau de Parfum Travel Case Refill, 7.5ml
listings.description: Embrace hedonistic adventure with this iconic Eau de Parfum; best suited for the dynamic sophisticate. Bright bergamot and a flush of lavandin are emboldened by black and pink pepper in the heart, finished with earthy green vetiver for a deep, sensual base.

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Musk Oud Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Kilian Hennessy's Inspiration: A silken explosion of petals and musk. The Perfume: A contemporary, Western twist on classic Rose Oud, Musk Oud is a quiet expression of syrupy rose and geranium petals, silken musk and spices. A heady dry-down of oud accord, patchouli and musk anchor an intoxicating rum-filled opening. Going down smooth, as sweet as it is seductive, a new page for ancient oud is written. Perfume notes: Geranium, Davana, Oud. Perfumer: Alberto Morillas.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Chance Eau Tendre Eau de Toilette Twist and Spray, 3 x 20ml
listings.description: A floral-fruity fragrance in a round bottle. Soft and tender top notes sweep you into a whirlwind of happiness and fantasy. The "Twist And Spray" slips easily into your purse, the ideal way to revive your fragrance throughout the day. An olfactory encounter with chance. A floral-fruity fragrance that intertwines the green and fruity Grapefruit-Quince accord with the softness of Jasmine and the smoothness of White Musks. A tender and delicate fragrance with a poetic trail of scent. The eau de toilette comes in a spray for a more generous use, with an effortless application on skin or clothing. To revive the notes of the fragrance throughout the day, the "TWIST AND SPRAY" comes in a practical travel format which you can slip into your purse and take with you anywhere. A complete perfuming ritual for the bath and body is also available to enhance the fragrance trail. 20 ml format sold with 2 refills. Refills also sold separately (3 x 20 ml).

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Scarlet Beetroot Cologne, 30ml
listings.description: Colour is all around, just like a scarlet beetroot splendidly spied in the veggie patch. Notes of beetroot, vibrant blackcurrant, and a dash of patchouli create a delicious fruity scent. How to use: Spritz generously onto your wrists, neck and pulse points. Your body heat will help to diffuse the fragrance as the day goes on. Wear alone or layer with another cologne or your favourite bath and body products. Your Jo Malone London order will be exquisitely wrapped in their iconic box, tied with a beautiful grosgrain ribbon. Looking to find your new favourite scent in person? Visit our Jo Malone London boutiques inside selected John Lewis & Partners shops: Cheadle Chelmsford Cribbs Causeway Edinburgh Exeter High Wycombe Horsham Milton Keynes Oxford Street Reading Southampton Stratford White City

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Le Parfum 60ml
listings.description: MYSLF Le Parfum, the new radical intensity. Highly sensual, with a velvety vanilla and amber trail. MYSLF, the masculine refillable fragrance by Yves Saint Laurent. An expression of who you are, with all your nuances. A statement of modern masculinity, for embracing all your facets and emotions. My scent, MYSLF. Austin Butler is the proud embodiment of MYSLF, as Global Fragrance Ambassador for YSL Beauty. YSL MYSLF Le Parfum scent: More intense. More powerful. More sensual. MYSLF Le Parfum isn’t a reinvention of the original - it’s a radicalisation. With a lavish dose of orange blossom, paired with layers of textured wood, MYSLF is a woody floral fragrance. For MYSLF Le Parfum this floral-wood fusion discovers new depths. As it opens, the soaring shiny freshness of bergamot is met with a multifaceted cocktail of spices - the sweet warmth of cinnamon, the bite of black pepper, the zesty green of cardamom. Like velvety petals fusing with warm skin, the beating heart of the scent, orange blossom absolute, offers a floral note that is deeper, richer, and more honeyed than you’d expect. The enveloping dry down reveals textured woods alongside a silky vanilla Bourbon infusion, for an unmissable amber trail. Embrace your nuances. Own your contrasts. Find your signature. A sensual trail, born to last. Top notes: vibrant & spicy accord with black pepper essence Heart notes: radiant & rich orange blossom absolute heart Base notes: wood accord with velvety vanilla Bourbon infusion YSL MYSLF Le Parfum bottle: A YSL silhouette in a bottle – sleek, timeless, and expertly crafted. The intensity of the fragrance is reflected by the bold matte black lacquering of the glass. A powdery finish that reveals the design’s layers of luxurious detailing in a new light. The iconic YSL Cassandre logo, sculpted directly into the glass, catches the eye with a glossy finish, in contrast to the surrounding matte texture. Gifting YSL MYSLF: YSL MYSLF is the perfect scent to share. Give MYSLF to those most special to you. A luxurious gift to receive and treasure, suitable for all of life’s most celebrated occasions. How to use: Apply fragrance to clean, dry skin. For added intensity, apply to your pulse points and/or hot spots (wrists, inner elbows and lower neck). Here the heat of your body will allow the perfume to reveal its full trail. Include the shoulders and back to intensify your fragrance further.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne 1 Million Eau de Toilette Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: To celebrate its 60th anniversary, Rabanne lights up the dance floor beneath the shimmer of its disco ball. A thousand facets, one singular obsession: making every celebration electric. Disco Holidays is the most anticipated moment of the season. Bring the Rabanne glow. Set contains: 1 Million Eau de Toilette, 50ml 1 Million Deodorant Spray, 150ml 1 Million Travel Spray, 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Sunlit Clementine & Vetiver Eau de Parfum Travel Case Refill, 7.5ml
listings.description: The air of laid-back, summer sophistication; this citrus Eau de Parfum energises with lively rays of clementine and mandarin, rounded by a velvety heart of iris absolute and a smoky-earthy signature note of sustainable, rich Bourbon vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Oud Stallion Extrait de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Oud Stallion was inspired by personal memories of Thibaud Crivelli, during which he smelled oud wood while attending horse races. Oud Stallion contrasts the smoky allure of leather with the profound richness of oud wood, complemented by hints of amber and spice. Maison Crivelli was created with the aim of surprising people with mixed, daring olfactory creations that defy conventions and stand out from the classics.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Samsara Eau de Toilette, 75ml
listings.description: For almost two centuries, Guerlain has been a story of fragrance and beauty, legacy and creation, daring and exploration, heritage and the future. Our roots enrich the present and inspire the future. With more than 1,100 fragrances created since 1828 by five generations of perfumers, our heritage is unique. The Legendary fragrance collection pays tribute to this exceptional heritage. Samsara is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by 5 generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library, that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Samsara is an elixir of seduction for a woman who has found harmony and balance, which is notably conveyed through the composition's raw materials: the sandalwood and a jasmine used only for religious offerings until then. Designed by Georges Chevalier, its iconic 'inverted heart' bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Elixir Des Merveilles Eau de Parfum Refillable, 30ml
listings.description: Created by perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena, Élixir des Merveilles intensifies the magic of the Merveilles collection. The delight of a new star, a distillation of enchantment. With a woody and amber fragrance, the Eau de Parfum combines gourmet candied orange, enveloping benzoin and deep patchouli. On the Merveilles star-spangled magnifying-glass bottle, a magical orange glow grows ever more intense. The cap is engraved with the Hermès “clou de selle” seal. The cap is engraved with the Hermès “clou de selle” seal. With its 30 ml format, you can let your imagination run wild anytime and anywhere. The refillable bottle is designed to last. The Eau des Merveilles Constellation: The second opus in the Hermès Merveilles collection, Élixir des Merveilles offers a deeper olfactory interpretation.

listings.rawTitle: Fresh Lily Jasmine Eau de Parfum 9ml
listings.description: An alluring bouquet of wild lily of the valley. Breathe in a bouquet of white bell buds and feel the embrace of new beginnings with our alluring floral fragrance Lily Jasmine Eau de Parfum. Featuring notes of spring muguet, jasmine sambac, and dreamy lavender, this wild, optimistic fragrance is enclosed in an apothecary-style glass bottle.

listings.rawTitle: New Notes Magico Safrano Extrait de Parfum, 60ml
listings.description: Embark on an olfactory journey of golden spices and sacred woods. Magico Safrano is a luminous yet mysterious amber-woody fragrance that perfectly balances fiery warmth with smooth elegance. Opening with a spiced glow reminiscent of comforting chai masala, it unfolds into a velvety heart of rich resins and smoky tobacco before leaving a majestic, lingering trail of timeless woods. It is designed for those who appreciate cultural richness, sensual warmth, and luxurious sophistication. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Golden Saffron, Warm Cinnamon, Bright Tangerine, Pink Pepper, Spicy Nutmeg Heart notes: Delicate Muguet, Rich Labdanum, Warm Benzoin, Smoky Tobacco Base notes: Precious Woods, Leathery Notes, Mossy Notes, Amber Resins, Musk, Tonka Bean

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Eau de Cologne du Coq Spray, 100ml
listings.description: With this Eau de Cologne, Pierre-François-Pascal Guerlain managed to create a scent that is at once an honor for France and for the profession. Of rare elegance and subtle freshness, Eau de Cologne du Coq is simultaneously reserved and appealing, dry and aromatic, stimulating and vibrant. Suitable for both men and women and wearable at any hour, it is an excellent scent for summer. Eau de Cologne du Coq is all the delicate yet tangy freshness of a spring morning. As light as a gentle breeze, this eau is composed of citrus notes such as lemon, bergamot and orange as well as aromatic scents such as rosemary and lavender. 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Babycat Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Walk on the wild side with Babycat. A scent that will make you roar. The olfaction: In Babycat, the pod of the vanilla orchid remembers that, like the leopard, it is a creature of wild nature. To magnify its dark side and tease out its claws, the Master Perfumer has created a sensual, enveloping suede accord combining exotic spices and sizzling resins. A blend that extends the sensual leathery facets of vanilla for an exceptionally potent trail. Like the feline print that inspires it, Babycat’s untameable essence takes you for a walk on the wild side... Fragrance family: Woody Ambery. Top note: Pink Pepper Essence, Black Pepper Essence, Elemi Essence Heart note: Olibanum Essence & Resin, Saffron Accord Base note: Vanilla, Cedarwood, Suede Accord The inspiration: It’s raw. It’s couture. Forever iconic. A provocative classic. No one has gone wilder for the sensual feline flair of the leopard print than Yves Saint Laurent. It was first sighted in the couturier’s collections on a silk dress in 1968. Since then, from the iconic Fall/Winter 1982-1983 couture collection to today’s cult designs, Yves Saint Laurent’s Babycat print has prowled its way onto evening dresses, pussy-bow blouses, killer stilettos and countless covetable accessories. The leopard print is a symbol of untamed glamour. Deeply intertwined with the Yves Saint Laurent style, its presence throughout the house's history reflects not only a bold stylistic choice but also an affirmation of the YSL silhouette – fiercely raw and exquisitely sophisticated.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Silk Mood Extrait de Parfum, 70ml
listings.description: Oud Silk Mood is reminiscent of an airy fragrance combining the rustle of silk and the soft touch of a rose petal. Olfactory description: Rose from Bulgaria Blue chamomile from Morocco Natural oud from Laos Papyrus from India

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Magnolia Alba Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Good to know: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs is being re-branded, the logo on your products may differ from the photos. The scent is still the same. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs invites you to compose your personalised Chloé fragrance as though arranging your favourite blossoms in a bouquet at a Parisian flower shop. Each perfume in the collection reveals a single floral, aromatic or woody scent rooted in the perfumer’s memory. Wear alone like a corsage or combine endlessly to create a lovely present or a perfume for all occasions. A flower, a perfumer, a story... Magnolia Alba, a fresh perfume for women by Louise Turner. This captivating Eau de Parfum by Louise Turner unfolds around the fresh, almost creamy scent of magnolia petals and their promise of sunny days in her native England. To create this women’s fragrance, Turner transcribed the smooth, plump, slightly lemony notes of magnolia blossoms in spring. This Chloé perfume is housed in an elegant pleated glass bottle topped with an ivory cap that appears to be carved in stone. Touches of gold at the neckband and label trim enhance the light hue of each beautiful fragrance. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists. Wear your favourite flower on its own to celebrate its vitality and intensity, or combine Magnolia Alba with other perfumes from Atelier des Fleurs to create a personalised fragrance bouquet. Disclaimer: Packaging may vary but scent remains the same.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL N°5 Eau de Toilette Spray 75ml
listings.description: N°5 Eau de Toilette, a proclamation of authenticity and distinction. A woody abstract floral fragrance that is powerful and textured, an invitation to discover N°5 in a new light. The fragrance has been rereleased in a streamlined bottle inspired by the original 1924 design. Sleek and stripped of all frills, to better showcase this unexpected interpretation of N°5. How to use: The Eau de Toilette comes in a spray and can be applied generously to the skin or inside clothing in a broad sweeping motion. A complete scented bath and body ritual is available to prolong the trail of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Fleur de Lait Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A fruity floramber feminine fragrance, Miu Miu’s Fleur de Lait weaves sweet dreams out of memories. Joyful and indulgent, the blissful, easy pleasure of a milky treat whipped up with silky mango on a summer day. The witty twist of a flower that smells like fruit. The pure scent of fluffy addiction infused in an ultra-desirable Eau de Parfum by Miu Miu. Fragrance notes: Top note: Mango Accord Heart note: Osmanthus Base note: Coconut Milk Accord Fleur de Lait’s delicious fruity accord conjures the creamy scent and silky texture of juicy mango flesh. The exotic fruit melds with the delicate apricot facets of osmanthus petals. A mouthwatering palette of sunset hues, fluffed up in Fleur de Lait’s velvety coconut milk accord. Sweet dreams are made of this. About the bottle: In a playful variation on Miu Miu’s codes, the bottle of Fleur de lait evokes the sensual matelassé texture of the luxury house’s iconic leather handbags. Reflecting the name of the fragrance, the opaque glass turns milky white. A black and white Miu Miu tag ring circles the collar, topped with an opaque sequin-shaped stopper in the brand’s signature Azzurro blue. How to use: Exude the carefree spirit of a Miu Miu girl with your new signature scent - spray Fleur de Lait to the pulse points on your neck, collarbone, and wrist. To leave an even longer-lasting scent trail, apply to the crooks of your elbows and the back of the knees, which will intensify the fragrance with the warmth of your body heat.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Stronger With You Absolutely Parfum is an addictive fragrance for men, inspired by the power of absolute love. This powerful and sensual fragrance is boosted by an addictive new rum accord, while lavender, sustainably sourced in France, is irresistibly enhanced with liquorice and fruity facets. Warm vanilla, harvested in Madagascar while supporting local communities, and smoky cedar wood, carefully extracted in Virginia, USA, round up this powerful scent. Stronger With You Absolutely is enveloped by an intense smoky lacquering that conveys the absolute strength of the parfum. The union of Stronger With You Absolutely Parfum for him and Because It's You for her creates an irresistible couple, empowered by two strong individuals. Together, Stronger. An intense and sophisticated smoky-lacquering envelops the iconic Stronger With You bottle from the bottom to convey the absolute strength of the parfum. With Stronger With You Absolutely, Emporio Armani introduced a new powerful Fougere Ambery Amber scent. Rum Accord: The signature of glazed chestnut is boosted by an addictive new rum accord Lavender: Lavender, sustainably sourced in France, is enhanced with liquorice and fruity facets Vanilla & Cedar Wood: Smoky cedar wood, carefully extracted in Virginia, USA, and addictive vanilla, harvested in Madagascar while supporting local communities, round up this powerful and intoxicating scent

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Homme Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Guerlain Homme is an authentic call to adventure. Keen on discovery, man flourishes in a nature that he makes his own. Guerlain Homme Eau de Parfum revels in contrast: freshness and strength united in a mysterious and intense fragrance. This Eau de Parfum surprises with its vibrant freshness lent by the mojito accord, the fresh floral accord and the green woody accord, which come together in an intense composition. This strength ensures its powerful and refined trail. Guerlain Homme boasts a bolder, woodier personality. Citrus Aromatic Woody. Powerful, sensual, sophisticated. The mojito accord (sweet lime, peppermint, rum) is made explosive thanks to an extra splash of rum. The floral accord recalls freshness and refinement. The green woody accord is reorchestrated for a more powerful trail and sensuality. Patchouli, cedar and vetiver are enhanced.

listings.rawTitle: New Notes Latte Pistachio Extrait de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Experience the smooth, creamy joy of a warm summer's afternoon. Latte Pistachio captures the irresistible first taste of pistachio ice cream, perfectly blending comforting warmth with pure delight. Crafted for dreamers who embrace both elegance and fun, this fragrance is a delightful scoop of something sweet, waiting to be savoured. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Zesty Lemon, Sweet Orange, Irresistible Pistachio, Salty Notes Heart notes: Cardamom, Coriander, Creamy Milk Base notes: Sandalwood, Warm Amber, Musk

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Les Légendaires L’Heure Bleue 1912 Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Heir to Guerlain’s exceptional heritage, the Les Légendaires collection pays tribute to legendary creations composed by five generations of perfumers since 1828. Inspired by a series of love stories, both real and imagined, each fragrance infused with raw materials leaves a glorious scent of emotion in its wake. Discover L’Heure Bleue 1912, the fragrance of suspended time. It’s that time of day when day embraces night and silence fully envelopes the world. An expression of harmony, a moment of stillness and grace tinted with deep blue echoed in L’Heure Bleue, composed in 1912. Painting an impressionistic olfactory canvas, Jacques Guerlain merged the violet accord and iris with the creamy ivory of vanilla, leaving a bewitching fragrance trail of both fresh and warm nuances. Through this ambery floral, a tale of eternal love is told. In this moment of suspended time, when the night is "yet to find its star" as Jacques Guerlain described it, L’Heure Bleue 1912 marks the meeting of two soulmates destined to become one in the frisson of eternity. "The sun has just set, but night hasn’t yet fallen. Time is suspended... in a moment when man finally finds himself in harmony with the world and with light." Jacques Guerlain. With their emblematic, gem-like bottles, the famous inverted heart designed by George Chevalier, Les Légendaires transcend the passing of time, serving as immortal inspiration for the future.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Kelly Calèche Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: A generous floral harmony, a winning sweetness. "A perfume of leather and flowers, as light as an angel's wing." Jean-Claude Ellena. A reminder of a visit to the Hermès leather stores, Kelly Calèche is a light, feminine, joyous expression of leather. It gives a nod to two emblems of the house, and translates the perfumer's tactile and olfactory emotions into an evocation of leather worn next to the skin, gently tanned by the touch and embroidered with fresh petals. Key notes: Violet and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Sunflower Pop 50ml Eau de Parfum Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Get our Floral Street x Van Gogh Museum scent in a limited edition sustainable gift set, featuring a 50ml & 10ml Sunflower Pop Eau de Parfum. Smells like... A citrus, fruity fragrance. Joy-bringing and sun-soaked. Bursting with rays of optimism. A masterpiece in a bottle. Yellow-tipped sunflowers from the brush of Van Gogh inspire this bright blend of fresh mandarin, bursts of sustainably sourced Calabrian bergamot, vegan honey accord, and a pop of bellini accord. Sunflower Pop is a vibrant, sumptuous citrus blend to bring to life the beauty and optimism of Van Gogh’s ‘Sunflowers'. Our products are vegan and cruelty certified by the Vegan Society & PETA Our ingredients are all sustainably sourced Our packaging is reusable, recyclable or biodegradable Our pulp boxes are crafted with 1 upcycled waste coffee cup The Floral Street Difference: We’re a female-founded, independent British brand Our fragrances are crafted by Jerome Epinette, one of the world’s best master perfumers Containing 20% perfume oil, our fragrances are luxury Eau de Parfum We’re a multi-award-winning brand How to use: Spray onto pulse points and let your perfum dry without rubbing. Store in a cool dry place out of direct sunlight. Set contains: Sunflower Pop Eau de Parfum, 50ml Sunflower Pop Eau de Parfum, 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Arancia di Capri La Riserva Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: An intense and multi-nuanced fragrance from a two-month maceration process, evoking the succulent sensation of a freshly hand-peeled ripe orange on a breezy morning with hints of wild rosemary. An olfactory homage to the unspoiled beauty of Capri's natural landscape, Arancia di Capri La Riserva is crafted from a two-month maceration process, infusing it with depth and texture that results in a full, intense, and silky essence. The light is scintillating, golden, and radiant, where each note harmonises in a beautiful balance, thanks to the prolonged development. Zesty Italian blood orange, mandarin, and petitgrain bigarade essences greet with freshness while the heart unfolds with the aromatic blend of rosemary and Italian basil essences, enhanced by a salty mineral accord. Finally, the base notes of cedarwood and ambrettolide, paired with a soft and embracing suede accord, leave a warm and lasting impression, bringing depth to the fragrance. Arancia di Capri La Riserva features a cap and bottle in a new, more intense shade of blue, embodying the long-lasting sillage of the fragrance. The fragrance comes in an enlarged hatbox, complemented by a refreshed label with updated finishings.

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Eau de Lierre Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: Ivy is a symbol of fidelity and attachment but ivy's scent cannot be extracted. It must, therefore, be invented, given green notes, the roots of its trail extended... Eau de Lierre is a fresh and slightly aquatic accord and as herbaceous as green sap rising up a vine.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Eau de Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Vibrant and sophisticated, Colonia is the emblematic Acqua di Parma Eau de Cologne that symbolises Italianity, capturing the dynamic spirit of a modern, metropolitan lifestyle. Created in 1916, Colonia embodies the spirit of Italian luxury – refined, timeless, and effortlessly elegant. As soon as Acqua di Parma's instantly recognisable golden fruits blend of radiant lemon, Calabrian bergamot, and orange starts to fill the air, Colonia's sparkling character comes alive. It is further amplified in the aromatic heart, where lavender harmoniously intertwines with rosemary. Warm and precious woody notes of vetiver, sandalwood, and patchouli round off the base of this iconic Eau de Cologne. The fragrance comes in the quintessential Acqua di Parma bottle, an epitome of the Art Deco expression. The transparent glass allows Colonia's nuances to be fully appreciated, while the classic black cap adds a touch of understated sophistication. The restyled minimal white labels echo the refined aesthetics of the Colonia collection, while the matte-paper box, characterised by its cylinder shape, features the brand's signature vibrant yellow shade.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Valaya Body Cream Refillable, 200ml
listings.description: The Valaya body cream leaves the skin scented with the elegant notes of the Valaya fragrance. It is refillable with a minimalist formula of carefully selected ingredients. The Valaya body cream delicately perfumes and hydrates the skin for 8 hours*. Massage the cream onto your body as part of your daily ritual. *Instrumental test on 11 women.

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Straight To Heaven Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Kilian Hennessy's Inspiration: Moments of ecstasy envelop the senses with Straight to Heaven, White Cristal. The Perfume: Smoldering with addictive sensuality, a burning splash of rich dark rum defines the opening, its sweet gourmand chord is softened by creamy vanilla and dried fruit. Spicy patchouli pairs with the fresh, woodsy scent of cedarwood to finish, finding animalic harmony at long last. Perfume notes: Patchouli, Nutmeg, Cedarwood. Perfumer: Sidonie Lancesseur.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Bluebell & Wild Strawberry Eau de Parfum Travel Case Refill, 7.5ml
listings.description: An ode to the quiet, sensuous assault of spring. This Eau de Parfum is a modern floral-fruity fragrance flourishing with juicy wild strawberry and warm amber accord, while a signature note of violet leaf absolute evokes the earthy, green crush of a forest floor. An energising scent, brimming with the season's optimism.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley-Paris Hair Rituel Le Parfum Hair & Body Spray, 100ml
listings.description: Hair Ritual by Sisley’s signature fragrance is now available as a perfume for the hair and body. Addictive. Exquisite. Divine... This perfume reflects the brand’s cult fragrance. It is designed to develop on both the skin and hair, which can retain scents for longer. Fresh and delicate, this hair and body perfume is instantly absorbed, leaving a long-lasting fragrance. The elegant, heady sillage unfolds with each movement. The perfume opens with a fresh and energetic burst of Hesperides, blended with lemon, verbena and lavender that blossom on mimosa flower and an aromatic plant heart, all enveloped in a cosy, comforting woody amber base. An intimate, discreet, unisex fragrance, this hair and body perfume can be worn alone or layered with any other fragrance to refresh and highlight it, without being too overpowering. Subtle yet magnetic, its charms are only revealed to the wearer and those who draw near.

listings.description: Kilian Hennessy's inspiration: Introducing a brand new collection, Kilian Hennessy felt it was time to pay tribute to his heritage, as heir to the renowned French cognac making family, and to his choice olfactory intoxicants for driving the night towards dawn. As a first-time collaboration with perfumer Franck Voelkl, Kilian Hennessy wanted to recreate the tasting of 'gin on the rocks' with a splash of lime - recalling his wife’s favorite drink. The Perfume: Anyone for notes of gin, distilled with rose and cucumber? The perfume Roses on Ice opens with the aquatic freshness of cucumber and the aromatic uplift of juniper berries, creating an icy sensation, rounded in an accord with voluptuous Rose Centifolia. Upon a drydown of sandalwood and musk, the scent expresses the sharp—yet deeply infused—character of gin consumed in its ideal. Perfume notes: Cucumber, Rose Juniper and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden A Floral Verse Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Luminous and enveloping, this Gucci unisex perfume opens with Indian Jasmine Sambac, drawn from the night-blooming flower said to capture the secrets of the moon. Exuding fruity green nuance, its intensely warm, floral character is infused with sensuality. At the heart of the Eau de Parfum, hand-picked Sri Lankan Black Tea Leaves are amplified by a Romandolide base, steeping the scent in gentle balsamic and musky undertones. This Gucci fragrance is contained in a green lacquered-glass bottle gilded with decorative foliage and the scent’s unique emblem – the golden vase. The bottle's natural green shade is a tribute to the green leaves of the scent's hero ingredients. Reveal your personal poetry by pairing A Floral Verse with other fragrances from the Alchemist’s Garden collection. Each one builds from a hero ingredient that shifts and magnifies when layered with other Gucci scents from the luxury collection. This perfume uses alcohol made from 100% recycled carbon emissions. Fragrance family: Floral. Scent type: Floral, green. Key notes: Top: Jasmine Sambac Heart: Black Tea Base: Romandolide How to use: The fragrances in the Gucci Alchemist’s Garden collection are designed to be layered together to create ethereal olfactory stories. Each one builds around a hero ingredient that transforms when paired with other Gucci scents. Uncover the magic of alchemy with these three suggested layering combinations for A Floral Verse: 1. Combine with Gucci A Midnight Stroll Eau de Parfum for a sensual, smoky trail of Black Tea Leaves and Incense Essence 2. Layer with Gucci A Song for the Rose to enlighten the Black Tea with elegant Bulgarian Rose for a floral immersion 3. Pair with Gucci Winter's Spring for a vivid composition where Jasmine Sambac and Black Tea Leaves are illuminated by Mimosa absolute Spritz generously onto the pulse points on your wrists, elbows, neck and behind your ears for a unique perfume for all occasions.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Thé Noir 29 Eau de Parfum Travel Refill, 3 x 10ml
listings.description: Thé Noir 29 is an ode to the noble leaf and the craft that surrounds it. Thé Noir 29 combines depth and freshness, softness and strength through permanent oscillation between the light of bergamot, fig and bay leaves and the depth of cedar wood, vetiver and musk. A special extraction of black tea leaves wraps up the composition by bringing to the formula a dry, leafy, hay, tobacco feeling in the dry down to transform this creation into a sensuous and addictive essence. Refill your travel tube with the fragrance of your choice. Includes 3 x 10ml spray bottles.

listings.rawTitle: OUAI Dean Street Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Jet set without the jet lag. This mood-boosting scent with notes of citrus fruits, apricot, rose, magnolia, amber, linden blossom, and musk is inspired by our favourite street in London.

listings.rawTitle: Sisley-Paris L'Eau Rêvée d'Aria Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Dreams inspire our creativity, they nourish us with images, memories and sensations. Les Eaux Rêvées express this imaginary place where inspirations collide, join together and become one – the inspirations of different generations of the d’Ornano family, the creators of Sisley. This collection is made up of six mixed fragrances, olfactory odes with a perfect, ambivalent nature. Sensual, biting devilwood: L’Eau Rêvée d’Aria combines the taste of spiced ginger with the complexity of devilwood, a flower with peachy and leather notes, and injected it into a fragrance with a vivacious, joyful personality, like a fantastical costume party. Designed in collaboration with two artists, Elżbieta Radziwiłł et Bronisław Krzysztof, L'Eau Rêvée d'Aria transports us to the world of swirling dreams. Canson paper case and glass bottle made in France. Case and bottle are recyclable. Top notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Ginger Middle notes: Osmanthus, Blackcurrant, Nutmeg Base notes: Vanilla, Benjoin, Patchouli

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Angel's Share Paradis Extrait de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: The ultimate interpretation of Angels' Share in an intense extrait de parfum - an irresistible ode to the finest spirits. The perfume: Inspired by an exceptional liqueur aged in oak barrels, Angels' Share Paradis captures the Maison’s incomparable savoir-faire and founder Kilian Hennessy’s legacy. The emblematic essence of Angels' Share unveils a new, daring intensity with tantalising raspberry liquor and exquisite Bulgarian Rose Oil Orpur. A lavish dose of Praline Accord, enriched with warm amber notes of Venezuelan Tonka Bean Absolut, blends seamlessly to linger on the skin, leaving a captivating, sensual trail. Perfume notes: Raspberry liquor, Cognac, Oakmoss Absolut. Collection: The Liquors. Perfumer: Benoist Lapouza.

listings.rawTitle: Goutal Le Temps des Rêves For Her Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Le Temps des Rêves evokes those moments when time slows down, and the mind drifts away with the softness of an azure sky. In a tribute to Grasse, orange blossom shines through, combining the freshness of neroli with the natural radiance of bergamot. The deep, honeyed Moroccan rose absolute is accompanied by warm myrrh. Milky accords, cereals, sandalwood and white musks gradually unfold, prolonging this luminous, comforting daydream.

listings.rawTitle: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Patchouli Blanc Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Symbolising purity, softness, and perfect balance, 'White' is a truly inspiring theme for the Collection, whose values are based on minimalism and olfactory excellence. To echo the Material, the Collection reveals an immaculate bottle in a deep and luminous white... And because Collection Extraordinaire is all about Nature and Poetry, the floral pattern of the Collection is delicately printed all over the bottle just like engraving... For Patchouli Blanc, the history of Patchouli has been a major inspiration, an authentic Patchouli which inevitably leads us to the sensation of silky, enveloping cashmere. A terribly seductive, clean scent with a pure, crystalline freshness that expresses the idea of a soft and cottony white. A special quality of Patchouli has been selected, a fractional essence, a more ethereal and floral version, which is combined with a bouquet of fresh roses on a delicate musky, woody signature. Fragrance family: Woody Musky. Top Note: Pink Pepper, Aldehydes Heart Note: Rose Essence Patchouli Essence Base Note: Cashmere Woods, White Musk

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Code Eau de Toilette Refill, 150ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Code - the aftershave for him. Timelessly sensual, in a pure and understated way this aftershave for him was the first Amber fragrance created by Giorgio Armani. A combination of citrus and wood for a cologne that strikes the perfect harmony of sophistication and seduction. This Eau de Toilette is a citron cocktail of bergamot and lemon with soft notes of olive tree blossom, warmed with Guaiac wood and Tonka Bean – a favourite in men’s fragrance. An evocative scent of tuxedos and exclusive parties, seduction is at the heart of this aftershave for him. Crafted as a statement bottle with a unique, rounded-square shape, the new Armani Code bottle reimagines the design of the original fragrance. This newly conceived bottle is refillable, demonstrating Giorgio Armani’s mindfulness of the planet. In its sleek, striking black form, elevated with sensorial touches and silver accents, the bottle stands as a beautiful object, designed to last. Dressed to impress, this cologne is perfect for day or evening wear with a smart edge. Iconic by nature, Armani Code Eau de Toilette would be best suited as a luxurious birthday, wedding, or anniversary gift. Armani Code Eau de Toilette for men is an Amber and woody fragrance created with notes of citron, tonka bean and guaiac wood. The Armani code of seduction. How to use: Apply on pulse points: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Eau de Parfum Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: This festive season, the Gaultier tarot cards have already been drawn. Something is afoot. The card of the Scandal Eau de Parfum gift set has been drawn and everything changes. This gourmand chypre fragrance is a game changer, and suddenly she’s on a winning streak. Gardenia is impressively irreverent. Sweet melt-in-the-mouth honey is absolutely addictive. Patchouli intensifies the fragrance with its obsessive caramelised notes. Excessive. Provocative. Scandal flouts every convention and always holds the winning hand. Inside her case, the scented body lotion prolongs her perfume unreservedly. What a gift. Set contains: Scandal Eau de Parfum, 50ml Scandal Eau de Parfum body lotion, 75ml

listings.description: Perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena created Eau de Pamplemousse Rose in 2009. Enlivened with new-found radiance, grapefruit mellows on contact with rose. A fruity, citrus composition, Eau de Pamplemousse Rose Cologne combines the sparkling notes of grapefruit with the delicacy of rose. The iconic lantern bottle is adorned with a bright green hue. Around the orange box, a vividly contrasting band recalls its colour. The Hermès Colognes Collection: Hermès Colognes explore the sensory nature of materials. listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Parfum, 100ml Bundle with Gift
listings.description: Issey Miyake Le Sel d’Issey Parfum 10ml Gift with Purchase* Gift: Issey Miyake Le Sel d’Issey Parfum, 10ml *Free with the purchase of specified Issey Miyake fragrance bundles. While stocks last. Subject to availability. Issey Miyake Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Parfum, 100ml Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Parfum is the new intense perfume for men by Issey Miyake. When touched by salt, nature is enhanced. Emotions are strengthened, experiences are amplified. The senses are ignited as salt brings flavour to life, with even more intensity. The woody marine dry amber men’s fragrance. Created by perfumer Quentin Bisch, this new woody marine dry amber fragrance reveals sea freshness with warm land vibrancy. Evoking the sea, a salty polarity combines a vivid salt accord with natural origin marine seaweed and natural origin oakmoss. Evoking the land, the earth polarity is infused with the sensual notes of natural origin incense and natural origin amber notes. Upcycled cedarwood enhances the enveloping warmth. A long-lasting fragrance combining the intensity of salt with a masculine elegance. Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Parfum is made with 94% natural origin ingredients, including 100% natural origin French alcohol, and is vegan-certified. A refillable perfume bottle with an intensified design. Designer Tokujin Yoshioka has intensified the pure and sharp aesthetic of the Le Sel bottle with amplified masculinity. The 20% recycled glass is warmed with a smoky grey gradient lacquer, and the cap is revisited in a deep gunmetal shade. The 50ml and 100ml formats are refillable with a 150ml refill. In perfect harmony, the outer box features gunmetal colour details on matte grey textured paper. It is made with 10% upcycled seaweed and material from well-managed, FSC™ certified forests and other controlled sources. Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Parfum is made in France. How to use: Enhance your perfume experience. Start with the Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Toilette shower gel, then apply Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Parfum all over, focusing on your pulse points, to enhance your fragrance experience.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Absolue Les Parfums Hell Of A Rose Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: In this land where nature's grandeur lives untamed, we grow a rose like no other. Absolue Les Parfums, a radical collection dedicated to our rose, born in our domain. Our first-ever rose-dedicated haute-parfumerie collection composed of 11 scents unveils our exclusive centifolia rose like you've never smelled before. Reinventing perfumery's iconic ingredient. Hell Of A Rose Eau de Parfum with Ambrette and Vertiver. Rising among ashes and against all odds, the rose is strong and resilient. She is textured by the musky addiction of ambrette. Fresh and smokey facets bring about a new intensity. Her brightness emerges from the intense vetiver like a glimmer of hope in the dark. Meet The Perfumer. Nathalie Lorson: "A rose and vetiver chiaroscuro. For this creation, the rose is contrasted and adorned with wood. Vetiver reveals its fresh and smoky facets to adorn the rose and reveal a new intensity." How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Cologne Intense Collection Festive Edition Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Five rich, intense fragrances hidden inside a festive gift box, finished with a tartan bow. Take someone special on a journey of scent exploration with Cologne Intense favourites in 9ml bottles, including decadent floral Velvet Rose & Oud and fresh and woody Cypress & Grapevine. Set contains: Velvet Rose & Oud Cologne Intense, 9ml Amber Labdanum Cologne Intense, 9ml Myrrh & Tonka Cologne Intense, 9ml Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense, 9ml Oud & Bergamot Cologne Intense, 9ml

listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums Divine Vanille by Olivier Pescheux Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Divine Vanille is a tribute to vanilla absolute, sustainably produced in Madagascar. Mysterious, suave, deep, carnal... simply irresistible. Natural tonka bean and benzoin, also sustainably produced, enhance the soft, balmy and addictive facets of vanilla. A blend of natural cinnamon bark and sensual, leathery tones of natural Osmanthus reveals rich facets of blond tobacco and dried fruits. An innovative fraction of natural cedarwood brings a creamy woody structure highlighted with silky musks, wrapping the fragrance with a delicate luminous veil.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Very Floral 35ml
listings.description: Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Very Floral for women is an empowering journey into the heart of bold femininity and self-confidence. Built around a delicate duo of exquisite roses, this radiant reinterpretation of Givenchy’s iconic fragrance reveals the most fearlessly feminine side of Irresistible with a new solar accord. At its heart, Centifolia Rose Absolute from Grasse and Rose Essential combine for the first time in an intense duo of rose blossoms. In a bold twist, French Blackcurrant Bud Absolute and a Coconut Water accord take the senses on an exhilarating spin with an unexpected freshness. Amplified by the pristine beauty of Iris Concrete, the allure of Ylang-Ylang, and the sweetness of Jasmine Sambac Absolute, this floral and sensual women’s fragrance is irresistibly addictive. Givenchy reinvented its iconic Irresistible prismatic bottle with an elongated and bold design, accentuated by a pink couture ribbon. The prismatic finish of the Irresistible Very Floral bottle captures the light and is adorned with the signature 4G logo in a nod to the Maison's heritage and reminder of Givenchy's unparalleled craftsmanship and legacy. More floral than ever, Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Very Floral invites you to let go and be yourself. Head notes: Bergamot Essence, Living Coconut Water, Blackcurrant Bud, Absolute MD France LMR Heart notes: Duo of Roses: Rose Essential LMR & Centifolia Rose Absolute. Grasse LMR, Iris Concrete China and Morocco, White Flowers: Ylang Heart Madagascar LMR, Sambac Jasmine Absolute India LMR Base notes: Cedarwood Heart USA Virginia LMR, Solar Accord, Musky Notes: Ambrette Absolute Ecuador and Peru LMR, Sinfonide, Vegan Ambrettolide MD: Molecular Distillation. LMR: Laboratory Monique Remy.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradigme Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Paradigme, the new signature masculine fragrance by Prada. A fragrance that transcends traditional preconceptions by asking – what if there’s another way? A question as an invitation to experiment and open new perspectives. Paradigme Eau de Parfum expresses sophistication and avant-garde in an unexpected masculine Ambery Woody scent. Opening a new olfactive paradigm, oscillating between enveloping warmth and exhilarating freshness. The warm sensuality of ambery woods is entwined with a green Bourbon Geranium, uplifted by a fusing Calabrian Bergamot Heart. The Paradigme bottle immediately invites curiosity. An architectural silhouette of radical elegance and an avant-garde statement through the tactile tilted Prada triangle. A bottle lacquered in an intense and alluring black to green gradation, the house’s iconic colour.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin sous la Mer Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: The creation: With Un Jardin sous la Mer Eau de Toilette, Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel ventures out into the beyond with an invitation to discover a surprising garden. An escape to the faraway Polynesian island of Taha'a: an unspoiled land where mountains and reefs, plants and corals converse in perfect harmony. The olfactory notes: Un Jardin sous la Mer is a floral and musky eau de toilette that combines a radiant tiare flower with the enveloping character of the tamanu nut and mineral notes that evoke the coral reef. The object: Designed by Fred Rawyler, the bottle is inspired by the lines of horse-drawn carriage lanterns. Its graduated shades of blue reflect the azure sky and the crystalline waters of the lagoon around Taha'a. The box features watercolour illustrations by artist Aino-Maija Metsola, depicting the vibrant life and colours of the coral reef. The Hermès detail: For each Parfum-Jardin, the House invites an artist to illustrate the box, giving them carte blanche to create a poetic expression of the garden through drawing. "Drawing is everything at Hermès, and everything starts with a drawing," comments Pierre-Alexis Dumas, artistic director at Hermès. The ethics: The 100ml, 50ml and 30ml bottles of Un Jardin sous la Mer Eau de Toilette can be replenished using the 200 ml refill (sold separately). The Parfums-Jardins Collection: The Parfums-Jardins collection brings together the soul of a place, the perfumer's inspiration and the theme chosen by Hermès each year to nourish its creativity. They are olfactory strolls to share for every moment, to indulge every desire for freshness, reverie or escape.
