Its graduated shades of blue reflect the azure sky and the crystalline waters of the lagoon around Taha'a. The box features watercolour illustrations by artist Aino-Maija Metsola, depicting the vibrant life and colours of the coral reef. The Hermès detail: For each Parfum-Jardin, the House invites an artist to illustrate the box, giving them carte blanche to create a poetic expression of the garden through drawing. "Drawing is everything at Hermès, and everything starts with a drawing," comments Pierre-Alexis Dumas, artistic director at Hermès. The ethics: The 100ml, 50ml and 30ml bottles of Un Jardin sous la Mer Eau de Toilette can be replenished using the 200 ml refill (sold separately). The Parfums-Jardins Collection: The Parfums-Jardins collection brings together the soul of a place, the perfumer's inspiration and the theme chosen by Hermès each year to nourish its creativity. They are olfactory strolls to share for every moment, to indulge every desire for freshness, reverie or escape.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre L'Absolu Platine Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Libre L'Absolu Platine, the signature Libre scent, now shimmering with absolute intensity. Elevated with an exquisite white lavender accord. Starring Dua Lipa, Global Fragrance Ambassador for YSL Beauty. Inspiration: Libre, the French word for ‘free’, pays tribute to YSL’s enduring spirit of empowering people to live their lives as authentically and unapologetically as possible. Since 1961 authenticity has dressed the YSL woman: fierce, bold, unapologetic. A woman powerful like ocean waves crashing against the shore. With fire burning in her soul, like flames flickering in the breeze. Bestowing strength, like an eagle soaring through the sky. To embody Libre is British singer-songwriter Dua Lipa. For those who live unconstrained, assured, and liberated in their freedom, YSL Beauty introduces new Libre L'Absolu Platine. An intense grand floral fragrance, characterised by sensuous orange blossom, and a crisp white lavender accord, for a unique sparkling scent. Scent: The new Libre L'Absolu Platine brings radiance and intense sensuality to the Libre floral signature. A sparkling interpretation of the original Libre signature, this exquisite fragrance brings to life a clash of intensities. A burning sensuality from orange blossom blazes through the scent, put in sharp contrast by the crisp freshness of a shimmering white lavender accord crafted exclusively for YSL, enhanced further by diva lavender, producing cool powdery notes. Lavender, typically a masculine-presenting note, now reveals an ultra-feminine facet through this unique accord – creating a dazzling, floral trail. Underlying this tension of fire and ice, an ambergris accord fuses with delicious vanilla for a long-lasting and smooth base. Crafted by master perfumers Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaïm. Top notes: bergamot, mandarin, natural aldehyde Heart notes: orange blossom, white lavender accord, diva lavender heart Base notes: vanilla bourbon, ambergris accord Bottle: A covetable bottle, like a couture accessory stitched from fine materials. Structured yet unexpected, with tailored YSL craftsmanship. More precious than ever, this jewel-like bottle showcases a spectacular metallic contrast. A gleaming silver lacquering lines the inside of the glass, imparting an everlasting liquid platinum effect that never diminishes as you use your fragrance. Against this ice-cold backdrop, the oversized YSL logo in gold-tone hardware appears more striking than ever. Collection: Feel free to love and show your love. Indulge yourself with LIBRE and share it with those most special to you. A luxurious gift, suitable for all of life’s most special occasions. LIBRE Eau de Toilette. A lighter, fresher take on the Libre signature fragrance, twisted with White Tea. Fresh and sensual LIBRE Original Eau de Parfum. The original grand floral scent. A unique blend of sensual orange blossom and cool lavender. Bold and captivating LIBRE Eau de Parfum Intense. A richer interpretation of the Libre floral signature, enriched with a smouldering orchid accord. Rich and full-bodied LIBRE Le Parfum. The Libre floral signature, infused with a spicy yet honeyed saffron accord. Vivid and unapologetic LIBRE L’Absolu Platine. The Libre floral signature, shimmering with absolute intensity, featuring a precious white lavender accord. Radiant and sparkling

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Rocabar Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: Composed by perfumer Gilles Romey in 1998, Rocabar is inspired by the equestrian world. A contraction of the English word ‘rug’ and the French words ‘à barres’ (meaning ‘striped’), its name alludes to the traditional horse blanket in saffron-coloured wool with red and blue stripes manufactured in the Hermès workshops. With a woody, amber character, Rocabar eau de toilette for men combines the warm notes of cedar with lively cypress and enveloping, balmy benzoin. The bottle, inspired by the lanterns of horse-drawn carriages, has a black cap reminiscent of a riding hat. The back label is illustrated with a design by Philippe Dumas, indicating that it belongs to the Parfums-Fondateurs collection. The Parfums-Fondateurs Collection: The Parfums-Fondateurs collection draws inspiration from the house’s heritage. Each THE CREATION encapsulates Hermès’ imaginary world in a name, a fragrance and a colour. Over the years, Hermès has pioneered a bold style of perfumery, resulting from encounters with exceptional perfumers. A contraction of the English word "rug" and the French expression "à barres", meaning striped, this novel for men takes its inspiration from traditional horse blankets made in the Hermès workshops, with blue and red stripes on a saffron background. Created by Gilles Romey in 1998, Rocabar reveals its most powerful facets in tones of wood, balms and resins, underscored by the full-bodied notes of cypress in its sillage.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Poison Girl Unexpected Eau de Toilette
listings.description: A fresh and unexpected floral heightened by an excessive dose of ginger. With Poison Girl Unexpected, François Demachy, DIOR Perfumer-Creator, shakes up noble ingredients with sassy, spirited accords to create a new, fresh and sparkling floral that is totally...Unexpected! A radically pop inspiration, a sudden, lightning-fast sensation that sends sparkling shivers down the spine and then rounds off with sugary softness. Top notes burst with a double dose of Tanzanian ginger. Incredibly fresh and nuanced, the sexy spice takes hold in abundance, melding with a sassy salty note. This delightful 'Ginger Tonic' suddenly yields to a sensual, floral heart of Damascus rose. Venezuelan tonka bean remains a constant enveloping signature, warmed with a light note of vanilla and musk. "With Poison Girl Unexpected, I wanted to bring the strong, contradictory sensation of a sour candy into a fragrance. I played with the contrast of a fruity note that would swell into a spicy, sexy accord. A ginger note slightly seasoned with a dash of salt was the obvious answer. It conveys all the 'expressive' charm of those tart candies that explode in your mouth and then give way to sweetness." François Demachy, DIOR Perfumer-Creator. Olfactive notes: Tanzanian Ginger: Ginger is a tropical plant that grows in humid, sunny climates. Ginger has been used for its medicinal qualities since ancient times, and its sweet, fresh fragrance is inimitable. The rhizomes of the ginger root give off its unique scent after steam distillation Damascus Rose: Native to Turkey and Bulgaria, the Damascus rose is used as an essence or an absolute. A key ingredient in the perfumer's palette, it finds full expression in the heart note of the finest fragrances Venezuelan Tonka Bean: The bean is picked from the tree and dried before being ground into a powder. This powder is then used to make the concrete or absolute. Intense and textured, tonka bean gives off a sweet, warm scent.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden The Eyes of the Tiger Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Alchemist’s Garden. Inspired by the science of alchemy, Alessandro Michele reimagines the path of transformation from lead into gold with the art of fragrance making to create seven eaux de parfum, four oils, three acque profumate and a candle. Alberto Morillas worked with Alessandro Michele’s vision on a collection using pure natural plants and flowers layered with modern molecules. Blended through rediscovery, a hero ingredient is magnified for each scent: Oud, Amber, Violet, Iris, Mimosa, Rose and Woods. Every fragrance and every formula is created as an unicum, telling the story of a place, a moment, a season, and a smell of memory. The Eyes of the Tiger Eau de Parfum. In China, amber is considered the 'soul of the tiger', which enters the earth and then becomes a stone. The Eyes of the Tiger is an imagined journey into the soul of the tiger. Benzoin and Tonka convey a tiger’s gaze with a dark hint of Vanilla. The scent is rounded out with woody and sweet Ciste resin, representing a tiger’s contrasting sides; dangerous and sensitive, fast and patient. For daily use.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Escentric 05 Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: Escentric 05 is a love letter to Cashmeran, an abstraction of summer on a Mediterranean island. Cashmeran is one of the greats of synthetic chemistry. Warm and woody, with a resinous pine note. It has an unusually complex character for a single molecule. Cashmeran was created in a laboratory at the IFF in the late 1970s. For Escentric 05, Geza Schoen wanted to recreate the experience of being on an island in the Mediterranean, like the ones he has spent so many summers. This scent pairing explores the idea of a modern Cashmeran fragrance with notes of bergamot, laurel, rosemary, cistus, fig, juniper, hedione, and of course, 15% Cashmeran. "What you notice as you walk up the path from the sea is how the heat changes plants and trees; they turn dry, resinous and aromatic," says Geza Schoen. "The top note of Escentric 05 is very simple: bergamot to keep things light, and orange, an ingredient which has an emotional tone to it, bright and happy. It reflects the orange groves that cover the island. Laurel and rosemary are typical Mediterranean plants with a spicy freshness. Juniper brings a herbal tonality, and cypress is a very dry, pungent wood." The dry-down has two classic Mediterranean ingredients, cistus labdanum and mastic. Mastic is a resin produced by a small tree that grows especially near the sea. It has a sweet, leathery, balsamic quality. And, of course, there is around 15% of Cashmeran — which gives the fragrance its piney warmth. "I also introduced a subtle fig, both the bitterness of the leaves and the ripeness of the fruit. Figs had to be in there because there is a fig tree by our house on the island. Fig feels authentic to the place; it reminds me of the happiness of summer by the sea," says Geza Schoen. So far, so chemical. Now here's the hype. An oceanic deconstructed summer fragrance that isn't fuelled by lunar exotic boring florals and is instead charged with psychedelic freshness. This fragrance is the equivalent of a cosy cashmere jumper dripped in the Mediterranean ocean. How to use: Spritz onto your pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind your ears, as desired, and let it dry naturally.

listings.description: The new floral Eau de Parfum. Idôle Now, a unique florality inspired by nature, merging natural original ingredients with science. At the heart of this new fragrance, a powerful trio of iconic ingredients: The uplifted Rose, a once uncapturable Orchid accord and the natural Vanilla infusion from Madagascar. A richer, bolder, more caring fragrance pushing the fragrance boundaries further in a more alluring way through fluffy vanilla facets. The uplifted rose: The Idôle Rose is upcycled through the use of discarded Rose water and then reinfused in the final formula. The natural print orchid accord: A unique natural scent translated into a musky orchid accord adding a touch of warm elegance to Idôle Now powerful trail while preserving the flower. A new irresistible facet, blooming with an even more alluring and powerful trail. What makes it different: The outer pack is FSCTM MIX certified. Our new power totem represents the light of a new dawn with its ombre bottle. More about your fragrance: Explore the unlimited scent of Idôle Now, a unique caring fragrance, inspired by nature.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 + Ginger Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: The most minimal fragrance is a single aroma-molecule: Molecule 01. The next most minimal adds 1 to 01: 01 + 1. This is Molecule +. Molecule 01 + Ginger consists of Iso E Super + Ginger. Iso E Super is an abstract synthetic molecule with a cedarwood tonality and a warm, velvety cocooning sensation. Ginger is extracted from the rhizome of the ginger plant with a fresh and spicy scent profile. M+ Ginger stands out with its contrasting nuances that are as surprising as they are addictive. Strong yet soothing, peppery but effervescent, ubiquitously familiar and singularly imaginative. "M+ Ginger oozes and boasts that simplicity of smell that people don't expect in any other fragrance. What's striking about ginger is how it combines a crisp and zesty freshness and peppery spiciness in one ingredient. I've always loved that. When I smelt this new 'ginger oil fresh' from the Ivory Coast, I knew I had to do Molecule + Ginger. I also used a CO2 ginger extract from China for a smoother, sweet aromatic ginger note, or as I like to say, neon fresh! It is so clean, so pure, with a sharp effervescent quality that plays beautifully in the landscape of Molecule 01," says Geza Schoen. This is an innovative reimagining of the classic ginger natural, where a velvety cocooning constitution dances with a lurid yellow, punchy freshness, resulting in a radically enlivening M+ offering. How to use: Spritz onto your pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind your ears, as desired, and let it dry naturally.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Solar Violet Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: L'Eau d'Issey Solar Violet. The luminous new perfume for women. L'Eau d'Issey Solar Violet is the new Eau de Toilette Intense by Issey Miyake born under the sun. A fragrance for women in which water meets matter in a new light. In the springtime, nature reawakens at a time of rebirth. Water is refreshed by a cool breeze. Matter is warmed by the first rays of sunshine. For this new women’s perfume, water blends with delicate violet to bring an explosion of purple to life. Warmth contrasts with freshness, and delicacy meets intensity to create a modern take on violet. A luminous floral fragrance born under a new light: For this new Issey Miyake Eau de Toilette Intense, perfumer Marie Salamagne has created a solar encounter between violet and aquatic notes in a floral fruity fragrance. Top notes of juicy, solar pear notes open the perfume, enhancing the powerful powdery luminosity of violet leaf absolute at the scent’s heart. Blossoming under the leaves of the plant, violets represent modesty, sensuality, and grace. Their intense and enchanting scent leaves a delicate floral trail that awakens the senses. As the fragrance dries down onto the skin, the tenderness of the violet is textured by the elegant silky base notes of the iris. A celebration of nature, this vegan-certified perfume is made with 90% natural origin ingredients. The 100% natural origin violet in L'Eau d'Issey Solar Violet is sourced responsibly in Egypt. A light violet perfume bottle: Inspired by violet petals, a light-filled touch of purple infuses the L'Eau d'Issey Solar Violet bottle and its outer packaging. The emblematic bottle is made with transparent glass, reflecting the purity of water, while the plastic-free 100% wooden cap symbolises the density of matter. A natural perfume committed to nature: The iconic L'Eau d'Issey cap has been reinterpreted to reduce the environmental footprint, using a single block of 100% wood, removing the need for plastic, and featuring the natural design of the wooden grain. Derived from material from well-managed FSCTM-certified forests and other controlled sources, this patented innovation results in a 97% reduction in water use**. The L'Eau d'Issey Solar Violet bottle is made from 20% post-consumer recycled glass. The box is made of material from well-managed, FSCTM-certified forests and other controlled sources. The vegan fragrance is made in France with 90% natural origin ingredients. It is dermatologically tested and can be worn in the sun*. The alcohol in the formula comes from 100% natural origin French beetroot. **In comparison with the L’Eau d’Issey Eau de Toilette 100ml cap. How to use: Spray L'Eau d'Issey Solar Violet over your skin, paying particular attention to your pulse points – your décolleté, inner wrists, and the crease of your elbows – to intensify your fragrance trail. The dermatologically tested formula can be worn in the sun.* *Does not dispense sun protection.

listings.rawTitle: MALIN + GOETZ Dark Rum Perfume Oil, 7ml
listings.description: Inspired by the old world bay rum first used by sailors travelling through the Caribbean and later popularised in barbershops, dark rum is a refreshing reinvention of a traditionally dark and spicy aroma. Sweetened with ripe plum and crisp bergamot, notes of leather, rum and creamy milk are blended into an intoxicating mix that adapts perfectly to its wearer. Both alluringly warm and fresh, this scent captures the essence of long days spent in the tropical sun and late nights with friends. With just a spritz, dark rum leaves a deep and indelible longing for all those places we’ve been, as well as those we’ve yet to visit. listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Ani X Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Ani was the first reference launched in 2019 under the new theme 'No Boundaries' that aimed to eliminate all emotional boundaries between people. The fragrance immediately became a global hit, being often mentioned as the best vanilla scent ever. With Ani X, NISHANE wanted to enhance this mystical journey through time that the fans had with Ani, a fragrance that pays homage to an ancient metropolis that now stands as a monument to the might of empires and the inevitability of time. Just like the original bestseller, Ani X aims to break down boundaries and to empower the wearers to build their own empire from the ruins. In an attempt to reach the perfume lovers who specifically seek the refreshing aspect of the scent, Ani X was designed to open with a richer burst of juicy citrus than the original formula of Ani. The freshness that the wearer will feel with the new Ani X on top of the well-known vanilla excellence of the original Ani will be a nice surprise for the perfume lovers. Ani X is a fragrance with true heritage to its name and invites you to explore how to eliminate the boundaries of time and space, to create your own empire even when all that remains are the ruins. So spray on Ani X, let the fragrance take you on a journey through the ages, and embrace the power of history in a bottle.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Eau Parfumée Au Thé Blanc Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Eau Parfumée Thé Blanc is a precious signature encapsulating the comforting olfactive botanical properties of natural white tea from China. Eau Parfumée Thé Blanc, launched in 2003, was conceived as a new olfactory adventure inspired by the spirit of daring, generosity and innovation at the heart of this iconic fragrance collection. Today, Bvlgari invites its clients to rediscover this timeless perfume creation through a new design, an upgraded formula featuring natural tea and a new conceptual story. Inspired by a dreamlike place where gems of nature spark the imagination, clients are welcome to experience Eau Parfumée's unique olfactive botanical harmonies inside the Botanical Garden. Eau Parfumée Thé Blanc Eau de Toilette traces a discreet path of serenity through this garden, unveiling the comforting olfactive botanical properties of white tea from China. With Eau Parfumee Thé Blanc, Master-Perfumer Jacques Cavallier captures the feeling of comfort offered by the most prestigious Chinese white teas in a woody floral musk fragrance that envelops the soul in a delicate cocoon of confidence and serenity. The exquisite white tea notes find their perfect alliance in a luminous accord of white musk, the olfactory signature of Bvlgari. The sensual, round, and clean accents of musk create a caressing effect that lasts. The silhouette of the flacon is inspired by the proud elegance of ancient Roman columns. The design is embellished by the iconic glass décolleté, symbolising a sensory experience as rich and intimate as wearing a jewellery creation. A crackled inlay adorns the beige gold cap and echoes the tradition of celadon ceramics originating in China. The front label is enriched with new hand-drawn botanical illustrations, meticulously crafted by a French botanist exclusively for Bvlgari and exquisitely embossed thanks to new selected paper made from hemp.

The sensual, round, and clean accents of musk create a caressing effect that lasts. The silhouette of the flacon is inspired by the proud elegance of ancient Roman columns. The design is embellished by the iconic glass décolleté, symbolising a sensory experience as rich and intimate as wearing a jewellery creation. A crackled inlay adorns the beige gold cap and echoes the tradition of celadon ceramics originating in China. The front label is enriched with new hand-drawn botanical illustrations, meticulously crafted by a French botanist exclusively for Bvlgari and exquisitely embossed thanks to new selected paper made from hemp.

listings.rawTitle: LOEWE Crafted Collection Field Diary Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: The quiet pulse of open air and soft light evokes a serene, untouched landscape. LOEWE Field Diary Eau de Parfum is conceived as a vibrant citrus-woody fragrance, capturing the raw poetry of nature’s quiet moments and translating them into a perfume. Field Diary Eau de Parfum is a contemporary olfactory escape shaped through top notes of green mandarin and blood orange balanced with lychee and orange blossom. A bright, uplifting mandarin scent mingles with delicate orange blossom notes to invite a state of sensory mindfulness. Artemisia adds an aromatic contrast, grounded by sandalwood and musk. As a deeply comforting musk perfume anchored in a warm sandalwood scent, this niche fragrance lingers with an earthy, quiet confidence. The resinous, ambery LOEWE Accord waves through the composition. Inspired by the organic beauty of traditional handblown glass, this citrus fragrance from the LOEWE Crafted Collection arrives in a sculptural glass flask, topped with a tactile granite cap, celebrating the collection’s innate artistry. This physical form beautifully connects human craft with the raw elements of the earth, offering a tactile dimension to this unique sensory experience.

listings.rawTitle: LOEWE Agua Drop Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Refreshing and floral, LOEWE Agua Drop Eau de Parfum combines the rich, warm aroma of the new LOEWE Accord with notes of bergamot and orange flower absolute to create a fresh, fruity and woody-ambery fragrance. Drop is the first perfume in the LOEWE Agua family of fragrances to feature the LOEWE Accord - a new and exclusive olfactory note inspired by the scent of the Spanish Rockrose wildflower. Raw and authentic, resinous and leathery, it has been crafted to capture the olfactory essence of LOEWE’s unique identity. While the LOEWE Agua family is inspired by the sparkle of light on flowing water, the new fragrance, Drop, evokes the tiny drops of dew that settle on the Rockrose’s petals after a long, cool night.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica On a Date Eau de Toilette
listings.description: The memory of a late summer’s evening overlooking the vineyards of Provence. As the sun sets over the endless vines, a dreamlike golden hour sets the scene for the perfect date. On a Date Eau de Toilette, by Maison Margiela, captures the sparkling and addictive fruitiness of ripe grapes soaked in warm sunshine, and the delicate yet decisive character of wild roses. Notes of sparkling Bergamot and luminous Rose convey the excitement of the perfect date. A sweet and textured Blackcurrant Liquor accord coupled with sensual and woody Patchouli transport us to the vineyards of Provence, steeped in the golden glow of a late summer’s sunset. When working on this fragrance, the perfumer Carlos Benaïm was inspired by his own cherished memories of Provence, the stage of his very first steps in the perfume industry. He particularly wanted to capture the Mediterranean sunshine as it heats the vineyards for harvests overflowing with addictive and joyful sensations of well-being. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Black Currant Liquor Accord, Bergamot Oil, Pink Pepper Oil Middle notes: Isparta Rose Petal Essence, Geranium Oil, Davana Oil Base notes: Patchouli Essence, Vetiver Oil, Moss Accord, Musks

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin Sur le Toit Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Un Jardin sur le Toit Eau de Toilette unveils a hidden garden nestled in the heart of Paris. A patch of nature nestled on top of the Hermès building at number 24 rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré. The fragrance, created in 2011 by perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena, pays tribute to this celebratory garden. A fruity, vegetal fragrance, Un Jardin sur le Toit Eau de Toilette scents the air of Paris with an accord of crisp apple tree and juicy pear tree. The bottle echoes the lanterns of horse-drawn carriages and was created by Fred Rawyler. Its glass is a vivid bright green and its box is illustrated by Philippe Dumas, a member of the Hermès family, with a breathtaking view of the city. The Parfums-Jardins Collection: The Parfums-Jardins collection brings together the soul of a place, the perfumer's inspiration and the Hermès annual theme. They are olfactory strolls to indulge every desire for freshness, reverie or escape.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Vetiver 46 Eau de Parfum Travel Tube, 10ml
listings.description: The Rolls Royce of Vetivers, nurtured in Haiti and retired to Grasse in accord with local know-how, is the pillar of this perfume that, without a doubt, is the most masculine of all Le Labo creations. Among the 46 essences that make it up, all have the distinctive male scent: pepper, gaïac, labdanum, cedar. Each expresses strength of character in its own way, and the delicate accompaniment of olibanum, a mysterious incense, leaves an intriguing spiritual dimension in its wake. Can't leave home without a fragrance? Le Labo have created a vintage, metal branded travel tube to protect and house the 10ml spray.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Miss Dior Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Miss Dior was born of those Provençal evenings filled with fireflies when green jasmine serves as a counterpoint to the melody of the night and the earth.” That is how Christian Dior described the inspiration behind the creation of his first fragrance, Miss Dior, in 1947. Francis Kurkdjian has now interpreted the original Miss Dior with the new Miss Dior Parfum. An intense women's fragrance dominated by a jasmine with rare, fruity facets, wrapped in ambery woody accords and infused with notes of mandarin. The olfactory translation of a nighttime stroll through a moss-covered forest, filled with juicy fruit and wildflowers. The emblematic Miss Dior houndstooth motif envelops around the bottle. A silvery 'poignard' bow tied around the neck completes the signature couture spirit of Miss Dior Parfum.

listings.rawTitle: Rituals Amsterdam Collection Home Perfume Refill, 400ml
listings.description: This refill of our Amsterdam Collection home fragrance has an elegant scent of fresh yuzu and Dutch tulips, perfect for filling your home with an energetic freshness. When the bottle of your home fragrance is empty, simply refill it with your favourite refill.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu L’Eau de Muguet Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The first feminine fragrance by Miu Miu, the floral green musky L’Eau de Muguet Eau de Parfum opens the door to the house’s contrasted femininity. Effortless and sophisticated, the transparent yet vivid accords capture the bloom of youthful springtime energy. Miu Miu’s energising twist on lily of the valley, gone rogue with earthy peppery Akigalawood. Spring has never smelled so cool. Fragrance notes: Top note: Lily of the valley accord Heart note: Damask Rose Base note: Akigalawood Joyfully floral. Musky and clean. Freshened by a touch of green. L’Eau de Muguet’s youthful energy stems from the most fragrant flower of spring. A dewy, transparent lily of the valley accord, elevated by the vivid twist of verdant notes. Earthy, peppery Akigalawood, a unique material derived from patchouli, adds a vibrant contemporary edge to the blend. About the bottle: Channelling Miu Miu’s irreverent codes, L’Eau de Muguet’s bottle conjures the texture of the luxury house’s iconic matelassé leather handbags. The brand’s signature azzurro blue tints the opaque glass, in a vibrant contrast with the translucent ruby red of the sequin-shaped stopper, and the collar’s black and white Miu Miu tag ring. How to use: Exude the carefree spirit of a Miu Miu girl with your new signature scent - spray L’Eau de Muguet to the pulse points on your neck, collarbone, and wrist. To leave an even longer-lasting scent trail, apply to the crooks of your elbows and the back of the knees, which will intensify the fragrance with the warmth of your body heat.

listings.description: Montblanc Star Oud is a woody, ambery Eau de Parfum. An ode to the ingenuity and heritage of Montblanc craftsmanship, this luxury fragrance is wrapped in an intoxicating fusion of an oud accord and cardamom.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Parfum evokes the sea breeze caressing the skin. A luminous fragrance that holds an unusual ingredient at its heart: seawater cypress, whose essential oil is extracted after the branches are immersed in seawater. The aromatic notes blend with salty and mineral nuances, offering authentic masculine freshness. The design: The transparent glass bottle reveals the bright golden hues of the fragrance itself, while the sinuous lines are embellished with elegant gold details. The blue enamel cap, inspired by the ceramics of the Amalfi coast, is completed by the famous DG monogram, now in its golden version. Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Parfum: golden, luminous, refined. The fragrance was created by Alberto Morillas exclusively for Dolce & Gabbana. Fragrance notes: Top notes: The fragrance opens with the lively citrus freshness of Calabrian Yellow Mandarin Heart notes: The heart reveals an accord of aromatic and salty notes thanks to Seawater Cypress Base notes: The fragrance closes on a sensual base of Cedarwood, creating a refined, woody, and modern composition Yellow Mandarin: sparkling sweetness Seawater cypress: salty and aromatic Cedarwood: decisive and sensual

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Forte Oud Yuzu Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Oud Yuzu Forte, the unexpected contrast between the sacred whorls of oud wood and the mischievous acerbity of yuzu. Wood and citrus meet to give a fragrance that plays with light and shadow. "Oud Yuzu Forte is the surprising illumination of sacred and mysterious oud wood, shot through with the tangy freshness of yuzu." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. Aqua Allegoria Forte, the intense collection, is a warm and enveloping journey to the heart of the world’s wonders: Eaux de Parfum celebrating the intense beauty of nature, revealed by the golden rays of a setting sun. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria Forte fragrances contain more than 90% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The 200ml refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75ml and 125ml bottles. *In accordance with ISO 16128, calculation including water. How to use: Create your own olfactory signature by pairing Oud Yuzu Forte with Bergamote Calabria, Orange Soleia, Pamplelune or Nerolia Vetiver. Select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: New Notes Bonbons a la Violette Extrait de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Step into a carefree world of pop sugary indulgence. Bonbons a la Violette is a sweet and enchanting fragrance reminiscent of unwrapping a cherished box of violet candies. Blending sugared florals with bright fruity accents and creamy sweetness, it is the perfect companion for bringing a touch of everyday magic and joy to any occasion. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Bright Bergamot, Sweet Orange Heart notes: Sugared Violet, Delicate Jasmine Base notes: Creamy Vanilla, Mossy Notes, Cedarwood, Warm Amber

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Limited Edition Le Male In Blue Eau de Parfum, 125ml
listings.description: With Le Male In Blue, a powerful wave of spicy aromatic freedom breaks at sea. Vaster than the horizon, stronger than a tidal wave, its intense Eau de Parfum plunges you into a captivating blue that’s ready to capsize everything. No more gentle waves! Wearing a black sailor shirt over his deep blue chest, the most daring of sailors tattoos his case with an eccentric wave from the Gaultier archives. He provokes its magnitude, chest bare and lavender at the stern, with a bravura bathed in benzoin. A limited edition with a lingering scent that makes this new wave legendary.

listings.rawTitle: L'OCCITANE Verbena Eau de Toilette, 75ml
listings.description: Our invigorating Verveine (Verbena) Eau de Toilette captures the bright, citrusy scent of the leaves, leaving you feeling refreshed, uplifted, and full of zest for life. Whether it’s a rainy day or the height of summer, this natural, energising fragrance gently awakens the senses and gives you an instant lift. Rediscover your iconic Verveine (Verbena) Eau de Toilette redesigned with a new, modern and minimalist look that reflects the cultural heritage of the Maison L'Occitane en Provence. How to use: For optimum diffusion, apply your eau de toilette on your pulse points, neck and wrists; these are particularly warm spots of the body. To perfume the clothes, spray at a distance of 10cm.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Tuxedo Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: The olfaction: Like a perfectly tailored tuxedo, this fragrance exudes an aura of effortless sophistication. YSL Beauty reimagines the classic chypre structure with a bold, contemporary edge, crafting a scent that is both elegant and unexpected. At its heart lies patchouli, its earthy, woody depths masterfully sculpted by perfumer Juliette Karagueuzoglou to create a sleek, unforgettable olfactory silhouette. A note that exudes a chic brand of toughness more traditionally associated with men. This iconic material was crafted in Grasse to enhance the most sensuous, sophisticated facets of its deep, dark woodiness. "This heart of patchouli forms the core of the fragrance, bringing verticality and style, two signature elements of the tuxedo," explains the perfumer, Juliette Karagueuzoglou. "Creating a fragrance with patchouli as the star ingredient is a true statement today." In this chypre ambery, the precious patchouli heart is masterfully cut and tailored by Juliette Karagueuzoglou to create a sharp, streamlined olfactory silhouette. Like a shiny satin lapel against a tuxedo’s matte grain de poudre fabric, the bright bite of black pepper and the fresh flash of coriander shed light on the dark material. A magnetic ambergris accord hints at the nude skin beneath the suit. The inspiration: Of all Monsieur Saint Laurent’s pieces, it is the most iconic. Introduced in his Autumn-Winter 1966 collection, the tuxedo reimagined a highly symbolic outfit of the masculine wardrobe: the smoking jacket, once worn to preserve gentlemen’s suits from the scent of cigars. Adapting its sharp tailoring to female silhouettes, Mr. Saint Laurent created the first evening pantsuit for women. While initially too avant-garde for his couture clientele, launched in the ready-to-wear SAINT LAURENT rive gauche line, it was a success with his younger clients. The couturier’s reimagining of the tuxedo may be his most empowering gift to women, revisited in each of his collections until 2002. This historically masculine garment perfectly incarnates the YSL style with its sharp tailoring, minimalist design, and effortless chicness. It wasn't about fussy embellishments or fleeting trends but about timeless elegance and confident simplicity. This eminent couture garment was not only a fashion statement but a cultural touchstone. An emblem of empowerment, androgyny and rebellion, that made it a synonym of the disruptive YSL spirit.

listings.rawTitle: Histoires de Parfums This Is Not A Blue Bottle 1/2 Eau de Parfum, 60ml
listings.description: This is the perfume of light. This is an explosion, a prism refracting the light into a splash of colours. A beam of Ivy, Lilac and Lily of the Valley illuminates a Sandalwood and White Musk Milky Way. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Ivy Leaves, Pink Pepper Heart notes: Lilac, Lilly of the Valley, Ylang-Ylang Base notes: Sandalwood, Vanilla, White Musk

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent	Libre Eau de Parfum 90ml Mother's Day Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: This Mother’s Day, YSL celebrates those who make you bloom. listings.rawTitle: Rabanne PHANTOM Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Discover Phantom Elixir: the most rock and roll masculine signature by Rabanne. Inspired by the exhilarating energy of a night out, Phantom Elixir is made for the rock and roll night owl, who lives by his own rhythm, and revels in the contrast between shadows and light. More intense than ever before, Phantom Elixir is a clash of a fresh marine accord, vibrant mineral oud, and warm vanilla, celebrating the duality of Rabanne masculinity. Inspired by Paris at night, where the shadows meet the light, the elegant bottle of Phantom Elixir comes in an intense glossy black-to-silver gradient to reflect the olfactive contrast inside. More daring, more seductive; it embodies the clash of freshness and warmth within for the rock and roll night owl who embraces the duality of masculinity.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Cedrus de Nuit Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Les Fleurs de Nuit by Chloé Atelier des Fleurs draws inspiration from the nights of the Rive Gauche, a timeless setting where creative effervescence meets Parisian audacity. True to the philosophy of the Maison Chloé and its founder Gaby Aghion, this collection offers a sensual portrait of iconic flowers that transform at nightfall. By day, they absorb the warmth and luminosity of the sun. By night, they fully bloom, revealing the richness and singularity of secret notes, voluptuous and narcotic, that emerge only in the shadow of night. With Atelier des Fleurs Cedrus de Nuit, perfumers Quentin Bisch and Louise Turner reinvent Cedrus by highlighting a flower both rare and ephemeral: the Queen of the Night, which sets ablaze the woody heart of the iconic perfume. Once a year, this white flower awakens and blooms in darkness, releasing a voluptuous aroma like a warm exhale in the cool night air. Through an unprecedented extraction process that faithfully captures the essence of a flower in its environment, its honeyed and subtly spiced scent is immortalised in all its intensity. Amplified by an amber base, then enhanced by a dark vanilla absolute and a resinous benzoin, the sensual intensity of the flower meets the enveloping warmth of woods. The Cedrus de Nuit bottle features a deep cobalt blue, evoking a midnight sky. Its undulated glass shape pays homage to the plissé soleil, the signature of Atelier des Fleurs fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Osmanthus Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Osmanthus is a sun-filled interpretation of the flower's deep and sensual notes. The intense and lively fragrance combines the richness of the osmanthus flower with green mandarin and neroli oil. An artistic combination that takes you to the rock forests of South East Asia where the elusive flower blooms with a rich and powerful fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Bloom into your true self with the new Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette. Inspiring a journey of self-discovery built on the empowering notion of connecting through difference, the floral fragrance for women stays true to the original Bloom signature. The newest addition to the Bloom bouquet is a lighter, more luminous interpretation of the Bloom signature that gently encourages women to Bloom into the truest version of themselves. Characterised by a trio of Jasmine, Tuberose and Rangoon Creeper, it is now enlightened by a sweetened Neroli accord. Just like the scent unfurls as its name suggests, Gucci Bloom women flourish in a natural, expressive and individual way, without conventional limitations. The perfume for her is presented in a frosted and luminous square-shaped pink glass bottle to bring freshness and vitality. The Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette for women celebrate the vitality and diversity of those who identify with the House’s modern philosophy.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Luce di Rosa Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Luce di Rosa is the sublimation of a contemporary and dynamic rose sculpted by light that counters mineral sharpness with a chiaroscuro effect, giving life to a multifaceted gender-neutral scent whose vibrant, clean, and bright notes are reminiscent of a symphony that alternates between piano and forte, adagio and vivace. Luce di Rosa, an embodiment of contrasts and dynamism, is a gender-neutral Signatures of the Sun fragrance that illuminates the essence of rose with the unexpected prism of vibrant sophistication. A fragrance sculpted by light that unfolds like a radiant glow, blending luminous citrus notes with warm undertones. The fragrance opens with an invigorating citrus blend, where Bergamot and Mandarin intertwine and is heightened by the spicy nuances of fresh Black Pepper and Pink Pepper CO2 extract, alongside the subtle accents of Cardamom Oil. At its heart, Luce di Rosa flourishes with the noble Bulgarian Rose Oil, the centrepiece of this olfactive masterpiece, extracted through steam-water distillation to capture the essence of the rose at its most vibrant, with a unique olfactory profile that is rosy, green, and spicy, with hints of honey. This dynamic rose is complemented by the verdant Geranium Oil, creating a floral and profoundly rich core. In the base, Luce di Rosa settles into a deep, grounding essence of Vetiver, Guaiac Wood, and Cedarwood, all enveloped by the soft, sensual embrace of Musk nuances, crafting a finale that unveils and reflects ever-different sensations over time.

Tobacco Vanille is opulent, warm and iconic. Reminiscent of an English Gentleman’s Club and blended with rich spices, vanilla and tobacco flower, it leaves a powerful impression.” TOM FORD.

Juniper berry essence layers over a heart of an addictive coconut gourmand accord. Anchored by a powerful base featuring spicy cardamom. With freshness and gourmand contrasts at the heart of this long-lasting and bold fragrance inspires the very essence of Eternity. Seductive. Sultry. Strong. Experience the essence of Eternity. listings.rawTitle: Chloé Rose Naturelle Eau de Parfum, Refillable, 100ml
listings.description: Chloé introduces Rose Naturelle Eau de Parfum, formulated with a 100% natural origin fragrance that combines luxury and nature in a perfume fragrance. Rose Naturelle is a fresh, floral and woody refillable Eau de Parfum for women with a vegan formulation and organic rose at its heart. Exuding the modern scent of organic rose, Rose Naturelle Eau de Parfum for women is an irresistibly floral perfume, connecting the strength and spontaneity of nature with that of the free-spirited Chloé girl. Effortlessly elegant, as well as authentic and aware, she lives in harmony with the natural environment she cherishes and that inspires her. This fresh and feminine scent is rooted in nature for wholesome luxury that resonates with the independent Chloé girl's lifestyle. Spritz on your wrists and neck to reveal a full expression of the graceful strength of nature. Our Eau de Pafum is formulated with 100% natural origin fragrance, alcohol and water. Nothing else. It is a vegan perfume and does not contain artificial colourants. Each gentle whisper of the emblematic and woody organic rose will remind you of a serene, natural setting that soothes and awakens the spirit. Our hand-picked rose is organically sourced, contributing to a more responsible and sustainable culture. It is the hero ingredient of this Eau de Parfum for women, opening the scent with an airy and feminine aura complemented by Moroccan neroli. Fresh and delicate cedrat essence mingles with green, sparkling blackcurrant for an assertive spirit, while base notes of cedar essence add a powerful woody facet. Sensual mimosa highlights the scent's round character and elevates the floral heart notes. Chloé now offers a new 100ml refillable bottle that can be refilled thanks to a new 150ml refill format without losing a single drop. Pursuing its initiatives towards a lower impact on the environment, recycled materials now represent 25% of the glass and 40% of the cardboard used for the box. Inspired by the Maison's iconic crêpe de chine blouse with a feminine neck tie, the timeless vintage-inspired bottle is adorned with a 100% recycled hand-tied ribbon in a new, natural shade of green. Refillable option only available on 100ml.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Absolue Les Parfums Hot As Rose Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: In this land where nature's grandeur lives untamed, we grow a rose like no other. Absolue Les Parfums, a radical collection dedicated to our rose, born in our domain. Our first-ever rose-dedicated haute-parfumerie collection composed of 11 scents unveils our exclusive centifolia rose like you've never smelled before. Reinventing perfumery's iconic ingredient. Hot As Rose Eau de Parfum with Patchouli and Aromatic Bouquet. The sun at its zenith, bursts through our rose’s petals sweetened by the fruit trees surrounding her by the buchu leaves. She is stunning and full of life. The essence of the rose is highlighted with juicy and fruity blackcurrant bud. She is strong yet sweet. Meet The Perfumer: Alexandra Monet & Alberto Morillas: "A radiant rose bathed in aromatics. For this creation, I imagined a floral composition built around two key ingredients: the queen of flowers, the Rose and an ensemble of aromatic notes: cypress, rosemary and thyme, like an ode to a lush garden."
